༄༅/ /kun mkhyen bsod nams seṅge'i rnam par thar pa dad pa rgya mtsho'i rlabs phreng rnam par g.yo ba zhes bya ba bzhugs/ /na mo gu ru pu ṇya singha ya/kun

tei:bibl.tei:idno: GuruLamaWorks/Precious-and-Rare-Disk-01-20130424/rtfs/4_AMAI/AMAI302_kun mkhyen bsod nams seṅge'i rnam par thar .rtf

tei:div.tei:p: ༄༅/ /kun mkhyen bsod nams seṅge'i rnam par thar pa dad pa rgya mtsho'i rlabs phreng rnam par g.yo ba zhes bya ba bzhugs// na mo gu ru pu ṇya singha ya/ kun mkhyen pa'i dbang po bsod nams seṅge'i rnam par thar pa dad pa rgya mtsho'i rlabs phreng rnam par g.yo ba zhes bya ba/ rje btsun ngag gi dbang phyug la phyag 'tshal lo/ /bsod nams ye shes tshogs gnyis mthar phyin pa'i/ /bcom ldan shākya seṅge'i bstan pa nyid/ /'phel zhing rgyas par mdzad pa'i 'phrin las can/ /kun mkhyen chos kyi rgyal po'i zhabs la 'dud/ /ces mchod par brjod nas/ 'dir khams gsum 'gro ba'i bla ma/ dus gsum sangs rgyas thams cad 'dus pa'i ngo bo/ srid pa gsum gyi 'dren mchog dam pa rtsod dus kyi rdo rje 'chang chen po/ snyigs dus kyi 'jam pa'i dbyangs dpal sa skya pa chen po grags pa rgyal mtshan nyid rje btsun sa skya pa'i ring lugs phyogs brgyar spel ba la bsam bzhin du sku'i skye ba bzhes pa/ mdo sngags bstan pa'i bdag po go ram bstan pa'i nyi ma kun mkhyen bsod nams seṅge zhes mtshan nyi zla ltar grags pa de'i ngo mtshar ba'i rnam par thar pa'i cha rnams rje de nyid kyi sku dngos kyi slob ma'i mchog tu gyur pa rnams kyi rang rang gi skal ba dang 'tshams par rnam thar spel bar mdzad pa las/ 'dir de dag gi don rags rims rnams 'thor ba bsdus pa'i tshul gyi phyogs gcig tu bsdebs ste lung rgyun mi chad pa'i phyir bri bar bya'o/ /de la don bdun te/ 'jam dbyangs sangs rgyas rin chen gyi mdzad pa'i rnam thar nas 'byung tshul bshad pa/ glo bo mkhan chen bsod nams lhun grub legs pa'i 'byung gnas rgyal mtshan dpal bzang pos mdzad pa'i rnam thar las 'byung tshul bshad pa/ rā ston yon tan 'byung gnas kyi mdzad pa'i rnam thar rtsa ba bsdus pa'i rnam thar bshad pa byin rlabs rgya mtsho las 'byung tshul bshad pa/ rje de nyid kyi yig mkhan a'u gzhon nu bzang pos mdzad pa'i rnam thar las 'byung tshul bshad pa/

dga' gdong pa rin chen dpal bzang gi mdzad pa'i rnam thar ngo mtshar dgos 'dod kun 'byung nas 'byung tshul bshad pa/ gsang phu ba don grub legs bzang gi mdzad pa'i rnam thar las 'byung tshul bshad pa/ bya btang kun dga' mchog ldan gyi mdzad pa'i rnam thar bstod tshig byin brlabs kyi 'dod 'jo dad pa bskyed byed las 'byung tshul bshad pa'o/ rnam thar 'di rnams kyi thog mtha' bar gsum gyi brjod don 'dra ba rnams dor nas/ rnam bzhag mi 'dra ba rnams phyogs gcig tu bsdus na glegs bam bzhugs chung bar 'gyur bar snang yang / kun mkhyen chen po'i dngos kyi slob ma brgyud pa dang bcas pa de dag la bdag cig tu dad pas na/ skyes chen dam pa de dag gi gsung gi 'phrin las mi nyams pa'i phyir rnam thar so so'i thog ma'i mchod brjod dang / mjug gi sbyar byang rnams bzhag pa'i gzhan rnam thar so so'i lus yongs rdzogs bris pa yin pas blo gsal dpyod ldan rnams kyi dgongs par mdzad 'tshal/ dang po ni/ rje btsun 'jam pa'i dbyangs rgyal ba mus pa chen po sangs rgyas rin chen gyis mdzad pa'i rnam par thar pa las 'di ltar 'byung ste/ 'dir bdag cag rnams kyi 'dren pa dam pa chos kyi rgyal po rin po che kun mkhyen go bo rab 'byams pa bsod nams seṅge zhes mtshan yongs su grags pa de nyid nges pa'i don du bskal pa dpag tu med pa'i sngon rol du tshogs gnyis rdzogs nas 'bras bu mngon du byas zin pa yin kyang / zhing 'dir gdul bya'i don du skye ba bzhes pa'i rnam thar cung zad tsam brjod na/ 'jam bu gling gi sa'i cha/ bod kha ba can gyi rigs mdo khams 'bom gyi yul du sa mo bya'i lo yab zhang skyabs dang / yum rgyal ba sman gnyis kyi sras su 'khrungs pa'i mtshan mi nyag dpal zhes btags/ skyes bu dam pa 'di nyid byis pa'i spyod pa las 'das pa/ dam pa chos kyi rigs sad pas dgung lo lnga drug bzhes pa'i dus su chab klog la sogs pa brda bstan pa tsam gyi mkhyen cing /

sgo gsum gyi rnam 'gyur thams cad thugs dang mthun par mdzad pas skye bo thams cad kha mthun par skyes bu dam pa gcig yong bar bsgrag go /dgung lo brgyad bzhes pa na/ mkhan po bsod nams 'od zer dang / slob dpon kun dga' 'bum pa las rab tu byung ste/ mtshan bsod nams seṅge zhes gsol/ mkhan slob gnyis la dge tshul gyi bslab bya rags rims kyang gsan/ de nas go bo rab 'byams pa shes rab dpal ba'i drung du mjal bas/ re zhig 'dir bsdod la slob gnyer gyis gsungs nas/ ka chen bzhi/ dbu ma rtsa 'jug la sogs pa'i gzhung rab tu mang po bzung / rong ṭīka gi bshad lung gnang / thugs la bzang bas shin tu dges nas nga rang dang 'dra ba cig 'ong ba 'dug go bo rab 'byams pa zhes mtshan gsol/ gzhan yang dbang rjes gnang / sems bskyed la sogs pa mang du gsan/ skabs cig tu/ 'jam dbyangs kyi bsnyen pa mdzad pas/ mnal lam du ral gri gcig phyag tu byung pa ral gri shub nas phyung pa nam mkha' la 'phyar bas/ dbus gtsang khams gsum thams cad khyab pa'i snang ba byung ba/ shes rab dpal ba la zhus pas 'phrin las bsam gyis mi khyab pa 'byung ba'i rtags yin gsungs/ gzhan yang bka' bcu pa sbyin bzang pa zhes bya ba la chos kyi rnam grangs 'ga' zhig dang / bla ma rgyal mtshan 'od zer las kyai rdo rje'i dbang bskur dang / ra sa mdo'i chos rje rin blo ba la grub thob brgyad cu'i rjes gnang la sogs pa'i chos bskor 'ga' zhig gsan/ de nas dgung lo nyi shu bzhes pa'i dus go bo rab 'byams pa shes rab dpal bas/ da khyod dbus gtsang la 'gro dgos gsungs nas gnang sbyin rdzong ltar/ rong ston thams cad mkhyen pa'i drung du zhu zhig 'bul ba brgya tshan mang po'i/ grwa pa brgya'i dod la rje nyid la bstod bkur bsngags pa dang bcas byon pas/ 'brug lo dpal na lend+rar phyags phebs/ rong ston chos rje'i drung du mjal bas shin tu dgyes te/

rje btsun mi g.yo ba'i rjes gnang mdzad dus/ mi g.yo ba ni khams pa brgya'i dod po la thim song gsungs/ mi g.yo bas rjes su 'dzin pa'i lung bstan kyang mdzad/ dbyar chos de'i chos khri'i steng nas gsungs pa'i chos thams cad gsan gsungs/ de nas gling smad shes rab dpal ba'i drung du mtshan brjod kyi lung / chos rgyal ma'i 'don thabs thun mong ma yin pa'i lung dang bcas pa gsan/ de nas rje nyid kyi dgongs pa la gzhung lugs rab 'byams nyan chog pa'i bshes gnyen gcig bsten nas slob gnyer mthar phyin par bya dgos la/ rong stong chos rje ni mi bzhugs/ gzhan su drag snyam pa las/ sngar rong ston chos rje'i zhal nas/ nged rang gi grwa pa byams chen rab 'byams pas kha rag bon drug tu 'brug lo bshad nyan 'brug ltar btsugs nas yod/ der slob gnyer byed dgos gsungs ba la rten nas/ sbrul lo dgung lo nyer gcig pa la 'bras yul skyid mos tshal du yongs rdzogs bstan pa'i mnga' bdag kun mkhyen chos kyi rgyal po sangs rgyas 'phel ba'i drung du byon nas/ byams pa'i chos lnga rang rang gi 'grel pa dang bcas pa/ tshadma mdo/ rnam 'grel/ rig gter/ gtan tshigs thigs pa la sogs pa rang rang gi 'grel pa dang bcas pa/ 'dul ba la so sor thar pa'i mdo/ mdo rtsa/ rgya cher 'grel/ me tog phreng rgyud la sogs pa dang / mngon pa kun las btus/ mdzod 'grel pa dang bcas pa la sogs du ma dang / dbu ma la rtsa 'jug bzhi gsum/ rigs tshogs/ gtam tshogs/ bstod tshogs la sogs pa du ma dang / gzhan yang spyod 'jug 'jam bsdud bzang gsum la sogs pa'i bshad lung du ma gsan cing / thos pa de dag kyang ming tsam ma yin par thos byung gi blo las blangs/ bsam byung gi mi brjed par bzung / bsgom byung gi tshul bzhin du yid la byas te thos bsam mthar phyin par mdzad pas tshogs pa thams cad ngo mtshar te/ 'di ni don gyi rab 'byams par 'dug zhes grags pa dang /

kun mkhyen chos kyi rgyal pos kyang / khams pa mgo bo che shes rab che zhes bstod bkur bsngags gsum yang yang mdzad de/ thugs dges pa chen pos rjes su bzung ba yin cing / bstan pa'i sbyin bdag chen po drung chen nor bzang pa la bdag gi grwa slob khams pa shes rab can cig yod pa 'di/ ma 'ongs pa na bstan pa la phan pa'i dge bshes gcig yong du re ba yin pas 'di la mthun rkyen sku drin gyis skyong dgos zhus pas/ dpon sa nas kyang zhal gyi bzhes te/ ra lnga gnyer chen ra lod rdo rje la/ khyed kyi go bo rab 'byams pa'i chas gos kyi mthun rkyen rel ma shor ba gyis zhes bka' lung gnang nas/ khong gis kyang zhabs tog tshul bzhin du bsgrub ste/ phyis su'ang na bza' la sogs pa rgyun mar 'bul bar 'dug go /dgung lo nyer lnga bzhes pa'i dus chos rje dge ba rgyal mtshan pa'i drung du rta mgrin lcags ral can la sogs pa'i chos bskor 'ga' zhig zhus so/ /de nas lo de nyid kyi ston rgyud gsum man ngag dang bcas pa la thugs gnyer 'dun pa drag po dang / rje rdo rje 'chang yab sras la mi phyed pa'i dad pa drag pos thugs rgyud bskul te/ dpal e waṃ chos ldan du phebs/ rdo rje 'chang chen po'i drung du thog mar dpal kye rdo rje 'grel pa lugs dang / sambu ṭi rdor dbyings kyi dbang gsan/ rjes gnang gi dus dung bskyar nas bus gsungs lan gsum bus pas skad che bar byung / grags pa dang mthun par bstan pa la phan thogs yong bar 'dug gsungs/ de nas rje rin po che'i drung du gsung ngag rin po che tshar gnyis la sogs pa'i zab pa dang rgya che ba'i dbang / byin rlabs/ rjes gnang / rgyud/ rgya gzhung gi bshad pa/ gzhan yang lung la sogs pa mang du gsan/ de nas dgung lo nyi shu rtsa drug pa shing pho khyi'i lo la rje rdo rje 'chang kun dga' bzang pos mkhan po/ sems dpa' chen po dkon mchog rgyal mtshan dang /

mkhan chen kha 'phyar bas las gsang slob dpon mdzad de/ kha skong gi dge 'dun dang bcas pa'i dbus su bsnyen par rdzogs pa dang dge slong gi sdom pa rnam par dag pa nos te/ nyes ltung phra mo tshun chad kyis kyang ma gos pa mdzad pa yin no/ /de nas rje sems dpa' chen po'i drung du lam 'bras kyi khrid tshar lnga/ de'i skabs su brgyud pa gnyis nas 'byung ba'i sems bskyed kyi cho ga rgyu lam gyi dbang / bdag med ma'i dbang / byin rlabs/ khrid/ gzhung bshad la sogs pa glegs bam dkar chag tu theb pa rnams dang / gzhan yang gzhung bshad sras don ma/ dmar ma/ pod nag ma dang bcas pa dang / rnal 'byor dbang phyug gi rje sa chen la dngos su gnang ba'i lcags ri khong mi 'da' ba'i zab chos bzhi la sogs pa/ pod dmar ma rje rdo rje 'chang gi dkar chag tu theb pa'i nang bzhin gyi byin rlabs khrid/ lung dang bcas pa thams cad dang / gzhan yang bla ma'i rnam thar thor bu ba rnams dang / bla ma spyi'i rnam thar ngo mtshar snang ba/ zhib mo rdo rje dang bcas pa/ bar ston gyi zin bris la sogs pa ste lam 'bras bu dang bcas pa'i gdams ngag thams cad bsgrub pa lung sbyin gyi bar du tshang bar gsan/ gzhan yang lam bskor phyi ma brgyad kyang gsan/ gzhan yang kyai rdo rje 'grel pa lugs kyi dbang / mtsho skyes lugs kyi dbang / rtsa rgyud brtag pa gnyis pa/ 'grel pa dang ldan dang bcas pa/ thun mong ma yin pa'i bshad rgyud rdo rje gur/ 'grel pa gur rgyan dang bcas pa/ thun mong gi bshad rgyud sambu ṭi/ 'grel pa gnad kyi gsal byed dang bcas pa rdzogs par gsan/ de rnams kyi sngon du 'gro ba rgyud sde spyi rnam dang / mngon rtogs ljon shing rnams kyang gsan/ kyai rdo rje'i bka' babs bzhi dang 'brel ba'i rgya gzhung / bod gzhung rnams tshang ma gsan/ bde mchog lū nag dril gsum gi dbang / nā ro mkha' spyod kyi byin rlabs/ de dag gi bskyed rims kyi bshad pa/

rdzogs rims nag po rims bzhi dang / rtsa dbu ma/ dril bu rims lnga/ bde mchog dkar po'i byin rlabs khrid dang bcas pa gsan/ rtsa rgyud/ 'grel pa mu tig phreng ba dang bcas pa/ kun spyod rje btsun gyi 'grel pa dang bcas pa la sogs pa dang / de dang 'brel ba'i 'khor lo bde mchog gi rgya gzhung / bod gzhung rnams tshang ma gsan/ bde mchog snyan brgyud kyang gsan/ gshed dmar lha lnga'i dbang / rdzogs rims shin tu spros med/ glo bo lo tsā bas khrid yig thor bu ba dang bcas pa/ spros med mdzes rgyan/ birwa pas mdzad pa'i rgya gzhung rnams dang bcas pa tshang bar gsan/ gzhan yang 'jigs byed sa lugs kyi dbang / sgrol ma bla med ma'i dbang rnams kyang gsan/ gsang 'dus mi bskyod pa'i dbang / de'i bskyed rims kyi bshad pa/ rdzogs rims rim lnga'i khrid/ rtsa rgyud kyi bshad pa 'grel pa sgron gsal/ mtha' drug rab gsal dang bcas pa dang / klu sgrub yab sras kyis mdzad pa'i rgya gzhung / 'gos kyi shog ril gsum/ 'gos kyi stong thun chen mo rnams kyang gsan/ gzhan yang kun rig 'chi 'joms/ tshe dpag med rnams kyi dbang sbyong rgyud kyi bshad pa dang bcas pa gsan/ gzhan yang mgon po'i rjes gnang thung ba dang / thun mong ma yin pa dang / sgrub thabs brgya rtsa/ rnam rgyal 'joms/ a ra pa tsa na/ don zhags dang bcas pa'i rjes gnang / skyer sgang pa nas brgyud pa'i thugs rje chen po'i rigs gtad rnams gsan/ gzhan yang rgyud 'bum/ 'dul ba lung / so thar/ rje btsun gong ma lnga'i bka' 'bum/ rgyal sras bka' 'bum/ sems dpa' chen po nyid kyi bka' 'bum rnams kyi lung tshang ma gsan/ gzhan yang dbu ma lugs kyi sems bskyed/ jo bo rje nas brgyud pa'i blo sbyong gi bskor tshang ma/ do pa nas brgyud pa'i gcod bskor gsum tshang ma/ bka' gdams gzhung drug rje rong chen gyi mdzad pa'i phar phyin gyi khrid yig rnams kyang gsan/ mkhan chen kha 'phyar ba bsod nams rgyal mtshan pa'i drung du/

gur rigs bsdus kyi dbang / rta mgrin lcags ral can dang / u tsa'i rjes gnang gsan/ bdag chen zha lu ba dang / chu mig pa'i drung du chos skyong gi rjes gnang gsan/ chos rje kun dga' dbang phyug pa'i drung du/ kyai rdor man ngag lugs kyi dbang / nag po lugs kyi he ru ka bzhi'i dbang / gsang 'dus 'jam pa'i rdo rje'i dbang / gsang 'dus spyan ras gzigs kyi dbang / don zhags gtso rkyang gi rjes gnang / bcu gcig zhal gyi rjes gnang / mi g.yo ba sngon po'i rjes gnang chu bsrung dang bcas pa/ mgon po gdong bzhi pa'i rjes gnang / ga ya dha ra nas brgyud pa'i mgon po dpa' gcig gi rjes gnang rnams gsan/ chos rje gung ru shes rab bzang po'i drung du mkha' 'gro rgya mtsho'i dbang / tshogs bdag gi rjes gnang / sdom gsum rab dbye'i bshad pa la sogs pa gsan pa'i rnam grangs 'di dag kyang rags pa tsam yin gyi/ 'di dag tu ma thob pa'i chos rnams gsan pa yang bsam gyi mi khyab par shes par bya'o/ /de ltar thos pa mthar phyin nas/ nyams len bsgrub pa mdzad pa'i tshul ni/ 'bras yul skyed mos tshal du kyai rdo rje'i gzhi bsnyen yongs su rdzogs pa mdzad pa dang / dben gnas bsam gtan phug tu lo gcig gi bar du bzhugs nas gshed dmar la sogs pa'i yi dam gyi bsnyen pa dang / kyai rdo rje rgyud gsum man ngag dang bcas pa la gzigs rtogs mthar phyin par mdzad pa dang / byams chen gser kha sding du bde mchog gi bsnyen pa dang / bla ma rin 'byung gi bsgrub pa mtshan ma brnyes pa'i bar du mdzad pa dang / bshad nyan la sogs pa mdzad pa'i bar skabs rnams su yang gshed dmar gyi bsnyen pa sbyin sreg dang bcas pa/ kyai rdo rje'i bsnyen pa kha gso sbyin sreg dang bcas pa dang / bla ma rin 'byung gi bsgrub pa dang / mgon po'i bsnyen pa la sogs pa yang nas yang du mdzad par gnang la/ khyad par dpal ldan sa skya pa'i nyams len gyi gtso bo chag med bzhi/

bde mchog dril bu pa/ gshed dmar lha lnga/ mgon po'i bsrung 'khor la sogs pa yi dam mang po'i bsgom bzlas thun bzhi dang / gsum dang / gnyis la sogs pa'i sgo nas bar ma chad par mdzad la/ yi dam chos skyong gi gtor bsgrub bskang gso la yang shin tu brtson par mdzad do/ /de dag la rten nas bla ma yi dam gyi byin gyis rlabs shing lung bstan pa dang / mkha' 'gro chos skyong gi 'phrin las bsgrub pa'i tshul ni/ go bo rab 'byams pa shes rab dpal bas/ nga dang 'dra ba'i mkhas pa gcig yongs ba'i rten 'brel 'dug gsungs pa dang / 'jam dbyangs kyi bsnyen pa mdzad pa'i skabs su ral gri nam mkha' la 'phyar bas dbus gtsang khams gsum khyab pa'i snang ba byung ba/ 'jam pa'i dbyangs kyi rjes su bzung ba'i mtshan mar 'dug pa dang / rong ston thams cad mkhyen pas mi g.yo ba'i rjes gnang mdzad pas mi g.yo ba khams pa 'di la thim song gsungs pa rje btsun mi g.yo bas byin gyis brlabs pa yin pa dang / rong chung gi lam 'phrang la po ti gcig bsnams nas byon pas/ gad pa chad nas rje nyid gtsang po'i nang du lhung nas chu'i 'khor la thogs pas/ sa skya paṇḍi ta spyi bor bsgom nas chos rgyal ma nyi shu rtsa bzhi 'thon pa'i bar bzhugs pa la/ lam la 'grul pas rig nas bde bar bton pa lta bu sa skya paṇḍi ta'i byin rlabs zhugs nges su 'dug pa dang / rdo rje 'chang kun dga' bzang pos dbang bskur gyi rjes gnang gi skabs su grags pa chen po yong bar lung bstan pa dang / sang nyin de'i drung du ku ru kulle'i rjes gnang gsan pa'i do nub rje rang nyid kyi mnal lam du bud med gos chen dmar smug gyon pa cig gi shing tog rlon pa thu ba gang gtad nas 'di zo zer ba dang / rnga dmar po gcig gtad nas brdungs gsungs pa mkha' 'gros byin gyis brlabs par 'dug pa dang / 'bras yul du bzhugs dus snyung gzhi drag po cig yod pa la/

sngags 'chang chen po rin chen rnam rgyal ba'i mnal lam du rgyal po cig gi bar chad yin par 'dug ste/ de la dmigs pa'i thugs dam mdzod zhus pa la rten pa'i stong len byang chub kyi sems dang / lta ba 'khor 'das dbyer med zla phyed tsam bsgom pa'i mnal lam du rje sems dpa' chen po'i kyai rdo rje'i bum dbang yan rdzogs par bskur nas lus kyi dri ma dag zhes gsungs pa'i skabs su mnal gsad/ de nas sku lus snyung gzhi las grol ba dang / gling dga' bde ba can du rje sems dpa' chen pos gzhung bshad dmar ma sang nyin gsungs pa'i do nub rje rang gi sku lus la snyung zug bzod klag med pa cig byung ba/ rje sems dpa' chen po mkhyen snyam du gzim pa'i mnal lam du rje sems dpa' chen po phebs nas/ sku lus la ljags mchin btab pas mnal gsad pa dang / snyung zug sprin dengs pa bzhin du song ba byung ba dang / nub cig mnal lam na ne gseng gi thog na grwa pa mang po chos khri cig brtsig gi 'dug pa sus yin dris pas/ rje mus pa chen po sbyongs rgyud gsungs pa'i khri yin zer/ bla mas kyang las rogs mdzad pas/ mus chen khri thog tu phebs nas zhal phod mang po dang bcas nas sbyongs rgyud gsungs pas/ legs par gsan pas tshig rigs shog lde gcig thugs la bzung ba ji lta ba bzhin/ kun rig rtsod spongs du 'dri bar mdzad pa dang / rje sems dpa' chen po'i drung du khams la 'byon pa'i brtag pa zhus pas/ brtag pa mi dgos khams la phyin pas longs spyod cung zad yong kyang tshe ring po mi yong shing 'gro phan kyang chung / dbus gtsang du bsdad na tshe yang cung ring zhing / 'gro phan rgya chen po yong gsungs pa dang / bshad nyan 'dzugs su 'byon khar byin rlabs bka' bsgo zhus pas zhabs spyi thog tu bzhag bla ma brgyud pa'i byin rlabs dang / /chos skyong gi bka' bsgo yang dag pa mdzad/ bdud rtsi ril bu brgya rdo gcig gi thog drangs brgya phrag gcig gi gnang sbyin dang bcas pa'i sgo nas/

rje sems dpa' chen po dkon mchog rgyal mtshan gyi rjes su bzung zhing byin gyi brlabs nas bstan pa'i bdag por mnga' gsol ba yin no/ /chos kyi rje kun dga' dbang phyug pa mnga' ris la phebs dus/ rta nag ri khud nas chu kha'i bar skyel ma mdzad/ 'gro mgon 'phags pa'i bdud rtsi ril bu gcig gnang nas dgon gnas pha gi la yang spyan rgyang gzigs shig ces ma 'ong pa na khri thog tu 'byon pa'i rten 'brel mdzad pa dang rgyu dus kyi dbang cig bskur ba'i mnal lam du/ mi cig gi khyed gzhan don rgya che ba'i rten 'brel byed pa yin zer nas/ rje btsun grags pa'i bum chu yin zer ba cig sku la bran byung bas/ tshe dpag med kyi gzugs su gyur pa'i snang ba byung gsungs ba la sogs pa dngos dang mtshan ma'i sgo nas bla ma yi dam gyi byin gyis brlabs shing / lung bstan yang bsam gyi mi khyab pa mnga' ba yin no/ /chos skyong ba'i bsrung ma rnams kyi 'phrin las bsgrub pa'i tshul yang / rta nag gser gling du bzhugs pa'i nub cig chos khrims pas zhal lta cig zhu ru phyin pas/ khyod yong pa sngas byung / mi nag po dung long btags pa pu tra yin nam snyam pa cig dngos su byung nas lab lab 'ga' byed grab yod pas da yal song gsungs ba dang / kha'ur gtor bsgrub bskang gso cig mdzad pa'i tshe/ gdong bzhi pa'i gtor ma'i ba dan de nyid rje'i phyogs su mgo dud nas 'dug pa dang / thub bstan du bzhugs pa'i dus nub cig mnal lam du mon pa phru gu gnyis skyed lhas kyi brag phug yin snyam pa cig na 'dug pa/ sku 'khor la yod pa 'dra la 'di tshe gdong bzhi pa'i sprul pa bram ze'i gzugs can yin tshod du 'dug gsungs pas/ mon pa gnyis po de mgo gug gug kha 'dzum 'dzum byed/ 'o na khyed ye shes kyi mgon po yin pas mngon shes la thogs pa med tsa na/ tshe mjug la bsgrub pa rtse gcig byas pa dga' 'am/

bshad pa byas na dga' gsungs pas/ de gnyis bsgrub pa bsgrub pa zhes brjod nas mgo ril ril/ kha 'dzum 'dzum song ba rmis gsungs/ tshad ma'i spyi don brtsams pa'i tshe mnal lam du/ bla ma blo rin pa dang gnyis kyi bstod pa mi rtog ma la dbyangs dang bcas 'then pas/ lung pa'i phu nas rol mo dang 'od zer gyi tshogs du ma dang / dmag dpung du ma yong ba'i snang ba byung / ci yin dris pas/ dpal mgon gdong bzhi pa'i da dung gi tshogs yin zer/ bltas pas zhabs kyi pus mo man chad kyi dpang la thog gsum rtsi 'dug 'khor rnams go cha'i 'od lhag lhag lham gyi 'bur rnams ni khrom khrom 'dug khyod kyi bstan bcos 'di'i bdag po nged tshos byed do gsungs ba byung ba dang / kun mkhyen nam bsod chen po'i mnal lam du/ sa skya'i gur mgon phur mo chos rdzong du goms pa cig bzhag nas brag sba ba la sgar rgyab byung ci yin dgongs pas/ phyid mo rje 'di nyid kyi rta nag gser gling du grwa tshang btsugs pa de la lta bar 'dug pas/ sa skya pa'i bstan pa dar bar yong ba 'dug gsungs pa dang / skabs skabs su bar chad kyi rnam pa cung zad byung pa la/ chos skyong gi bskang gso gtor bsgrub zhag sbrel tsam re mdzad pas bar chad las grol ba mngon sum gyi grub pas so/ /de nas gzhan don 'phrin las mdzad pa'i tshul ni/ rje 'di nyid dgung lo sum cu so gnyis bzhes pas 'brug lo shar ba dang / gcen po ye shes rgyal mtshan pas bskul nas khams phyogs la thegs pa'i lugs su 'bras yul skyed mos tshal du phebs nas kun chos kyi rgyal po la zhus pas grol cha ma gnang / bskyar nas nan zhus 'phul bas/ nged rang gi zhu sa rje sems dpa' chen po yin pas zhu ru song gsungs byung / ye shes rgyal mtshan pas sems dpa' chen po'i drung du phyin nas zhus pas/ gong ltar dbus gtsang du bsdad na 'gro phan rgya che ba'i zhal lta byung /

de nas khams la mi 'byon pa'i thugs thag bcad/ skyed mos tshal du bzhugs nas mdo phyogs kyi bshad nyan cis phyin pa mdzad pa'i ngang nas/ kun mkhyen sangs rgyas 'phel ba'i zhal lta la/ ngas mus su sems dpa' chen po'i drung du chos 'phro rnams zhu ru 'gro la/ de'i ring la nga'i tshab go bo rab 'byams pas gyis la chos shod/ grwa pa rnams kyis kyang phyag 'bul gyis gsungs/ gzhan yang bslab bya dgos pa tsho zhib rgyas su mdzad nas mus su thegs/ rje nyid kyis kyang zhal lta'i lugs bzhin phar tshad 'dul mngon la sogs pa'i sde snod kyi chos bsam gyi mi khyab pa dang / bcom ldan 'das gshin rje gshed dmar po lha lnga'i dkyil 'khor du dbang bskur ba la sogs pa gsang sngags kyi chos bsam gyi mi khyab pa dang bcas pa'i sgo nas gdul bya rnams yid tshim par mdzad/ de nas kun mkhyen sangs rgyas 'phel mus nas skyed mos tshal du phebs 'phral/ rje nyid dgung lo sum cu so bdun pa bya lo la mus su rje sems dpa' chen po'i drung du phebs/ de'i lo byams chen chos rje bsod nams chos kyi kun dga' bkris yang mus su phebs dpon slob rnams kyi rje sems dpa' chen po'i drung du gsung ngag la sogs pa'i zab pa dang rgya che ba'i chos mang po gsan/ rje nyid kyang khams tshang gi grwa pa mang po la sa skya bka' 'bum la sogs pa chos kyi rnam grangs mtha' yas pa gsungs/ de dag gi skabs su byams chen chos rje dang bshad nyan 'dzugs pa'i gleng bgros yang yang byung pa/ sang nyin rje sems dpa' chen po'i drung du bka' bgros zhu bar thag bcad pa'i/ de nub byams chen chos rje'i mnal lam du chos khri chen po gcig brtsig gin 'dug pa sus yin dris pas/ rje btsun grags pa rgyal mtshan gyi yin zer ba rmis/ sang dpon slob gsum zhal 'dzoms dus/ byams chen chos rje'i rmi lam rmis tshul dang / bshad nyan gyi bdag rkyen byed pa'i zhal lta zhus pas/

rje btsun sems dpa' chen po thugs dges te rten 'brel bzang gsungs/ bshad nyan 'dzugs pa la thag bcad/ byams chen chos rje shar phyogs la thegs/ ston zla ba gnyis tsam rje sems dpa' chen pos bsam gtan phug tu sku 'tshams mdzad/ sku 'tshams grol khar rje 'di nyid kyi zhus nas 'jigs byed sa lugs kyi dbang / rje nyid dang grub pa'i dbang phyug dkon mchog blo gros sku mched pa'i thog drangs bdag cag dpon slob nyi shu rtsa gcig gis thob/ der rjes khyi lo ston rje sems dpa' chen po ngam ring chos sdes gdan drangs/ tshogs pa brgyad brgya tsam la gsung ngag lam 'bras la sogs pa dang / blo sbyongs la sogs pa'i chos 'khor rgya chen po bskor bar mdzad/ rje nyid kyis kyang sems dpa' chen po'i phyag phyir byon nas ngam ring chos sde'i slob dpon rnams kyi thog drangs/ khams gtsang gi grwa pa mang po dang bcas pa la rgyud gsum gyi bshad pa dpyis phyin par gnang / der rjes khyi lo'i dbyar bshad nyan 'dzugs pa'i bka' bgros la rten pa'i rje nyid kyi byams chen chos rje'i drung du byon/ gser kha sdings su sku 'tshams zla ba gcig gnyis mdzad/ ston byams chen chos rje dang dpon slob rnams kyi bshad nyan 'dzugs pa'i phyir bsam 'grub rtser phebs/ gser gling du byon pa'i lam khar gaṇḍi khur nas 'tshong pa yin zer mi cig dang thug rten 'brel shin tu bzang gsungs/ gaṇḍi de nyan thos nas yar bsnams pa yin no/ /de nas gser gling du phebs te me pho khyi lo rgyal gyi zla ba la slob gnyer ba bzhi bcu tsam dang bcas te dpon slob rnams kyi gra tshangs btsugs te bstan pa rgyas pa'i rtsa ba tshugs pa yin no/ /de thad du byams chen chos rjes nas khal stong ra ma la sogs pa'i bdag rkyen gnang ba dang / nang so gtsang chen don grub rdo rje bas/ rje dpon slob gang bzhugs rnams kyi gsol chas rgyun ma dang /

byin la yang dbyar phogs dgun phogs kyi rgyun 'dzugs par mdzad/ dpon drung g.yung pa tshe dbang bkra shis pas kyang mdo khar nas phogs rgyun ma 'bul bar mdzad do/ /de nas dpon slob rnams bshad nyan mdzad pa'i tshul la/ rje nyid kyi mdzad pa'i bca' yig tu/ rang re'i 'chad nyan brda chad 'di rje btsun rdo rje 'chang kun dga' bzang po'i zhal snga nas sde snod kyi bshad nyan la thugs shin tu dges par yod pa blo la bzhag sems dpa' chen po mus pa'i zhal snga nas mdo sngags kyi bshad nyan rkang tshugs gyis zhes dngos su bka' lung gnang ba la rten/ chos rje bsod nams chos kyi kun dga' bkra shis rgyal mtshan dpal bzang pos bdag rkyen sbyar te/ me pho khyi lo skar ma rgyal gyi nya ba'i tshes bco lnga la rta nag gser gling gi dgon pa btsugs pa 'di/ spyir sangs rgyas kyi bstan pa dar ba'i phyir dang / khyad par grub mtha' bzang po'i gnad mi nub pa bya ba'i phyir dang / rang nyid kyang gsung rab kyi tshig don la goms pa lhur len pa'i ched du yin gyi/ de las gzhan pa'i kun slong gi gtso bo mi dge ba dang / lung ma bstan gyi bsam pa med/ de'i rgyu mtshan yang sngon chad lo brgyad song ba'i bar du yang chos mthun gyi bshad nyan gong 'phel du song ba 'dis kyang shes par nus/ de nas bzung ste ji srid bshad nyan 'di'i rgyun gnas kyi bar du 'dir bzhugs pa'i dge 'dun rnams kyi mdzad spyod kyi tshul mdo tsam bkod na/ spyir byin rlabs kyi bka' babs/ don dam gyi lta ba/ kun rdzob kyi grub mtha'/ gsung rab kyi 'grel tshul/ bshad bsgrub kyi phyag len thams cad gangs can bstan pa'i bdag po rje btsun sa skya pa yab sras kyi bka' srol gyi rjes su 'brangs dgos/ khyad par sde snod kyi bshad nyan brtson pas bsgrub pa dang / de'i phyag len gyi tshul rnams mkhas pa'i dbang po g.yag rong rnam gnyis/ mkhyen rab dbang phyug grags pa bzang po/

de'i sras kyi mthu bo bdag gi bla ma smra ba'i dbang po sangs rgyas 'phel gyi ji ltar mdzad pa'i phyag len la rten dgos gsungs pa dang mthun par/ rje rang nyid bla ma gong ma nas brgyud pa'i bskyed rdzogs kyi nyams len zab mo rnal 'byor dgu'i tshul dang mthun par mdzad pa'i ngang nas sde snod kyi gzhung 'chad pa'i rnam grangs la/ yon tan rin po che'i bsdud pa'i tshigs su bcad pa/ mngon par rtogs pa'i rgyan/ 'grel pa don gsal la sogs pa byams chos lnga/ mngon pa gong 'og dbu ma rtsa shes/ 'jug pa/ bzhi brgya pa/ spyod 'jug 'dul ba mdo rtsa/ tshad ma rnam 'grel/ rig gter/ sdom gsum rab dbye la sogs pa rnams kyi ṭīkka/ spyi don dka' 'grel la sogs pa'i sgo nas brdar sha chod par gsungs/ sngags kyi rgyud man ngag dbang bskur la sogs pa gsungs pa'i rnam grangs ni/ rtsa rgyud brtag pa gnyis pa dag ldan dang bcas pa/ gur gur rgyan dang bcas pa/ sambu ṭi gnad kyi gsal byed kyi dang bcas pa/ bde mchog rtsa rgyud mu tig phreng ba'i steng nas/ kun spyod rje btsun gyi ṭīkka'i steng nas/ gsang 'dus rtsa rgyud/ 'grel pa sgron gsal mtha' drug rab gsal dang bcas pa'i steng nas/ sbyongs rgyud rje rang nyid kyi mdzad pa'i ṭīkka'i steng nas bshad pa mdzad do/ /man ngag la lam 'bras bu dang bcas pa cha lag yongs su rdzogs pa dang / dril bu rim lnga/ rtsa dbu ma/ nag po rims bzhi/ bde mchog dkar po'i khrid la sogs pa dang / gshed dmar spros med/ gsang 'dus rim lnga la sogs pa gnang bar mdzad do/ /dbang bskur mdzad pa'i rnam grangs ni/ /kyai rdo rje man ngag lugs kyi rgyu lam/ bka' babs gzhan gsum gyi dbang / bdag med lha mo bco lnga'i dbang byin rlabs dang bcas pa/ gur sam gnyis/ gsang 'dus rigs gsum/ bde mchog lū dril gnyis/ mkha' 'gro rgya mtsho/ sangs rgyas thod pa/ 'jigs byed sa lugs/ gshed dmar lha lnga/

sgrol ma bcu bdun ma/ kun rig 'chi 'joms/ a ra pa tsa na lha lnga/ tshe dpag med/ rigs gsum spyi dbang la sogs pa'i dbang bskur mdzad do/ /de lta bu'i rgyud man ngag dbang bskur ba rnams kyi rgyab rten gyi rgya gzhung dang bod gzhung rnams kyi bshad pa dang / lung yang gnang bar mdzad do/ /rjes gnang la/ sgrub thabs brgya rtsa/ rgya mtsho/ rnam rgyal 'joms/ a ra pa tsa na/ rta mgrin lcags ral can/ u tsa/ 'byung 'dul/ sgrol ma dkar sngon/ mi g.yo ba dkar sngon/ don zhags/ thugs rje chen po'i rigs gtad/ rnam 'joms bir lugs/ dmar po bskor gsum/ chos skyong che chung rnams kyi rjes gnang la sogs pa bsam gyis mi khyab pa gnang bar mdzad do/ /gzhan yang dbu ma lugs kyi sems bskyed/ zhen pa bzhi bral/ gcod khrid/ blo sbyongs don bdun ma'i khrid rnams kyang gsungs so/ /lung la gong ma lnga/ rje yab sras gnyis/ rje rang nyid dang bcas pa'i gsung 'bum la sogs pa bsam gyi mi khyab pa gsungs par mdzad do/ /de lta bu'i sgo nas sangs rgyas kyi bstan pa nam lang pa la nyi ma shar ba ltar mdzad pa'i skabs su/ bstan pa'i sbyin bdag gtsang chen don grub rdo rje ba dpon blon pas rin chen rtser thub bstan rnam par rgyal ba'i dgon gnas phul/ der chu mo sbrul gyi lo bzhi bcu zhe lnga bzhes pa'i tshe dpon slob rnams der phebs bla brang 'du khang la sogs pa'i 'dzin gras/ spyi khang sgos khang la sogs pa'i bdag rkyen yang dag pa mdzad/ der thugs phab ste dge 'dun brgya phrag du ma 'dus pa la mdo sngags kyi bshad nyan sngar bas kyang dar zhing rgyas par mdzad do/ /de lta bu'i skabs mtshams nas e waṃ chos ldan du chos rje kun dga' dbang phyug pa la bka' lung man ngag gsan pa dang / der bzhugs kyi dge 'dun rnams la rje rang nyid kyi gdams pa zab mo gnang ba la lan 'ga' yar phebs shing / khyad par chos rje dpal ldan rdo rje bas gdan sa bzhag

rje rang nyid kyi khri thog tu ma phebs pa'i gong du dgun thog gnyis kyi bar du gsung ngag la sogs pa'i sbyin pa rgya chen pos gdul bya tshim par mdzad pa dang / 'bras yul/ dga' ba gdong sogs su kun mkhyen chos kyi rgyal po la mjal ba la'ang lan 'ga' yar byon/ khyad par grwa tshang tshugs nas lo gsum pa byi ba'i lo/ rje btsun sems dpa' chen po dkon mchog rgyal mtshan pa'i drung du sleb lung chos sder dpon slob nyi shu tsam gyis phebs/ kyai rdo rje'i dbang dang gdams ngag gi zab don 'ga' zhig kyang gnang / mdo sngags gnyis char gyi sgo nas bstan pa spel ba'i bka' bgros mdzad de/ dpon slob rnams phyir phebs so/ /gnas gzhan du dpon slob dang bcas te chos dbar mdzad pa yin no/ /dga' ba tshal/ mdo mkhar/ gdan sa chen po dpal ldan sa skya/ khro phu/ bo dong / bzhad rnams su chos thog 'ga' yar phebs la/ gsang sngags don du gnyer ba'i slob ma mang po dang bcas te 'chum bde chen du gsung ngag tshar gcig gsungs pa la phebs so/ /gong e waṃ du gsung ngag tshar gcig gsungs pa'i mu nas/ ngor pa'i slob dpon/ lan tshan gyi grwa pa dang bcas pa rnams kyis gdan sa mdzad dgos pa'i zhu ba nan ches pa dang / rje bla ma yab sras kyi dgongs pa rdzogs pa'i thabs la dgongs nas/ yos lo hor zla dang po'i tshes lnga la khri thog tu mnga' gsol nas/ yos 'brug sbrul rta bzhi la rgyud gsum man ngag dang bcas pa la sogs pa chos tshul du ma'i sgo nas gdul bya dpag tu med pa smin grol la 'god par mdzad do/ /de dag gi skabs su thub bstan du slob gnyer ba rnams la slob dpon rin po che bsod nams 'od zer ba/ chos rje thugs rje dpal bzang pa/ chos rje dbang phyug grub pa gsum gyi bshad nyan rkang la blangs pa mdzad pa la rten nas bstan pa la 'phel rgyas sngar las lhod pa med par gyur pa yin/ de nas rta lo sa ga zla ba'i nyer lnga'i dus chen steng su rdo rje 'chang yab sras kyi lung bstan cing /

rje rang nyid kyi thugs kyi sras su gyur pa rim gnyis la thugs brtan zhing / rgyud gsum man ngag dang bcas pa la sogs pa gsang sngags rgya mtsho'i don la dbang 'byor pa'i bdag nyid chos rje rin po che dkon mchog 'phel ba e waṃ chos ldan gyi gdan sar mnga' gsol te/ gnang sbyin dang bstan pa la bya ba rgya chen byed dgos pa'i zhal bkod mdzad nas thugs dgyes spro chen po dang bcas te thub bstan rnam rgyal du phebs nas sngar bzhin du mdo sngags kyi chos bsam gyi mi khyab pa gsungs bar mdzad do/ /rtsod pa'i sgo nas bstan pa spel ba ni/ 'bras yul skyed mos tshal du rtses thang rab 'byams pa sangs lhun pas zhal phod dang bcas dam bca' bzhag pa la/ rje 'dis dngos stobs kyi rig pas sun phyung ste/ stobs mtshungs 'khor gsum mdzad pas kun mkhyen chos kyi rgyal pos kyang bstod bkur bsngags gsum gnang / der bzhugs pa'i sde snod 'dzin pa thams cad kyis kyang rje 'di nyid kyi rigs lung ma mdzad nas de tsam song ba la rig pa 'di bzhin yong ba/ bsgom byung gi shes rab skyes par thag bcad/ des mtshon rgyas pa ni de nyid kyi dgyes rdor/ gsang 'dus/ kun rig gsum gyi rtsod spongs/ sdom gsum dris lan la sogs pa rnams kyi sgo nas shes par bya'o/ /rtsom pa mdzad pa'i sgo nas bstan pa spel tshul ni/ rje rdo rje 'chang yab sras la bstod pa/ rje sems dpa' chen po'i rnam par bstod pa 'grel pa dang bcas pa/ bla ma rin 'byung la gsol ba 'debs pa/ go bo rab 'byams pa shes rab dpal ba/ kun mkhyen sangs rgyas 'phel/ bdag chen blo gros dbang phyug pa rnams la bstod pa/ khro phu'i byams chen la bstod pa/ phag mo dkar mo'i bstod pa/ gur lha brgyad kyi bstod pa/ kyai rdo rje'i bla ma mchod chog phar tshad bla ma brgyud pa'i gsol 'debs rnams mdzad/ kyai rdo rje'i bskor la/ lam 'bras chos 'byung /

kyai rdor man ngag lugs kyi rnam bshad/ mngon rtogs tshul bcu bzhi pa'i ngag 'don/ dbang chu'i rnam bshad/ sa chog mchod gtor gyi rnal 'byor/ lus dkyil bshad pa/ lam dus kyi dbang bskur tshul/ snang ba gsum gyi skabs su mkho ba'i zin bris/ a seng ma'i 'grel pa/ lam 'bras kyi lam rims dang mthun pa'i smon lam/ rigs su skyes dang dam tshig can gyi bshad pa/ bir bsrung thun mong ma yin pa dang / rnam 'joms bir lugs kyi byin rlabs bya tshul/ bdag med ma'i sgrub thabs dbang gi tho yig dang bcas pa/ zab don bdud rtsi snying khu rtsa 'grel/ kyai rdo rje'i sgo nas rten la rab gnas bya tshul/ kyai rdor rtsod spongs/ ga ya dha ra nas brgyud pa'i mgon po dpa' gcig gi rjes gnang bya tshul rnams so/ /bde mchog gi bskor la/ chos 'byung / bde mchog rnam bshad/ lū nag gi sgrub thabs/ nag po rims bzhi'i khrid yig rnal 'byor ma'i bsgrub bskor dang bcas pa'o/ /gsang 'dus la/ mdor byas kyi ṭīkka rtsom 'phro/ gsang 'dus rims lnga'i khrid yig kha skong / gsang 'dus rtsod spongs/ gsang 'dus 'jam pa'i rdo rje'i sgrub thabs/ gtor chog dkyil chog mchod phreng dang bcas pa/ 'jig rten dbang phyug gi thun mong ma yin pa'i mngon rtogs kyi zur bkol/ 'jam pa'i rdo rje'i rnam bshad rnams so/ /gshin rje'i bskor la/ 'jigs byed sa lugs kyi mngon dkyil/ gshed dmar spros med rgyun gyi rnal 'byor dang bcas pa/ gzhan yang sbyongs rgyud kyi ṭīkka/ kun rig gi sbyin bsreg kun rig rtsod spongs/ arga'i cho ga rnams mdzad/ rtags 'jug gi ṭīkka brda grol nges pa'i dpal ster/ zhen pa bzhi bral gyi khrid yig bde ba can gyi smon lam/ gzhan yang zhu ba po so so'i ngor/ karma pa chos grags rgya mtsho/ byams chen skyes pa/ mi nyag grags rdor ba/ chu 'dus mkhas btsun pa/ 'chum bde chen gyi mkhan po rnams la bstod pa re mdzad/

dris lan gyi bskor la/ chos rje rgyal mtshan/ chos rje nyi zla seṅge/ mdo khams pa dbang phyug rgyal mtshan/ ga zi rin chen dpal la sogs pa la gnang ba'i bcu bskor ro/ /gzhan yang dgon pa'i bla ma dang / /mi dpon so so la gdams pa/ bsngo ba smon lam/ bkra shis kyi mtha' rten dang bcas pa rnam grangs mang bar mdzad do/ /sde snod kyi bskor la/ phar phyin dka' 'grel/ sbyor ṭīka yan lag rgyas bshad/ dge 'dun nyi shu'i rnam gzhag ston pa skyes bu mchog gi gsal byed/ bsam gzugs/ 'gog snyoms/ thod rgal rnams/ ston pa snyoms 'jug gsal/ rten 'brel gyi spyi don 'khor 'das rab gsal/ rgyud bla ma'i 'grel pa rtsoms 'phro/ rnam 'grel gyi ṭīkka rgyas pa kun bzang dang / sbyor ṭīka spyi don chen mo/ rig gter gsal byed/ 'dul ba mdo rtsa'i sa bcad/ bslab bya mdzod kyi 'grel pa ngo mtshar gsum ldan rtsoms 'phro/ phung khams skye mched kyi rnam gzhag dbu ma rtsa ba'i rab byed nyer bzhi pa yan gyi ṭīkka/ 'jug pa'i dka' 'grel/ dbu ma'i stong thun che chung gnyis/ rin chen phreng ba dang rigs tshogs phyi ma bzhi'i bsdus don gtsang nags phug pa'i mdzad pa la mi 'dra ba'i khyad par sbyar ba/ sdom gsum spyi don/ ṭīkka/ dris lan/ kha skongs rnams mdzad do/ /de dag la sogs pa'i skabs su nang du ting nge 'dzin dang rtogs pa mnga' ba'i stobs kyi/ dngos dang mtshan ma'i tshul du bla ma yi dam/ sangs rgyas byang sems/ mkha' 'gro chos skyong bsam gyi mi khyab pa gzigs pa dang / mngon mkhyen kyang phyis su 'di 'dra 'byung gsungs ba thog tu bab par snang ngo / /de ltar mkhas pa'i bya ba gsum gyi bstan pa ches cher gsal bar mdzad nas/ 'phrin las kyi 'bras bu bstan 'dzin bskrun tshul yang / sa skya'i khri thog tu phebs pa mgon po 'jam pa'i dbyangs kyi rnam 'phrul bdag chen bsod nams rgyal mtshan pa sku mched rnams dang /

e waṃ chos ldan gyi khri thog tu bzhugs pa/ mkhyen brtse nus gsum mnga' ba'i bdag nyid/ 'dren mchog chos kyi rje rin po che dkon mchog 'phel ba'i gtso mdzad/ ya gi mnga' ris/ ma gi mdo khams/ bar dbus gtsang gi chos sde'i mkhan po/ dgon pa'i bla ma/ grwa pa'i slob dpon/ nyid kyi dngos kyi slob ma bsam gyi mi khyab cing / de dag gi dngos kyi slob ma/ de'i yang slob ma la sogs pa rnams kyi rje nyid kyi gsung thub pa'i gsung ltar bzung nas/ sangs rgyas kyi bstan pa chu bo'i rgyun ltar du gnas par mdzad do/ /de ltar rje nyid kyi sa skyar chos dbar lan gnyis phebs pa'i dang po rje nyid dgung lo lnga bcu bzhes pa khyi lo'i mjug la sa skyar phebs/ phag lo hor zla gsum pa yan tsam bzhugs/ de'i bar la sa skya'i dge ba'i bshes gnyen rnams la kyai rdor mtsho skyes lugs la sogs pa'i dbang rjes gnang dang / rgyud sde spyi rnam/ rtsa rgyud brtag pa gnyis pa la sogs pa'i sngags kyi bshad srol du ma dang / dge 'dun spyi la yang sdom gsum rab dbye la sogs pa'i sde snod kyi chos bsam gyi mi khyab pa dang / skye bo'i tshogs rnams la zhen pa bzhi bral la sogs pa'i chos sbyin bsam gyi mi khyab pa gnang / dkon mchog gi rten gyi drung du yang dkar me/ snyan dar mtha' yas pa dang / mgon khang rnams su mchod gtor rgya che bar phul te/ sangs rgyas kyi bstan pa dar ba dang / sems can thams cad bde zhing skyid pa'i smon lam dang 'phrin las zhu bar mdzad/ dge 'dun tshogs pa la yang mang ja 'gyed dang bcas pa lan grangs du mar bsgrub/ dpon slob rnams la yang gdan sa'i bla ma slob dpon/ grwa pa/ dpon chen la sogs pa yon bdag rnams kyi brnyed bkur gya nom la phul te/ stag thog phyogs la dpon slob rnams chos dbar bteg te/ mang mkhar rje 'brog mi lo tsā ba chen po'i gnas mu gu lung / rje ga ya dha ra'i lha rtse'i bsgrub khang /

zhang dgon pa ba'i sag thang sding rnams su gnas mjal dang / smon lam thugs bzhed mthar phyin pa bsgrub nas thub bstan rnam rgyal du phebs/ lan rjes ma nyid dgung lo drug cu bzhes pa spre'u'i lo sa skyar phebs nas/ lo de ma rdzogs bar la gdan sar bzhugs te dkon mchog gi spyan sngar mchod pa/ dge 'dun tshogs pa la mang ja/ gser stobs che ba'i gnang sbyin dang bcas pa/ dge 'dun skye ba'i tshogs dang bcas pa la gang la gang 'os kyi sbyin pa rgya chen po gnang bar mdzad do/ /bya lo hor zla dang po la chos dbar tshur phebs lam sngon mo rdzong du chos zhag 'ga' yar cig mdzad pa'i ngang nas sku grib la rten pa'i snyung gzhi cig gi rkyen byas/ zhing 'dir mdzad pa re zhig de tsam du dgongs nas dgung lo drug bcu re gcig bzhes pa hor zla dang po'i nyer gcig la gzugs kyi sku chos dbyings su bsdu bar mdzad do/ /de la sngar 'phros kyi tshul du gsungs pa la/ nged lo nyi shu rtsa lnga pa la ngor du slebs nas rdo rje 'chang gi drung du 'grel pa lugs la sogs pa'i dbang lung mang po thob/ sum cu so bdun pa la mus su rje sems dpa' chen po'i drung du lam 'bras dang 'brel ba'i rgyu lam la sogs pa mang po thob/ bzhi bcu zhe dgu pa la ched du gtad nas chos rje kun dga' dbang phyug pa la rgyu dbang zhu ru phyin/ da bzod drug bcu re gcig pa 'di la bsam gtan phug tu lo 'tshams cig byed rgyu byung na dog cha sel te/ de min ci 'dra yong ngam gsungs pa'i ma 'ongs pa lung bstan pa'i thog tu gnas par mdzad do/ /de nas sku gdung thub bstan du gdan drangs/ chos rje tshul khrims bzang po dang / sems dpa' chen po gzhon nu rgyal mchog pa'i sku skyes pa la sogs pa rdo rje 'dzin pa bzhi sde gcig gi bsgrub mchod nar mar phul/ dge 'dun tshogs pas thugs dgongs rdzogs pa'i thabs brtsams te/ gtso bor bla brang nas gzhi bzung /

grwa pa yon bdag dang bcas pas rang rang gi 'byor pa'i bye brag gi zla ba gnyis kyi bar du mang ja/ gdan non ma chag par zhus nas gsol 'debs bsgrub/ de'i dbyar mtshungs med chos kyi rje rin po che dkon mchog 'phel ba thub bstan rnam rgyal du phebs nas nang rten gtsug lag khang bzhengs pa la sogs bka' zhal/ dge 'dun rnams la gsung chos la sogs pa bka' drin gyi bskyangs nas hor zla brgyad pa'i nyer gcig la sku gdung la bzhu phul te/ sbyin sreg mdzad zhi bar gshegs nas sku gdung ma bzhu'i bar thams cad du nam mkha' la 'ja' 'od dang / me tog gi char la sogs pa rgyun mi chad par babs par snang ngo / /gnam gang la gdung khang zhal phye ba na dbu ril bur byon zhing / gdung rus dang gdung thal la ring bsrel grangs med pa byung / de la dbu thod ni nang rten gyi thugs khar bzhugs/ gdung rus thog cig tsha tshar btab nas sku 'dra dang nang rten gyi nang du bzhugs su gsol/ /thog cig 'jam dbyangs kyi skur btab nas na bza' gser phul nas phyogs phyogs su byin rlabs kyi rten du phul te/ hor zla dgu pa'i yar tshes la chos rje ngor pas gtso mdzad dpon slob rnams kyi nang rten dang sku 'dra'i gzungs gzhug dang / rab gnas rgyud sde dang mthun par mdzad de byin rlabs kyi gzi 'od 'bar bar bzhugs so/ /kun mkhyen bsod nams seṅge'i rnam par thar pa dad pa rgya mtsho'i rlabs phreng rnam par g.yo ba zhes bya ba las/ rje btsun sangs rgyas rin chen gyis mdzad pa'i rnam thar nas byung ba bshad pa'i skabs ste dang po'o// //sa mo bya la mdo khams phyogs su bltams/ /gzhon nu nyid nas dam pa'i mgon gyi bzung / /shes bya'i gnas kun 'bad pa chung ngus mkhyen/ /kun mkhyen chos kyi rgyal po'i zhabs la 'dud/ /ces mchod par brjod nas// ༈ //spyi don gnyis pa glo bo mkhan chen bsod nams lhun grub legs pa'i 'byung gnas rgyal mtshan dpal bzang pos mdzad pa'i rnam thar las byung tshul bshad pa ni/

kun mkhyen rin po che bsod nams seṅge'i rnam par thar pa glo bo mkhan chen pas mdzad pa las 'di ltar 'byung ste/ bla ma dam pa 'di'i rnam par thar pa dbang du byas na gnyis te/ mdzad pa'i rgyu dang / mdzad pa'i tshul dngos so/ /dang po ni/ thabs dang shes rab dbyer mi phyed pa'i lhun gyi grub pa'i sku gsum brnyes pa nyid de/ ji skad du sangs rgyas thams cad mnyam par sbyor ba'i rgyud las 'byung ba'i rdo rje 'dzin dbyangs zhes bya ba'i bstod pa las/ rtag tu dri ma med pa thugs rje'i shugs las byung / /smon lam grub pa 'gag pa med pa'i chos nyid can/ /'gro ba'i don bsgrub rab tu brtson pa mtha' yas pa/ /thugs rje chen po'i bdag nyid rtag tu rnam par snang / /zhes bshad pa ltar ro/ /gnyis pa la gnyis te/ thog mar sdom gyi mdor bstan pa dang / de nyid tshig lhug pas rgyas par bshad pa'o/ /dang po ni/ 'dus byas ngang tshul dgongs shing chos kyi don rnams rig /'dod lha'i mtshan ma brnyes dang 'phrin las lung bstan thob/ /dam pa'i byin rlabs zhugs shing 'jam dbyangs bla mas bskyangs/ /dbang dus bstan pa gtad cing mkha' 'gros dngos grub byin/ /bla mas bar chad bsal zhing bstan la phan par gnang / /phyi nang bar chad bzlog cing gzhan phan mtshan ltas brnyed/ /mnal tshe ltas bzang mthong nas 'dren pas rjes su gdams/ /'khrul med ngo mtshar skye ba'i ltas bzang bcu gsum mo/ /bstan bsrung dngos su gzigs shing lha mi'i mchod pa thob/ /dam chos gaṇḍi sgrogs dang rje btsun dbang rgyun gsol/ /sa lam spangs rtogs rdzogs dang 'gro don rtsoms med pa'i/ /grub pa'i dbang phyug mchog gi mtshan ltas rnam bzhi yin/ /mdo sngags rnam bshad mdzad dang ngan rtog lta ba bzlog /'gro don bstan 'dzin bskrun zhing brtse chen bla ma gzigs/ /gzhan phan smon lam mdzad dang ma 'ongs rten 'brel bsgrigs/ /gzhan las phul du byung ba'i mdzad pa rnam drug go

/zhes te/ de ltar na ngo mtshar ba'i ltas bcu gsum/ grub pa'i mtshan ma/ phul du byung ba'i mdzad pa drug ste khyad par du 'phags pa'i rnam par thar pa nyi shu rtsa gsum pa 'di ni gang bshad par bya ba'i gzhi'o/ /gnyis pa ste/ 'dus byas ngang tshul dgongs shing / /zhes pa ste/ bla ma 'di dgung lo drug bzhes pa'i tshe bzang po spyod pa'i dpe la klog dar mdzad pas/ de'i nang gi bdag ni 'chi ba'i dus byed gyur pa na/ /zhes pa'i tshig gzigs pa tsam gyi 'dus byas mi rtag pa'i gnas lugs thugs su chud cing sems bcos ma ma yin pa thugs la 'khrungs te/ skyes bu dam pa mtha' dag gang du skye ba bzhes pa'i thog ma nyid nas byang chub kyi sems 'byung ba nyid ni chos nyid do/ /chos kyi don rnams rig ces pa ni/ de nyid kyi tshe gsung rab gling dga' bde ba can du dbyar cig 'khor 'das dbyer med 'di bsgom pas rtogs pa bzang po cig skyes gsungs/ kyi don rnams me long la gzugs brnyan 'char ba bzhin gsal bar gyur to/ /zhes thos te/ pha rol tu phyin pa drug las shes rab kyi pha rol du phyin pa'i rigs kyi nus pa yongs su gsad pa ni 'di lta bu'o/ /'dod lha'i mtshan ma brnyes pa dang zhes pa ni/ dgung lo brgyad pa la rong ston thams cad mkhyen pa'i dngos kyi slob ma slob dpon kun dga' 'bum dang / slob dpon bsod nams 'od zer zhes bya ba gnyis bzhugs pa'i sar dge bsnyen gyi sdom pa nos shing de'i tshe mtshan dang po mi nyag dpal zhes bya ba yin pa las/ bsod nams seṅge zhes bya bar btags la/ dbu ma rtsa 'jug byams chos lnga/ sdom rig gnyis/ rnam 'grel la sogs pa gzhung lugs chen po bcu bzhi tsam dang / g.yag ṭīka rin chen phreng ba'i mkhyen gsum yan dang / rong ṭīka rnams thugs la byang bar mdzad cing / gzhan yang chos kyi rnam grangs mang du zhu ba dang / gzigs par mdzad nas de'i skabs cig tu 'jam pa'i dbyangs kyi bsnyen pa mdzad pas mnal lam du ral gri shub dang bcas pa cig phyag tu 'byung ba rmi/ dgung lo bcu bdun pa la dbus gtsang du phebs par bzhed pa'i tshe/

'bom lung nas nyin lam cig pa'i mtshan dus su byung gsungs/ de shub nas bton pas lung pa cig gi bar snang kheb pa byung ba'i mtshan ma shar ro/ /'di lta bu ni 'dod pa'i lha'i rjes su bzung ba'i mtshan ma yang dag pa ste/ 'jam dpal rtsa ba'i rgyud la sogs pa rgyud sde mang po zhig nas 'di lta bu nges pa can gyi rtags su bshad do/ /'phrin las lung bstan thob ces pa ni/ go bo rab 'byams pa chen po shes rab dpal bas mtshan ltas brtag pa na khyod la rgyab ri kha lho'am/ shar du bstan pa'i dgon pa zhig tu 'phrin las rgya che ba yong bar 'dug go zhes lung bstan mdzad pa de kho na bzhin du mngon du gyur pa'o/ /dam pa'i byin rlabs zhugs shing zhes pa ni/ /bla ma de nyid kyi rong ston chen po'i drung du 'bul ba dang bcas te brdzangs pa'i dus su rong ston la mi g.yo ba dkar po'i rjes gnang gsan pa'i tshe/ bcom ldan 'di la rtsal lags kyi/ /'di la 'go bar mdzad du gsol/ /zhes pa'i dus su rong ston gyi zhal nas mi g.yo ba 'di la thim song ngo zhes gsungs pa yin te/ 'di ni rmad du byung ba'i spyod yul lo/ /'jam sa skya paṇḍi ta skye ba mang por rjes su bzung ba cig yin pa 'dra ste/ 'dis gsung rab la shin tu mos shing blo la 'jim pa dang / rtogs dka' zhing the tshom du gyur pa rnams de nyid kyi drung du mar me la sogs pa phul zhing gsol ba btab pas rtogs pa dang gdon gyi nyen pa la sogs pa'i bar chad rnams la yang gsol ba btab pas zhi ba cig byung gsungs/ dbyangs bla mas bskyangs zhes bya ba'i don ni/ dam pa 'di nyid gsang phu'i gling smad gdan sa pa shes rab dpal ldan zhes bya ba la sa skya paṇḍi ta'i bskyed rims bsgom pa la rten te chos rgyal ma dang / a ra pa tsa na ci grub 'dod pa'i bsgom bzlas bla mchod gong ma rtog nas brgyud pa zhig yod pa de zhus nas thugs dam du mdzad pa'i skabs cig tu rdzong dkar du byon pas/

rong chung gi sbub kyi 'phrang shin tu dog pa zhig la brag lam chad nas gtsang po'i 'khor chen po'i nang du lhung / de ma thag sa skya paṇḍi ta mkhyen zhes pa dang / chu nang der chos rgyal ma tshar nyi shu rtsa gcig 'don zhing lus/ de nas mi mang po lam du byung pas dbu zhwa mthong bas mi rnams kyi rig nas thag pa btang ste drangs pas 'thon pa yin no zhes gsungs te/ 'di lta bu 'jam pa'i dbyangs dang dbyer ma mchis pa'i chos rjes rgyun du bskyangs pa'i mtshan ma yang dag pa gor ma chag la 'dis mtshon nas/ gang dag 'jam dbyangs bla ma brgyud pa dang bcas pa'i mtshan nas brjod cing skyabs su 'gro ba de dag kyang 'di lta bu'i byin rlabs kyi gter brnyed par 'gyur ro/ /zhes rjes su rig par bya'o/ /dbang dus bstan pa gtad cing zhes pa ni/ de nas dgung lo nyer lnga bzhes pa'i tshe/ /dpal e waṃ chos ldan du rdo rje 'chang kun dga' bzang po'i drung du phebs pa'i sar chos la 'grel pa lugs kyi dbang gsan/ slar sambu ṭi rdor dbyings kyi dkyil 'khor du dbang gsan pa'i tshe mtha' rten gyi dbang rdzas kyi dung bskyar nas gnang ste bus gsungs pas/ lan gsum du bus pas skad kyang shin tu che ba byung ngo / /'di ni ma 'ongs pa na dam pa'i chos kyi dung bus nas bstan pa'i bdag por mnga' gsol ba'i rten 'brel bsgrig pa'o/ /de nas kyai rdo rje man ngag lugs kyi dbang dang / 'dod rgyal gyi rjes gnang la sogs pa mang du gsan/ mkha' 'gros dngos byin zhes pa ni/ /de'i dus su ku ru kulle'i rjes gnang sang nyin gsan rgyu'i do nub kyi mnal lam du gos chen dmar po gyon pa'i bud med cig gi shing thog rlon pa thu ba gang sprad nas 'di zo zhes pa dang / rnga dmar po cig phyag tu gtad nas brdungs shig pa'i brda mdzad/ bla mas rnga de brdungs pas skad kyi stong gsum khyab snyam pa byung zhes gsungs pa ste/

snod du gyur pa'i skyes bu dam pa rnams la mkha' 'gro ma rnams kyi byin gyis rlobs pa de yang nges pa kho na'o/ /de nas bla ma 'dis dgung lo nyi shu rtsa bdun bzhes pa'i dus su bla ma rdo rje 'chang chen po la mkhan po/ rgyal ba mus pa chen po la las kyi slob dpon/ rnam thar 'ga' zhig las las slob mkhan chen kha 'phyar bas mdzad zer ba 'dug mkhan chen byang chub sems dpa' kha 'phyar bas la gsang ste ston pa'i slob dpon zhus nas bsnyen par rdzogs pa dge slong gi sdom pa rnam par dag pa nod cing lhag pa tshul khrims kyi phung po mig gi 'bras bu ltar gces spras su mdzad de/ sngon dge slong rnams tshur shog gi bsnyen par rdzogs nas lo brgya lon pa lta bu'i kun spyod dang ldan par gyur to/ /zhes gsungs pa lta bu'i ngang tshul la mnyen par mdzad do/ /de nas mus kyi gling dga' bde ba can dang / e waṃ gnyis su re mos kyi bzhugs shing / rje mus pa chen po'i drung du gsung ngag rin po che lam 'bras bu dang bcas pa tshar lnga dang / lam bskor zhar byung 'phros dang bcas pa yongs su rdzogs pa rnams dang / shin tu zab pa rnal 'byor gsang mtha'i bskor rnams dpyis phyin zhing lhag ma ma lus pa gsan la/ gzhan yang chos kyi bka' drin bsam gyi mi khyab pa rjes su gsan no/ /yang dus de tsam gyi skabs su dam pa gzhan las chos gsan pa ni/ mkhan chen byang chub sems dpa' la sbyongs rgyud dkyil 'khor bcu gnyis dang / gur rigs bsdus kyi dbang / rta mgrin nag po'i rjes gnang la sogs pa gsan zhing / gung ru shes rab bzang po dang / bdag chen zha lu ba dang / bdag chen chu mig pa rnams las kyang sdom pa gsum gyi rab tu dbye ba dang / gdong bzhi pa'i rjes gnang dang / 'brog mi lugs kyi mgon rkyang gi rjes gnang la sogs pa gsan zhing / gzhan yang dbang lung man ngag lag len phra mo tshun chad nas mtha' chod cing gsan pa rgya shin tu che ba zhus so/

/bla mas bar chad bsal zhing zhes pa ni/ /gling dga' na bzhugs pa'i dus su gzhung bshad dmar ma cig gsan gyin yod pa na/ glo bur du snyung ba thu mo nyin gang pa cig byung / de'i dgong mo mus chen gyi gzim khang la dbu gtad nas bzhugs pas mnal gyi za zi cig la gzim khang de'i nang dri bzang gi gang nas mus chen phebs te zhal chab mang po du btab pa'i snang ba byung bas/ de'i mod la snyung nad glo bur ba de nam mkha' la sprin dengs pa bzhin du song gsungs so/ /'di lta bu ni lam gyi drod rtags bla na med pa yang yin zhing / chos rje sa skya paṇḍi tas sku tshe'i 'du byed stong ba'i tshe/ /mgon po khyod kyi gsung rab mchog /nan tan gyis ni legs bsgrub pas/ /bar du gcod pa'i chos de grol/ /zhes lam zab mo bla ma'i rnal 'byor gyi grol bar bshad pa'i tshul dang ji lta ba bzhin du mthun par snang ngo / /bstan la phan par snang zhes pa ni/ dgung lo so gcig pa la sku mched rnam gnyis mdo khams su 'byon par brtsams te/ zhar la e waṃ du phebs dus bstan pa'i bdag po byams chen rab 'byams pas/ rong ston chen po'i lung bstan gyi zhal ta yod pa sogs kyi rgyu mtshan dang bcas nas/ bstan pa'i sbyin bdag rin spungs nor bu bzang po la dkri thabs kyi zhu yig phul/ khong gi kyang khyed dbus gtsang du bzhugs nas 'chad nyan mdzad pa ma gtogs khams la byon pas mi chog 'on kyang rdzong dkar du byon slob dpon rab 'byams pas kyang khyed khams la gtong ba cig mi 'char la che gsungs/ de nas rdzong dkar du phebs/ chos rje rdzong dkar ba la yang khams su 'byon pa'i zhu ba phul bas/ bla mas kyang gdan sa'i dgongs pa gtad pa'i stobs kyi thag gcod ma mdzad par/ gcen po ye shes rgyal mtshan pa mus chen la brtag pa zhu ba la brdzangs/ de'i tshe mus chen gyi zhal nas brtag pa byed mi dgos khams su phyin na tshe ring rgyu med/

bstan pa la phan thogs chung / longs spyod che ba 'ong / dbus gtsang du bsdod longs spyod chung kyang bstan pa la phan thogs che/ tshe'ang cung zad ring ba 'ong gsungs/ de nas sku mched gnyis kyi mus chen gyi dgongs pa dang bstun nas/ bla ma ye shes rgyal mtshan pa khams su byon/ bdag nyid chen po 'di'i dbus gtsang du bzhugs te bstan pa'i bya ba rgya chen po mdzad pa la thugs mngon du phyogs par mdzad/ de bzhin du 'chad nyan 'dzugs pa'i dus su chos rje sku skyes pa dang / chos rje 'di gnyis ka mus pa chen po'i drung du bka' gros zhu ba la sang 'dzoms rgyu yin pa'i do nub sku skyes pa'i mnal lam du/ chos khri chen po gcig brtsig gin 'dug pa sus yin byas pas/ rje btsun grags pa'i chos khri yin zer ba byung / sang dpon slob gsum ka 'dzoms par sku skyes pas rmi lam 'di bzhin byung ba'i rgyu mtshan zhus pas/ de la mus chen gyi zhal nas de rten 'brel shin tu bzang gsungs nas thugs dges pa'i rnam pa mdzad cing / bshad nyan 'dzugs pa la thugs thag bcad/ khyi lo'i sos kha sku skyes pas gdan 'dren byung nas 'chad nyan la phebs pa'i tshe/ rgyal ba mus pa chen pos zhabs kyi padmo spyi bos bzung nas smon lam mdzad pa'i tshe/ bla ma des kyang rtsa brgyud kyi bla ma dang mkha' 'gro chos skyong la bden pa brdar nas/ spyir sangs rgyas kyi bstan pa dang / khyad par dpal ldan sa skya pa'i bstan pa la bsam nas mdo sngags kyi bshad nyan byed pa yin pas bar chad bsrung / mthun rkyen bsgrubs gsungs ba'i bka' bsgo mdzad cing / sku la 'phar g.yo sogs lus nyams kyang dpag tu med pa mdzad/ bdud rtsi ril bu brgya phrag dang stong rdo sogs kyi gnang sbyin du ma mdzad nas rgyal ba'i bstan pa 'dzin pa'i chos kyi rgyal tshab dam par bka' bsgo bar mdzad de/ ji skad chos rje sa skya paṇḍi tas mdzad pa'i thub pa'i bstod pa las/

du/ khyod kyi sras ni 'jam pa'i dbyangs/ /slob ma sha ra dwa ti'i bu/ /byams pa rgyal tshab dam par bskos/ /sems shes su zhig the tshom za/ /zhes bshad pa dang tshul mtshungs par rjes su gnang ba'i don ma lus pa mngon du gyur pa yin no/ /phyi nang bar chad bzlog cing zhes pa ni/ spyir skyes bu dam pa 'di la snang ba'i dngos po ma lus pa mig 'khrul lta bu dang / rang bzhin lhan cig skyes pa dbyer med pa'i don mngon du gyur pa'i phyir/ gang yang nyams kyi snang ba mkhyen bgyis na/ /bdud dang gol sa rang grol dag tu 'gyur/ /zhes gsungs pa ltar bar chad kyi chos rang grol ba yin mod kyis/ 'on kyang dman pa rnams lam brtson pa bskyed pa dang / phyi nang gi bar chad kyi dmigs phyed par bya ba'i phyir/ gzhan ngo tsam du snang bar mdzad pa la 'gal ba med do/ /de yang bdag nyid chen po 'di sbrul lo rdzong dkar na bzhugs pa'i dus snyung ba shin tu thu ba cig byung / de'i tshe sngags 'chang rin chen rnam rgyal ba phyag phyi la bzhugs pas/ khong gi mnal lam du/ bla ma 'di la bar chad brtsoms pa'i rgyal po cig 'dug de la khong gi khyod 'di la bar chad byed pa'i rgyu ci yin/ khyod gang nas 'ong pa yin zhes dris pas/ de na re/ nga gu ge'i rgyal po yin/ nged gu ge'i nor stobs che ba ngor na yod/ de don gyi 'di ma 'ong pa ngor pa'i bstan pa 'dzin pa la drag shos cig 'ong ba 'dug pas bar chad brtsoms pa yin zer ba byung nas/ 'di la dmigs pa'i thugs dam mdzod zer/ sngags 'chang rin chen rnam rgyal ba de yang bslab gsum rnam par dag pa thugs dam la brtson zhing nus pa che/ mnal lam dang gzigs snang la sogs pa yang dag pa 'char ba zhig yin pas de yang thugs dam la bzhag thog mar zhag nyer gcig gi ring la thugs dam chag med yod pa'i steng du/ lta ba 'khor 'das dbyer med la thun bzhir bcad pa'i thugs dam la gtso bor mdzad pas/

zhag bdun song ba'i srod la sngar khong zer ba'i rgyal po de'i chos 'phrul shar byung / de'i tshe lus sbyin par gtong ba'i dmigs pa mdzad cing lta ba la mnyam par gzhag pas bgegs kyi snang ba 'ja' yal ba bzhin du song nas/ de man chad kyi zhag re re zhing sku khams shin tu bde zhing sku gzugs kyang stobs brnyed par byung nas/ kyai rdo rje'i gzhi bsnyen yang yongs su rdzogs par mdzad cing / de dag gi skabs su yang mtshan ma khyad par can du ma zhig yod par gsal lo/ /'di lta bu'i yang dag pa'i lta ba dang snying rje chen po zung du 'brel bas ni bdud kyi sde ma lus pa pham par nus pa sngon gyi gleng gzhis shes te/ mdo las/ rgya che rol pa/ shākya'i rgyal pos rten cing 'brel ba'i chos/ /dngos med ngo bo med pas rab mkhyen pa/ /nam mkha' lta bu'i sems dang rab ldan pas/ /g.yon can dpung tshogs mthong nas g.yo ba med/ /ces gang gsungs pa lta bu'o/ /yang rje btsun sa skya pa'i bsrung ma khyad par can rnams la ji ltar bka' bsgo ba bzhin du 'phrin las bsgrub pa'i stobs kyi kyang phyi nang gi bar chad rnams bzlog par nus pa yin te/ sa skyar lan snga ma phebs dus skyed lhas su gtor bsgrub mdzad pa'i tshe gnyan los rgya gar nas gdan drangs pa'i 'od ma'i thugs dam/ bla ma 'di'i sku mdun phyogs la mgo dud nas 'dug pa mngon sum du dbon po nam mkha' snying pos mthong ba dang / thub bstan du bzhugs pa'i tshe dus cig gi mnal lam du/ mon pa phru gu gnyis skyed lhas kyi brag phug yin snyam pa zhig na 'dug pas/ phyag phyir yod pa'i grwa pa 'dra la 'di tsho gdong bzhi pa'i sprul pa bram ze'i gzugs can tsho yin tshod du 'dug gsungs pas/ mon pa de gnyis mgo gug gug pa dang kha 'dzum 'dzum byed/ 'o na khyed ye shes kyi mgon po yin pas mngon shes la thogs pa med/ ngas tshe mjug la bsgrub pa rtse cig byas pa dga' 'am/

bshad pa byas na dga' gsungs pas/ de gnyis bsgrub pa zhes pa'i tshig gcig kho na brjod/ de nas mgo ril ril kha 'dzum 'dzum mdzad song ba rmis gsungs/ 'di lta bu yang ye shes kyi mgon po rnams kyi dges pa'i rnam 'phrul bstan pa yin la/ yang skabs 'gar snyung ba'i tshul bstan pa bag re byung ba la yang zhag bdun bdun tsam gyi gtor bsgrub dang / thugs dam mdzad pas tshegs med par bar chad kyi phyogs las grol bar mngon sum gyis grub pa dang / mdo dang sde bdun rigs pa'i gter dang bcas pa'i spyi don nyi ma'i me long rnga sgra zhes bya ba rtsom pa mdzad pa'i tshe/ mnal lam du dge slong rin blo pa dang gnyis kyi bstod pa mi rtog ma dbyangs dang bcas pa cig 'then pas lung pa'i phu nas rol mo'i sgra dang 'od zer gyi tshogs du ma dang / dmag gi dpung du ma yongs pa'i mthong snang byung / ci yin dris pas/ dpal mgon zhal bzhi pa'i dmag dpung gi tshogs rnams yin zer/ bltas pas zhabs kyi pus mo man chad la ni thog gsum tsam 'dug 'khor rnams kyi go cha'i 'od lhag lhag lham gyi 'bur rnams ni khrom khrom 'dug nas/ khyod kyi bstan bcos 'di'i bdag po nged tshos byed do zhes gsungs ba byung ste/ de nas bstan bcos kyi lus yongs su rdzogs par mdzad do/ /'di dang chos rje nam mkha' bsod nams kyi mnal lam du byung pa yang mthun par 'dug ste/ de nyid kyi zhal nas grwa tshang de 'gran zla dang bral ba cig tshugs nges su 'dug na ning nga'i rmi lam du rta nag ri khud kyi rtse der sgar chen po gcig 'dug 'di gang gi sgar yin byas pas/ sa skya'i gur mgon gyi sgar yin zer ba cig rmi/ da rta nag 'dir sa skya pa'i bstan pa cig yong tshod du 'dug shin tu legs zhes gsungs par grags pa yang bden pa'i ngag las thos so/ /de ltar na gzhan snang du yang phyi nang bar chad gang gi yang brdzi bar mi nus pa mngon sum gyis grub bo/

/de la 'di skad ces/ blo ngan mtshan mor brjod pa'i gya gyu yang / /ye shes nyi ma bzhin du gsal ba'i drung / /srog bral shing rta'i 'khrul 'khor ji bzhin du/ /don med ngal ba'i khur gyis dub pa bas/ /klu dbang gtsug gi nor bu'i con pan dang / /grags pa'i zhabs zung mdzes pa'i rigs sngags kyis/ /kun bsrung go cha ldan pa'i gnyis skyes de'i/ /'gran zlar 'os pa'i dbang byed gzhan su yod/ /ces ched du brjod pa'o/ /gzhan phan mtshan ltas brnyes zhes pa ni/ dus cig gi tshe mnal lam du gser gyis bris pa'i po ti shin tu mang ba cig 'dug de dag thams cad la bltas pas tshig bcom ldan 'das ma he'i dbang po la phyag 'tshal lo/ sa pho khyi'i lo la bshad nyan 'dzugs par brtsams nas/ chos rjes sku skyes pa dang yon mchod gnyis 'grogs te gser gling du byon pa'i bar lam du mi cig gi gaṇḍi phul ba dang / yang dus cig gi tshe sa skya'i rgyab ri yin snyam pa cig gi khog pa gzhom ste stong par 'dug pa na/ 'di gso dgos zhes rtsol ba cher mdzad pas grogs mang po shig kyang 'jug ste/ gsos pas gso thub pa'i snang ba cig byung ste/ sa skya pa'i bstan pa 'di la phan cung zad thogs pa 'dra gsungs/ yang dus cig gi tshe/ da nas lo nyi shu rtsa lnga'i bar dge ldan pa'i bstan pa 'di nub 'gro ba yod do zhes mi cig zer ba'i snang ba byung ste ga la lta'am gsungs/ zhes pa kho na 'dug pa de nga rang gis 'jigs byed sa lugs kyi mngon dkyil 'di brtsams pa dang / 'di la dar rgyas yang che bar 'dug pa la lta ba 'dra gsungs la/ 'on kyang 'di ni lhas rjes su bzung ba'am mtshan ma yang dag pa yin te/ gsang ba spyi rgyud las/ rmi lam sangs rgyas mthong na ni/ /yon tan rgya mtsho mngon sum bzhin/ /mchod rten dag dang dam chos dang / /de la bskor ba byed pa dang / /mdo sde dag ni klog pa dang / /zhes bshad pa dang shin tu mthun pas so bsam mo/

/gzhan yang lug lo nas sprel lo'i bar rdzong dkar du mdo phyogs kyi 'chad nyan shin tu smar bar mdzad cing / sdom gsum gyi spyi don dang / ṭīkka la sogs pa mdzad/ de'i dus su zla ba gzas zin gyis nub cig mnal lam du mi dkar po cig gi dung dkar shin tu che ba gcig pang du bzhag byung ba des skyil krung mdzad de bzhugs pa'i khyon thams cad gang nas 'dug pa rmi/ 'di la dpag na nga la 'phrin las dga' mo zhig yong tshod du 'dug gsungs/ 'di lta bu yang dag pa'i rtags khyad par can yin te/ snga ma bzhin du mdo rgyud du ma las bstan to/ /mnal tshe ltas bzang mthong nas 'dren pas rjes su gdams/ /zhes pa ni/ bla ma 'di kun rig gi rtsod spong rtsom shing bzhugs pa'i tshe/ nub cig gi mnal lam du ne gseng cig gi thang chen po cig na grwa pa mang po chos khri gcig brtsig gin 'dug pa/ su'i khri yin dris pas/ rje mus pa chen po sbyong rgyud gsungs pa'i khri yin zer/ bla mas kyang khri brtsig pa'i las dka' mdzad pas mus chen khri thog tu phebs nas zhal phod mang po dang bcas nas 'dug pa rmis gsungs/ sbyongs rgyud gsungs ba brtsoms pa 'di byed pa la phan dgongs te legs par gsan pa brtsams pa la phan pa'i tshig rigs shog lde gcig tsam thugs la bzung ba/ ji lta ba bzhin du kun rig rtsod spongs gi nang du bris shing / brtsoms pa nyid kyi mjug tu/ rmi lam ri rtser rtags kyi mtshan ma mthong / /zhes pa yang bris so/ /de ltar na de yan chad kyi rnam par thar pa rnams ni rang nyid kyi yon tan ji ltar gnas pa bzhin du rang rig pa'i tshad mas grub cing / gzhan gyis mthong zhing thos pa na yang ngo mtshar ba'i yid kyi shes ldan gyi skye bo phyogs 'dzin gyi yid kyis ma dkrugs pa rnams dwang ba skye ba'i phyir/ 'khrul med ngo mtshar skye ba'i ltas bzang bcu gsum mo/ /zhes smos/ da ni grub pa'i mtshan ma bzhi las/

dang po/ bstan bsrung dngos su gzigs shing zhes pa ni/ /rta nag gser gling du nub cig gi tshe bsam 'grub rtse pa'i grwa pa bka' bcu pa bstan pa rab gsal bya ba chos khrims la yod pa khong gi sku drung du zhal ta zhig zhu ba la mun sros nas phyin bka' bkyon mdzad/ khyod der 'ong pa sngas byung bas yal song ba ma gtogs/ pu tra yin snyam pa'i a tsa ra rna ba la dung long yod pa zhig byung / lab lab 'ga' re byed grab cig yod pa yin te/ da 'gags song zhes dngos su gsungs ba yin pa 'dug cing / gzhan yang gnas skabs 'gar zhabs drung na mi su yang med kyang tshig brjod du med pa'i zhabs rgya mdzad pa'i zla'o re yod pa lta bu'i skad dir re ba mi gnyis gsum pa re yod pa 'dra ba cig yong gin 'dug pa ni/ a'u gzhon nu bzang po la sogs pa zhabs drung du rgyun du bsdod pa 'ga' yar gyis kyang tshor 'dug go /lha mi'i mchod pa thob ces pa ni/ bo dong er dpon slob rnams chos dbar la phebs nas bzhugs pa'i tshe/ bya rgod gshongs su spyan ras gzigs rang byon la gzigs su byon pas skabs su me tog gi char shin tu che ba babs pa la kun ngo mtshar du 'dzin pa byung ste/ 'di ni sngon gyi dus su bcom ldan 'das kyi shes rab kyi pha rol du phyin pa la sogs pa'i mdo sde zab mo gsungs pa'i tshe/ lha rnams kyi me tog mandha ra ba chen po la sogs pa rnams kyi mchod pa bshad pa dang / byang phyogs kyi rgyud 'di nyid du chos rje dpal ldan sa skya paṇḍi ta chen po dang / mkhas pa'i dbang po g.yag phrug sangs rgyas dpal dang / bdag cag gi 'dren pa rje btsun kun dga' dbang phyug pa la sogs pa skyes bu dam pa du ma zhig la yang dam pa'i chos kyi dga' ston 'gyed pa'i tshe me tog gi char chen po babs pas bstan pa la dga' ba'i lha rnams kyi mchod pa yin par gdon mi za'o/ /ji ltar lha rnams kyi mchod pa de bzhin du nang gi yon tan gyi khyad par can byang chub kyi sems rin po che rnam pa gnyis kyi 'gro ba mtha' dag rjes su bzung ba'i phyir/

rang dang dus mtshungs pa'i dge ba'i bshes gnyen grangs med pa rnams dang / dam pa'i chos skyong zhing mtha' bzhi'i rgyal khams la dbang bsgyur ba'i 'dzin ma'i dbang phyug chen po rnams dang / blo gsal zhing don du gnyer ba'i gdul bya grangs med pa rnams dang / skye bo phal pa bsod nams dang rjes su mthun pa'i dge ba'i rtsa ba cung zad tsam la gnas pa tshun chad kyang / skyes bu dam pa 'di las dam pa'i chos kyi 'brel pa lta zhog sku mthong ba dang / yon tan gyi chos 'ga' tsam thos pa dang / mtshan tsam dran pas kyang yid la dwangs ba'i tshogs ches cher 'phel zhing ngo mtshar ba dang / yid la tshim pa ster ba dang / lus kyi ba spu g.yo ba la sogs pa tshul du ma'i sgo nas mchod cing skyabs su 'dzin pa sha stag tu gyur pa yin te/ gang yang sems can skal ba dman pa dang / sdig pa'i grogs po'i dbang du song zhing gdon gyi blo gros mthu nyams shing / yang dag pa'i don la lta ba'i 'dren byed kyis dben pa'i chu skyar gyi sgyu ma 'dzin pa de dag ni ma gtogs so/ /dam chos gaṇḍi sgrog pa dang zhes pa ni/ glang lo'i dbyar e waṃ chos ldan nas las tshan gyi mi sna chos khrims dang bcas pa thub bstan du byon nas/ bla ma 'di la e waṃ du gdan sa'i 'khur bzhes dgos pa'i rgyu mtshan phul bas/ sngar mnal lam cig tu e waṃ chos ldan nas grwa pa mang po 'bog khres 'khur nas la chung la kha phyogs su 'gro yis 'dug pas/ bla ma 'dis ngor 'du khang steng nas gaṇḍi zhig brdungs pas grwa pa de tsho log byung ste/ de rnams la chos zhig bshad pa'i snang ba byung ba dang / rje rdo rje 'chang gi sambu ṭi'i dbang bskur ba'i dus kyi rten 'brel bsgrigs pa de yang thugs la dran pa dang / rje btsun rdo rje 'chang kun dga' dbang phyug pa mnga' ris la phebs pa'i lam khar gsung ngag gi tha ma rang la lta grub dang / gnas dgon la mig rgyang dang brtson pa bsrings dgos so gsungs pa yang thugs la bzhag nas/

'di tsam yang dus la babs pa yin snyam du dgongs te zhal bzhes gnang / glang gi lo'i ser mchod la e waṃ du phebs/ gsung chos mang du gsungs/ de nas thub bstan gyi dgun chos dang po la phebs nas grwa tshang gi chos 'chad pa'i khur slob dpon rnam gsum dang / chos rje spyan tshab pa tshul khrims bzang po pa dang bzhis mdzad pa dang / grwa tshang gi bsgrigs rnam gzhag gang dang gang dgos pa'i zhal bkod rnams legs par mdzad/ slar yang stag gi lo la e waṃ chos ldan du phebs nas khri thog tu ma bzhugs par gsung ngag la sogs pa chos rnams kyi rnam grangs ci rigs par gsungs/ de nas yos lo hor zla dang po'i dus tshod dang tshes grangs shin tu bzang po yar tshes lnga'i dus la babs pa'i tshe/ rigs drug gi bdag nyid rgyal ba rdo rje 'chang kun dga' bzang po'i dam pa'i chos kyi seṅge'i khri ga la ba der bzhugs su gsol nas lha dang mi'i bkra shis kyi tshigs su bcad pa du ma dang / me tog sil ma char du phab nas rgyal tshab chen por mngon par dbang bskur zhing / de'i tshe phyogs mtha' yas pa'i bstan pa'i sbyin bdag chen po rnams dang / chos grwa so so'i dge ba'i bshes gnyen 'khor dang bcas pa rnams dang / e waṃ 'di nyid kyi las tshan tha dad kyi dge 'dun 'dus pa rgya mtsho'i tshogs kyi bkra shis pa'i dga' ston phul zhing / skal ba dang ldan pa'i gdul bya'i tshogs rgya mtsho'i rdul dang mnyam pa rnams kyi rin po che dbang gi rgyal po'i cod pan ltar spyi bo'i gtsug tu bskur ro/ /de'i tshe dus de nyid nas bzung lo bzhi'i bar du rgyud sde so so dang 'brel ba'i dbang dang / grol lam bskyed pa'i rim pa dang / rdzogs pa'i rim pa bka' yod cing lhad med pa rang rang gi cha lag dang bcas pa dang / rgyud sde so so nas 'byung ba'i byin rlabs dang / khrid kyi rim pa zab dgu rnams dang / khyad par du yang rnal 'byor dbang phyug chen po birwa pa'i gsung ngag gi bdud rtsi rje btsun sa skya pa brgyud pa dang bcas pa rnams kyi gsan pa'i snyim pas legs par gsol ba gsung ngag rin po che lam 'bras bu dang bcas pa zhar byung gi 'phros tshun chad yongs su rdzogs pa dang /

de dag gi rgyab rten du rtsa ba'i rgyud brtag pa gnyis pa/ thun mong ma yin pa'i bshad rgyud rdo rje gur/ thun mong gi bshad pa'i rgyud dpal yang dag par sbyor ba ste rgyud gsum gyi bshad bka' zab cing rgya che la mtha' chod pa'i tshul gyi legs par bshad nas dus skabs kun du gdul bya rnams yang dag pa'i lam la sbyor bar mdzad do/ /de lta bu'i rgyun mi chad pa gzhan gyi don la rtse gcig tu mdzad pa'i tshe skabs shig tu mtshan ma shar ba ni/ rje btsun dbang rgyun gsol zhes pa ste/ rgyu dus kyi dbang cig mdzad pa'i tho rang kha mnal lam du/ mi cig gi khyod gzhan don rgya che ba'i rten 'brel byed zer nas/ rje btsun grags pas bum chu yin zer ba cig sku la bran byung bas tshe dpag med kyi gzugs su song ba'i snang ba byung gsungs ba dang / mkhas pa kun blo ba'i mnal lam du yang / bdag nyid chen po 'di la e waṃ gyi khri thog na 'dug pa'i steng gi bar snang na rje btsun grags pa rgyal mtshan bzhugs pas 'di gzhan don rgyun ring ba'i thabs byed zer ba snyam pa cig nas/ rje btsun chen po tshe dpag med kyi sku gcig tu 'gyur song ba'i snang ba byung zer te 'di yang snga ma dang mthun par snang ngo / /de lta bu'i rnam par thar pa bzhi po de ni rang gi rgyud yongs su smin cing gdul bya gzhan yang 'bad pa med par rjes su 'dzin nus pa'i rtags khyad par can yin la/ de yang 'phags pa sa la gnas pa rnams kyi spyod yul yin par shas cher 'byung ba'i phyir/ sa lam spangs rtogs rdzogs dang 'gro don rtsol med pa'i/ /grub pa'i dbang phyug mchog gi mtshan ltas rnam bzhi yin/ /zhes smos so/ /da ni phul du byung ba'i mdzad pa drug las/ thog mar mdo sngags rnam bshad mdzad/ /ces pa ni/ spyir yongs su rdzogs pa'i mkhas pa chen po rnams kyi bstan pa'i bya ba 'chad rtsod rtsom gsum gyi sgo nas mdzad pa shas che ba yin la/

de la dgongs nas bdag nyid chen po 'dis kyang bde bar gshegs pa'i bstan pa'i tshul 'chad pa dang / rtsod pa dang / brtsams pa gsum gyi dar bar mdzad do/ /de la brtsams pa ji ltar mdzad pa'i tshul ni/ spyir skyes bu dam pa rnams 'phags pa'i lam la zhugs nas rgyal ba'i dgongs pa 'grel byed gzhan la ma ltos par rang dbang du yang 'chad nus pa yin pas/ 'di yang de lta bu'i tshul dang mtshungs par gsung rab kyi dgongs pa la dbang ba yin du zin mod kyis/ 'on kyang deng sang gi gdul bya rnams kyi thub pa'i bka' la yid ches bskyed pa'i phyir mdo sngags kyi gzhung rnams kyi dgongs pa 'grel ba'i tshul du bstan bcos rnams mdzad do/ /de yang thun mong du grags pa pha rol du phyin pa'i gzhung lugs kyi bskor dang / thun mong ma yin pa rdo rje theg pa'i bskor dang / mdo sngags gnyis char gyi don thun mong du ston pa dris lan dang / bstod tshogs kyi bskor la sogs pa mang du snang mod/ mtshan rnams ni dkar chag tu gsal bas 'dir ma bris la/ bstan bcos rang rang gi ngos nas ni brtsams pa gang mdzad kyang tshig brling zhing brjod bya'i don rgya che la bka' ba'i gnas rnams dpyis phyin par bshad cing / mi dgos pa'i sar tshig gi ngal ba lta bur mi len par/ rnam dpyod kyi ji tsam du brtags shing dpyad pa de tsam du myur thug pa med pa'i brjod bya'i don la nges pa sha stag tu snang te/ rje btsun bsod nams rtse mos slob dpon cha pa'i bstod pa mdzad pa las/ bsam pa'i don la dpyod blos rab tu gzhigs gyur na/ /dus mtha' gtum mthar thug med gzigs pa'i spyan dmar ba/ /zhes gsungs pa'i don de 'di la ji lta ba bzhin du tshang bar mthong ngo / /brjod bya rgya che ba yang sdom gsum 'khrul spongs las/ dpal ldan rang bzhin bde ba'i go skabs gzhom med nang gi bdag nyid hūm̐ gi dngos/ /bde ba'i thabs mchog smin byed dbang gi badzra gsum gyi bsrung ba bla med bsgrub/

/mi 'gyur ba'i phaṭ kyi mtshan rtog 'gas pa'i sbub las snying po gsal 'thon pa/ /rgyud gsum ngo bo dbyer med mngon gyur 'jam dbyangs bla ma'i zhabs kyi padmor 'dud/ ces pa'i shlau ka gcig po de nyid kyi nang du bstan bcos rtsom pa po sangs rgyas kyi yon tan/ des brtsams pa'i bstan bcos kyi brjod bya'i gtso bo ma lus pa phan yon dang bcas pa/ de la log par rtogs pa rnams 'khrul zhing tshar bcad dgos pa rgyu mtshan dang bcas pa legs par bshad pa ltar ro/ /ngan rtog lta ba bzlog ces pa ni/ rtsod pa'i sgo nas sangs rgyas kyi bstan pa gsal bar mdzad pa'i tshul te/ de yang kha ba can gyi ljongs 'dir sangs rgyas kyi bstan pa la log par smra ba mang du byung yang / dpal ldan sa skya paṇḍi ta chen po byon te bstan pa'i dri ma shas cher gsal ba'i tshul yan chad ni sdom pa gsum gyi rab tu dbye bar gsal zhing / de nas kyang phyis byon pa'i skyes bu dam pa gzhan dang gzhan gyis kyang cung zad tsam gsal bar byas so/ /dus phyis rigs drug gi bdag nyid rgyal ba rdo rje 'chang chen po kun dga' bzang po zhes bya ba 'phags pa'i yul gyi paṇḍi ta bcu bzhi tsam gyi sku'i skye ba dran pa de nyid kyis spyir sangs rgyas kyis bstan pa mtha' dag dang / khyad par du rje btsun sa skya pa gong ma rnams kyi lta grub phyin ci ma log par dar rgyas su mdzad cing / rgyal ba'i gsung rab rnams nam lang pa la nyi ma shar ba ltar gsal bar mdzad pa'i rjes su/ 'khor ba thog ma med pa nas ngan rtog gi bag chags goms pa dang / skye ba 'dir yang gsang sngags rdo rje theg pa la sbyangs shugs chung pa'i bshes gnyen 'ga' zhig gi shin tu zab mo'i gnad sbyang gzhi dang sbyong byed kyi thabs la phyin ci log tu 'chad pa rnams bdag nyid chen po 'dis lung rigs du ma'i sgo nas sun phyung ste/ 'thad pa dang bcas pa'i bla ma gong ma rnams kyi grub pa'i mtha' gsal bar byed pa grub mtha' gshan 'byed la sogs pa du ma zhig mdzad/

yang 'ga' zhig gis yi dam gyi lhas lung bstan pa yin no zhes de kho na nyid 'dus pa'i rgya mtsho zhes bya ba'i gzhung brtsams pa'i ngal ba lta bur blangs nas gnad kyi don rnams la/ rje btsun grags pa'i gsung rab la sun 'byin du rgol ba dag byung ba yang / blo gros chen po 'di nyid kyi legs par sun phyung ste lung rigs kyi rnam gzhag zhib tu bshad pa'i bstan bcos mdzad do/ /yang 'ga' zhig gis rnam bshad zla zer gyi tshig don la brgal brtag gi sgo nas rtsod par smra ba du ma byas pa yang lung rigs kyis tshar bcad nas 'dren pa mchog gi dgongs pa gzhung bsrangs bar byed pa'i bstan bcos mdzad de/ yang dus phyis zhig nas dpal ldan sa skya paṇḍi ta'i gsung rab mtha' dag dang / khyad par du sdom pa gsum gyi rab tu dbye ba zhes bya ba'i gzhung gi tshig don la gting nas 'khu ba 'ga' zhig gis mdo rgyud kyi lta ba'i mthar thug rnam rig tu 'grel ba dang / sdom gsum gyi tshig don shas cher log par 'grel ba dag byung la/ de dag kyang smra ba'i dbang phyug 'dis 'dod tshul re re nas sun phyung ste/ ji ltar gnas pa'i don shin tu gsal bar byed pa sdom gsum 'khrul spongs zhes bya ba dang / sdom gsum kha skong zhes bya ba dang / lta ba'i gnad la 'khrul pa bye brag tu 'gog pa/ bsgrub pa'i thabs kun du bzang po'i nyi 'od kyi don 'grel lam bzang gsal ba'i snang ba zhes pa mdzad de/ gzhung 'di'i nang du lta ba'i tshul la log rtog glo bur ba de dag 'gog pa la/ sems can thams cad 'bad med du grol bar thal ba/ grub mtha' bzhi'i rnam bzhag mi rung ba/ sems tsam gyi grub mtha' dang de smra ba'i gang zag gi mi rung ba/ mthar thug gi lta ba nges bzung mi rung ba/ dbu ma'i don mi rung ba/ 'khor 'das kyi bya byed mi rung ba/ zhen pa 'gog tshul rgya nag gi lta bar 'gyur ba/ rjes kyi tshig sbyor mi rung ba/

gong 'og dang zung 'jug mi rung ba ste/ mi rung ba dgu thog tu 'bab par 'gyur ro zhes rgyas par bkag yod do/ /de ltar rang gzhan gyi rgol ba mtha' dag bsgrub pa dang / sun 'byin pa'i rtsod pa'i tshul gyi zil gyis gnon nus par yin pa gor ma chag go /'gro don bstan 'dzin bskrun zhes pa ni/ 'chad pa nyi ma'i don gyi thub pa'i bstan pa rgya cher spel ba'i tshul te/ de yang dang po mdo phyogs kyi 'chad nyan mdzad pa nas brtsams ste/ phyis mdo sngags gnyis char gyi bshad pa khor yug tu mdzad pa'i bar la bstan 'dzin gyi skyes bu mtha' yas pa bskrun zhing / khyad par du yang nang gi yon tan gsum la gnas nas mtha' yas pa'i gdul bya rnams rjes su 'dzin par nus pa'i sras kyi thu bo dam pa yang mang du bskrun te/ dpal sa skya'i bdag chen bzhi thog pa bsod nams rgyal mtshan dpal bzang po dang / rgyal ba rdo rje 'chang gi rgyal tshab dam pa chos kyi rje dkon mchog 'phel ba dang / rgyal ba mus pa chen po'i rgyal tshab dam pa chos rje sangs rgyas rin chen pa la sogs pa bla ma gong ma'i rgyal tshab rnams dang dus mtshungs pa'i lung rigs kyi dbang phyug phal che ba yang slob mar ma gyur pa med de/ mtshan rnams ni mang pas bri ma nus so/ /khyad par du rta'i lo hor zla bzhi pa'i nyer lnga'i dus chen gyi steng du rgyal tshab dam pa dkon mchog 'phel ba chos kyi khri chen po'i steng du mngon par dbang bskur ba yin te/ de yang rgyal tshab dam pa 'di nyid la rgyal ba rdo rje 'chang chen pos ma 'ongs pa phan thogs pa yong gsungs pa'i lung bstan yod pa dang / rgyal ba mus pa chen pos kyang rje btsun dam pa kun dga' dbang phyug la chos rje dkon mchog 'phel ba rta nag tu slob gnyer la thong gsungs pa'i zhal ta yod pa rnams thugs la bzhag nas rje btsun rdo rje 'chang chen po'i bstan pa slob ma'i tshogs dang bcas pa rnams dang /

bstan bsrung gi bar du legs par gtad nas bka' bsgos shing chos kyi bdag por lung bstan pa yin no/ /brtse chen bla ma gzigs zhes pa ni/ shing pho 'brug gi lo gsung ngag gi smin byed tshogs pa stong ra chen tsam la mdzad dgos byung nas/ dge 'dun nam zla grang ba'i stobs kyi sku cung zad bsnyel bar byung nas/ nyin mo yud tsam gzim pas mtshan lam du rje btsun sa skya pa chen po byung nas/ sems can gyi don la g.yel bar ma byed ces gsungs pa'i snang ba byung / de'i dus su/ rigs drug kun gyi bdag po rdo rje 'chang / /rgyal ba kun gyi mkhyen pa 'jam pa'i dbyangs/ /sangs rgyas kun gyi mthu stobs birwa pa/ /dbyer med bla ma khyed la bdag skyabs mchi/ /zhes pa'i skyabs 'gro yang mdzad do zhes rnam par thar pa 'ga' zhig las thos so/ /de ltar na bla ma 'di ni nang du ting nge 'dzin gyi rtogs pa khyad par can mnga' ba'i stobs kyis/ phyi rol du'ang dngos dang nyams snang dang / mtshan mo la sogs pa la sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' du ma gzigs pa dang / sangs rgyas kyi zhing khams du ma bgrod pa la sogs pa dag pa'i snang ba du ma 'char ba zhig go /gzhan phan smon lam mdzad dang ces gdan sa chen por lan gnyis phebs pa'i snga phyi gnyis char la rta zla'i tshes gcig nas bco lnga'i bar la gtsug lag khang so sor yang mar me'i phreng ba rgya chen po dang / bye brag 'jam pa'i dbyangs kyi drung du mar me'i phreng ba brgya rtsa gcig rgyun mi 'chad par phul nas/ bstan pa dang sems can gyi ched du smon lam mdzad pa na/ snga ma phebs pa'i dus su dgun shin tu grang ba'i skabs yin kyang chu bo dang chu phran la sogs pa thams cad bzhu ste sos ka lta bur gyur nas/ kha'u gtsang po dang / stag byang chub sems dpa'i bsgrub chu la sogs pa rdol zhing rgyas pa dang / bla ma rje btsun chen pos mdzad pa'i brda'i tshig rnams kyi don rang lugs su rtogs pa dang /
