da nas lo gsum tsam bar sa skya'i nyin lam gru bzhi 'di la sa gtsang ba/ lo legs pa/ dus gzings med pa 'ong zhes lung bstan pa thog tu babs pa dang / grwa tshang 'di yang dus de nas bzung ste je rgyas song zhing / nged rang la yang na tsha la sogs pa'i bar chad shin tu dkon pa zhig byung gsungs so/ /phyi la phebs pa'i tshe/ phebs stabs bde mi bde'i bar chad kyi mtshan ma cung zad byung ba na/ da lan sa skyar ma sleb na skye ba 'di la sa skyar sleb pa med ces gsungs nas/ sa skya paṇḍi ta la bstod pa chos kyi rgyal po'i sgo nas gsol ba btab pas/ dus gcig gi tshe bdud chen po zhig gi bar chad du 'dug da ni bde dog med par 'gro rgyu yong pa yod pas khyed rang rnams kyang 'gro ba'i grab gyis zhes tshogs pa rnams la brda' mdzad/ ji ltar gsungs pa bzhin thugs kyi dgongs pa grub ste/ skabs cig gi tshe/ tshogs khang steng shod cig gi steng na nged rang 'dug 'og na nged rang gi tshogs pa 'di ka yin pa la/ dbu mdzad gzhan zhig gi chos spyod kyi rim pa rnams dkrug gin 'dug pa la/ nged rang gi rtsol ba cher byas pas phyis sgrig thub pa'i snang ba byung ste/ 'o cag gi rjes 'di la bstan pa bye zhig cung zad yong ba 'dra/ der rjes dga' mo zhig yong tshod du 'dug gsungs/ de nas sa skya nas dgongs pa rdzogs te na bza' brag phug tu phebs pa'i tshe/ nyi ma dgong myur ba na rta khyod kyis kyang bed mang du byin/ phyi ma rjes su 'dzin pa yin no gsungs/ pa ni/ dus dang gnas skabs thams cad du yang bstan pa dang sems can gyi don la dmigs pa'i smon lam yang dag pa la brtson pa yin mod kyi/ khyad par du yang gong ma sangs rgyas dang 'dra ba rnams kyi gnas khyad par can du smon lam stobs 'gyur khyad che bar dgongs nas sprel lo hor zla bcu pa'i tshes brgyad la lha khang chen mo pa dang / lha sa'i dpon chen rnam pa gnyis kyi gdan drangs te/

gdan sa chen po dpal ldan sa skyar dpon slob drug brgya tsam phyag phebs/ chos rje sa skya paṇḍi ta'i dus chen la sde chen po de nyid du tshogs pa'i gzhi byes kyi dge 'dun nyis stong lhag tsam la mang ja shin tu bzang ba lan gnyis kyi bar du bsgrub shing / gser zho brgya dang bcu bzhi'i gral 'gyed dang bcas pa'i rnam gzhag rgya chen po mdzad cing / gzhan yang phyag na yod pa'i dngos po rnams kyi steng nas gtsug lag khang so so la mar me'i phreng ba rgya chen po bsham zhing mchod pa'i khyad par bsam gyis mi khyab pa/ gzhan yang gtsug lag khang rnams kyi zhig bzos kyi rgyu dang / gong ma rnams kyi dus mchod la sogs pa mtha' yas pa'i sgo nas 'gro ba rnams tshim par mdzad do/ /de na gnas pa'i skye bo mtha' dag kyang / /bla ma dam pa 'di ni rje btsun rin po che grags pa rgyal mtshan gyi sprul pa yin yang dag pa zhig go /zhes tshad ma'i gnas su 'dzin to/ /de dag gi tshe yang rje btsun sa skya pa chen po mnal lam du byung gsungs pa dang / chos skyong 'di tsho yang gtor bsgrub dang sngags bgrang ba tsam gyis mi chog par dbyangs dang tshogs 'khor la dga' ba cig 'dug gsungs ngo zhes thos so/ /de ltar na gzhan gyi don du rang gi dge ba cung zad tsam yang ma lus pa bsngo ba'i rgyas btab nas byang chub sems dpa' kun du bzang po'i spyod pa dang rjes su mthun par mdzad pa 'di yang sa la gnas pa'i 'phags pa rnams kyi rnam par thar pa yin yang dag pa'o/ /de nas gdul bya gzhan gyi don rgya che ba la dgongs nas dag pa'i snang ba rab 'byams bstan nas zhi bar gshegs pa'i tshul bstan pa dang / de dag gi gnas skabs su yang thun mong dang thun mong ma yin pa'i rnam par thar pa'i tshul mang po zhig 'dug mod kyi 'dir mi 'bri la/ don du gnyer ba rnams kyi zhabs drung du yun ring po bsten zhing brdzun mi zer ba'i ngag las btsal bar bya'o/

/da ni don tshan drug pa ma 'ongs rten 'brel sgrigs pa zhes smos te/ gdan sa chen po de nyid du bzhugs ring gyi gnas skabs kun tu 'phrul pa'i bse mgon gyi drung du bskang gso tshar bdun bdun dang / lnga lnga dang / dkyus ma la yang tshar gsum re ma chag pa tshogs 'khor dang bcas pa mdzad nas mjug tu spyir bstan pa dang sems can la dmigs pa'i smon lam dang / bye brag tu thub bstan du ston pa'i gser sku bzhengs pa la bar chad med cing / 'gro ba rnams kyis mthong ba dang / thos pa dang / yid la dran pa tsam gyis sems can la phan pa 'byung ba'i smon lam mdzad cing / khyad par du yang ma 'ongs na rje btsun sa skya pa'i bstan pa dar rgyas kyi rten 'brel la dgongs nas bse mgon de nyid kyi drung du rten gtor phyag dam 'byar ba zhig kyang bzhugs su gsol/ /de ltar na dus gsum du sangs rgyas kyi bstan pa 'ba' zhig la 'chad rtsod rtsom gsum dang / thos bsam bsgom gsum gyis gdul bya'i don mdzad pa ni/ gzhan nyan thos dang rang sangs rgyas la sogs pa theg pa dman pa'i gang zag rnams kyi spyod yul ma yin zhing / de dag las phul du byung ba'i phyir gzhan las phul du byung ba'i mdzad pa rnams drug go /zhes smos te/ de ltar na rnam par thar pa nyi shu rtsa gsum pa che long nas bshad zin to/ /nyi shu rtsa gsum pa 'dis go rim la dus rim pa can du byung ba'i steng nas bshad pa med cing / ngo mtshar ba dang grub pa thob pa dang / phul du byung ba sogs kyi khyad par gyi go rim rnam par bzhag pa yin no/ /yang 'di'i nang du 'phros don gyi rnam par thar pa 'ga' zhig dang / thun mong ma yin pa'i tshul ma bstan pa rnams kyang 'dir don gyi chud pa go bar byas nas zhib tu gzhan du btsal lo/ logs su chos rdzong gting kheb pas bsgrigs pa/ ra dbon gyi bsgrigs pa/ a'u gzhon nu bzang po'i bsgrigs pa rnams yod cing /

'di ni a'us bsgrigs pa las gzhi byas pa yin no/ /zhes pa de rnams kyi kun mkhyen bsod nams seṅge'i rnam par thar pa dad pa rgya mtsho'i rlabs phreng rnam par g.yo ba zhes bya ba las/ glo bo mkhan chen bsod nams lhun grub legs pa'i 'byung gnas rgyal mtshan dpal bzang pos mdzad pa'i rnam thar las byung ba bshad pa'i skabs ste gnyis pa'o// ༈ //'gro kun dga' mdzad 'dren pa bzang po dang / /dkon mchog bstan pa'i rgyal mtshan 'dzin mdzad pa'i/ /rjes bzung yongs rdzogs bstan pa'i bdag por gyur/ /kun mkhyen chos kyi rgyal po'i zhabs la 'dud/ /ces mchod par brjod nas/ spyi don gsum pa ra dbon yon tan 'byung gnas kyi mdzad pa'i rnam thar rtsa ba bsdus pa'i rnam par bshad pa byin rlabs kyi rgya mtsho las 'byung tshul bshad pa ni/ mnga' ris dol bu'i char 'khrungs pa ra ston yon tan 'byung gnas kyis mdzad pa'i kun mkhyen bla ma'i rnam thar las 'di ltar 'byung ste/ 'di la gsum ste/ brtsam pa la 'jug pa klad kyi don/ brtsam bya rnam thar gyi rang bzhin/ brtsams pa'i mjug gi don no/ /dang po la mchod par brjod pa/ brtsam par dam bca' ba/ rgyu mtshan gyis bzod par gsol ba gsum las/ dang po ni/ bla ma dam pa la phyag 'tshal lo/ /zhes ste/ bla ma ni gong na bzhugs pa'i yon tan gyis lci ba'o/ /dam pa ni sku bzhi'i ngo bor grub pa'o/ /gnyis pa ni/ sngon bsags bsod nams shar gyi ri bo'i rtser/ /mtho ris yon tan rta bdun gyis drangs pa'i/ /dal 'byor 'od stong ldan pa thob dus 'dir/ /dpal ldan bla ma'i rnam thar 'di brtsam mo/ /zhes ste/ mtho ris kyi yon tan bdun ni/ rigs gzugs 'byor pa dang ldan pa/ /shes rab dbang phyug phun tshogs pa/ /nad med tshe dang ldan pa'o/ /gsum pa ni/ skal ldan gdul bya'i bung ba bsdu phyir dang / /skal dman blo yi mun pa gsal ba'i phyir/ /dad pa'i yid kyi cung zad brjod pa la/

/mkhas pa rnams kyis bzod par mdzad du gsol/ /ces ste/ nyi ma'i dkyil 'khor gyi rnam thar gyi padmo kha phye ba ni/ skal ldan gyi bung ba dad pa chen po bsdud pa dang / skal dman gyi log blo'i mun pa gsal ba'i phyir yin gyi/ mkhas pa rnams la 'gran sems kyi min pa'i phyir/ de dag gis kyang bzod par mdzad rigs so/ /zhes pa'o/ /gnyis pa brtsams bya rnam thar gyi rang bzhin la/ brtsams gzhi'i mtshan don bshad pa/ brtsams bya rnam thar dngos/ ji ltar btsams pa'i tshul ste gsum las/ dang po srid zhi'i bsod nams nyid kyi legs bsdus nas/ /skyon rnams ma lus gzhan la gtad do zhes/ /da ltar blo gros ldan pa ji snyed pa/ /de nyid brjod pa'i mi yi seṅge khyed/ /ces ste/ bsod nams ni mtho ris dang / de la srid pa dang zhi ba'i bye brag ste de dag gi phun tshogs thams cad bsdus nas 'khor 'das kyi skyon thams cad gzhan la gtad de/ de lta'i skyon kun spangs shing yon tan thams cad dang ldan pa ni mi'i seṅge khyod nyid yin no/ /zhes gzu bo'i blo gros dang ldan pa thams cad kyis brjod pa ste/ mdor na bsod nams seṅge zhes bya ba'i mtshan gyi don no/ /gnyis pa la bltams pa dang / mkhas btsun bzang gsum gyi rnam thar ro/ /dang po ni/ yum gyi lhums su zhugs tshe ltas dang bcas/ /ngo mtshar yid la the tshom skyes par gyur/ /shākya seṅge yum la bltams pa'i tshe/ /tshangs dang lha dbang sku yi bkod pa la/ /legs par blta dang bzung ba la slebs na/ /khyod nyid bltams tshe de dag shi ba'am/ /gnyid la song ba'am yang na med pa ci/ /zhes te/ snyigs dus kyi mdo sngags bstan pa'i mnga' bdag mtshan brjod par dka' ba 'di ni nges pa'i don du rje btsun 'jam dbyangs dang tha mi dad pa sa skya pa gong ma zhig gi ngo bor bzhugs pa yin mod kyis/ drang ba'i don du lta grub rnam par dag pa spel ba'i phyir/ mdo khams smar khams sgang gi rgyud 'bom bya ba'i sa'i thig le go bo la steng gi yul du yab zhang skyabs zhes bya ba dang /

yum rgyal ba dman zhes bya ba las/ sa mo bya'i lo ston zla brgyad pa skar ma lha 'tshams la babs pa'i dus/ yum la bde ba dang ldan zhing / yab kyang nyi zla shar ba la sogs pa'i mtshan mas brgyan te 'khrungs pa ni ston pa nyid lta bu yin pa la/ tshangs pa dang brgya byin gyi ston pa 'khrungs pa'i tshe/ sku'i bkod pa la blta ba dang / khrus gsol ba dang / byang chub kyi rigs su nges par la sogs pa bshad na/ khyod nyid bltams pa'i tshe/ de dag ma byung bas kho bo the tshom skyes pa ste/ yang na skabs de nyid du de dag yod kyang shi ba'am/ gnyid la song pa'am/ yang na sngon yang de dag med pa yin nam ma shes zhes pa'i don no/ /gnyis pa la/ btsun pa sdom pa gsum gyi rgyud smin pa'i dang / mkhas pa mdo sngags kyi gzhung la sbyangs pa'i dang / bzang ba phyi nang gi yongs 'dzin gyi zin pa'i rnam thar dang gsum las/ dang po ni/ gzhon nu nyid nas gzhon nu'i sa la dad/ /chos la goms pas chos kyi 'du shes dang / /dge ba'i blo yi dge slong thos dang ldan/ /gang yin rnams la gang yid gus pas bsten/ /grub thob brgyad cu'i rnal 'byor bsgom pa'i tshe/ /mkha' la nyi zla bzung ba'i mtshan ma byung / /grags pa'i ba dan phyogs bcur g.yo ba yi/ /mtshan ma mngon du gyur la phyag 'tshal lo/ /zhes te/ de yang dgung lo brgyad pa la klog mthar phyin nas/ dgu pa la slob dpon kun dga' 'bum zhes bya ba'i drung du bsnyen te/ phar phyin gyi gzhung dang / dbu ma la 'jug pa dang / 'dul ba sum brgya pa rnams thugs la zin nas/ dgung lo bcu pa'i tshe go bo rab 'byams pa chen po shes rab dpal ldan pa la mkhan po dang / slob dpon kun dga' 'bum pas las slob mdzad de rab tu byung ba dge tshul gyi sdom pa yang dag par nos nas/ slob dpon sbyin pa bzang po pa las/ ka ri ka lnga bcu pa/ ka sha'i 'grel pa don brgyad ma dang bcas pa/ sum brgya pa 'od ldan rang 'grel dang bcas pa/

mdo rtsa ba rnams gsan te nyan thos 'dul ba'i gzhung lugs la legs par sbyangs shing / nyes ltung gi dri ma phra mos kyang ma gos par gyur to/ /bcu gcig pa la go bo rab 'byams pa chen po las dbu ma lugs kyi sems bskyed gsan te/ de nyid las spyod 'jug dang / sems bskyed chen mo dang / sdom pa nyi shu pa'i 'grel pa zhi ba 'tshos mdzad pa dang / byang sa'i tshul khrims le'u gsan te sems dpa' chen po'i brtul zhugs bzung bar gyur to/ /bcu gsum pa la wa pa chos rje rgyal mtshan dpal bzang po las kyai rdo rje'i man ngag lugs kyi dbang bzhi rdzogs par zhus nas/ sta gon gyi mnal lam du/ bla ma kun dga' bzang pos btang ba yin zer ba'i bud med sma ra se khyug ge ba gcig gi rnga 'di brdungs dang zer nas rnga cig gtad byung ba de brdungs pas/ srid pa gsum g.yo bar nus pa tsam gyi sgra byung ngo / /yang 'di nya ra gyis zer shing gi 'bras bu rlon pa thu ba gang byin pa rmis gsungs te rten 'brel thams cad rang 'grig tu gyur pa'i don no/ /de nas ra ba mdor chos rje rin blo ba zhes bya ba la grub chen brgyad cu rtsa bzhi'i byin rlabs dang / rdo rje gdan pa'i bstod pa'i lung zhus nas yul du phebs te/ bstod pa zhing tshigs zhig tu 'don gyis bzhugs pas/ de'i ngang la mnal du song ba dang mnal lam du ral gri shub dang bcas pa cig brnyed nas/ de shub nas phyung bas rdzogs pa'i dus med par sngo nar byung / dbus gtsang la phebs dgongs pa'i bag chags kyi dbang gi ral gri 'di dbus gtsang du yang sleb pa 'dra dgongs pa dang / ral gri ma lus pa 'thon te dbus gtsang gi gzhung mtha' dag kyang khyab te/ ral gri'i rtse mo gnyis la phan tshun nyi zla gnyis 'chang zhing / gzhung nag skrang nge gas pa cig 'dug pa rmis/ de yang ral gri ni shes rab mu mtha' med pa/ rtse mo la nyi zla 'chang ba grags pa chen po 'byung ba dang /

logs gnyis shin tu bkrag pa ni sku tshe'i stod thugs gnyer smar ba dang / tshe smad 'phrin las che ba/ gzhung gas pa ni bar skabs bar chad mang po 'ong ba'i ltas su 'dug gsungs te/ mdor na gsang sngags kyi chos la dbang 'byor pa yin no/ /de ltar na sdom pa gsum gyi rgyud legs par bltams nas so so'i nyes ltung gi dri ma dang / rtsa ba dang yan lag gi ltung bas ma gos par gyur to/ /gnyis pa mkhas pa mdo sngags la sbyangs pa'i rnam thar la/ dang por lung bstan brnyes pa/ pha rol du phyin pa'i gzhung lugs la sbyangs te mkhas par gyur pa'i tshul/ rdo rje theg pa'i rgyud grol te mkhas par gyur pa ste gsum las/ dang po ni/ nyid kyi mtshan ldan chen pos lung bstan nas/ /thub dbang gnyis pa shākya rgyal mtshan zhabs/ /brgya tshan du ma'i mgon du legs phul ba'i/ /phul byung lung bstan brnyes la phyag 'tshal lo/ /zhes te/ de yang go bo rab 'byams pa chen mo dang / slob dpon kun dga' 'bum pa'i drung du/ dgung lo bcu dgu bzhes kyi bar phar phyin dang / /dbu ma 'jug pa/ mngon pa mdzod/ 'dul ba'i gzhung phran rnams la thugs sbyong mdzad cing / thugs rtsol shin tu che ba'i stobs kyi/ grwa rogs 'ga' zhig slob dpon gyi slob gnyer la bskul sngas pa dang tshig pa za nas rje nyid gzhon nur gnas pas/ 'khyig brdungs grogs mched rnams kyi byas pa dang / gsung skad ma bton par dbu phur te nam phyed phyed tsam nas shar sbyangs mdzad pas thugs rdzogs shin tu che bar gyur te/ slob dpon pas 'di yang go bo rab 'byams pa yin no zhes mtshan gsol to/ /de nas dbus gtsang la phyags phebs par dgongs te/ go bo rab 'byams pa chen mo la bka' gnang zhus pa dang / khong gi zhal snga nas/ nga yang chos rje thams cad mkhyen pa la 'bul ba cig byed cing / grwa pa 'ga' yar kyang zhabs drung du rdzong dgos pa 'dug pas/ ri bo che thub nga rang yang 'gro/

de dang dus mnyam du 'di nas grwa pa rnams 'gro grab gyis gsungs pa'i bka' gnang phebs te/ dgung lo bcu dgu pa yos bu'i lo ri bo cher dpon slob rnams phebs/ chos rje rab 'byams pa 'phrin las shin tu che bas ri bo che'i khri thog tu phebs nas/ skye bo mang po la chos gsungs pa dang gzhan don rgya che ba mdzad/ de dus dbus gtsang du 'gro ba'i grwa pa drug bcu re 'dren tsam yod pa rdzong ba'i grab gnang ba dang / pha mnyam gyi bur song bas/ gcig rang chos rje rong chen gyi zhabs drung du 'bul ba'i zhu zhig gi mgor 'debs su ma 'dod pa dang / go bo rab 'byams kyi zhal nas/ sang nga chos 'chad du 'gro ba'i tshe khyed rang grwa pa rnams kyi nang nas/ nga dang dus mnyam du khri steng du sleb pa de ming mgor btab gtong ba yin gsungs pa dang / grwa pa rnams kyang rang sar gyes/ /de lugs su byas pas/ rje 'di'i mnal lam du ri kha lho bstan gcig na chos khri sa dkar gsol ba thog mang rab 'dug pa/ 'di rnams su'i chos khri yin byas pas/ khyod kyi yin zer ba rmis/ mnal gsad pa dang sang nga yi khri thog tu sleb pa yin nam/ phal cher rang gshed chung bas mi sleb las che/ 'on kyang lan gcig sleb tu re la 'gro dgos dgongs nas/ sang phyag phebs pa dang / chos rje rab 'byams pa yang khrom mang po'i sib na ber thul gsum tsam bzhes nas khri khar 'byon gyin 'dug pas/ khrom sib tu phyin tsa na chos rjes ber thul gyi thu ba cig nas zin byung / de ma shor ba byas byon pas/ chos rje dang dus mnyam du khri thog tu sleb pas/ chos rje yang shin tu dges/ de nas chos rje rab 'byams pas/ rje rong chen gyi zhabs drung du 'di lta bu'i zhu zhig mdzad de/ ston pa gnyis/ mchog gsum pa/ sangs rgyas bzhi pa/ sgo bsrung lnga pa/ gnas drug pa/ rgyan bdun pa/ chos kyi rgyal po thams cad mkhyen pa'i zhabs drung du zhes sogs kyi mgo rgyang dang /

skabs don 'bul ba'i rnam grangs/ go rab la sogs pa grwa pa brgya/ ham chung la sogs pa ja sigs brgya/ 'gying dkar la sogs pa mdzo pho brgya/ zhes sogs 'bul ba'i rnam grangs dang bcas te rong ston thams cad mkhyen pa'i zhabs drung du/ dgung lo nyi shu pa 'brug gi lo la phyags phebs/ gsar chos la mi g.yo ba dkar po'i rjes gnang gnang / de'i tshe rje rong ston gyi zhal nas/ mi g.yo ba ni sbug gi khams chung mgo bo che 'di la thim song gsungs so/ /gnyis pa ni/ thos pa'i bang mdzod lta ba'i nor dang ldan/ /gsung rab khang bzang pha rol phyin pa'i gzhung / /yongs 'dzin mkhas pa rnam mang nyer bsten nas/ /'dzam gling mkhas par gyur la phyag 'tshal lo/ /zhes te/ de yang rong ston thams cad mkhyen pa'i drung du phar phyin gyi mkhyen gsum yan/ dmar ston rgya mtsho rin chen pa la 'dul ba'i spyir bstan rnams legs par gsan nas/ dgung lo nyer gcig pa sbrul gyi lo la smra ba'i dbang po byams chen rab 'byams pa'i drung du phar phyin/ mdo sde brgyan sogs byams pa'i chos rnams dang / dbu ma rtsa ba la sogs pa thal rang gzhung phyi ma'i gzhung lugs mtha' dag dang / mngon pa mdzod rang 'grel dang bcas pa/ kun las btus rgyal sras ma dang bcas pa/ /tshad ma mdo sde bdun dang bcas pa/ 'dul ba mdo rtsa rgya cher 'grel dang bcas pa rnams dgung lo nyer gsum pa'i bar du thugs sbyangs pha rol du phyin pa'i theg pa la mdzad de/ 'dzam gling na mkhas pa'i grags pa thob par gyur to/ /gsum pa ni/ zab lam rdo rje'i theg pa bla med pa/ /snyigs dus drug pa kun dga' bzang po'i zhabs/ /yun ring bsten nas thugs kyi sras mchog tu/ /legs par gyur pa de la phyag 'tshal lo/ /zhes te/ nyer gsum pa'i dus e waṃ du chos kyi rje rdo rje 'chang gi drung du phyag phebs/ gsar chos la kyai rdo rje'i 'grel pa lugs kyi dbang gnang / de nas sngon bag chags kyi stobs kyi rje btsun sa skya pa'i mdo sngags kyi lta grub rnam par dag cing /

chos kyi drod ma yal ba bla ma kun dga' bzang po yab sras dang mjal ba 'di yang sngon bsod nams bsags pa yin/ da ni bla ma 'di dag gi gsung gi bdud rtsi 'thung ngo snyam du dgongs nas/ chos rje rdo rje 'chang gi drung du bsnyen par rdzogs pa zhus pas/ chos rje'i zhal nas/ ma 'ongs pa na khyod la dpal ldan sa skya pa'i bstan 'dzin cig re/ nga'i sdom rgyun 'di sa skya paṇḍi ta nas brgyud pa ma yin/ chos kyi rje sa skya paṇḍi ta nas brgyud pa'i sdom rgyun chos rje kha 'phyar ba la 'dug pas/ khong la mkhan po zhus/ las slob nged kyi byed gsungs/ de nas chos rje dpon slob gnyis kas chos rje kha 'phyar ba la gsol ba btab kyang / chos rje kha 'phyar ba'i gsung las/ chos rje lta bu'i mkhan po bzhugs bzhin du ngas byed pa mi 'ong / las slob kyang nga mi byed/ chos rje bya bral ba la gsol ba thob gsungs/ de nas mkhan po mdzad du ma gsan pas/ chos rje rdo rje 'chang gi mkhan po/ chos rje kha 'phyar ba bsod nams rgyal mtshan gyi las slob/ chos rje bya bral ba dkon mchog rgyal mtshan gyi gsang ste ston pa/ bla ma sangs rgyas dpal grub pas grib tshod pa mdzad de bsnyen par rdzogs pa mdzad do/ /de nas chos kyi rje rdo rje 'chang gi drung du kyai rdo rje'i rgyud gsum dang / ngan song sbyong ba'i rgyud dang / bde mchog rtsa ba'i rgyud/ bshad pa'i rgyud/ rnal 'byor ma kun spyod kyi bshad bka' rnams rje btsun sa skya pa'i bka' srol bzhin rdzogs par gsan/ kyai rdo rje la sogs pa gnyis med kyi dbang bka' dang / bde mchog lū dril/ mkha' 'gro rgya mtsho la sogs pa ma rgyud kyi dbang bka' dang / gsang 'dus 'phags lugs/ gshed dmar lha lnga/ rdo rje 'jigs byed sa lugs la sogs pa pha rgyud kyi dbang bka' ste bla med kyi dbang bka' rnams dang / kun rig rtsa ba'i dkyil 'khor sbyongs dkyil bcu gnyis dang bcas pa la sogs pa rnal 'byor gyi dbang bka' rnams dang /

a ra pa tsa lha lnga'i dbang bka' sogs spyod rgyud kyi dbang bka' rnams dang / rigs gsum spyi dbang la sogs pa bya rgyud kyi dbang bka' ste rgyud sde bzhi'i dbang bka' 'ga' zhig dang / sgrub thabs rgya mtsho/ brgya rtsa ste rjes gnang dang sgrub thabs gcig tu bsdus pa a bhya dang / rdo rje gdan pa las brgyud pa sogs dang / thugs rje chen po skyer khang lugs dang / dpal mo lugs la sogs pa zhi ba'i las bsgrub pa'i tshogs dang / mi g.yo ba sngo dkar la sogs pa shes rab rgyas pa'i lha rnams dang / steng phyogs tshe dpag med/ sgrol ma dkar mo la sogs pa tshe rgyas pa'i lha rnams dang / rdo rje rnam 'joms/ sha wa ri la sogs pa nad gdon bsrung ba'i lha rnams dang / ku ru kulle/ 'dod pa'i rgyal po sogs dbang du byed pa'i lha rnams dang / rdo rje nag po chen po sogs mi mthun phyogs tshar gcod pa'i lha rnams kyi rjes su gnang ba dang / zhen pa bzhi bral/ gsung ngag rin po che/ dril bu rim lnga/ bde mchog dkar po'i khrid/ shin tu spros med la sogs pa khrid bka' zab mo rnams dang / chim gyi sa bcad dang bcas pa'i mdo sil bu bcu bdun/ 'phags pa'i sa bcad dang bcas pa'i zab mo mdo lnga/ brgyad stong pa/ gzhan yang dbu ma rin chen phreng ba/ bshes springs la sogs pa'i lung bsam gyi mi khyab pa gsan/ chos rje kha 'phyar ba'i drung du/ gur rigs bsdus kyi dbang / rta mgrin lcags ral can/ spyan ras gzigs seṅge sgra/ 'jam dbyangs dmar ser/ gnyan sgrol sogs gsan/ rje bla ma mus pa chen po'i drung du/ ka rī ka lnga bcu pa/ sum brgya pa 'od ldan dang bcas pa/ dul ba'i lha'i sde pa tha dad bklags pa'i 'khor lo/ yon tan 'od kyi mdo rtsa/ gser gling pa'i rgya chen 'grel pa dang bcas pa/ las brgya rtsa gcig pa/ dge tshul gyi lo dri ba/ so so thar pa'i mdo'i 'grel pa/ 'dul ba rnam 'byed kyi 'grel pa tshul khrims bskyang gi mdzad pa/

rtsa ba'i lung so so thar pa/ bshad pa'i lung bzhi/ rnam 'byed/ zhu ba/ phran tshegs te gzhi thams cad yod par smra ba'i 'dul ba lung gi sde tshang bar gsan/ dmar khrid/ zhen pa bzhi bral/ jo bo'i blo sbyong don bdun ma'i nyams khrid/ blo sbyong thor bu ba gcig tu sdom pa/ mtshon cha 'khor lo/ rma bya dug 'joms/ sems dpa'i rim pa/ byang chub sems dpa' kun du bzang po'i blo sbyong / birwa pa'i blo sbyong / sum pa lo rtsa ba'i blo sbyong / skyid sdug lam khyer gyi blo sbyong / rten 'brel snying po'i blo sbyong / zas la sogs pa spyod lam la rten pa'i blo sbyong / phung po zan du skyur pa/ ku sa la'i tshogs gsog glang ri thang pa'i tshig skang brgyad ma/ gyer bsgom rdo rje'i glu/ sangs rgyas bsgom pa'i nyams len/ jo bo'i lam yig chung ba dang bcas pa dang / rgyal sras bka' 'bum/ 'gro mgon dpal ldan ye shes kyi mdzad pa'i rgyal sras pa'i rnam thar/ blo sbyong zin bris ma/ chos rje rgyal mchog pa'i blo sbyong / kun sdom chen mo la sogs pa blo sbyong man ngag gi rigs su gtogs pa rnams dang / bsgom rims gsum dang / rgya chen spyod pa ston pa/ byang sa dang / mdo sde brgyan/ ngo mtshar spyod pa ston pa dpa' bo'i skyes rabs/ 'chos skyobs kyi ched du brjod pa'i tshom/ lta spyod zung 'jug ston pa zhi ba lha'i bslab spyod gnyis te bka' gdams gzhung drug tu grags pa dang / dbu ma rin chen phreng ba/ bshes springs/ sa lu ljang pa'i mdo 'grel/ ye shes snying po kun las btus pa/ jo bo'i chos chung brgya rtsa la sogs pa blo sbyong gzhung pa'i chos su grags pa rnams dang / gcod bskor gsum gyi dmigs khrid/ gcod bka' rnying ma shin tu dag cing / bram ze arya de wa'i gzhung gsum dang bcas pa rnams dang / thugs rje chen po gtso 'khor gsum gyi rigs gtad/ don yod zhags pa'i rigs gtad/

dpal mo'i gzhung bzhi la sogs pa thugs rje chen po'i bskor dang / 'jam dbyangs dmar ser sa skya paṇḍi ta'i yig bskor dang bcas pa/ phyag na rdo rje u tsa/ gos sngon can/ 'byung po 'dul byed/ rme ba brtsegs pa/ rnam 'joms bir lugs/ ba ri'i lugs/ gnyan sgrol yan lag drug pa dang bcas pa/ mgon po lcam dral/ lha brgyad/ dmar po bskor gsum la sogs pa'i rjes su gnang ba dang / kyai rdo rje'i rgyud gsum/ bde mchog rtsa rgyud/ gsang 'dus rtsa rgyud/ ngan song sbyongs rgyud kyi bshad bka' dang / kyai rdo rje 'grel pa lugs kyi rgyud 'grel ku mu ti/ sgrub thabs yan lag drug pa/ dkyil chog bzang po yongs bzung / rin chen 'bar ba la sogs pa'i gzhung phran rnams dang / kyai rdo rje mtsho skyes kyi rgyud 'grel padma can/ sgrub thabs mtsho skyes/ dkyil mchog nas gling ma la sogs pa'i gzhung phran rnams dang / kyai rdo rje nag po lugs kyi dkyil chog sgrub thabs sogs gzhung phran rnams dang / kyai rdo rje man ngag lugs kyi rgya gzhung rdo rje'i tshig rkang / thun mong ba'i yig sna bcu bzhi/ gsung ngag gi yig sna bcu drug rgyud 'chad thabs kyi chos sna bcu bzhi la sogs pa rje btsun sa skya pa'i gsung rab rnams dang / bde mchog nag po gzhung drug lū hi pa smad lnga/ dril bu pa bskor gsum/ mkha' 'gro rgya mtsho'i rin chen sna bdun/ sangs rgyas thod pa'i sgrub thabs/ dkyil chog gsang 'dus 'phags lugs kyi 'grel chen sgron ma gsal ba/ sgrub thabs mdor byas/ mdo sre/ spyod bsdus sgron me/ rim lnga/ sbyin sreg dkyil mchog nyi shu pa/ zla grags kyi phyi rol mchod pa'i cho ga la sogs pa gzhung phran mtha' dag dang / 'gos kyi stong thun/ rngog gi stong thun/ bu ston gyi mtha' drug rab gsal/ gsung ngag rin po che'i khrid/ lam sbas bshad kyi khrid/ nag po rims bzhi'i khrid/ dril bu rims lnga'i khrid/

gsang 'dus rim lnga'i khrid/ shin tu spros med kyi khrid/ gzhan yang thun mong ma yin pa'i zab chos/ lam zab bla ma/ bir bsrung thun mong ma yin pa/ rnal 'byor ma'i 'pho chung / rje btsun gong ma gsum gyi gsung 'bum/ sa skya paṇḍi ta'i sdom gsum/ rig gter rang 'grel/ thub pa dgongs gsal/ sangs rgyas kyi zhu 'phrin/ dris lan gyi tshogs 'ga' zhig rdo rje 'chang gi gsung 'bum/ rje mus pa nyid kyi gsung 'bum la sogs pa gsan/ chos rje kun dga' dbang phyug pas drung du/ mgon po che chung gi rjes gnang / rje de nyid kyi bsgrigs pa'i yig bskor dang bcas pa/ dmar po bskor gsum/ de nyid kyi bsgrigs pa'i yig cha dang bcas pa/ gsang 'dus 'jam rdor sa lugs/ sgrub thabs kun du bzang po che chung / dkyil chog bzhi brgya lnga bcu pa/ /de'i 'grel pa shanti pas mdzad pa/ 'jam dpal zhal lung / rtsi lu pa'i 'grel pa/ dman zhabs kyi 'grel pa/ shanti pa'i 'grel pa/ thag ga pa'i 'grel pa/ rin po che rdo rje'i 'grel pa/ ngag gi dbang phyug grags pa'i yan lag bdun pa rtsa 'grel/ grol ba'i thig le/ bdag grub pa la sogs pa 'jam rdor gyi rgya gzhung mtha' dag dang / kyai rdo rje nag po lugs/ a ra pa tsa lha lnga/ rigs gsum spyi dbang rnams kyang gsan/ gsang 'dus spyan ras gzigs kyi dbang / /de'i sgrub thabs jo bos mdzad pa dang bcas pa rnams gsan/ chos rje gung ru ba la/ tshogs bdag dmar chen gyi rjes gnang / sdom gsum gyi bshad pa/ kun rig gzhan phan 'od zer/ shrardha'i thig rtsa rtsa 'grel/ a bha ya'i thig skud 'debs tshul man ngag dang bcas pa/ gzhan yang phyag len phra mo bsam gyi mi khyab pa gsan te mdo sngags kyi gzhung lugs mtha' dag la dka' spyad bzod par byas nas/ yongs 'dzin dam pa rnams kyi zhabs pad yun ring du bsten pas na mkhas pa'i gtsug rgyan du bzhugs pa yin no/ /gsum pa bzang ba phyi nang gi yongs 'dzin gyi zin pa'i rnam thar la/

phyi'i yongs 'dzin dge ba'i bshes gnyen gyi zin pa dang / nang gi yongs 'dzin mkha' 'gro ngang gi 'du ba'i rnam thar dang gnyis las/ dang po ni/ sa skya'i 'jam dbyangs hor la phebs pa'i lam/ /khyi spyang cig gi 'brel pas sku tshe 'dir/ /dkon mchog mchod pa'i rgyal mtshan 'dzin pa de'i/ /rmad byung lung bstan brnyes la phyag 'tshal lo/ /lugs de'i bstan la lhag par dad gyur pa'i/ /sku skye'i mtshan ldan gang de'i khyod nyid la/ /rnam drag gus pas bstan 'di dar bya'i phyir/ /gsol btab lung bstan brnyes la phyag 'tshal lo/ /zhes te/ de yang dgung lo nyer drug bzhes pa'i tshe khams su phebs par dgongs te/ skyid tshal du phyags phebs pa dang / smra ba'i dbang po byams chen rab 'byams pas khams su byon na mi 'ong / sbyin bdag nga yi sbyar ro/ /chos rje mus pa chen po la yang bka' gnang zhu dgos gsungs nas ma btang / de nas chos rjes gzhis dga' rin spungs pa'i nang so nor bu bzang po la sbyor gtong mdzad/ mus chen gyi drung du khams su mi gtong ba zhu zer ba'i zhu zhig phul/ rje 'di nyid kyi zhu yig dang bcas nas mus su byon/ rje mus pa chen po'i zhal nas/ khyed khams su 'gro ba ga la 'os/ nad gzhi'ang thu mo cig byung 'dug 'di sangs na bu ston kha che lta bu la 'gran bzod pa'i 'phrin las kyang 'ong che yod gsungs nas/ re zhig ngor du bsdod/ nad 'di drag na rdzong dkar du song gsungs ba bzhin dang du blangs te ngor du phebs/ 'tsho shas shin tu dkon par yod kyang dbyar kha lo ma dang / dgun nyung ma la rten/ na bza' 'phying pa rul po cig dang bcas nas thugs gnyer gyi 'dun pa ma bshol bar/ dgong mo chag med rnams grub rjes/ rig gter rang 'grel dang / sambu ṭi'i 'grel pa gnad kyi gsal byed dang bcas pa dang / brtag gnyis dag ldan kha skong shar pas mdzad pa dang bcas pa dang / gur gur brgyan dang bcas pa dang /

tshul bzhi'i ston byed/ rgyud sde spyi rnam mngon rtogs ljon shing dang bcas pa/ bdag med stod 'grel/ rtsa ltung 'khrul spongs/ sdom gsum rab dbye la sogs pa la nyin re bzhin zhal 'don gnang / dus dus su dka' gnas la thugs zhugs pas nam lang pa yang ma gsan pa byung gsungs/ de dus sku la snyung gzhi dam yang / sgro 'dogs kyi 'khril shing thams cad bcad/ rdo rje 'chang gi na bza' ras bem cig gnang ba bzhes ma nus/ dkon gnyer rgyal rin gyi phul ba'i kha thul cig bzhes/ de nas nga'i nang 'di la phan pa'i chos zhig zhu zhus pas/ chos rje ngor pa'i zhal nas/ nad nad kyi grol dgos pa yin/ bzung so ngan pa 'dug pas mar khu yog tshad 'thung gsungs byung bas/ de dus chos mi gnang mar khu 'thung rgyu mi 'dug dgongs pa byung gsungs/ de nas re zhig na da chos mi gnang ba 'dug pas mus su 'gro dgos pa 'dug zhabs drung du phyag 'bul la 'gro dgongs nas/ dgong mo zhig ka drug mar phyag 'bul du byon nas rgyu mtshan phul bas/ sang bsdod de nas phyin pas chog gsungs ba'i bka' lung byung pas/ sang bsdad pas gsal cha ni gang yang ma byung par las pa na/ da sang nges par 'gro dgos dgongs nas de nub gzim pas mnal lam du/ skyes pa gos dkar po gyon pa cig na re/ lus 'di bkru dgos par 'dug pa khrus shig byas pa drag zer ba byung / gang gi bkru byas pas bum chu 'dis khrus zer nas bum pa kha dog mi 'dra ba bzhi chu mi 'dra ba bzhi'i bkang nas/ mi dmar po zhig gi thod pa cig chang bzang po zhig gi bkang nas sngon la 'di 'thung las/ de nas khrus gyis zer nas chang de gsol rjes/ mi mi 'dra ba bzhis bum pa re re bzung nas khrus byas pa rmis/ mnal sad pa dang / da mus su phyin na dge sbyor 'phel ba 'dug dgongs nas snga mo bzhengs/ khres po cung zad tsam dang bcas nas byon pas/ nya chu mig tu phebs pa dang / nang skor cig byung nas chos rje'i bka' yod zer nas log byon/

de'i nyin gshed dmar lha lnga'i sta gon gnang / de nyin bshad du mi btub pa'i rmi lam mang po byung gsungs so/ /de nas dbang de rdzogs pa dang skyabs 'gro gzhan ma byas par nad de yang ngang gi 'thon/ rje bla ma la yang thun mong ma yin pa'i dad pa skyes so zhes gsungs so/ /nyer brgyad pa la skyid tshal du phebs bshad nyan gyi dbu btsugs/ so gnyis pa dang / so gsum pa la sdom gsum gyi spyi don dang / ṭīka chen sogs brtsams/ rin spungs nor bu bzang po dang / byams chen sku skyes kun dga' bkra shis pa gnyis kyi bdag rkyen gyi gtso bo mdzad do/ /gnyis pa ni/ mkhas grub chen po nam mkha' bsod nams la/ /brag la mgon po'i sgar chen legs btab nas/ /mi mthun phyogs rnams tshar gcod byed pa yis/ /mtshan ma mngon du gyur la phyag 'tshal lo/ /zhes te/ skyid tshal du rje nyid bshad nyan kyi dbu 'dzugs pa'i dus dang mtshungs par chos rje nam bsod chen mo'i mnal lam du/ rta nag mda'i brag lba ba la gur mgon gyi sgar btab nas mi mthun phyogs ma lus pa 'joms pa cig byung / de dang po yin na chos rje sku skyes ri khud 'dzin pa'i ltas su 'dug snyam na'ang / phyis go bo rab 'byams pas bshad nyan gsar pa 'dzugs pa'i ltas su 'dug gsungs so/ /'di ni mkha' 'gro ngang gi 'du ba'i ltas te/ dam tshig rnam par dag pa nyid kyi phyir ro/ /gnyis pa gsung sbyangs pa 'chad rtsod rtsom gsum gyi rnam thar la/ rtsod pa gnam lcags kyi rdo rje log lta'i ri bo bsnyil pa'i tshul/ 'chad pa lha'i rnga po ches mi shes pa'i gnyid las blangs pa'i tshul/ rtsom pa legs bshad kyi nyi mas thub bstan gyi gling bzhi gsal ba'i tshul/ dang po la mkhas pa'i gtso bo pham par byas tshul/ phung chen gyi bar chad gsal bar byas tshul gnyis las/ dang po ni/ gnas lugs nang nas dgongs pa'i mthu stobs kyis/ /ngag gi dbang pos rjes bzung mkhas pa'i gtso/

/rig pa'i rtsal gyi legs par pham byas nas/ /grags pa'i rgyal mtshan thob la phyag 'tshal lo/ /zhes te/ ngor nas byon dus skyid tshal na rje btsun 'jam dbyangs dkar pos byin gyi rlabs pa/ gnas lnga rig pa'i mkhas pa chen po sangs rgyas lhun grub ces bya ba kheng pa'i ri bo ni shin tu mtho/ grags pa'i ba dan gyi phyogs bcur gsal/ slob ma'i dpung ni skar tshogs bzhin rgyas/ rtsod 'chad kyi nam mkha' ni kun du khyab pa zhig yod na'ang / nyin cig mang ja byung nas smra ba'i dbang po byams chen rab 'byams pas/ nged rang gi grwa pa na dge bshes bsam gyi mi khyab pa yod pa'i dus 'dir dge bshes rnams kyi 'brel gtam byed dgos pas/ bstan gsal gyi tshad ma la dam bca' zhog go bo rab 'byams pas sdom gsum dang / sangs rgyas lhun grub pas mngon pa la zhog las/ grwa gsar blo gsal ba rnams kyi sgrog gleng thong gsungs/ de dus bstan gsal dang / rje 'di gnyis kas dam bca' ma bzhag par/ rab 'byams pa sangs rgyas lhun grub kyi mngon pa gong 'og gi bshad pa/ 'grel pa 'grel bshad/ bod snga ma rnams kyi bgros/ deng sang gi dge bshes rnams kyi bzhed tshul zhal po'i khra tshogs dang bcas pa/ zhal nas ni chu ltar du 'khrug phyag ni maṇḍal gyi tshom bu bkod pa bzhin mdzad kyin 'dug pa la/ byams chen rab 'byams pas bshad pa myag nyog la don med/ dam bca' hril ba cig zhog gsungs pa dang / dpang lo chen po'i bzhed pa bkag nas/ mdo sde pa yan la yang sems sems byung / rdzas tha dad pa yin zhes gsungs so/ /de nas grwa shar blo gsal rnams kyi phyogs phyogs nas sgrog gleng gi 'gro 'ded mang po byas pas kyang / la la la cham skyur/ la la la 'ur 'joms/ la la la rtsod g.yo byas nas klag brnyed par ma nus so/ /mjug tu rje nyid kyi ngas sgrog gleng cig gtong bas gsan cig gsungs pa dang / khong gi dgongs pa la slob gnyer dang po yang hal le ba las med/

bar skabs su ngor du bsdod yun ring pas ngag rdib yod/ 'on kyang 'di mkhas grags can yin pas/ de ring sgrog gleng 'gro ba cig byas nas khams gsum du grags pa zhig byed dgos bsam nas shin tu dga' ste/ gtong byas mas 'phro la hob lang zhwa phud/ tshogs pa la nged la go bo rab 'byams pas sgrog gleng gnang ba yod gsan cig gsungs so/ /de rjes thal 'gyur gyi 'gro 'ded 'ga' yar song rjes/ khyab pa re dam cig phud nas/ khong na re/ shing sdong 'di'i rtsar 'di go ba nga min pa ma byung zer te sham sham mang po byed do/ /de nas sngar gyi grub mtha' dang sgo bstun nas/ gtso sems cig gi 'khor du byung ba'i sems byung de/ /gtso bor sems de la ltos pa'i gtso bor 'gyur ba med par thal/ gtso bo sems dang 'khor sems byung rdzas tha dad yin pa'i phyir/ zhes gsungs pas/ 'dod gsungs pas/ 'o na chos mngon pa'i gtso bo sems byung shes rab yin par thal/ chos mngon shes rab dri med rjes 'brangs bcas/ /zhes gsungs pa'i phyir byas pas/ 'dod zer/ 'o na chos mngon pa'i skabs su gtso bo yin na/ rang 'khor dang ldan pa'i gtso sems de la ltos pa'i gtso bo yin dgos par thal/ zag med kyi shes rab de chos mngon pa'i gtso bo yin pa'i phyir byas pas/ 'dod zer ro/ /'o na gtso bo sems dang mtshungs par ldan pa'i zag med kyi shes rab chos can/ khyod rang 'khor du ldan pa'i gtso bo sems la ltos te gtso bo yin par thal/ khyod chos mngon pa'i skabs su gtso bo yin pa'i phyir/ 'khor gsum mo gsungs pas/ byams chen rab 'byams pa'i zhal nas/ sgrog gleng la bdag rkyen cig gyis gsungs so/ /de nas bzhengs nas sku gzan shing sdong la gzar nas/ rung khang bar srang rgyugs byas/ khong gi zhal po rnams thugs kyi dran nas/ bla ma la brnyas pa ma bzod de/ rgyug shar mang rab mdzad/ zhal po yang mang du bton/ khong gi gdong la gzigs pas rngul nag shar re 'dug gsungs so/

/de nas byams chen rab 'byams pa thugs shin tu mnyes te sku bstod dpag tu med pa de khar gnang / sku gzan bzhes pa de kha phud nas gnang / da nas bshad nyan rkang tshugs la gyis gsungs ba'i bka' lung nan che ba gnang ngo / /de yang ngor pa'i bla ma yab sras dang / mkha' 'gro chos skyong rnams kyi byin rlabs yin par 'dug gsungs te/ de nas mkhas pa'i grags pa thob pa yin no/ /gnyis pa ni/ phung chen bar chad brtsams phyir grwa pa rnams/ /nad chen gyis btab de tshe mgon khyod kyis/ /mthu chen grags pa'i bstod pa legs btsugs nas/ /bde chen rnal du bkod la phyag 'tshal lo/ /zhes te/ de yang skyid mos tshal du nyin cig bud med shin tu gdong dmar ba ma mad gnyis byung nas mang ja zhu zer ro/ /de nas ja skol bas ja sun gnyis pa yan chad bstod pa 'ga' bzung byas nas/ ja bsang byas pa dang / mang ja skol mkhan gyi bud med gnyis po ni med cing / khog pa'i nang / rkyen la sogs pa ni khrag gi gang nas 'dug go /de nas grwa pa rnams la shol rims kyi nad gdug pa can byung ste/ rim 'gro dkar chos 'don pa la sogs pa gang gis kyang bzlog ma nyan pa la/ rje 'di'i rje btsun grags pa'i bstod thung tshogs su 'ur 'don du btsugs shing / nad pa rnams la yang de kha brgya rtsa re bgrangs pa'i sngags chu sbyin pas/ nad thams cad gsos par gyur te bde ba chen po la bkod par byas so/ /zhes pa'i don to/ /gnyis pa 'chad pa lha'i rnga bo ches mi shes pa'i gnyid las bslang ba'i tshul la/ zur 'chad kyi grwa pa bskyangs tshul/ gsar 'dzugs kyi bshad grwa btsugs tshul/ rgyal tshab dam par dbang bskur ba'i tshul lo/ /dang po la pha rol du phyin pa'i zur 'chad mdzad tshul/ rdo rje theg pa'i zur 'chad mdzad tshul lo/ /dang po ni/ bstan pa'i pad tshal rgyas pa'i tshal mchog tu/ /bstan pa'i gtso khyod bstan 'dzin mgon du bkod/ /bstan pa'i bya ba 'chad rtsod rtsom gsum gyi/

/bstan pa dag par spel la phyag 'tshal lo/ /zhes te/ yang skyid tshal du byams chen rab 'byams pa thugs shin tu mnyes nas/ zur 'chad kyi dbang por bskos dus bsnyen rdzogs byed pa'i bsgrub bya 'ga' yar glo bur du byung nas/ dgong ma gcig chos rje'i zhal nas/ khyod kyi las slob byed dgos pas/ las de rnams la blo la 'ong ba cig cis kyang gyis gsungs/ do nub kong bu sbar nas gzigs pas nam gsum cha yan la gdams ngag brjod pa la sogs pa las slob la dgos pa thams cad thugs su chud/ sang bsgrub bya rnams kyi slob dpon mdzad/ gdams ngag kyang thugs nas gsungs pas thugs rab mu mtha' med par dgongs te/ gdan sa gtod pa'i bka' lung byung ngo / /de mtshams byams chen rab 'byams pa mus su sems dpa' chen po'i drung du gsung ngag gsan du phebs/ skyid tshal gyi grwa bu slob rnams rje nyid la gtad de/ nyid kyis kyang bstan pa dang bla ma'i dgongs pa la dgongs nas bshad nyan phul du phyin pa gnang / grub mtha' rnam par dag pa'i srol gtod pa dang / 'ga' zhig gi blo la de ma bzod pa/ dpon slob kyi bar du dbyen byas/ de nas chos rje rab 'byams pa skyid tshal du phebs/ nyid la sems dpa' chen po'i zhal ta la cis kyang mus su shog gsungs ba'i bka' gnang ba la rten/ grwa pa gcig kyang ma khrid par rje mus pa'i drung du byon to/ /gnyis pa ni/ sems dpa' chen pos bstan pa rgyas pa'i phyir/ /ngam ring chos sder rgyud gsum smra ba'i rjes/ /rig pa'i dbang phyug stong phrag tshogs pa'i sar/ /legs bkod gsang chen spel la phyag 'tshal lo/ /de tshe phas rgol log lta'i bstan bcos che/ /legs lam gsal phyir bstan pa spel ba dang / /de don dgongs pa'i mod la bla ma yis/ /mngon sum 'dom par mdzad la phyag 'tshal lo/ /zhes te/ de nas sems dpa' chen po/ mi'i dbang po rnam rgyal grags pa yab sras kyi ngam ring chos sder gsung ngag gnang ba la gdan drangs/

de dang mnyam du rje nyid kyis kyang phebs nas/ rje mus pa'i zhal nas/ gsung ngag sogs khrid rnams ngas skyong / rgyud gsum la sogs pa'i dgag bsgrub kyi bshad pa rgya chen rnams go bo rab 'byams pas gyis gsungs pa yin dus/ rje mus pa la gsung ngag gsan mkhan stong ra can tsam byung / 'di nyid la rgyud gsum gsan mkhan sangs rgyas rnam gsum sogs sde snod kyi pha rol du phyin pa phyed dang bzhi brgya tsam byung / de dus dpal dus kyi 'khor los rjes su bzung ba sa skyong rnam rgyal grags pa dang / sa jo ba'i grub mtha' la dgag bsgrub mang du mdzad/ khyad par lus kyi dkyil 'khor don dam bden par 'dod pa'i log rtog bkag kyang de na bo dong pa'i rgyud don gsal ba zhes bya ba'i kun rig dar te/ bo dong pa nyid kyi mdzad pa de rgyud kyi dgongs par bsgrub cing / gzhan phan 'od zer la sogs pa snga rabs pa'i lugs rnams 'gog pa/ lung rnam nges dang rig pa rnam par nges pa zhes bya ba'i bstan bcos la bshad nyan shin tu mang ba yod pa de dag gi log rtog ldog pa'i bstan bcos zhig brtsam dgos par 'dug dgongs pas/ de'i nub mo mnal lam/ mtha' ne'u gseng me tog sna tshogs kyi brgyan cing nyams dga' ba'i dbus su chos khri dkar la mtho ba'i steng na rje mus pa sku nyams dang ldan par bzhugs nas/ deng sang bod na ngan song sbyongs rgyud la nga bas mkhas pa med nyan mkhan yod na shog gsungs/ gnang ba zhu zhus pas/ ngan song sbyong rgyud shin tu zhib pa dgag bsgrub kyi mtha' gcod dang bcas pa tshar gcig gsan/ mnal gsad pa dang don phal cher thugs la 'dug dka' gnas kyi gnad mang po yang de dus go /de nas gzhan phan 'khrul 'joms zhes bya ba'i kun rig gi rtsod spong mdzad de/ log rtog log nas gzhan phan mtha' yas kyi phyag len rnam par dag pa dar bar mdzad de/ don 'di la dgongs nas rtsod spong gi mjug las/

rmi lam ri rtser rtags kyi mtshan ma mthong / /zhes sogs gsungs so/ /gnyis pa gsar tshugs kyi bshad grwa tshugs pa'i tshul la/ dang por btsugs pa'i tshul/ mthar gnas dgon btab pa'i tshul lo/ /dang po ni/ gang zhig chags sdang rmongs pa'i dbang gi /rab dkrugs bstan pa bsam par med pa ni/ /bstan 'dzin khyod la mthu yi rab bsdigs kyang / /bstan bsrung rgya mtshos bsrung la phyag 'tshal lo/ /zhes te/ sa brgyad bzhes pa me pho khyi'i dpyid mus su byams chen sku skyes dang mjal bshad grwa gsar 'dzugs kyi bka' bgros kyi gzhi gnang / de'i dbyar bsam 'grub rtse'i brag dmar chos sder chos rje sku skyes gdan drangs dus/ khyung tshang shar gyi bshad grwa'i gtso bo byams mgon don yod dpal phyags phebs/ nga yi gdan sa byed dgos/ chos rje sku skyes la yang zhal lta zhus gsungs dus/ gdan sa zhal gyi ma bzhes/ grwa pa rnams la sdom gsum/ rig gter/ phar phyin/ rnam 'grel rnams gsungs/ ston mus su byon nas sems dpa' chen po la sngar gyi rgyu mtshan rnams zhus pas/ mdo sngags gnyis ka'i bshad grwa rkang tshugs pa cig logs su tshugs/ rin spungs pa'i sa skyong rnams kyis kyang sbyin bdag los byed yin/ nged kyis kyang nus gang thon gyi mthun rkyen byed gsungs ba la brten/ chos rje sku skyes la'ang de mthun gyi phyag dam gnang nas/ chos rje sku skye'i gsung gis/ nang so bde gshegs chen mo nor bu bzang po'i thugs kyi dgongs pa rdzogs thabs la/ sku'i rten byams chen khro phu bas lhag pa cig bzhengs/ gsung gi rten la grwa pa gsar pa 'di 'dzugs/ thugs kyi rten la byang chub chen po'i mchod rten shin tu che ba cig bzhengs pas/ dpon blon rnams dang bka' bgros 'dzugs dmigs su btsud de/ lo 'di la tshugs pa byed do gsungs nas/ chos rje sku skyes bstan pa'i sbyin bdag 'gro ba kun la bu ltar brtse ba'i thugs dang ldan pa/

sa skyong don grub rdo rje dpal bzang po dpon blon rnams kyi bgros nas rta nag gser gling gi dgon pa me pho khyi'i lo skar ma rgyal la babs pa'i dus khyad par can la bshad grwa grwa pa drug la btsugs te/ sangs rgyas nyi ma 'jig rten kun gyi brgyan/ /ces sogs dkon mchog gsum dang / bla ma la mchod par brjod pa'i bca' yig gnang / de nas bzung ste thub bstan rnam rgyal phyag tu ma byung gi bar la gser gling du gzhi mdzad/ ldong mkhar/ dga' ba tshal/ byams chen rnams su chos bar la thegs bzhud gnang nas bshad nyan shin tu smar zhing / rtsom pa'i phreng ba yang dpag tu med pa mdzad/ dus cig na dga' ba tshal du grwa pa rnams la bar chad kyi mtshan ma byung ba na/ rje btsun grags pa'i bstod ring btsugs pas bar chad kyi g.yul las rgyal/ gser gling du rje nyid la gzhan gyi mthu gtad byas nas cung zad snyung ba na/ rje sems dpa' chen pos grong bslus gyis shig gsungs pa'i lung bstan la rten nas de bzhin mdzad/ mgon po'i bsrung 'khor gtso bor bsgom/ /bka' stod chos skyong rnams kyi zhal mngon sum du bstan/ bstod pa rnam par rgyal ba'i rnga chen zhes bya ba mdzad nas/ phas rgol phye mar brlag bshad bsgrub kyi rkang tshugs/ rten 'brel thams cad de nas rang 'grig tu gyur to/ /gnyis pa ni/ sa gzhi byin rlabs rnam par rgyal ba'i zhing / /mkha' 'gro chos skyong rnams kyi legs phul nas/ /'phral rkyen bstan pa'i sbyin bdag chen po yis/ /gus phul gnas dgon mdzad la phyag 'tshal lo/ /zhes te/ dgung lo zhe bzhi pa 'brug gi lo la bstan pa'i sbyin bdag sa skyong don grub rdo rje dpon blon gyi rta nag tshang ma chab 'og tu tshud de/ rin chen rtse'i chos sde la bor zegs byung ba rnams kyi 'dzin spras dang / sku dbang thob pa'i gnas dgon cig dgos par dgongs te/ dpon drung g.yung pas dga' bde nang pa bka' bgros zhu ba la brdzangs/

rje nyid 'jig rten gyi 'phri ba chod pa zhig yin pas mi shes sam dgongs nas/ bla brang dang gtsug lag khang de 'phro la gsos/ chos sde'i bod ru rnams kyi yongs sgo sngar lugs bzhin sbyar nas/ rje nyid kyis kyang sngon mnal ltas khyad par can byung ba bzhin bzhes te/ thub bstan rnam par rgyal ba'i chos grwa chen po btab nas mdo sngags kyi bshad nyan rtsal thon pa gnang bar skabs zhig thugs skyo nas/ da lta lha rtse ba'i spyi khang gi gzhi 'dir gzim khang zur pa cig bcos/ der thugs dam mdzad kyin bzhugs dgongs pa dang / nang so dpon blon rin chen rtser phebs pa dang 'dzoms pas/ dpon drung la da sngar 'chad nyan lo bcu bzhi tsam byed par dam bcas pa yang song / skyabs 'gro zhig byed rtsis yin pa/ /dgon pa 'di nga la gnang mkhan khyed dpon blon gnyis yin/ da 'bul yang khyod rang gnyis la 'bul bas rtsis bzhes pa zhu gsungs pa'i bka' lung gnang dus/ dpon drung gi phyag phul te/ nged mi nag pa rnams kyi chen po mi shes na'ang / sngon bu ston thams cad mkhyen pas bla ma dam pa bsod nams rgyal mtshan/ rgyal sras thogs med pa gsum mkhas mnyam yin tshod 'dug bu ston dang / bla ma dam pas bshad grwa bskyangs/ rgyal sras pas bsgom mdzad tshod du 'dug ding sang bu dang bla ma dam pa'i 'phrin las 'di yin zhes pa'i 'dzin skyong byed mkhan mang po 'dug ste/ rgyal sras pas blo sbyong re tsam bsgom mkhan ma gtogs 'phrin las chen po mi 'dug rgyal sras pa yang bsgom mdzad pas grol ba yin mchis te/ khong gnyis po yang bshad nyan mdzad pas ngan song du rang ma gshegs lags sam/ gsungs ba'i zhu ba phul ba thugs kyi dkyil du zer nas bshad nyan gyi rkang tshugs pa yin gsungs/ gsum pa rgyal tshab dam par dbang bskur tshul la/ gsol ba btab tshe ngo mtshar ba'i ltas byung tshul/ phebs dus rten 'brel ngang gi 'grig pa'i tshul/ phebs nas gzhan don mdzad tshul dang gsum las/

dang po ni/ e waṃ gdan sar brgyud pas legs bkod nas/ /dam pa'i byin rlabs legs par zhugs pa dang / /'os med lha mi kun gyi bsngags pa'i tshe/ /me tog sil ma babs la phyag 'tshal lo/ /zhes te/ dgung lo nga gsum pa glang gi lo e waṃ chos ldan gyi gdan sar mi sna chos khrims dang bcas pa gdan 'dren la byung dus/ ngas lo gcig gnyis zur 'chad byed/ glo bo ba ngor pa'i sbyin bdag gi gtso bo yin pas bka' bgros zhu ba la 'gro dgos gsungs/ don gyi zhal len de 'phro la mdzad pa ni/ sngar byon pa'i ngor pa'i gdan rab thams cad kyi lung bstan pa thugs la bzhag ste/ de yang rje rdo rje 'chang la chu 'dus mkhas btsun yon tan rgya mtsho ba dang lhan cig tu sambu ṭi'i dbang zhus pas/ dbang khang gi phug de na rje 'di bzhugs pa dang / rje rdo rje 'chang gi mtha' rten gyi dbang rdzas thams cad rje nyid la gnang / khyad par rjes gnang gi dung / 'khor lo/ po ti gsum gnang dus/ dung de bus dang gsungs nas bus pas shin tu pher ba gnyis/ gzhol le ba gcig ste gsum bus pas 'dzum mdzad nas 'ong ba 'dug gin gsungs te de dus rten 'brel sgrigs so/ /rje sems dpa' chen po mus su bzhugs dus/ chos rje kun dga' dbang phyug pa mnga' ris su phyags phebs nas/ mar lam mus su mjal du byon/ de'i phyag phyi la chos rje ngor pa gdan sa pa dkon mchog 'phel sku na gzhon nur yod pas/ sems dpa' chen po'i zhal nas/ chos rje kun dga' dbang phyug pa la/ khyod kyi dbon po 'di ma 'ongs pa na mi go chod pa cig 'ong du re bas/ slob gnyer cig la sbyor dgos/ de yang mdo phyogs kyi slob gnyer cig sngon la byed dgos pas/ de la lta grub gtsang zhing rje btsun sa skya pa'i gzhung lugs rkang tshugs pa/ rje btsun rin po che la yang mi phyed pa'i dad pa yod pa go bo rab 'byams pa yin pas/ da lta grwa nyung se las med de khong gi grwa tshang du thongs/

nged kyi dbon po gnyis kyang gtong bar yod/ ma 'ongs pa na dpon slob kun la khyad che ba yin gsungs pa'i bka' gnang ba la rten/ chos rje kun dga' dbang phyug pas kyang de bzhin mdzad/ mus nas kyang chos rje sangs rin pa dang / dbon po chos skyong bzang po ba gnyis rdzong ltar gnang ste/ bka' gnang de'i khongs na don chen po yod do/ /chos rje 'jam dbyangs pas ni gzim khang 'og tu mjal ba la byon dus/ ka dan dkar po yug gsum dang / dza ti sder ma gang gnang nas ma zhus bzhin du rje rdo rje 'chang gi bstod pa kho rang gi mdzad pa'i dad pa'i rba rlabs ma'i lung gnang / ma 'ongs pa na lung gi rgyun 'di dgos pa yin gsungs zhal skur mang rab mdzad kyis 'dug gsungs te 'di la gnad cig yod do/ /chos rje kun dga' dbang phyug pa mnga' ris la lan rjes ma phebs dus ri khud du mjal du byon pa'i mda'i chu kha thub bskyel ma gnang / de dus bdud rtsi ril bu thum bu gcig gnang / bshad nyan la brtson pa bskyed yar log 'gro na grwa pa gzugs che ba rnams dbus su chug chung ba rnams kyi mtha' bskor gdugs phub pa bzhin byon gsung gin 'dug de dus chung ba dbus su bcug che ba tshos mtha' bskor na mdzes pa 'ong lags zhus pas/ de bzhin byas pas kyang 'ong / bla ma gong ma'i lta grub dang / gnas dgon la brtson pa chen pos bsrings dgos so gsungs nas chu la phebs song gsungs te/ 'di la yang dgos pa zhig yod do/ /chos dpal ldan rdo rje bas gdan sa bzhag sa skya la phebs dus gdan sa su drag zhus pas/ g.yas g.yon spo sa mang po med/ go bo rab 'byams pa la gsol ba 'debs dgos zhes dngos su phud do/ /de ltar bla ma brgyud pa thams cad kyi bskos shing mkha' 'gro chos skyong rnams kyi byin rlabs legs par zhugs pa'i stobs kyis gdan 'dren pa byung dus/ chos grwa thub bstan rnam par rgyal bar me tog sil ma babs pa ni mngon sum du gyur pa yin no/

/de dus 'ga' zhig gi e waṃ du phyags phebs pa'i zhal bzhes sngas/ da dung 'thad bkod kyi na ma 'dra blangs pa drag zhus dus/ rje'i zhal nas/ da su la yus byed pa yin/ ngor pa yang shin tu dka' ba'i dus su 'dug deng sang glang tshan de ngas ma blangs na mi 'ong / de la su la yang yus mi 'gro /gal te 'gro na rje yab sras la byed dgos te/ de dag gi bka' drin ji ltar byas kyang 'khor ba'i dus mi 'dug gsungs te zhal bzhes 'phral la gnang ba ni dam pa kho na'i ring lugs 'dzin par mngon no/ /gnyis pa ni/ e waṃ gdan sar sang dus phebs pa'i tshe/ /rgya gar paṇa chen bzhi yi legs bstod nas/ /mdo sngags bstan pa rgyas pa'i 'phrin las ni/ /cig char mngon sum gyur la phyag 'tshal lo/ /zhes te/ de yang mdo phyogs kyi grwa bu slob rnams la bka' lung gi khyab pa mdzad/ khyad par chos kyi tsho 'dzin grogs ldan pa gsum la bka' gnang / 'jig rten gyi skyong dar gsol dpon la gyis gsungs te/ sang dus phebs rgyu yin pa'i do nub mnal lam du/ /chos khri zhig gi steng du bzhugs nas mang po la gsung chos gsung gis 'dug pa dang / chos khri de'i phyogs bzhi nas rgya gar gyi paṇḍi ta klu sgrub/ 'phags pa lha/ dbyig gnyen/ phyogs glang dang bzhi yis rim pa bzhin/ gdams pa'i rin chen lhun brtsegs mchog /bsod nams rgya mtsho'i dbus gnas shing / /legs bshad seṅge'i bsti gnas pa/ /yon tan ri dbang la phyag 'tshal/ /zhes gsungs pa rmis pas rten 'brel khyad par can 'grig par dgongs te tshogs su btsugs/ rje nyid kyang shin tu mnyes te ngo mtshar ba'i ltas du ma dang bcas byon to/ /gsum pa la chos kyi sbyin pas gdul bya smin grol gyi lam la bkod tshul/ dus mchod kyi phreng bas bla med lhag pa'i lha mnyes tshul/ chos dbar gyi sar ngo mtshar ba'i ltas khyad par can byung tshul/ bu chen gyi mchog rnams kyi bstan pa'i rgyal mtshan bzung tshul lo/

/dang po ni/ gsung ngag smin byed rim par bskur ba'i tshe/ /cung zad bsnyel nas gdan la gzim pa dang / /rab dkar sa yi mgon po kun snying pos/ /sems can don la bskul la phyag 'tshal lo/ /zhes te/ de yang glang lo dang stag lo gnyis e waṃ gyi chos 'chad gnang / yos bu'i lo gzhis dga' bas dkon ja dang bcas gdan pa'i khur bsnams/ 'brug sbrul rta'i lo'i stod rnams gdan sa mdzad de/ de'i bar la dgun dpyid zla ba drug e waṃ du rgyud sde bzhi'i bshad grwa la g.yel ba med par bzhugs/ dbyar ston zla ba drug thub bstan du sde snod gsum gyi bshad grwa la g.yel ba med par bzhugs te/ grags pa'i 'brug sgra ni shin tu che/ 'phrin las kyi nyi 'od ni phyogs bcur gsal/ bu slob kyi ljon pa ni 'dzin ma'i khyon kun du khyab pa'i tshe/ shing pho 'brug gi lo gsung ngag gi smin byed tshogs pa stong ra can tsam mdzad dgos byung nas/ dgun nam zla grang ba'i stobs kyis ser ma cung zad g.yos/ dbang khang du gdan steng la nyin mo cung zad cig mnal lam du song ba dang / dbang khang gi mthong kha'i thad du rje sa skya pa chen po kun dga' rnying po 'od dang gzi mdangs dang bcas phyag g.yas pas se gol brdab te/ rigs kyi bu sems can gyi don la g.yel ba ma byed gsungs ba'i snang ba byung / de dus/ rigs drug kun gyi bdag po rdo rje 'chang / /rgyal ba kun gyi mkhyen pa 'jam pa'i dbyangs/ /sangs rgyas kun gyi mthu stobs birwa pa/ /dbyer med bla ma khyed la bdag skyabs mchis/ /zhes pa'i skyabs 'gro shor bas de kha tsam thongs gsungs nas mi snang ngo / /de'i lo sa skya pa chen po'i bris sku gangs can na che zhing mtshar ba byin rlabs kyi dpal mnga' ba de bzhengs so/ /de ltar mdo sngags kyi bshad grwa bsam gyi mi khyab pa grwa dgon gnyis su spyi ru bskyangs te/ phan tshun gnod pa med pa dar rgyas kyi sgo nas dpal ldan sa skya pa'i bshad sgrub dri ma med pa gsal bar mdzad pa 'di ni dus gsum du ma byung ba lta bur snang ngo /

/gnyis pa ni/ gong ma'i mchod pa rnam dag 'dzin bya'i phyir/ /skor gsum bsrung ma'i tshogs la bka' bsgos nas/ /bar chad med par gang 'dod 'grub gyur pa'i/ /'phrin las dbang phyug khyod la phyag 'tshal lo/ /zhes te/ de yang rje rdo rje 'chang gi rje btsun gong ma'i dus chen btsugs/ rje sems dpa' chen pos rdo rje 'chang gi zla mchod thugs dgongs rdzogs thabs sa ga'i zla ba la dkyil 'khor lnga'i bsgrub mchod btsugs/ chos rje kun dga' dbang phyug pa'i zla mchod kyang ma chag pa yod pas/ bla brang du stod smad kyi 'bul ba stobs che yang lo re la mang ja bla mchod la zla mchod nyi shu tsam/ dus chen bzhi dang rtsa brgyad/ bsgrub mchod la nyi ma drug bdun re la snga ja phyi ja gnyis gnyis 'dren pas mang ja bzhi bcu tsam re bla brang rang nas gnang dgos pa dang / gtsug lag khang sogs rten gsum rnams kyi drung du nyin mtshan khor yug gi dkar me stobs che ba 'bul dgos pas dka' gnas shin tu che bar gzigs nas bka' bcu pa sangs rgyas rgyal mtshan dpon slob mdo khams su yos lo la/ gsung rab kun gyi rgya mtshor gnas bcas nas/ /dga' bzhi'i nor bus rims gnyis spyi bor mdzes/ /'phrin las bzang pos nor la dbang 'byor pa/ /rje btsun bla ma gdeng can dbang po rgyal/ /zhes sogs bla ma dang dkon mchog gsum la mchod par brjod pa sngon du btang ba'i 'bul yig gi mjug tu/ zla gam dbang gi dkyil 'khor dbus gnas shing / /yan lag rab rgyas rin chen rgyan phreng ldan/ /khams gsum 'dod pa kun la dbang bsgyur ba/ /'dod pa'i rgyal pos don 'di dge legs mdzod/ /'od zer dmar po'i phreng bas srid gsum gsal/ /utpal dmar po'i mda' gzhu'i khams gsum dgug /khro chags bzhad pa'i spyan zur g.yo ba can/ /rig byed lha mo de yi dge legs mdzod/ /glang chen zhal ldan 'dzum khro'i mche ba gtsigs/ /gzhon nu lang tsho dar dmar cod pan bcings/

/bcu gnyis phyag can zhabs gnyis 'gying bag can/ /khro rgyal de yi don 'di dge legs mdzod/ /rje btsun brgyud par bcas pa thams cad kyi/ /bstan pa bstan 'dzin bsrung bar bka' bsgos pa'i/ /bsrung ma'i dbang po bgrangs yas thams cad kyi/ /'gal rkyen gsal zhing mthun rkyen bsgrub par mdzad/ /ces pa'i dmar po bskor gsum dang bsrung ma rnams la bcol dam gnang ste brdzangs pas/ rta lo'i dgun e waṃ chos ldan du phebs/ de dus ja sigs phyed dang sum brgya dang / g.yu ka to ra gang / rta dres nyi shu rtsa lnga/ gos dar btsem ma btsem du ma/ gu gu shas gtso byas pa'i maṇḍal du ma/ gzhan yang dung rwa can la sogs pa mchod rdzas dpag tu med pa tha na rgya khab/ me lcags/ skud pa khres do mang po dang bcas te/ dngos gtsang zhing rnam par dag pa re re nas yig nang du theb pa mdzad nas byung ba yang rje nyid kyi mdzad 'phrin kho na yin zhing / de dus gdan sa phog tshar bas/ khong rnams kyi sngon mo rdzong du gdan 'dren la byon/ rjes kyang de 'phral la phebs nas rtsis bzhes gnang / ja 'bru gcig kyang mchod pa ma gtogs gang la yang snga skyin sogs mi byed pa'i bca' ba mdzad/ ja sun lnga ru spar/ dad chu ma/ khyod nyid dam pa ma/ rje nyid kyi mdzad pa'i bde ba can gyi smon lam la sogs pa gsar du 'dzugs pa'i bka' bgros kyi gzhi mdzad/ lug lo'i ston yang 'bul bsdud kyi lhag ja sigs lnga bcu lhag tsam byung ste/ rtsis pas lo nyi shu rtsa bdun gyi bar gyi mchod pa'i ja mdang bar mdzad pa ni kun la mngon sum du gyur cing / 'bul bsdud rang gi ngo thag dus gsum khegs par kun mthun snang du grub pa la rtsod pa med do/ /gsum pa chos dbar sar ngo mtshar ba'i ltas khyad par can byung tshul la/ sa skyar byung tshul/ bo dong er byung tshul/ 'jad dben tshang du byung tshul gsum las/ dang po ni/ gdan sar phyags phebs bstan dang sems can don/

/grangs med mdzad de tshe 'dir bsgrub snyam pa'i/ /dgongs pa shar tshe nag po chen po'i 'khor/ /pu tras lung bstan mdzad la phyag 'tshal lo/ /zhes te/ sa skyar lan snga ma phebs pa'i tshe/ bla brang shar du bzhugs nas skye bo la sbyin gtong dang / rten gsum rnams la dkar me sogs bsam gyi mi khyab pa'i sems can gyi don mdzad de/ nub cig dang tshe yang lhag ma tsam du 'dug 'di la bsgrub pa cig byas pa drag gam da dung bshad nyan gyi rgyun 'di kha bskyangs na sems can la phan che ba yin dgongs pa dang dus mnyam du pu tra dung long dang bcas pa 'dzum bzhin du 'ong nas/ da dung sems can gyi don kha byas pa dga' zer ro/ /gzhan yang bdag nyid chen po 'di la dpal sa skya pa'i bka' bsrung thams cad ngang gi 'du ba yin te/ de dus kha'ub tu phebs dus/ dkon gnyer gyi rmi lam du sring mo bzhis zam pa'i bar du bsu ba byed pa rmis pa dang / sgo rum gyi dkon gnyer gyi mi su yang med pa la bse mgon dang zhabs rgya byed pa thos pa dang / gser gling du chos khrims pa 'ga' zhig la da kyi nas pu tra byung gsungs ba na 'jigs pa'i snang ba byung ba dang / sku drung du su yang med dus na 'khor rnams kyis nyan rna byas pas zhabs rgya mang po byed mkhan 'dug cing / de kha la drung du phyin pa dang / 'ur sgra dang bcas te mi snang bar 'gro ba la sogs pa byung 'dug pas so/ /gnyis pa ni/ e yi chos sder legs par phebs pa'i tshe/ /log rtog can 'ga'i log rtog bzlog pa'i phyir/ /blo sbyong dpal ye'i lung mdzad gus pa 'phel/ /lha rdzas me tog 'thor la phyag 'tshal lo/ /zhes te/ de yang shing pho 'brug gi lo bo dong er chos bar la phebs/ de dus bo dong pa rnams dgag bsgrub kyi dbang gi phal cher mi dad cing / nad yams kyang chos bar ba snga ma gzhan rnams la byung ba'i gzhug pa'i stobs kyis phyag la sogs pa lta ci mchis/

ldang ba tsam yang mi byed pa la/ spyi chos la blo sbyong dpal ye ma'i lung mdzad pas/ me tog bsam gyi mi khyab pa babs te thams cad dad nas chos nyan pa mang po mi thob pa lta bu dang / khyad par de dus sku rim drag po'i stobs kyi grwa bu slob gcig la yang na tsha ma byung ba dang / bya rgod gshongs su rnam sras mdung dmar can la gtor ma 'bul du byon pas/ de nyid kyi mda' dar dmar po gnang ste/ bu ston kha che la yang 'di lta bu byung 'dug gsungs ba dang / nang bskor rnams kyi nyams med par dres khal a tsi ma'i mdun du ded pa la sogs pa yang bar chad kyi mtshan ma ci yang ma byung ba sogs ngo mtshar ba'i gnas dpag tu med do/ /gsum pa ni/ dben tshang dam pa'i gnas su legs bzhugs tshe/ /ye shes mgon po lag pa bzhi pa'i 'khor/ /bya rog gdong gi cung zad btses pa dang / /snying chu bsres nas bsgo ba phyag 'tshal lo/ /zhes te/ dben tshang du lan snga ma phebs dus/ mus su dkar me 'bul ba sogs rjes byon/ de mtshams grwa pa 'ga' bzung gi mi 'os pa'i spyod pa/ de na phyag bzhi pa'i sku 'dra shin tu gnyan cing byin rlabs che ba cig 'dug pas/ de'i 'khor 'das pa gdong brgyad/ 'jig rten pa gdong brgyad/ rtsa mi sangs rgyas grags kyi phul ba bzhin yod pa/ nang tshan bya rog gdong gi sa 'bri'i 'khrug gzhi chen po byung dus/ sa skya pa dang 'gras pa zhe la bzhag nas byed du bcug pa la/ rje nyid kyi man ngag khyad par can 'byung ba bzhin/ snying chu bsres te bka' bsgos pas/ /lan rjes ma gnyis phebs dus cung zad 'tshub pa tsam ma gtogs/ dam las 'da' bar ma nus so zhes pa'i don to/ /bzhi pa bu chen gyi mchog rnams kyi bstan pa'i rgyal mtshan bzung ba'i tshul ni/ e waṃ la sogs gdan sar bu chen rnams/ /legs 'khod rta yi lo la grub pa'i tshe/ /da ni bstan pa'i bya ba'ang de tsam zhes/ /gzhan don phebs par dgongs la phyag 'tshal lo/

/zhes te/ de yang dgung lo nga brgyad zhes pa rta'i lo e waṃ thu thugs kyi sras mchog chos rje dkon mchog 'phel ba gdan sar bsko bzhag gnang / /de'i lo kha mus su chos rje sangs rin pas mus kyi gdan sa mdzad/ bdag chen bsod nams rgyal mtshan pas dpal ldan sa skya'i gdan sa mdzad nas bu chen go sa che ba rnams rang rang gi mdzad 'phrin mdzad pa la thugs shin tu mnyes/ gzhan yang bshad sgrub kyi rgyal mtshan 'dzin pa'i bu chen gyi mchog mnga' ris na bya tshang mkhan po/ steng chen mkhan po/ nam gling mkhan po la sogs pa bshad grwa 'dzin pa dang / la stod byang bu zhe dgon gyi gdan sa nyi zla seṅge/ se mkhar chung gi gdan sa chos rje spyan tshab pa/ bshad pa'i srol 'dzin chos rje thugs rje dpal bzang pa/ bya rgod gshong na 'bum rab 'byams pa/ thub bstan na sku dngos kyi gdan sa gnas lnga rig pa'i paṇḍi ta dbang phyug grub pa/ e waṃ du ngor pa'i slob dpon chos rje sangs rgyas rgyal mtshan pa/ skyid tshal na 'jam dbyangs kun dga' chos bzang / mdo khams na chos rje kun dga' zla ba/ chos rje shākya blo gros la sogs pa bshad grwa chen po 'dzin pa'i mkhas pa bsam gyi mi khyab pa dang / mnga' ris na dge slong shes rab rin chen/ dge slong shākya rgyal mtshan/ sa skya na rab 'byams pa mgon po dbang phyug rting kheb na chos rje kun dga' mchog ldan/ nyang stod na bka' bcu pa chos skyong bzang po/ mdo khams na dge slong tshul khrims 'od zer la sogs pa tshe dang bsgrub pa mnyam pa bsgrub rgyud kyi bstan 'dzin bsam gyi mi khyab pa da lta mngon sum du bzhugs pa rnams dang / rdo rje 'dzin pa sangs rgyas dpal grub/ sems dpa' chen po bsod nams rgya mtsho la sogs pa mdo sngags kyi bstan pa la bya ba byas pa'i bshes gnyen bsam gyi mi khyab pa bskrun par mdzad de/ bstan pa nyi ma'i 'od bzhin gsal bar mdzad pa ni thams cad kyi mngon sum du gyur pa yin no/

/de ltar bu chen gyi mchog rnams kyi gdan sa zin nas/ rje nyid kyang shin tu thugs rangs te/ sngar bshad nyan yang 'phel po byung / slob ma rnams kyis kyang re che sa nas ma bslus/ da kha yang rgas/ rje bla ma yab sras kyi thugs kyi dgongs pa yang ci rigs pa bsgrub pas na/ smon lam rnam par dag pas 'tshams sbyor dgos gsungs te/ bde ba can gyi smon lam mdzad de nas/ nga dgu bzhes pa lug gi lo la bde ba can gyi zhing bkod kyi bris sku de dang mthun par bzhengs/ bstan pa spyi'i sbyin bdag don grub rdo rje/ nam mkha' rdo rje/ bkra shis mgon la sogs pa dang / bu chen rnams dang tshul mtshungs pa shar mi nyag gi paṇḍi ta grags pa rdo rje/ rje btsun sa skya pa'i lung rigs man ngag gi rgyud bltams pa chos rje bsod nams lhun grub la sogs pa rnams la so sor bya ba grub zin pa lta bu'i phyag dam gnang ste gzhan don la phebs par dgongs so/ /gsum pa 'chad pa legs bshad kyi nyi mas thub bstan gyi gling bzhi gsal ba'i tshul la/ pha rol du phyin pa'i tshul gsal bar byas tshul dang / rdo rje theg pa'i tshul gsal bar byas tshul lo/ /dang po la shar phyogs kyi chos la dbang 'byor tshul/ sdom gsum gyi bdag po yin tshul/ 'gal 'brel gyi don gtan la phab tshul lo/ /dang po ni/ dga' ldan khro phur phyags phebs bstod pa'i tshe/ /ya mtshan byams pas mngon sum legs so byin/ /byams dang snying rjes sems la dbang 'byor pa/ /sems dpa' chen por gyur la phyag 'tshal lo/ /zhes te/ de yang khro phur lan snga ma phebs dus byams pa la bstod pa byams pa'i dkyil 'khor ma mdzad nas/ dgong cig zhal ras lha khang du rje nyid kyi zhal 'don du tshar bcu gcig tsam mdzad/ rtsom snga ma la/ pha rol phyin drug rtsod pas go bgos nas/ /zhes sogs tshig bcad de'i mjug tu/ gnas skabs kun du mgon po khyed nyid kyi/ /zhes sogs kyi tshig bcad der slebs pa yod pas mnal du cung zad cig song ba'i snang ba byung bas/

rje btsun gyi zhal mngon sum du bstan te/ lam bzhi'i rims pa de 'grig la don bzang ba cig 'dug ste/ 'bras bu chad 'dug pa gsungs/ lam bzhi'i rims gang lags zhus pas/ rje btsun gyi zhal nas/ pha rol phyin drug spyod pas go bgos nas/ /zhes pa 'di tshogs lam/ yang dag lta ba'i nyams myong gsal ba yi/ /zhes pa 'di sbyor lam/ rang bzhin dag pa'i gnas lugs mngon gyur nas/ /zhes pa 'di mthong lam/ bag chags spong phyir bsgom par byin gyis rlobs/ /zhes pa 'dis bsgom lam bstan 'dug pa gsungs/ phyis de'i mjug tu 'bras bu ston pa/ sgrib gnyis sprin bral chos dbyings nam mkha' la/ zhes sogs kyi tshig bcad de bsnan gsungs so/ /de ltar na mgon po byams pas dngos su byin gyis brlabs pas sher phyin la dbang 'byor te/ dgongs 'grel gyi bstan bcos phar phyin gyi spyi don yan lag rgyas bshad/ dka' 'grel/ sbyor ṭīka skyes bu mchog gi gsal byed/ snyoms 'jug rab gsal/ 'khor 'das rab gsal/ dbu ma rtsa ba'i ṭīkka brtsams 'phro/ 'jug pa'i dka' 'grel/ dbu ma'i spyi don chen mo/ lta ba shan 'byed/ rigs tshogs phyi ma/ ye shes snying po kun las btus/ /sa lu ljang pa'i mdo 'grel/ byang chub sems 'grel/ rin chen phreng ba/ bzhi brgya pa sogs la bsdus don re re mdzad pa ni shin tu ngo mtshar zhing / mkhas pas mthong na yid 'phrog par gyur to/ /gnyis pa ni/ sdom gsum kha skong bstan bcos che mdzad nas/ /yun ring las tshe bstan pa'i byi dor la/ /g.yel ba ma byed ces pa'i lung bstan dang / /bstan pa rnam par dag mdzad phyag 'tshal lo/ /zhes te/ de yang gser gling du sdom gsum kha skong mdzad nas rtsom 'phro la yun ring po zhig las pa'i tshe/ nub cig mnal lam du sems dpa' chen po byon nas/ bstan pa'i byi dor la g.yel ba ma byed ces gsungs pa dang / gdong bzhi pa mi dga' ba'i tshul bstan nas 'dug pa la ci yin gsungs pas/

bstan bcos 'dis 'phro mi rtsom pa gsungs/ de ltar na rje 'di nyid ni sdom gsum rab dbye'i bdag po lta bur gyur pas/ sdom gsum gyi phyogs la spyi don/ ṭīka chen/ sa bcad/ zab don bdud rtsi nying khu rtsa 'grel/ dris lan kha skong rang / de'i sa bcad dang phyogs snga ngos 'dzin/ gzhan yang de'i phyogs la gtogs pa/ nyi zla seṅge'i dris lan/ mus srad pa rdo rje rgyal mtshan gyi dris lan/ chos rje spyan tshab pa'i dris lan/ ldan ma shes rab seṅge'i dris lan la sogs pa/ mdor na sa skya paṇḍi ta'i bka' bsdu ba po lta bur gyur pa ni blo gzu bor gnas pa kun gyi mthong ba 'di yin no/ /gsum pa ni/ rigs lam gsal ba'i rigs pa'i bstan bcos chog rigs pa'i gtsug rgyan dgongs bzhin rigs bshad pa/ /rigs gter dgongs 'grel rigs gnas brtsams pa dang / /rigs mgon gdong bzhis rigs pas skyong phyag 'tshal/ /zhes te/ gser gling du bzhugs dus sde bdun mdo dang bcas pa'i dgongs pa tshul bzhin du 'grel ba tshad ma rigs pa'i gter gzhir bzhag pa'i tshad ma'i spyi don chen mo nyi ma me long rnga sgra zhes bya ba rtsom pa mdzad pa'i tshe/ nub cig mnal lam du/ dge slong blo rin pa dang gnyis kyi mi rtog ma dbyangs dang bcas pa 'then pas/ dpal mgon gdong bzhi pa 'khor dang bcas pa byon te gzigs mi nus pa tsam/ zhabs kyi pus mo man chad la ni theg gsum tsam 'dug 'khor rnams ni mtshon cha'i 'od lhag lhag zhabs lham gyi 'bur rnams ni 'od khrom khrom 'dug nas/ khyod kyi bstan bcos 'dis bdag nged tshos byed ces gsungs so/ /de ltar na don gyi 'gal 'grel gcod par byed pa ni rtog ge dang / mngon pa yin la/ de'i tshul gsal bar mdzad pa'i bstan bcos ni/ rnam 'grel gyi don/ rig gter gsal byed/ ṭīka chen/ sbyor ṭīka mngon pa 'og ma'i ngo mtshar gsum ldan rtsom 'phro/ gong ma'i ji snyed shes bya'i sgo 'byed/

'dul ba'i bslab bya/ mdo rtsa'i sa bcad la sogs pa sngon gzhan gyi spyod yul du ma gyur cing / legs par bshad pa'i chu bo 'dus pa dgos 'dod kyi nor bu 'byung ba'i gnas ni de dag go /gnyis pa rdo rje theg pa'i tshul gsal bar byas tshul la/ pha rgyud kyi phyogs gsal tshul/ rgyud sde gzhan gsal bar mdzad tshul lo/ /dang po ni/ rdo rje 'chang dngos 'da' bar dgongs pa'i tshe/ /ye shes zhabs lugs 'dzin pa'i sras mchog tu/ /lung bstan sems dpa' che la dbang zhus tshe/ /zangs dkar thugs dam gnang la phyag 'tshal lo/ /zhes te/ rje rdo rje 'chang sku mya ngan la 'da' kha ru rje btsun rin po che'i sku gcig bub 'dug pa bslangs pa dang / 'jam rdor gyi sku shin tu mtshar ba cig tu song / zhabs kyi mtho bong gcig ma tshang 'dug zhal 'gyur ba de nged rang la mi dga' ste/ ma 'ongs pa nga'i brgyud 'dzin cig gi 'jam rdor gyi srol 'byed par 'dug ces lung bstan pa de rje 'di nyid yin zhing / khyad par rje sems dpa' chen pos sa skya pa chen po zhal mngon sum du gzigs nas/ thog mar 'jam rdor gyi dbang zhus gsungs ba de rje 'di nyid la bkas gnang / de dus gsang 'dus 'jam rdor gyi dbang gnang ba zhu zhus pas/ da res stabs mi 'grig pa 'dug 'di la rdzong ba gyis gsungs nas zangs dkar lo tsā ba'i thugs dam 'jam rdor gyi rag sku shin tu thugs rtsis che ba de gnang nas/ 'jam rdor gyi bdag por dbang bskur ba yin zhes rje nyid kyi rab 'byams pa sangs rgyas 'phel la sogs pa la 'jam rdor gyi dbang bskur ba'i tshe gsungs pas na/ pha rgyud mtha' dag gi bdag por gyur pas na/ de'i gsal byed/ 'jam rdor gyi bsgrub dkyil/ gtor chog maṇḍal/ mchod chog rnam bshad/ spyan ras gzigs kyi mi 'dra ba'i khyad par/ rim lnga'i khrid yig gsang 'dus rtsod spong / 'jigs byed kyi mngon dkyil/ spros med rgyun gyi nyams len la sogs pa so so'i bshad srol dang mi 'gal zhing /

gdams pa'i gnad ma 'phyugs par gyur pa ni mngon sum du gyur pa'o/ /gnyis pa ni/ rgyud kyi brgyud pa'i brda 'grol nges pa yis/ /dpal ster dpal la dbang 'byor nyid la ni/ /gshin rje grags kyi grags pa'i sku 'dra yis/ /ye shes pa des gdams la phyag 'tshal lo/ /zhes ste/ de yang sa skyar lan snga ma phebs dus/ stong thun sa bcad kyi mjug na/ bla med phyogs ni ris bsgyur mig bcas pa/ /zhes sogs tshig bcad brdas bcings pa gsum bzhi yod pa la/ tshig bcad dang po'i don 'grel pa yang mang du yod cing / gnyis pa man chad kyi don 'grol mkhan med par gyur pa na/ bdag chen blo gros pas 'di dag gi don gang yin gsungs dri ba mdzad pa dang / rgyu mtshan 'bul rgyu ma byung pa las/ de'i nub nas bla brang shar na bzhugs pa'i rje btsun rin po che'i dngos slob sna ro bande gshin rje grags kyi bzhengs pa'i rje btsun gyi sku 'dra byin rlabs can de'i drung du mchod pa bsham nas gsol ba drag tu btab pas/ nyin cig thugs la rang dgar de dag gi don shar te/ tshigs su bcad pa de dag gi don 'grol pa brda 'grol nges pa'i dpal ster zhes bya ba'i bstan bcos brtsams/ des mtshon nas rje btsun gong ma rnams kyi gsung rab kyi dgongs pa gang 'grel kyang / de dag gi mngon sum du gdams par mdzad pa'i bstan bcos so/ /lam 'bras chos 'byung gi kha skong / snang ba gsum gyi dogs gcod gnyis/ a seng ma'i bshad pa/ lus dkyil gyi bshad pa/ rdo rje'i tshig rkang gi sa bcad rtsom 'phro/ lam dus kyi dbang gso ba dang bskur tshul/ bir bsrung thun mong ma yin pa'i byin rlabs bya tshul sogs gsung ngag gi thun mong ma yin pa rnams dang / mngon rtogs tshul bcu bzhi'i ngag 'don maṇḍal mchod chog bdag med ma'i bsgrub dkyil/ kyai rdor rnam bshad/ smon lam dbang bzhi ma/ mtsho skyes phra mig sambu ṭī'i gsal byed/

dbang chu'i sa chog dang rnam bshad/ gur rigs bsdus kyi bsgrub dkyil/ sambu ṭī'i dka' gnad kyi sa bcad la sogs pa/ kyai rdo rje'i rgyud gsum dang 'brel ba'i yig bskor rnams dang / bde mchog lū nag gi mngon rtogs/ nag po rim bzhi/ rnal 'byor ma'i yig bskor/ lū hi pa'i rnam bshad/ bde mchog chos 'byung la sogs pa bde mchog gi chos bskor rnams dang / ngan song sbyong rgyud kyi ṭīkka/ kun rig rtsod spong / sbyin sreg la sogs pa rnal 'byor rgyud kyi chos bskor rnams dang / arga'i cho ga thugs rje chen po'i gzhung bzhi nyams su len tshul la sogs pa spyod rgyud dang / bya rgyud kyi phyogs su gtogs pa ste mdor na rgyud sde bzhi dang 'brel ba'i bstan bcos ji snyed mdzad pa ni/ rgyud kyi rtsa ba bshad pa'i yal gas mdzes shing / man ngag gi me tog rab tu rgyas pa skal ldan gyi gdul bya 'bras bu la spyod pa'i dpag bsam gyi shing lta bu'i rje btsun sa skya pa rnams kyi bstan pa'i 'dzin ma kun du khyab par mdzad do/ /gsum pa thugs dag pa mkhyen brtse nus gsum gyi rnam thar la/ nus pa'i stobs kyi bdud rnams bcom tshul/ mkhyen pa'i stobs kyi ston par gyur tshul/ brtse ba'i stobs kyi gzhan don mdzad tshul lo/ /dang po la gdug pa can btul tshul/ bdud bzhi bcom tshul/ bar chad las grol tshul lo/ /dang po la khro phur btul tshul/ sde chen du btul tshul lo/ /dang po ni/ khro phur g.yu 'bar tsha gsum dam la btags/ /rig pa'i dbang phyug sngon gyi mkhas rnams las/ /nus pa che ba'i grags pa legs thob pa'i/ /phul byung mthu stobs ldan la phyag 'tshal lo/ /zhes te/ khro phur sngon mkhan chen g.yag pa dang / mkhyen rab dbang phyug la sogs pas chos bar mdzad dus bar chad kyi mtshan ma mang du byung ba la/ rje 'dis chos bar gang mdzad kyang / rgyal po g.yu phreng ba 'bar ra ba/ tsha tshi ma gsum dam la btags nas 'byon pa'i tshe bskyel bsu dang /

bzhugs dus mthun rkyen 'ba' zhig byed pas na thams cad kyi nus pa phul du phyin par rtogs so/ /gnyis pa ni/ sde chen 'chum gyi chos sder phebs pa'i tshe/ /gal spyang bsu bas legs bsdu mnal lam du/ /bar chad med pa'i dam bca' nod gyur te/ /sde brgyad bran du bkol la phyag 'tshal lo/ /zhes te/ 'chum sde chen du lam 'bras gsung du 'byon dus/ rta nag phu'i chu tshan khar nub cig mnal lam du/ gal spyang gi bsu ba byas/ phyag phul/ ras yug dkar po kha tshar gnyis ma tshang ba zhig phyag rten la phul te bar chad mi byed pa'i dam bca' byas pas sde brgyad la dbang 'byor pa yin no/ /gnyis pa bdud bcom pa'i tshul la bzhi las/ dang po phung po'i bdud bcom pa'i tshul la/ /phung po'i bdud ngo mdze yi btab pa'i tshe/ /bla ma lhag pa'i lha yi byin rlabs dang / /nyid kyi rtsod pas de nyid bzlog byas nas/ /nus pa'i grags pa thob la phyag 'tshal lo/ /zhes te/ phung po'i bdud ni/ sngon gyi las nyon gyi 'phangs pa'i zag bcas nyer len gyi phung po yin la/ de yi ngo bo mdze yi btab pa'i tshe/ /bla ma dang lhag pa'i lha gshin rje gshed kyi dbang bskur ba'i byin rlabs dang / rje nyid kyi zhal 'don gyi stobs kyi grol ba ni gong du bshad zin to/ /gnyis pa nyon mongs pa'i bdud bcom pa'i tshul ni/ nyon mongs bdud ngo glo rnag gi btses tshe/ /dbyer med zung 'jug rgya yi sangs rgyas nas/ /nyams myong tshad mas rang rgyud grol mdzad pa'i/ /man ngag tshad du gyur la phyag 'tshal lo/ /zhes te/ de yang skyid tshal du nyon mongs pa'i bdud ni/ sems rgyud rab tu ma zhi bar byed pa'i nus pa ste/ rtsa ba dug gsum las byung ba yin la/ de yang gti mug las klu gdon gyi rtsa ba glo rnag 'byung zhing / de'i gnyen po zung 'jug la zung 'jug gis rgyas btab nas 'khor 'das dbyer med bzhin bsgom pas grol nas tshad ma bzhi'i go rim gyi nang nas tshad mar song ba'i go rim gyi thog ma nyams myong tshad ma rgyud la skyes te/

tshad ma gzhan gsum yang tshad mar song ba zhes bya ba'i don to/ /gsum pa 'chi bdag gi bdud bcom pa'i tshul ni/ 'chi bdud chu yi ngogs su zhugs pa'i tshe/ /sa skya'i 'jam dbyangs bla ma'i gsung rab dang / /bstod pa gus pa'i sgo nas legs bton pas/ /mod la bzlog par gyur la phyag 'tshal lo/ /zhes te/ de yang chos rje dge ba rgyal mtshan pa'i drung du 'jigs byed rtog bdun gyi bshad bka'/ man ngag gi gnad 'ga' zhig dbus su gsan nas skyed tshal du 'byon lam rong chung gi 'phrang las chu gtsang po chen po la lhung nas de'i tshe 'bog khres kyi steng du rigs gter dang / rang 'grel pod khres zhig bsnams yod pas des bteg nas chu nang du 'khor gyin lus cig lus pa'i tshe/ bstod pa chos kyi rgyal po gus pa'i sgo nas zhal 'don gnang bas/ dum cig nas zla'o rnams byung ste thag pa btang nas 'thon no/ /de ltar 'chi bdag gi bdud ni rang dbang med par srog 'gag par byed pa yin la/ de 'dis mtshon nas bcom mo/ /bzhi pa lha'i bu'i bdud bcom tshul ni/ lha'i bu'i bdud ngo byad kha'i 'dres btses tshe/ 'jam dbyangs bla mas bstod pas bzlog byas nas/ /mi mthun phyogs kun nye bar zhi mdzad pa/ /'dod pa'i 'chings las grol la phyag 'tshal lo/ /zhes te/ de yang skyid tshal du kyai rdo rje'i gzhi bsnyen mdzad pas/ nyin gcig mi nag po shin tu che ba gcig gi skyid tshal gyi lho ri la btegs byas nas/ rje 'di pang du 'ub bsdus te tham tham song ba dang / bstod pa chos kyi rgyal po la zhal 'don gnang zhing / thugs kyi da khyod kyi nga za nus pa gyis shig dgongs nas yug cig song ba dang / lhod lhod btang byung / de nas khyod gang nas yin byas pas/ nga gu ge nas 'ong zer/ ci la 'ong gsungs pas/ ma 'ongs pa na khyod la ngor pa'i bstan 'dzin cig 'ong pa 'dug gu ge'i nor drag tshad glo bos khyer/ de rnams ngor pa kun dga' bzang po la phul/

khong la ni brlags blta ma nus/ khyod la bar chad cig byed nus sam bsam nas 'ong te/ khyod ni 'jigs so zer nas mi mngon par song / de nas lta ba la mnyam par bzhag gsungs so/ /lha'i bu'i bdud ni/ bdud gzhan gsum las 'da' ba la bar du gcod byed yin la/ de ni 'di kho nas bcom mo/ /gsum pa bar chad las grol ba'i tshul ni/ phyi rol 'byung po'i bdud kyi gtses pa'i tshe/ /de nyid bzlog phyir thugs dam la bzhugs pas/ /'phrin las lha mos grol ba'i mtshan ma dag /mnal lam ngang du bstan la phyag 'tshal lo/ /zhes te/ de yang dgung lo nga dgu bzhes pa'i tshe/ 'byung po chen pos bar chad rtsom par chas pa na/ de bzlog pa'i phyir thugs dam mdzad pas/ nub cig mnal lam du yum yin snyam pa'i bud med gcig byung nas/ sgrol ma thon zer ro/ /de la thugs ma ches pa slar yang thugs dam gyi brtson pa mdzad pas/ rje nyid rang gi mdzad pa'i sgrol ma'i bstod pa dngos grub rgya mtsho nam mkha' 'ur 'ur 'dug go /de la yang thugs ma ches pa brtson pa bskyed pas/ mnal lam du rje btsun ma 'phags ma sgrol ma ljang khu/ g.yas na rje btsun grags pa rgyal mtshan dang / g.yon na gnyan phul byung pa gtsug tor rgyal po bzhugs pa dang bcas pas sgrol ma 'thon/ da lan gyi bar chad 'dis sel/ lo 'khor ma gcig gi khag thag pa byed do gsungs gin 'dug pa na/ sngar yang zhal bzhi pa yin zer ba cig la 'khrul byung bas ci 'dra yin nam dgongs nas/ man ngag thun mong ma yin pa las byung ba'i brda dang brda'i lan mdzad pas yang dag ma kho na yin pa 'dug gsungs so/ /gnyis pa mkhyen pa'i stobs kyi ston par gyur pa'i tshul ni/ de ltar phyi nang gsang ba'i bdud dpung rnams/ /legs bcom yon tan kun gyi mdzod ldan pas/ /grags chen sangs rgyas gnyis par legs grags nas/ /ston pa gnyis par gyur la phyag 'tshal lo/ /zhes te/ de ltar na phyi nang gsang gsum gyi bdud dpung rnams bcom pas spangs phun tshogs dang /

bstan pa'i 'dzin skyong gong du smos pa bzhin mdzad pas ye shes phun tshogs dang ldan pa'i phyir/ grags chen gyi sangs rgyas gnyis par 'dzam gling yongs la grags te/ bdag rnams la ni ston pa gnyis pa lta bur gyur to/ /zhes pa'i don to/ /gsum pa brtse ba'i stobs kyi gzhan don mdzad pa'i tshul la/ 'phrin las kyi lhag mdzad tshul/ zhing gzhan du 'phrin las che bar dgongs tshul/ zhing 'di'i 'phrin las rgyun mi chad pa'i rten 'brel bsgrigs tshul/ de dag gi don bsdu ba dang bzhi las/ dang po la chos kyi lhag rnams rdzogs par mdzad tshul/ smon lam rnam par dag pas 'tshams sbyar tshul/ gzhan don kho na'i dbang gi gshegs par byon tshul/ ngo mtshar gyi bltas bstan tshul/ zhing gzhan du gshegs pa'i mgo brtsams tshul lo/ /dang po ni/ nyid kyis gzhan gyi don la bzhud dgongs nas/ chos kyi lhag rnams bu chen so so la/ /legs gnang 'jig rten bde bar bya ba'i phyir/ /smon lam 'debs par bzhed la phyag 'tshal lo/ /zhes te/ de yang drug cu bzhes pa spre'u yi lo la chos kyi lhag ma rnams rdzogs par bya ba'i phyir/ thub bstan du thugs kyi sras rnams la gsung ngag dbang gong ma'i khrid dang bcas pa/ gzhung bshad sras don ma rnams gnang / rgya mkhar du phebs chos rje sangs rgyas rin chen pa la chos kyi lhag ma rnams rdzogs par gnang / ston e waṃ du phebs chos rje dkon mchog 'phel ba la chos kyi lhag ma rnams dang / khyad par mgon po gdong bzhi pa'i rjes gnang chig brgyud ma gnang ba'i dus tshes brgyad yin pa la/ gnang grab mdzad pas cung zad 'tshub nas/ tshes bcu bzhi'i bar bskang ba mdzad nas de'i nyin yongs su rdzogs pa gnang ste chos bdag po la 'phrod pa lta bu mdzad/ dgun sa skyar phebs bdag chen bsod nams rgyal mtshan pa dang / rab 'byams pa mgon po dbang phyug pa la sogs pa bu chen rnams la chos kyi 'phro rnams rang rang sar rdzogs par mdzad cing /
