'jig rten gyi 'khrug long rnams nye bar zhi bar bya ba'i phyir/ smon lam 'debs par dgongs te gdan sar phyags phebs par bzhed do/ /gnyis pa la/ de la bar chad cung zad byung tshul/ bar chad la grol te thugs dgongs bzhin grub pa'i tshul lo/ /dang po ni/ bshes gnyen 'ga' yi snying la mi bzod phyir/ /de 'gog sbyor ba dpag yas byas gyur kyang / /mkha' 'gro chos skyong rnams kyi legs bsu ste/ /slob ma'i tshogs bcas byon la phyag 'tshal lo/ /zhes te/ de yang sngar rje nyid dpon slob 'ga' zung cig gdan sar phebs nas dkar me dang / gtor ma 'bul ba la sogs pa mdzad dgongs pa na/ sa skya nas dpon chen bka' bgros pa dang bcas pas gdan 'dren tu dpon slob tshang ma phebs dgos zer ba byung dus/ bstan 'dzin du rloms pa 'ga' zhig gi snying la ma bzod par nas de 'gog pa'i sbyor ba sde bdag chen po rnams bcu bdun pa la sogs pa'i thabs dpag tu med pa byas kyang / mkha' 'gro chos skyong rnams kyi legs par bsus te/ hor zla bcu gcig pa'i tshes bcu gcig la gdan sar phebs so/ /gnyis pa la smon lam mdzad tshul/ 'phrin las bsgos tshul gnyis las/ dang po ni/ 'jam dbyangs ngo bo'i drung gi gtso mdzad sar/ /rnam dag dkar me'i phreng ba bgrang yas par/ /'phags pa'i dge 'dun stong phrag gnyis lhag la/ /rin chen gser gyi mchod la phyag 'tshal lo/ /zhes te/ de yang sa skya paṇḍi ta'i dus chen bcu bzhi'i nyin sa skya'i 'jam dbyangs gzi 'od 'bar gyi gtso mdzad pa'i rten gsum rnams la bla brang so sor dkar me'i phreng ba bgrangs ba las 'das pa sbar nas/ dbu rtse rnying mar gzhi byes kyi dge 'dun stong phrag gnyis lhag tsam la mang ja/ brgyad bar du gser ngo bo sgor mo zho re'i 'gyed bcas/ bdag chen pa la 'bul ba shin tu che ba dang / sdug 'phongs rnams la yang sbyin gtong dpag tu med pa mdzad de smon lam rnam par dag pa dang /

khyad par 'jam dbyangs kyi drung du zla ba gnyis kyi bar la dkar me nyi shu lhag tsam 'khor yug tu phul zhing / bla brang so sor yang de ltar mdzad nas/ thugs skabs dang smon lam byon/ 'jig rten bde zhing lo legs dang / /zhes sogs 'jig rten gyi khams 'di la dgongs pa'i smon lam dang / bstan pa'i sbyin bdag nang so nor bu bzang po/ dpon drung g.yung pa/ rgyal mkhar nang so nam mkha' tshe rgyal/ mus pa nang so nam mkha' rgyal mtshan/ rin chen rtse pa'i nang pa gsol dpon sku mched la sogs pa sku gshegs pa rnams la dgongs pa'i smon lam mdzad/ sa skyong don grub rdo rje dpon blon/ mi dbang nam mkha' rdo rje dpon blon dang / /chos kyi rgyal po a seng rdo rje brtan pa sku mched/ dpal sa skya'i gdung brgyud dri ma med pa rtse gdong nas bdag po chen po nam mkha' bkra shis rgyal mtshan dpal bzang po la sogs pa dpal ldan sa skya pa'i bstan pa stobs kyi 'dzin pa'i mi'i dbang po rnams kyi sku tshe dang chab srid 'jam dar che ba'i smon lam dang / khyad par dus kyi 'khrug pa zhi ba'i smon lam dpag tu med pa gnang ngo / /gnyis pa ni/ rjes 'jug bar chad g.yul las rgyal phyir dang / /dgongs pa'i lhag ma'i rten gsum grub phyir dang / /gong ma'i rnam thar 'dzin par bya ba'i phyir/ /gtor bsgrub dus su mdzad la phyag 'tshal lo/ /zhes te/ de yang lha sa dang / kha'ur phyags phebs dus ma gtogs/ gzhan gang bzhugs kyi bar la bse 'bag gi drung du gtor ma theng bcu gcig ma/ shing mgon gyi drung du gsum ma/ gzhan bzhi thog gi gsang ba'i mgon khang / 'cham sku chen mo dang rta thog ma gnyis/ 'phags pa'i mgon khang / pu tra/ gung gi mgon khang / rin chen sgang gi mgon khang / zur khang / bla brang shar/ rdzong chung la sogs pa'i mgon po rnams la gnang chags kyi gtor ma phul te bka' bsgos pa'i tshul ni/ rjes 'jug rnams bar chad kyi g.yul las rgyal ba'i dang /

spyir rje nyid kyi rje rdo rje 'chang yab sras kyi thugs dgongs rdzogs par bya ba'i phyir/ gsung ngag brgyud pa'i bris sku thog tshad ma bcu tsam dang / gzhan yang thub pa'i gos thang / mgon po'i gos thang / byams pa dang bde ba can gyi zhing bkod/ grub chen brgyad cu rtsa bzhi la sogs pa bris sku'i tshogs rab tu mang po dang / sa skya bka' 'bum/ rje rdo rje 'chang dang sems dpa' chen po'i bka' 'bum sogs gsung gi rten rab tu mang po dang / khyad par bstan pa'i sbyin bdag a seng rdo rje brtan pas phul ba'i gsung ngag brgyud pa'i gser sku mgon po dang bcas pa la nyi shu rtsa lnga/ bstan pa'i sbyin bdag don grub rdo rjes phul ba'i rdo rje phreng ba/ kṛ ya'i dkyil 'khor gsum mgon dang bcas pas bris sku bzhi bcu zhe drug la sogs pa rnams la zhal kheb/ gong gsham/ lag so sos bzhugs gdan nam bza' dang bcas pa 'bul bar mdzad de/ dgongs pa'i gtso bo'i rten gsum rnams grub mod kyi/ dgongs pa'i lhag bstan pa'i gtso bo'i 'od dpag med kyi gser sku gang rung cig grub pa'i phyir dang / grub chen buddha la sogs pas kyang sku mya ngan las 'da' khar gtor bsgrub dus gcig char du mang po 'bul bar mdzad pas na/ bla ma gong ma'i rnam thar 'dzin pa'i phyir gtor bsgrub dang bka' bsgo de ltar mdzad pa yin no/ /gsum pa gzhan don kho na'i dbang gi gshegs par 'byon pa'i tshul ni/ de nas gzhan don dgongs pa'i dbang gi ni/ /lha rgyal rdzong du slob ma'i tshogs phebs nas/ /dam chos bdud rtsi dpal la rol pa'i tshe/ /gdan 'dren mtshan ma byung la phyag 'tshal lo/ /zhes te/ de la hor zla bcu pa la khro phur phyags phebs te zla phogs gcig bzhes nas zla phyed bzhugs/ hor zla bcu gcig pa la gdan sar phebs/ bya lo zla ba dang po'i tshes bcu dgu yan bzhugs nas/ zla mjug la khro phur phebs te smon lam gnang nas/

thub bstan du sku gshegs pa'i thugs dgongs gtad 'dug kyang / bstan pa'i sbyin bdag bo dong nang sos gdan 'dren nan ches pa la rten nas/ gzhan don kho na'i dbang gi zla ba dang po'i tshes bcu gcig la lha rgyal rdzong du phebs/ bcu gsum nas gsung chos tshugs te/ gsung chos rgyun mar gsung pa'i tshe/ zhing gzhan du gdan 'dren pa'i mtshan ma yod tshod 'dug pas/ rta so pa 'ong gin 'dug bltos dang gsungs spyan nam mkha' la hur hur yang yang du gzigs pa mdzad do/ /bzhi pa ngo mtshar ba'i ltas bstan tshul la/ phyi rol du bstan tshul dang / gsung gi bstan tshul gnyis las/ dang po ni/ de tshe 'ja' 'od gur dang nyi ma'i 'od/ /skye dgu'i snying gi dpal bskyed byung ba dang / /'da' ba'i tshul ston dgongs pa la bzhag nas/ /don gyi zhal gyi bzhes la phyag 'tshal lo/ /zhes te/ de yang tshes bco brgyad dang bcu dgu gnyis la 'ja' ris kyi tshogs sngon ma mthong ba bsam gyi mi khyab pa dang / nyi ma'i 'od shin tu dro zhing gzhung gi 'khyag pa la sogs pa rnams kyang bzhu te dpyid tsha ba'i dus lta bur gyur pa na/ spyan nam mkha' la gzigs nas dpal ldan sa skya pa'i bstan 'dzin ngor pa yin pa zhig sku gshegs pa'i ltas su 'dug gsungs/ a ta ku re yin gzhan 'dra 'chi ba yin las che zhes sogs dang / ma 'ongs pa'i lung bstan brjod kyi mi lang ba gsung chos gsungs ba bor nas gsungs te mjug tu shes na bde bar gshegs pa'i bslab bya tshar gcig yin zhes gsungs nas nang du thegs so/ /gnyis pa chos kyi sdom bzhi bstan tshul/ zhing 'di'i mdzad pa tshar tshul gnyis las/ dang po ni/ chos kyi sdom bzhi nye bar bstan pa'i mthus/ /dngos 'dzin ma lus bshig par dgongs nas ni/ /de don rtogs phyir mngon pa phar phyin dang / /dka' 'grel tshig 'tshams bzhag la phyag 'tshal lo/ /zhes te/ chos kyi sdom bzhi ni/ 'dus byas mi rtag pa/ zag bcas sdug bsngal ba/

chos thams cad bdag med pa/ mya ngan las 'das pa zhi ba yin la/ des dngos 'dzin ma lus pa bshig pa'i tshul ni/ chos dbyings bstod par/ mi rtag sdug bsngal stong pa zhes/ /bya ba gsum pos sems sbyong byed/ /mchog tu sems ni sbyong byed pa'i/ /chos ni rang bzhin med pa yin/ /zhes gsungs pas/ de'i don bstan pa'i phyir mngon pa kun btus kyi mtshan nyid kun las btus pa 'dus byas mi rtag par bshad pa dang / rnam shes kun 'dus su zag bcas sdug bsngal bar bshad pa'i skabs su tshig mtshams mdzad/ phar phyin du skabs lnga par/ 'gog pa med pa'i rang bzhin la/ /zhes sogs su tshig mtshams mdzad/ dka' 'grel du skabs gnyis pa gtan la dbab pa bsdu ba'i lugs kyi mthong lam 'chad par tshig mtshams mdzad pa yin no/ /gnyis pa ni/ zhing 'di'i gdul bya'i don kun rdzogs pa dang / /zhing gzhan gdul bya'i re ba bskangs ba dang / /skal dman mig gi lam du mi snang bar/ /bstan phyir tshad ma'i tshig mtshams bstan phyag 'tshal/ /zhes te/ rnam 'grel gyi yid sngon 'chad pa'i/ /de phyir long bas mthong ba min/ /zhes dang / phyi dro'i gzhung 'tshams/ gsal ba'i rnam pas dbyen phyir ro/ /zhes par gzhung mtshams mdzad pa'i dgongs pa ni rtsa ba rtogs nus so/ /lnga pa zhing gzhan du gshegs pa'i mgo brtsams tshul ni/ de nas snyung ba'i tshul bstan 'da' bar dgongs/ /bde ba can du gshegs par zhal bzhes te/ /bdag 'dzin bshig phyir gzim mal du bzhugs nas/ /dpag yas mtshan ma bstan la phyag 'tshal lo/ /zhes te/ nyi shu'i snga dro snyung ba'i tshul bstan nas phyi dro gzim mal du bzhugs pa na/ ga zi kun dga' ye shes phyag rtsa bltas pas ser ma g.yogs 'dug zhus pas/ nad 'di las mi thar/ rang lo re'i steng du kyai rdor man ngag lugs kyi dbang re thob/ lo bcu gsum pa la chos rje rgyal mtshan bzang po pas gnang / nyer lnga pa la rje rdo rje 'chang gi gnang / so bdun pa la rje sems dpa' chen po gnang /

zhe dgu pa la chos rje kun dga' dbang phyug pa la zhus/ da lo yang drug cu re gcig 'gro ste/ dbang zhu ba'i yul mi yul na mi 'dug bde ba can na rje bla ma yab sras bzhugs/ de'i drung du e skye yin gsungs/ de'i srod thugs dam gtor bsngo la sogs pa rdzogs par mdzad rjes/ dge rgan shes rab rgyal mtshan la sang tshes grangs du yin gsungs/ nyer cig lags zhus pas/ chos rje kun dga' dbang phyug pa yang gsungs/ de nas mnal la cung zad cig song ba dang / rmi lam ya mtshan/ rta sga gtad gcig dang / rta pa gsum 'dug gcig sa skya nas 'ong pa'i mgon po che ba/ gcig kha'u nas 'ong pa'i mgon po gdong bzhi pa/ gcig bya rgod gshong nas 'ong pa'i rnam sras mdung dmar can yin zer/ de'i zhor la rtse gdong nas btang pa'i mi gsum gyi bsrung mdud mang rab zhus song gsungs so/ /gnyis pa zhing gzhan du 'phrin las rgya che bar dgongs tshul la/ ji ltar gshegs pa'i tshul/ ngo mtshar ba'i mtshan mas spras pa'i tshul gnyis las/ dang po ni/ cho 'phrul zla ba'i nyer gcig nyi shar dus/ /mgon khyod mgon po mya ngan 'das gzim ltar/ /'dod pa'i phyogs su yan lag mchog bstan nas/ /bde ba can du gshegs la phyag 'tshal lo/ /de tshe zhal ras padma ra ga yis/ /lhun po ltar brjid nyes pa'i rdul dang bral/ /byams dang snying rjes spyan ras nyi zla'i mdzes/ /'dzum mdangs dge 'od 'phro la phyag 'tshal lo/ /zhes te/ de yang nyi shu gcig gi snga dro'i phyi'i thugs dam gzhan rnams dang / gtor ma 'bul ba'i bar du mdzad/ rnal 'byor ma'i thugs dam ma mdzad par nyi ma shar rgyang tsam du song song bzhugs/ de nas shes rab rgyal mtshan gyi pang du dbu bcug mgon po mya ngan 'das gzim ltar du mdzad de rnal 'byor ma'i 'pho ba mdzad nas bde ba can du gshegs so/ /'di la ni rje nyid dbang 'byor pa yin te/ rje sems dpa' chen po'i sku sder cig bzhengs nas gzungs bzhugs mdzad pa na/

gdung tsha spyan ras gzigs dngul ma cig bzhugs su a nus gsol bas/ dbu'i thad du rdol ba dang 'jigs pa na/ mi lto ma 'ongs pa na 'pho ba theb pa'i snga ltas yin gsungs ba dang / nub gcig 'pho ba sbyongs bar mdzad pa na/ rlung sku stod du brdzes nas 'pho la khad du gyur pa na/ rje nyid kyi dmigs pa glod kyang rlung ma phebs par zhal 'grul pa la sogs pa byed dgos byung 'dug pas so/ /de ltar sku gshegs pa'i tshe zhal ras shin tu dmar zhing / rlung la sogs pa ma gos par/ /spyan gnyis ni dkar nag shin tu 'bye shing 'dzum la/ zhal mchu'i sgros dang bcas pa ni lhag par 'dzum ste/ 'od dang 'od zer rab tu 'phro ba'i sgo nas bzhugs pa ni drung na yod pa thams cad kyi mngon sum du gyur pa de yin no/ /gnyis pa ni/ de nas bzung ste spur sbyangs ma tshar bar/ /rin chen me tog mkha' la 'ja' ris dang / /bstan bsrung rgya mtshos bsrung ba'i mtshan ma dang / /ngo mtshar bdun ldan khyod la phyag 'tshal lo/ /zhes te/ de nas nyer gnyis kyi snga dro spur rtags byung nas/ nyer gsum gyi nub spur spyan drangs te nyer lnga'i tho rang thub bstan du phebs/ de'i nyin bzhu 'bul ba'i grab byas pas/ dus la ma babs pa dang / rje ngor pa yang phyags ma phebs pa la brten/ bla brang nang gi mgon po'i sku 'dra rnams kyi mi dgyes pa'i mtshan ma byung nas the tshom zos te sbyong bar ma nus/ hor zla brgyad pa'i bar du bzhugs su gsol/ de'i bar la gsol 'debs kyi mdzad 'phrin dang / rje nyid kyi dgongs pa dang mthun par ston pa'i gser sku rgya mtho bcu bdun yod pa nang rten du dmigs nas bzhengs pa dang / thang sku rje nyid kyi sku 'dra gtsug lag khang gi thog tshad ma dang / gzim mal gser sku dang / de dag bzhugs pa'i gtsug lag khang dang bcas pa grub ste thams cad bar chad med par rje ngor pas zhal bkod dang gzungs bzhugs rab gnas la sogs pa gang dgos kyi mthun rkyen thams cad tshang bar mdzad pas byin rlabs kyi dpal 'bar bar yin la/

de'i bar la gang gi mdzad 'phrin rnams kyang bstan bsrung rnams kyi legs par mdzad pa dang / sku gdung drung du'ang bsrung ba'i mtshan ma dang / nam mkha' la sngon ma mthong ba'i 'ja' ris babs legs dang / gdugs dang / rgyal mtshan 'dra ba bsam gyi mi khyab pa'i bkod pa dang / lha rnams kyi me tog sil ma'i char sna tshogs pa rgyun mi chad 'bebs pa dang / gang dgos kyi bzo ris pa dang mthun rkyen rnams kyang dus mnyam du 'bad rtsol mi dgos par ngang gi 'du ba dang / sngar ma dad pa rnams kyang dad gus thun mong ma yin pa brnyed pa sogs kyi mngon du gyur pa de yin no/ /gnyis pa ni/ ye shes me yi bzhu la phul ba'i tshe/ /gdab bya dngos byon 'debs byed du mas gang / /bstan pa spel phyir thub pa'i thugs khar bzhugs/ /'phrin las rgyun mi chad la phyag 'tshal lo/ /zhes te/ hor zla brgyad pa'i nyer gcig gi tho rangs kyi cha la rje ngor pas spur bzhu phul te/ de dus ston sad byung gis dogs nas grong pa rnams 'jigs pa na/ de'i nyin nas nam mkha' 'khor zhing char gzim bu shin tu nyams dga' ba babs te ngo mtshar bar gyur cing / rigs kyi bdag po gdab par bya ba dbu ril por byon nas/ de'i nang du 'dis 'debs par byed pa'i rigs bdag bcom ldan 'das gshin rje gshed dang / rnal 'byor ma dngos su byon pa'i lha tshogs kyi gang bar gyur pa nang rten ston pa'i thugs khar bstan pa rin po che spel ba'i slad du bzhugs su gsol/ gzhan yang sku gdung rnams ring bsrel dang / gdung log dang / yig 'bru'i tshogs dpag tu med pa byon zhing / byin che ba rje ngor pas mi yar bar bya ba'i phyir dang / bla ma gong ma rnams kyi phyag bzhes bzhin du dad ldan so so la dad pa'i rten du bsod nams spel ba'i phyir rje btsun 'jam dbyangs kyi sku btab pa khri tsho bzhi lhag tsam dang / nang rten gyi gzungs bzhugs tshul du gdung tsha khri tsho lhag tsam dang bcas pa gser gyi legs par brgyan te grub par mdzad pa dang /

lhag ma rnams kyang yar gyi dogs nas phye mar btang ste ril bu bzos nas rten sgam gyi nang du bzhugs su gsol bas/ phyag bzhes rnam par dag pa'i sgo nas rje bla ma'i dgongs pa rdzogs par mdzad pa ni mthun snang du grub pa de yin no/ /nang rten gyi gzungs bzhugs ji ltar yod pa'i rim pa ni/ zhib par gzhan du bkod pa ltar yin zhing / rags rigs tsam smos na/ gtsug tor nang du gdung tsha byin rlabs can shin tu mang ba dang / dbu nang rigs lnga'i li sku lnga/ /rje yab sras kyi sku lder gnyis la sogs pa dang / mchu skor la sa paṇa gyi phyag phreng lung thang dang / thugs khar rje rdo rje 'chang gi na bza'/ rje sems dpa' chen po'i na bza'/ rje kun dga' dbang phyug pa'i na bza'/ rje nyid kyi sku char/ de'i mtha' bskor du zangs dkar lo tsā ba'i thugs dam/ rgyal sras thogs med kyi thugs dam sogs gser sku byin rlabs can mang po dang / gzhan yang rje nyid kyi gdung tshwa dang / gzungs rgyud sde bzhi dang mthun pa la sogs pas legs par gang bar mdzad de/ hor zla dgu pa'i tshes bcu la rab gnas la sogs pa'i sgo nas mthar phyin par mdzad do/ /bzhi pa don bsdu ba ni/ mdor na mang du smos pa ci dgos te/ /khyod kyi mtshan tsam yid la dran pas kyang / /gnas skabs mthar thug 'dod pa'i don stsol ba'i/ /yid bzhin nor bu khyod la phyag 'tshal lo/ /zhes te/ de ltar rnam par thar pa mang du brjod pa smos ci dgos/ khyed kyis mtshan tsam the tshom sgo nas yid la dran pas kyang ji ltar 'dod pa'i don thams cad grub pa yin te/ snying nas dad dam ji ltar dga' ba yi/ /the tshom gyis sam gzhan gyi ngor yang rung / /gang zhig thub dbang zla ba der phyag 'tshal/ /des ni lha yi bde ba phun tshogs thob/ /ces pa dang mtshungs pa'i phyir ro/ /gsum pa ji ltar brtsams pa'i tshul la/ yid 'byung gi sems gdung pa/ dad pas ngal bso thob pa/ shugs 'byung gi smon lam gdab pa/

rgyas par brjod mi nus pa/ mdor bsdus sgro bskur dang bral ba'i tshul lo/ /dang po la yid 'byung ba'i rgyu/ ji ltar 'byung ba'i tshul lo/ /dang po ni/ kye hud bstan pa'i nyi ma nub pa dang / /lta ngan 'byung bya'i mgo bo bteg pa dang / /rnam 'byed blo gros mun par gyur pa dang / /skal ngan mun pa'i dmag rum 'thib pa dang / /sgros ngan byang bus dgung tshigs gsal ba dang / /blo ngan skar ma'i dpung tshogs rgyas pa dang / /rab 'byams gzhung gi padmo zum pa dang / /dad ldan slob ma'i rkang 'thung skam pa dang / /rab dkar las 'bras zad pa mnyam du mdzad/ /ces smos te/ rje nyid sku gshegs kyang bde bar gshegs pa'i bstan pa lnga brgya pa phrag phyed dang gnyis tsam gnas pa'i phyir de lta bu'i tshul mi rigs so snyam na/ de nyid rje btsun rin po che sku gshegs pa na/ rje sa skya paṇḍi tas/ 'gro ba'i sgron ma mgon po chos kyi rje/ /lhar bcas skye bo kun gyi mig gcig po/ /'jig tshogs lta ba'i ri bo rab bsnyil nas/ /mya ngan 'das pa dam pa'i dbyings su zhi/ /don mthun dge legs nor bu rin chen gling / /sems pas 'jug pa dag pa'i lam bstan te/ /ded dpon rgyal po gru chen 'dzin pa'i gtso/ /ded dpon dam pa zhi ba gling du gshegs/ /thabs tshogs chu 'dzin shes rab glog 'gyu ba/ /dgongs pa dag pa'i mkha' la nyer 'dus nas/ /gdul bya'i lo thog rgyas mdzad char sprin de/ /mya ngan 'das shing nam mkha'i dbyings su deng / /mkhyen brtse'i 'od zer phyogs kun gsal mdzad pa/ /dam pa nyi ma 'gran zla med pa'i 'od/ /bdag tu blta ba'i rab rib kun bsal te/ /gdul bya'i ri la nye bar nub pa bstan/ /ye shes nyi ma chen po de/ /nub pas 'gro ba'i mig long ste/ /sangs rgyas 'gro la thugs rje yi/ /bstan pa dag kyang nub par phyogs/ /shin tu bdag la chags pa yi/ /skye bo rang bzo spyod rnams kyi/ /skyobs pa shākya seṅge yi/

/gsang sngags rgya mtsho rnam par dkrugs/ /smin pa dang ni grol ba dang / /'phrin las dang ni 'bras bu dang / /phyi dang nang gi rten 'brel yang / /ngan spyod rnams kyi log par spyad/ /zang zing bsnyen pa gtsor 'dzin pa/ /'khor dang grags pa bsgrub rnams kyi/ /rdo rje theg pa'i 'jug ngogs kyang / /thub pa'i gsung las log te 'jug /de lta bas na mkhas rnams kyi/ /shes par byos la brtson par gyis/ /bde bar gshegs pa'i bstan pa yang / /bud shing zad pa'i me ltar snang / /kyi hud bde bar gnas pa su/ /kye hud mya ngan su mi byed/ /kye hud log par lhung ba mtshar/ /thub pa thugs rje ci zhig kye/ /bdag tu 'dzin pa'i 'khrul 'khor gyi/ /'phangs pa'i rnam smin nges par myong / /sangs rgyas bstan pa 'gro ba'i mig /zum pa da lta mngon du gyur/ /'di la grogs dag ji ltar bsgrub/ /bsgrub par bya ba'i 'phrin las gang / /mig med grogs kyi rnam par spangs/ /lam yang rab tu 'khyams par gyur/ /the tshom dra ba rab tu dam/ /srid pa'i chu klung gting mtha' med/ /bdag tu 'dzin pa'i g.yang sa mang / /log lta'i ri bo bgrod par dka'/ /su zhig bdag cag rnams kyis skyabs/ /phyogs rnams mun par ma gyur tam/ /snying rjes non pa'i smre bsngags 'di/ /thugs rje mnga' bas gsan par rigs/ /su zhig skyobs pa med pa'i skyabs/ /su zhig dpung gnyen med pa'i gnyen/ /su zhig dman la thugs rje mnga'/ /de lta bu yi dgongs par rigs/ /de ltar bde bar gshegs pa'i bstan pa yang / /ston ka'i chu bzhin myur du bri ba dang / /sde snod 'dzin pa 'gro ba'i mig gyur pa/ /dam pa skye bo phal cher 'das pa na/ /bdag cag rnams kyi bgyi ba gang yin pa/ /sems dang ldan pa rnams kyi dpyod cig dang / /mi nyid thob pa'ang shin tu rnyed dka' bas/ /nyams pa med pa'i lam du 'jug par bya/ /zhes pa dang tshul mtshungs so/ /gnyis pa ji ltar 'byung ba'i tshul ni/

kye hud khyed ni thugs rje che ldan na/ /mya ngan khung du sdug bsngal zas dang ni/ /mchi ma'i btung bas 'tsho ba bdag sogs la/ /brtse ba med par gshegs pa 'di ci lags/ /kyi hud de tshe bdag gi lus sems rnams/ /sa la thim pa'i mkha' la yal byed pa'i/ /thabs dag khyed kyi dngos su mi 'doms par/ /'di 'dra'i bya ba mthong bar mdzad ci lags/ /kyi hud sems kyi glang po yan pa 'di/ /de tshe nyid kyi gsod par mi mdzad par/ /lus la snying po med pa'i gnas 'di ru/ /da dung snang ba'i zas la 'god ci lags/ /zhes te/ tshigs bcad dang pos lus kyi rnam 'gyur/ gnyis pas lus sems gnyis ka gsum pas lus sems lhan cig pa'i dbang du byas te bshad pa ste rtogs sla'o/ /gnyis pa dad pas ngal bso thob pa'i tshul ni/ de ltar na yang khyod zhabs bsten pa dang / /nyid sku'i dkyil 'khor sangs rgyas gcig bsdus pa'i/ /ngo bor bsgom byed zab la bstan pa'i mthu'i/ /yid kyi ngal bso thob par gyur pa lags/ /zhes so/ /gsum pa shugs 'byung du smon lam ni/ da dung khyed kyi thugs rje dri ma med/ /nyes bral dbyings kyi mkha' la legs bzhugs pas/ /dka' ba'i tshig dang don rnams ma lus pa/ /rmi lam du yang ston par mdzad gyur cig /ces so/ /bzhi pa rgyas par brjod mi nus pa ni/ gang khyod rnam par thar pa ma lus pa/ /shes bya ma lus shog bur gyur nas ni/ /kun mkhyen mkhyen pa'i pir gyi legs bris kyang / /skal pa grangs med gsum du'ang cha tsam yin/ /zhes pa'o/ /lnga pa mdor bsdus te sgro bkur dang bral ba'i tshul ni/ 'dir brjod 'di ni rgyas par brjod min yang / /rang blo la snang rang gi thos pa'i tshul/ /dad pas myur blang dad pas smras 'di la/ /brdzun tshig brdzun du gyur pa nyid dpang lags/ /zhes pa'o/ /gsum pa rtsom pa mthar phyin pa mjug gi don la/ brtsams pa'i dge ba bsngo ba/ byed pa po'i khyad par bstan pa'o/

/dang po la bstan pa la bya ba byed par bsngo ba/ legs bshad tshul bzhin du ston par bsngo ba/ 'di phyi gnyis kyi yon tan dang ldan par bsngo ba'o/ /dang po ni/ de skad bstod pa'i bsod nams 'di yi ni/ /yang dag bla ma dam pas rjes bzung ste/ /rgyal ba'i bstan la bya ba byed pa dang / /snyan brgyud gdams pa'i mdzod dang ldan par shog /ces pa'o/ /gnyis pa ni/ gnas skabs kun du khyed kyi legs bshad tshogs/ /skal ldan 'gro la tshul bzhin ston pa dang / /dri ma med pa'i gzhung lugs mtha' dag la/ /thogs med blo gros legs par rgyas par shog /ces so/ /gsum pa ni/ tshe 'dir rnam dag tshul khrims kyis mdzes shing / /thos bsam bsgom pas bya bas rgyud grol te/ /tshe 'di'i snang ba nub par gyur ma thag /khyed zhabs padmo gus pas len par shog /ces so/ /gnyis pa byed pa po'i khyad par ni/ zhes pa 'di ni rje 'di nyid la mi phyed pa'i dad pa dang ldan pa mnga' ris dol po'i char skyes pa'i btsun pa yon tan 'byung gnas zhes bya bas bris te/ skal ldan dad pa'i blo gros dang ldan pa rnams la dpyis phyin par byas nas 'bul lo zhes pa'o/ /zhes pa de rnams kyi kun mkhyen bsod nams seṅge'i rnam par thar pa dad pa rgya mtsho'i rlabs phreng rnam par g.yo ba zhes bya ba las ra ston yon tan 'byung gnas kyi mdzad pa'i rnam thar las 'byung tshul bshad pa'i skabs ste gsum pa'o// ༈ //bod yul bstan pa'i mnga' bdag sa skya pa'i/ /bzhed gzhung skyong mdzad mkhas grub mang byon yang / /thun mong min pa'i dgongs pa 'grel mkhas pa'i/ /kun mkhyen chos kyi rgyal po'i zhabs la 'dud/ /ces mchod par brjod nas/ spyi don bzhi pa rje de nyid kyi yig mkhan a'u gzhon nu bzang pos mdzad pa'i rnam thar las 'byung tshul bshad pa ni/ kun mkhyen bla ma mkhas pa'i dbang po de nyid kyi drung du lo bcu phrag gcig dang bdun gyi bar du rtsom yig rnams kyi phyag phyi zhus pa a'u gzhon nu bzang pos mdzad pa las 'di ltar 'byung ste/

dam pa de'i ngo mtshar ba'i rnam par thar pa rags rim tsam zhig sgro btags kyi dri ma ring du spangs te/ lo bcu bdun tsam gyi bar du phyag phyir 'brangs ste zhal nas thos pa dang / yid ches pa'i gang zag gzhan la yang dris te/ nges par 'byung ba rnams rjes 'jug gi gdul bya blo gsal ba 'ga' zhig gi rnam par thar pa rtsom pa'i rgyur 'gro ba'i ched du bdag gi 'di bzhin bkod pas/ 'di dag la yid ches kyi gnas su mdzad du gsol/ de la 'dir le'u gsum ste/ mdo khams na bzhugs ring gi rnam thar/ dbus gtsang du phebs nas gsan sbyong mdzad tshul/ bstan pa'i byi dor bshad nyan mdzad tshul dang gsum/ dang po ni/ bdag cag rnams kyi 'dren pa dam pa mdo sngags bstan pa'i mnga' bdag dpal ldan bla ma dam pa 'di nyid mdo khams kyi sa'i cha/ yul gyi dge brgyad dang ldan pa 'bom yul la che chung gnyis su yod pa'i 'bom chung zhes bya bar/ gdung rus rus tsha stod smad gnyis kyi stod pa/ mes po la dkon mchog skyabs zhes bya ba sgrol ma la thugs dam mdzad pa/ yab zhing skyabs stag lo pa/ mtshan brjod/ yi ge drug pa/ 'phags ma sgrol ma sogs kyi thugs dam la shin tu brtson pa/ yum rus 'bor tsha/ mtshan rgyal ba dman bya ba la yab zhang skyabs kyi khyim sor ma sleb gong du 'khrungs pa'i gcen bla ma ye shes rgyal mtshan/ yab yum gnyis ka gcig pa la gcen lha bzo pa brtson 'grus 'bum rnam dpyod kyi shes rab phul du phyin pa/ de 'og bla ma 'di nyid dgung rta sa mo bya/ gcung dge ma/ legs pa rgyal mtshan pa/ de 'og nam 'brug ste mchod lnga byon pa'i/ bla ma 'di nyid dgung lo drug pa la klog bslab/ de'i tshe klog dar gyi yi ge rnams kyi rnam pa me long la gzugs brnyan 'char ba bzhin byung / bslab pa'i dpe bzang po spyod pa'i/ bdag ni 'chi ba'i dus byed gyur pa na/ /zhes pa'i tshig de gzigs ma thag byams snying rje bsam gyi mi khyab pa 'khrungs shing /

'dus byas mi rtag pa'i don thugs la 'khrungs pas spyan chab kyi chu rgyun bsam gyi mi khyab pa g.yos pa yum gyi dgongs te ngo mtshar bar 'dzin pa dang / dgung lo brgyad pa la slob dpon kun dga' 'bum pa la dge tshul gyi sdom pa nod/ de nas dbu ma rtsa 'jug byams chos lnga/ sdom rig rnam 'grel sogs gzhung lugs chen po bcu bzhi tsam dang / g.yag ṭīka chen mo'i mkhyen gsum yan chad/ rong ṭīka rnams thugs la byang bar mdzad/ dbus pa rin blo ba la grub thob brgyad cu'i rjes gnang sogs chos kha yar gsan/ de'i tshe 'jam dbyangs kyi bsnyen pa cig mdzad pas mnal lam du/ ral gri shub bcas cig phyag tu 'dug pa shub nas phyung bas lung pa cig gi kha zhang dang mnyam pa gcig byung / ral gri de'i rtse la ri mo nag khyug pa cig 'dug pa snyam byed do/ /da lta'i gzhi nad 'di yong ba la lta ba 'dra/ ral gri de la dpags na da lta'i 'di bas kyang che ba cig yongs thang gsungs/ dgung lo bcu gsum pa'i steng du nyag re rgyal mtshan 'od zer ba la kyai rdor man ngag lugs kyi dbang gsan/ dbus gtsang la phebs khar gling spa spong gi yul du go bo rab 'byams pa shes rab dpal ba'i phyag phyir bla ma 'di dang bla ma slob dpon gzhan yang kha yar yod pa khong la byin rlabs zhu ba'i mi skya ser mang du 'tshogs/ khong khri thog tu 'byon dus bla ma 'di dang / slob dpon gzhan tsho la khyed rang tsho nga khri thog tu 'gro dus nga'i ber thul la 'jus khri thog tu nga dang mnyam por su sleb pa la nga dang mnyam pa yong ba yin gsungs/ bla ma 'di dang slob dpon gzhan tshos 'jus khroms kyi dkyil la byon pas khong dang mnyam du khri thog tu bla ma 'di min pa/ slob dpon gzhan tsho ma slebs/ de nas khong pas bla ma 'di la ji ltar yong gi mnal lam bzhag pas/ rgyab ri kha lho bstan nam shar bstan lta bu yod pa'i sar bla ma 'di la 'phrin las rgya chen po yong ba'i mnal lam byung zer khong gi lung bstan mdzad/

slob dpon bsam bzang pa dang / sbyin bzang pa gnyis la yang mdo phyogs kyi chos 'brel tshon re yod gsungs/ mdo khams su gser chos kyi po ti mang po la gzigs pa'i mnal lam yang yang byung / de dag la bltas pa'i tshig bcom ldan 'das ma he'i dbang po la phyag 'tshal lo/ /zer ba 'ba' zhig 'dug ste/ da lta nga rang gi 'jigs byed mngon dkyil rtsom pa 'di la lta ba 'dra gsungs pa dang / gzhan khams su bsdod ring la rmi lam yang bzang po kyang mang po rmis ba cig yod na'ang / dus phyis de tsam gyi rmi lam bzang po mang du mi yong ba 'dug gsungs/ de nas go bo rab 'byams pa shes rab dpal bzang pos rong ston chos rje'i drung du zhu yig dang / 'bul ba'i rnam grangs la bla ma 'di la rab 'byams kyi mtshan gsol te/ bla ma 'di nyid kyi thog drangs grwa pa/ ja sigs/ rin po che/ dung shin tu che ba/ dkar yol/ gos rta dre sogs phul te/ bar chad med par grub ste dpal na lend+ra thub dbang gnyis pa rong ston chos rje'i drung du dgung lo bcu dgu pa me mo yos la phyags phebs/ le'u gnyis pa dbus gtsang du phyags phebs nas gsan sbyong mdzad pa'i rnam thar la/ thog mar rong ston chen po'i drung du bcom ldan 'das mi g.yo ba'i rjes gnang dang / phar phyin mkhyen gsum yan chad kyi gzhung chos gsan/ de nas rong ston chen pos smra ba'i dbang po byams chen rab 'byams pa la lung bstan gyi zhal ta bla ma 'di la lugs gnyis kyi sgo nas bdag rkyen gyi bstan pa la phan pa'i dge bshes yong gsungs ba'i zhal ta dang bcas rdzong dkar du phebs/ lo gsum tsam gyi bar du lung rigs la sbyangs/ dngos stobs kyi rigs pa'i dbang phyug chen por gyur/ chos rje rdzong dkar ba sogs dpon slob kun gyi rnam dpyod kyi shes rab zab pa dang rlabs che bar mthun snang du grub/ de nas gcen po ye shes rgyal mtshan pa khams nas na lend+rar phebs/

bla ma 'dis kyang na lend+rar byon/ rig pa'i dbang phyug dge ba rgyal mtshan pa dang mjal gsang sngags kyi chos 'brel kha yar zhus/ gsung rab kyi 'brel gtam kha yar mdzad pas/ dam pa des rig pa bzang ba'i thag bcad/ chos rje shes rab dpal ldan pa la sa skya paṇḍi ta'i bsgom bzlas gsan/ slob dpon nam snying pa la mdo phyogs kyi zin thun mtshon tsam gsan/ de nas sku mched gnyis rdzong dkar du 'byon khar/ dwags po paṇḍi ta bkra shis rnam rgyal ba la rjes gnang kha yar dang / sdom gsum gyi gsung chos mtshon tsam gsan/ khong gi bsnams 'phro'i dbu zhwa gcig gnang / 'di gon yar lam gyi lam du bar chad zhi ba yin gsungs ba dang / gzhan yang thugs dges pa'i zhal ta kha yar gnang / de nas yar byon pa'i rong chung gi sbug tu brag lam zhig gtsang po'i 'khor chen po'i dkyil du bla ma 'di lhung / de 'phral du sa skya paṇḍi ta chen po mkhyen ces pa zhal nas brjod/ chu nang du chos rgyal ma tshar nyer bzhi thon pa'i bar du lus/ de nas lam la mi 'gro ba gsan nas chos rje dwags po'i dbu zhwa de gyen la 'phangs pas mis mthong / de nas thag pa brkyangs te byon pas nyes med du 'thon/ rdzong dkar du phebs dgung lo nyer lnga pa chu mo bya'i bar du mdo phyogs kyi gsan sbyangs mdzad pas/ bstan pa yongs su rdzogs pa'i bshes gnyen chen por gyur/ de nas e waṃ chos ldan du phebs/ snyigs dus kyi rdo rje 'chang chen po kun dga' bzang po pa'i drung du gsar chos la 'grel pa lugs kyi dbang gsan/ chu 'dus mkhas btsun pa dang mnyam du sambu ṭi rdor dbyings kyi dbang gsan pa'i dus/ dbang gi mtha' brten gyi dung dbang gral ba kun la 'grim tshar nas dung phyag tu bsnams nas bla ma 'di'i mdun du byon nas dung 'di bus gsungs ba lan gsum bus pas skad che bar byung / de nas rdo rje 'chang chen pos dung de phyag tu bzhes dkyil 'khor gyi drung du phebs nas zhal ta'i rigs ni gang yang mi gsungs/

mkha' 'gro rgya mtsho'i dbang / ku ru kulle dang 'dod rgyal gyi rjes gnang gsan/ gsung ngag tshar gnyis gsan pa sogs chos kyi bka' drin mang du gsan/ de'i snga nub mnal lam du bud med gzhon nu dmar mo gos chen dmar po gyon pa gcig na re/ 'di zo zer shing thog rlon pa thu ba gang sprad/ de nas rnga dmar po gcig gtad nas brdungs zer nas brdungs pas skad kyi stong gsum khyab pa byung gsungs/ de nas dgung lo so gnyis pa'i bar du e waṃ dang / mus kyi gling dga' bde ba can gyi bar du yar 'byon mar 'byon mdzad de/ rje btsun mus pa chen po la gsung ngag tshar lnga'i thog drangs rnal 'byor gsang mtha'i chos bskor yongs su rdzogs pa dang / gzhan yang chos kyi bka' drin mang du gsan/ yang gling dga' na gzhung bshad dmar ma'i bshad pa gcig gsan dus dgongs dus gcig glo bur du dbugs stod la 'tshangs 'gro la khad byung ba/ mus chen gyi gzim khang la dbu gtad nas za zi cig la mus chen byon zhal nang du zhal chab mang po btab pas/ des 'phral du snyung ba de drag khyim dri bzang gi khengs pa yang byung gsungs/ dgung lo nyer bdun pa la rje rdo rje 'chang mkhan po/ mus chen las slob/ kha 'phyar ba gsang ston las bsnyen par rdzogs par mdzad/ mkhan chen kha 'phyar bas sbyong dkyil bcu gnyis/ gur rigs bsdus kyi dbang / rta mgrin nag po'i rjes gnang dang bcas pa gsan/ chos rje gung ru la sdom gsum rab dbye'i bshad pa dang / tshogs bdag gi rjes gnang gsan/ bdag chen zhwa lu ba la gdong bzhi pa'i rjes gnang gsan/ bdag chen chu mig pa la mgon po dpa' gcig gi rjes gnang gsan/ sa skyar chos dbar snga ma phebs dus 'khon blo gros rgyal mtshan pa la dkar mo nyi zla'i rjes gnang gsan/ de dag gi skabs su snyung nad gzhi ma la dmigs te gshed dmar gyi bsnyen pa mdzad pas phan pa byung / de ltar gong du bshad pa'i bla ma rnams la rdo rje theg pa'i chos bskor rnams gsan nas dgung lo so gcig pa yos kyi lo la khams phyogs su 'byon par dgongs te rdzong dkar du phebs pa'i lam zhor la sngar e waṃ du phebs dus chos rje rdzong dkar bas bstan pa'i sbyin bdag rin spungs nor bu bzang po la gtsang phyogs su bzhugs ring 'phral chas kyi zhabs tog dgos pa'i zhal ta mdzad/

des kyang zla ba ngo ma stong ba'i gsol chas kyi mthun rkyen sbyar ba la brten khong la mjal du sku mched gnyis kyi byon pas/ khong na re/ sngar ngas zhabs tog cher ma grub na'ang rgyun ma chad tsam bsgrub/ da dung zhabs tog bsgrub pas nged kyi sa char bzhugs 'chad nyan mdzad pa ma gtogs khams la byon pas mi yong gsungs/ de nas rdzong dkar du phebs chos rje'i drung du khams la 'byon pa'i rgyu mtshan zhus na'ang / chos rje rdzong dkar ba rang gi gdan sa'i dgongs pa gtad/ yos la dbyar gyi ring la 'byon bzhud thag ma chod/ de nas yos lo'i dgun stod dbus gtsang du bzhugs pa dang / khams la 'byon pa gang legs kyi brtag pa zhu ba la mus chen gyi drung du gcen po ye shes rgyal mtshan pas byon pas/ bla ma de'i zhal nas/ brtag pa byed mi dgos/ khams su phyin na bstan pa la phan thogs mi yong / tshe'i bar chad che/ dbus gtsang du bsdad na bstan pa la phan thogs che/ tshe'i bar chad chung / longs spyod dkon pas 'dam kha gyis gsungs/ de nas dbus gtsang du bzhugs pa dgongs pa yin pa sku mched gnyis kyi thag bcad/ bla ma ye shes rgyal mtshan pa khams su byon/ bla ma 'di rdzong dkar du bzhugs 'chad nyan mgo btsugs/ rdzong dkar gyi grwa pa thams cad bla ma 'di la shin tu gus pa byung na'ang / 'brug lo dang / sbrul lo la skabs skabs su gsung chos re tsam gsungs ba ma gtogs snyung nad gzhi ma de lang nas 'chad nyan smar po rang ma byung / sbrul lo dbyar chos rje rdzong dkar ba dpon slob dbus phyogs su zla ba bdun tsam gyi ring chos dbar la thegs/ de'i ring la bla ma 'di rdzong dkar du bzhugs/ thog mar snyung nad gzhi ma de la dmigs nas lta ba 'khor 'das dbyer med la thun bzhir bcad pa'i thugs dam rtsal 'don mdzad pa'i zhag kha yar song nas srod thun la babs pa'i skabs su nyams snang la/ rdzong dkar gyi lho ri de dang mtho dma' mnyam pa'i rgyal po'i gzugs cig shar/

de la lus sbyin par gtong ba'i dmigs pa mdzad/ de'i ngang la mnyam par gzhag pas kho 'ja' yal ba bzhin song / de'i sang nas sku khams shin tu dwangs pa'i ngang la zhag nyer gcig thugs dam de'i rgyun bskyangs/ de nas sku khams kyang shin tu bde bas kyai rdo rje'i gzhi bsnyen kyi sku mtshams dam par bzhugs/ sku mtshams grol nas phar phyin brgyud pa'i gsol 'debs sogs rtsom pa phran tshegs 'dra mdzad/ sku mtshams kyi ring la mnal lam khyad par can kha yar byung gsungs/ 'di byung gi gsal kha mi gsungs/ de nas rta lo hor zla gnyis pa la chos bar kyang phebs na'ang / de'i lo rdzong dkar ba la chags sgo'i stabs kyi rgya nad de zhugs/ lo de'i ring la bshad nyan smar po ma byung / nad pa kha yar la gdon gyi skyon che ba byung ba la/ bla ma 'di'i phyag mdud dang gsang chab byin pa tsam gyi phan pa dang / nad pa 'ga' re la rjes gnang mdzad pas nad gsos pa dang / nad pa ma yin pa gnyis la rnam rgyal gyi rjes gnang mdzad dus kyi nub mo gcig gi mnal lam du/ chos rje mus chen pa byon nas khyod kyi mi de tsho la phan thogs chen po byas gsungs nas thugs dges pa'i rnam pa mdzad pa byung gsungs/ de'i tshe bla ma 'di nyid kyi dge tshul gcig gi rmi lam du chos rje rdzong dkar ba dang / bla ma 'di gnyis kyi grwa pa thams cad me'i rwa bas bskor ba la/ drug bdun tsam phyir bros pa'i rmi lam byung zer/ de nas lug lo la chos rje rdzong dkar ba mus chen gyi drung du gsung ngag gsan pa la thegs/ bla ma 'di'i rdzong dkar du bzhugs/ lug lo nas sprel lo'i bar du 'chad nyan shin tu smar/ de dag gi skabs su sdom gsum gyi spyi don dang / sdom gsum gyi ṭīkka/ phar phyin gyi spyi don rnams kyi rtsom pa yang grub sprel lo'i sos ka chos rje rdzong dkar ba skyid tshal du phebs/ de nas mkha' 'gro chos skyong gi nus pa dang /

thub bstan gyi grwa pa tshugs pa'i gzhan phan rgya che ba'i rten 'brel gyi shugs kyi rdzong dkar du ma bzhugs par mus chen gyi drung du sprel lo'i ston phebs nas/ khyi lo'i sos ka bar bzhugs/ de'i ring la skabs skabs su grwa pa la chos gsungs ba dang / mus chen gyi rnam thar sogs rtsom phran tshegs kha yar kyang mdzad/ mus chen gyi drung du byams chen sku skyes pa phebs/ lo gcig tsam bzhugs/ khong gi lkog tu bla ma 'di la gtsang phyogs su bshad nyan 'dzugs dgos dgongs ngas bdag rkyen rkang tshugs pa byed gsungs pa'i gsung gleng yang yang mdzad/ skabs cig mus chen pa'i drung du bla ma 'di dang sku skyes pa de mthun gyi bka' bgros la 'tshogs pas/ sku skyes kyi mdang nga'i rmi lam du mi mang po chos khri gcig brtsig gin 'dug su'i chos khri yin byas pas/ rje btsun grags pa'i chos khri yin zer/ sku skyes pas de'i brtsig grogs mdzad gsungs/ de la mus chen thugs dges pa'i rnam pa mdzad/ da sku skyes kyi sbyin bdag mdzad do/ /go bo rab 'byams pas bya bral bshad nyan tshugs bstan pa la phan thogs rgya chen po yong gsungs/ de nas bka' gros de la thag bcad/ sku skyes pa byams chen du byon/ mus chen ngam ring du gsung ngag gi chos 'khor bskor ba la phebs pa'i phyag phyir bla ma 'dis byon/ de'i dus mus chen gyis/ gur gyi rgyud kyi bshad pa gyis gsungs/ ngam ring gi dge bshes lnga brgya tsam la gur dang / sdom gsum sogs kyi bshad pa mdzad/ kun gyis bla ma 'di mdo sngags rgya mtsho'i pha rol du gson par thag bcad/ de'i dus kyai rdor rtsod spong / gsang 'dus rtsod spong / kun rig rtsod spong rnams mdzad/ nub cig mnal lam du/ ne thang chen po gcig gi steng na grwa pa mang pos khri brtsig gin 'dug pa/ sus yin byas pas mus chen sbyong rgyud gsungs pa'i khri yin zer/ bla ma 'dis kyang de'i rogs byas/

khrid tshar nas khri de'i steng du mus chen phebs/ sbyong rgyud gsungs/ zhal phod yang cher mdzad/ gsung rigs shog bu lnga drug tsam thugs la bzung na'ang / mnal sad pa dang shog bu cig tsam ma gtogs bsnyel 'dug thugs la gang yod de kun rig rtsod spong gi nang du bris/ de'i rgyu mtshan kun rig rtsod spong du/ rmi lam ri rtser rtags kyi mtshan ma mthong / /ces pa'i tshig 'di yin par mngon/ /de'i skabs su ngam ring mkhan po spo ra bka' bzhi pa dang gsung rab kyi 'brel gtam mdzad/ rig pa bzang ba'i grags pa thob/ de nas khyi lo'i sos ka sngar gyi bka' bgros gzhir bzhag sku skyes pas bla ma 'di ngam ring du gdan 'dren pa btang / bla ma 'dis byams chen du phebs khar/ mus chen la zhabs dbang zhus pas/ zhabs spyi bor bzhag rtsa brgyud kyi bla ma dang bsrung ma dam tshig can rnams la bka' bsgos/ 'di mdo sngags kyi bshad nyan 'dzugs pa la mthun rkyen bsgrub/ 'gal rkyen spongs gsungs ba mdzad/ de nas thog mar rdzong dkar du smra ba'i dbang phyug byams chen rab 'byams pa la mjal du byon/ thugs bzhed bstun pa'i zhal lta zhus pas thugs dges pa'i zhal lta gnang / de nas byams chen du phebs dbyar zla ba gsum gyi bar du sku skyes pa'i dben gnas gser khang sding du rab 'byams pa legs dang / go bo dbon po 'jam dbyangs dpal phyag phyir 'brangs te sku mtshams la bzhugs/ thugs dam chag med kyi steng du sngar mus chen gyi zhal ta snyung nad gzhi ma la dmigs pa'i dge sbyor gyis gsungs pa la dgongs/ bla ma rin chen 'byung ldan gyi rnal 'byor la gtso bor rtsal 'don mdzad/ de'i dus bla ma rin 'byung gi gsol 'debs kyang brtsams/ de nas khyi lo'i mjug tu bya bral bshad nyan 'dzugs pa la gtsang la byon/ thog mar mkhas pa'i dbang po don yod dpal bas rjes su bzung nas mkhas pa de dang phyogs gcig pa zhig mdzad dgongs pa sku skyes pa dang gnyis ka la yod na'ang /

rten 'brel gyi shugs dang mkha' 'gro chos skyong gi byin rlabs la rten nas bshad nyan rang rkang tshugs pa cig mdzad pa shar// //le'u gsum pa bstan pa'i byi dor 'chad nyan mdzad pa'i tshul la/ sku tshe snga ma'i rten 'brel gyi shugs kyis bla ma 'di mdo khams su sku 'khrungs pa dang / e waṃ gyi dgon pa gzhi 'ding pa dang / bla ma 'di dbus gtsang la 'byon pa dang / bstan pa'i sbyin bdag ched don grub rdo rje sku 'khrungs pa dang / bla ma 'di thub bstan gyi bya bral bshad nyan 'dzugs pa dang / nang so don grub rdo rje ba chab srid la dbang bsgyur ba rnams dus mtshungs shing / thog mar rgyal po'i pho brang bsam 'grub rtser 'chad nyan btsugs/ de nas rta nag gser gling du phyags phebs/ sku skye pas grwa pa sbyor ba dang / grwa tshang gi gral du dgos pa'i yo byad gang la gang dgos kyi mthun rkyen rnams legs par sbyar/ thog mar don gnyer ba re re gnyis gnyis byung nas rgyud tshar re tsam dang / rjes gnang re tsam mdzad pa ma gtogs sngags chos cher ma gsungs/ mdo phyogs kyi 'chad nyan la rtsal 'don mdzad/ lo bzhi lnga tsam la grwa pa brgya dang brgyad cu tsam skor dang bcas pa 'chad nyan shin tu smar zhing / gser gling du phebs dus mkhyen rab kyi dbang phyug nam mkha' bsod nams pa'i drung du grwa pa cig gi gser gling na go bo rab 'byams pa'i bya bral bshad nyan btsugs/ de'i mthun rkyen gang dgos thog mar byams chen sku skyes pas mdzad par 'dug zhus pas/ bla ma de'i zhal nas na ning nged kyi rmi lam du sgar chen po brag lba ba'i nang khugs der 'dug gang gi sgar yin dris pas/ sa skya'i gur mgon gyi sgar yin zer rta nag 'dir sa skya pa'i bstan pa cig dar yong tshod du 'dug grwa tshang de tshugs nges gsungs/ 'di lta bu dang / bla ma 'di la skabs skabs su gzhan gyi byad kha la rten pa'i snyung ba thu mo re yong dus/

zhag kha yar shā sa na gsungs ma chag gi rgyun btsugs pas myur du bzlog pa'i mtshan ma re nges par yong gin 'dug pa 'di ni bstan pa'i 'phrin las gur gyi mgon po 'khor bcas 'di'i dus rtag tu mthun rkyen bsgrub cing bar chad sel bar gdon mi za'o/ /de dag gi skabs su legs bshad kyi rtsom pa rnams phal cher mdzad cing / rtsom pa'i rnam grangs skabs 'dir brjod na/ thog mar rdo rje theg pa'i skor rnams brjod par bya ste/ de yang bstod tshogs la bla ma rin 'byung gsol 'debs/ rdo rje 'chang la bstod pa gnyis/ /mus chen la bstod pa dang / rnam thar gyi rtsa ba gnyis/ chos rje rdzong dkar ba la bstod pa gnyis/ gung ru shes rab bzang po la bstod pa/ chos rje kun dga' dbang phyug la bstod pa/ kyai rdor 'grel pa lugs dang / bde mchog brgyud 'debs kyi kha skongs/ bdag chen chu mig pa/ blo gros pa/ go bo rab 'byams pa shes rab dpal rnams la bstod pa/ gzhan chos 'brel yod pa'i bla ma kha yar la bstod pa shlau ka re re ba 'ga'/ paṇḍi ta shes rab dpal ldan la bstod pa/ chos 'brel med kyang zhu ba po'i ngor bla ma'i bstod pa mdzad pa ni/ karma pa/ paṇḍi ta grags pa rdo rje/ chu 'dus mkhas btsun pa/ 'chum pa mkhan po nam mkha' dpal skyong ba la bstod pa/ chos 'brel med pa'i bla ma kha yar la shlau ka re re ba yang 'ga' zhig mdzad/ yi dam gyi bstod pa la/ khro phu'i byams pa la bstod pa/ de'i drung na bzhugs pa'i phag mo dkar mo la bstod pa shlau ka gcig de mdzad dus phag mo'i ka pā lar chang gcig blug nas nang mchod byin rlabs cig mdzad gin 'dug pa zhag lnga'i bar du chang de ro bcud ma yal zhing / kha dma' tsam yang ma song ba 'dug go /rje btsun ma sgrol ma la bstod pa/ chos skyong gi bstod pa la/ lha brgyad gdong bzhi pa dang bcas pa la bstod pa/ nor lha'i bstod pa la/ dmar po bskor gsum la bstod pa shlau ka gnyis re/

smon lam dbang bzhi ma/ gsung ngag gi go babs kyi smon lam/ phar tshad kyi mchod yal/ mus chen gyi rnam thar snga rting rtsa 'grel dang bcas pa/ gsung ngag gi bla ma mchod chog brda 'grel nges pa'i dpal ster/ zab don bdud rtsi'i nying khu rtsa 'grel/ a seng ma'i 'grel pa/ lam 'bras chos 'byung / snang ba gsum dang gzhung ji lta ba bzhin dkri ba'i skabs kyi yig sna gnyis/ kyai rdor lus dkyil gyi bshad pa/ bdag med ma'i sgrub thabs dang dbang gi tho yig lam dus kyi dbang bskur gso/ bir bsrung thun mong ma yin pa'i byin rlabs bya tshul/ mngon rtogs tshul bzhi'i ngag 'don/ maṇḍal mchod chog gzhal yas khang gi phyag tshad sgo sbrag sogs kyi khyad par/ kyai rdor rtsod spong / rgyud kyi tshig don la dogs gcod/ kyai rdor rab gnas/ dbang chu'i sa chog dbang chu'i bshad pa/ gur rigs bsdus kyi sgrub thabs/ de'i dkyil chog sambu ṭi'i bsdus don tshigs bcad ma/ rnam 'joms bir lugs kyi byin brlabs bya tshul/ bde mchog chos 'byung / bde mchog mngon rtogs/ bde mchog rnam bshad/ nag po rim bzhi'i khrid yig gsang 'dus rtsod spongs/ rims lnga'i khrid yig 'jam rdor bsgrub dkyil/ de'i gtor mchog mchod phreng 'jam rdor dang spyan ras gzigs mi 'dra ba'i khyad par/ 'jam rdor rnam bshad/ 'jigs byed bsgrub dkyil/ spros med rgyun gyi rnal 'byor/ mngon par byang chub pa'i tshul la grangs nges phye ba/ kun rig rtsod spong / kun rig sbyin sreg sbyong rgyud ṭīkka/ thugs rje chen po'i gzhung bzhi nyams su len tshul/ arga'i cho ga sdom gsum kha skong / de'i sa bcad/ phyogs snga ngos 'dzin dris lan cung zad dang bcas pa/ sog po bka' bcu pa/ go bo sangs rgyas rgyal mtshan/ drung chen kun spangs pa/ dpon drung g.yung pa/ bstan pa'i sbyin bdag ra lod rdo rje/ ldan ma tshe rgyal skyabs rnams la gdams pa re re/ nyi zla seṅge/

dbang phyug rgyal mtshan/ ga zi ratna shrī/ mus srad pa rdo rje rgyal mtshan/ bsgrub pa ba tshul khrims bzang po/ ldan ma shes rab seṅge/ bka' bcu pa rin chen byang chub rnams kyi dris lan re re/ rtags 'jug gi ṭīkka/ smon lam chen po bcu'i tshigs bcad bsngo ba mdor bsdus/ e waṃ du sa chen gyi bris sku chen mo bzhengs pa'i bkod pa bsngo ba mdor bsdus dang bcas pa/ e waṃ nas mdo khams su 'bul sdud brdzangs dus kyi yi ge bstan pa'i sbyin bdag a seng rdo rje brtan pas gsung ngag brgyud pa'i gser sku 'bul dus kyi gtang rag gi phyag rtags/ thub bstan du bla ma nyid kyi gsung ngag gi bris sku bzhengs dus kyi gsol 'debs bkod pa/ bde ba can gyi zhing bkod bzhengs dus mdzad pa'i smon lam rnams bzhugs shing / bka' 'bum gyi dkyus su mi bzhugs pa la/ mtsho skyes phra mig sambu ṭi'i cho ga'i gsal byed/ mkha' spyod sgo 'byed/ mgon po'i bsrung 'khor/ mgon rkyang gi rjes gnang / rdo rje'i tshig rkang gi sa bcad rtsom 'phro/ mdor byas kyi ṭīkka rtsom 'phro/ zhen pa bzhi bral gyi rtsom 'phro rnams so/ /mdo sngags thun mong du sdom gsum ṭīkka/ sdom gsum spyi don/ de'i sa bcad/ sdom gsum dris lan dang bcas pa/ sher phyin phyogs la/ mngon par rtogs pa nyi khri snang ba dang sbyar nas rang lugs su bshad pa phar phyin dka' 'grel/ yongs grags dang mthun par bshad pa phar phyin spyi don/ sbyor ṭīka yan lag rgyas bshad/ dge 'dun nyi shu/ sems sems byung / rten 'brel/ bsam gtan gzugs med/ 'gog snyoms/ thod rgal rnams dang / dbu ma'i bskor la/ 'jug pa'i dka' 'grel/ dbu ma'i stong thun chen po/ dbu ma'i lta ba shan 'byed/ dbu ma rtsa she'i rab byed nyer gsum yan chad kyi ṭīkka/ rtsa 'jug gnyis/ rigs tshogs phyi ma/ mdo bsdud pa/ sa lu ljang pa'i mdo/ brgyad stong don bsdus dang bcas pa'i gzhung rang rang gi ngos la mchan bu btab pa'i sa bcad/

'dul ba la dge slong gi bslab bya gtso bor ston pa 'dul ba snying po/ mdo rtsa'i sa bcad do/ /tshad ma la rnam 'grel ṭīkka chen po/ rnam 'grel sbyor ṭīka rnam 'grel gyi spyi don che chung gnyis/ rnam 'grel gyi sa bcad/ rgyud bla'i dka' 'grel rtsom 'phro/ mngon pa mdzod kyi spyi bshad/ sa bcad/ spyi don gsum phyogs gcig tu rtsom pa'i 'phro rnams te mdo sngags kyi legs bshad 'di rnams skal ba dang ldan pa/ rnam dpyod kyi shes rab yod pa/ blo gzu bor gnas pa'i skyes bu zhig gi bltas na rgya bod kyi gsung rab dri ma med pa rnams kyi dgongs pa bla ma 'di'i rnam dpyod kyi me long la cha shas yongs su rdzogs par 'char nges pa'i rgyur gdon mi za lags so/ /yongs 'dzin gang dang gang la chos gsan pa'i tshul rnams zhib par 'dri dgos na'ang / gsan yig gcig rtsom ma grub pas gong du shar ba'i dmigs gsal de tsam las 'dri bar ma nus so/ /dam pa'i chos 'chad pa'i tshul la/ grwa tshang tshugs pa nas 'brug gi lo yan chad du mdo phyogs gtso bor gsungs shing / 'brug lo la rta nag gser gling du gsung ngag tshar gcig mgo btsugs pa nas khyi lo'i bar du lo re re la tshogs su tshar re/ zur du gsung ngag lo bskor ma tshar bzhi da bcas pas gsung ngag tshar nyer gnyis/ kyai rdor rgyud gsum/ sbyong rgyud/ bde mchog rtsa rgyud sogs rgyud kyi bshad pa nar ma/ dbang rjes gnang khrid lung sogs dang / mdo phyogs kyi bshad pa nyi ma re la chos thun bcu lhag dang bcas pas 'khor yug tu grwa pa bdun brgya bskor gyi bsam pa tshim pa mdzad/ sbrul gyi lo la bstan pa'i sbyin bdag chen po rin spungs pas thub bstan gyi dgon gzhis phul ba nas brtsams der bzhugs/ skabs skabs su sbyin bdag gi stabs kyi chos dbar la byon pa la/ sbrul lo la khro phur phebs nas chos dbar mdzad pa la/ sngar chos dbar yongs nas rigs lung 'dzugs pa sogs mi nus par yod pa 'dug na'ang /

bla ma 'di'i rim gnyis kyi rtogs pa bzang zhing byang chub kyi sems stobs che ba'i shugs kyi sa cha de'i gzhi bdag sogs kyis kyang bar chad mi byed pa'i steng du chos bsgrub pa'i grogs byed kyi smar bar byung / de nas bzung ste sa mo bya'i bar du khro phur lo re bzhin chos dbar la phebs/ de bar bla brang / spyi sa/ grwa pa so so dang bcas pas ja dkar me sogs mchod pa'i yo byad bzang bar 'khyer te/ ye shes pa dngos su bzhugs nges kyi byams chen de'i drung du bstan pa dang sems can 'ba' zhig la dgongs pa'i smon lam rnam dag rgya cher 'debs pa mdzad/ de nas phag gi lo la gdan sa chen po dpal ldan sa skyar dpon chen rnam pa gnyis kyis gdan drangs/ dpon slob bdun brgya tsam gyi chos dbar la phebs/ der yang sde der bzhugs pa'i rten gsum khyad par can rnams kyi drung du mchod pa'i yo byad mar me'i phreng ba stobs che la rgyun ring bar 'bul ba dang / phyag tu gang byung gi dngos po rnams gzhi byes kyi tshogs pa la mang ja 'gyed la sogs pa bsgrub pa dang / bstan pa dang sems can la dgongs pa'i smon lam rgya chen po dang / bstan pa'i bsrung ma chen po dpal gur gyi mgon po'i drung du yang mchod gtor grangs mang la rnam par dag pa phul te/ bstan pa dar rgyas kyi 'phrin las 'chol ba yang mang du mdzad/ de'i dus su bstan pa'i sbyin bdag chu 'dus pas gdan drangs/ longs spyod kyi dngos po brgya 'bul grangs med bar mdzad/ de dag kyang gdan sa chen por dge 'dun la phul/ smon lam rnam dag mdzad/ sngar thub bstan du phebs chos kyi 'khor lo rgyun mi 'chad pa bskor ba'i skabs su/ glang lo la e waṃ chos ldan gyi mi sna chos khrims dang bcas pa byon/ e waṃ gyi gdan sa pa la phebs dgos pa'i zhu ba phul bas/ sngar mnal lam gcig tu ngor nas grwa pa mang po 'bog khres 'khur nas la chung khar 'gro yin 'dug pa la bla ma 'di'i e waṃ gi 'du khang gi steng nas gaṇḍe gcig brdungs pas grwa pa de rnams log byung nas chos bshad pa cig rmi gsungs nas de thog tu 'khel zhing dus la babs par dgongs nas/

e waṃ du glang lo'i ser mchod la phebs/ stag lo lam 'bras gsungs/ de nas bzung ste rta lo'i bar du dgun e waṃ du rdo rje theg pa'i chos kyi 'khor lo bskor/ dbyar thub bstan du mdo phyogs gtso che ba'i chos kyi 'khor lo bskor cing / de'i ring la thub bstan du rje mus pa chen po'i spyan tshab pa chos rje tshul khrims bzang po pas dbang / rjes gnang / lung / khrid/ phyag len rnam par dag pa'i sgo nas don gnyer ba rnams kyi bsam pa tshim pas bla ma 'dis rdo rje theg pa'i bstan pa 'degs pa'i ka chen du gyur/ bka' bcu 'dzin pa bsod nams rgya mtsho bas rje nyid kyi gsung bgros tshig rigs ma 'phyugs par 'chad pas bla ma 'di'i mdo phyogs kyi bstan pa 'degs pa'i ka chen du gyur/ gzhung lugs rab 'byams smra ba thugs rje dpal bzang pas tshad ma gtso bor 'chad pa'i ngos nas bla ma 'di'i bstan pa 'degs pa'i ka chen du gyur/ sgra dang snyan ngag la sogs pa tha snyad kyi gtsug lag du mas gzhung lugs rab 'byams kyi kha brgyan pa kong ston dbang phyug grub pas legs bshad sna tshogs 'chad pa'i ngos nas bla ma 'di'i bstan pa 'degs pa'i ka chen du gyur/ de rnams rang rang don gnyer bu slob kyi tshogs rab tu mang po'i zhabs tog dang / grwa tshang spyi'i 'khur sbyin bdag gi skyong tshul la sogs pa bla ma nyid kyi dgongs pa ji lta ba bzhin bsgrub ste gnas dge 'dun bzang po ba dang bcas pas bla ma nyid e waṃ du bzhugs ring thub bstan gyis grwa tshang gi lugs gnyis kyi mdzad pa gong 'phel du bsgrub/ bla ma nyid e waṃ du bzhugs ring la nub gcig gi mnal lam du/ mi gcig gi rje btsun grags pa'i bum chu yin zer nas bla ma nyid kyi dbu la bum chu de blug pas tshe dpag med kyi gzungs kyi phreng bar byung ba bla ma nyid kyi sku la thim pa'i rnam pa byung / mi de na re/ khyed gzhan don rgya chen po yong ba'i rten 'brel yin zer/

e waṃ gdan sar bzhugs ring la bstan pa'i sbyin bdag chen po a seng rdo rje brtan pas bla ma 'di glo bor gdan 'dren pa'i thugs rtsol che bar mdzad na'ang / rten 'brel gyi shugs kyi phebs pa cig ma byung ba la bstan pa'i sbyin bdag chen po des gsung ngag brgyud pa'i gser sku nyi shu rtsa bzhi mthar brten bstan bsrung gyi sku dang bcas pa dus myur du grub par byas te/ de dag gi gzungs rdzong thob tshul sogs kyang rje rdo rje 'chang chen po'i dngos slob mkhas pa chen po grags pa rgyal mtshan gyi gnad ma 'phyugs par mdzad/ rab gnas mdor bsdus dang bcas pa mdzad de yon mchod gnyis kyi mtshams sbyor ba 'bar ra ba rgyal mtshan dpal gyi gdan drangs te thub bstan rnam par rgyal ba'i dgon par phebs nas/ slar yang bla ma 'di nyid kyi rab gnas phun sum tshogs par mdzad pa da lta thub bstan gyi bla brang na bzhugs so/ /bstan pa'i sbyin bdag dpon drung g.yung pa la ma 'ongs pa na ci 'gyur gyi mtshan ma dod pa'i mnal lam yang byung 'dug gzhan yang mnal lam ngo mtshar ba 'ga' yar yod tshod 'dug na'ang gsal por mi gsungs/ gzhan gyi bgros 'dra 'dug na yang yid mi ches pas 'dir ma bris/ yos lo la e waṃ gi khri thog tu bzhugs/ chos rje sgar pa dpon slob mdo khams su 'bul sdud la brdzangs/ rta lo la rje rdo rje 'chang gi khri thog tu kun gyi rtsod pa med cing mthun nang du grub par chos kyi rje dkon mchog 'phel ba rgyal tshab tu bskos/ 'dis e waṃ du gdul bya 'phrin las bsam gyi mi khyab pa dang bcas te e waṃ gi bstan pa dar rgyas yong ba'i yid ches chos rje dkon mchog 'phel ba'i mched ma gcig rdo rje 'chang gi drung du rab byung byed rtsis yin pa la/ rje rdo rje 'chang gi drung du snga nas rab byung byed phyin chad 'dir rab byung byed chug ma 'ongs pa na phan thogs yong ba'i rigs cig 'dug gsungs ba dang /

rje btsun kun dga' dbang phyug pa snga ris la lan snga ma phebs nas e waṃ du 'byon pa'i zhor la mus chen pa'i drung du mjal du byon pa'i phyag phyir chos rje dkon mchog 'phel ba yod pa la/ mus chen gyi chos rje kun dga' dbang phyug pa la 'di khyed tsho'i g.yog kyang la ma khrid/ rta nag na go bo rab 'byams pa'i rtsar slob gnyer la thong / ma 'ongs pa na mi res pus mo la re ba'i dus yong gsungs ba'i lung bstan 'dra yod pa yang yang gsungs/ de nas lug gi lo dpyid ka 'chum sde chen gyi mkhan po gnas brtan 'dul ba 'dzin pa mkhas btsun bzang gsum 'dzoms pa nam mkha' dpal skyong bas bla ma 'di gdan drangs gsung ngag tshar gcig dbang rjes gnang sogs kyi shangs phyogs kyi skal ldan rnams zab lam la bkod/ de dag gi skabs su rigs ldan gyi sprul pa rta'i bse ru rnam rgyal grags pa'i sras chos rgyal nam mkha' rdo rje bas zhabs tog dpon slob bdun brgya skor chos dbar la lan kha yar byon/ yang skabs skabs su gzim mal zhus tshar nas nam phyi mor song nas drung na mi med kyang tshig 'di yin brjod mi shes pa'i gsung gleng mdzad pa'i zla'o gcig yang yang yong ba cig gda'o/ /de dag dang mthun par bstan pa'i sbyin bdag chen po dang bkra shis sgang pa nang so bsod nams rgyal po bas lo kha yar phogs kyi zhabs tog bsgrub nas bo dong er dpon slob bdun brgya bskor phebs/ de'i tshe spyi chos la blo sbyong gsungs pa dang / bya rgod gshong du bcu gcig zhal la mjal du phebs dus su me tog gi char bsam gyi mi khyab pa babs pa kun gyi mthun snang du grub bo/ /dang po gser gling du bzhugs dus nas bstan pa'i sbyin bdag 'jig rten gyi mes po dpon drung g.yung pas ldong mkhar du lo re bzhin dpon slob rnams la phogs kyi zhabs tog rgya chen po phul/ chos kyi 'khor lo rgya chen po bskor bar mdzad/

gser gling du bzhugs pa'i skabs su sku tshe snga ma nas las dang smon lam gyi 'brel pa'i sbyin bdag dga' bde'i spyod par grags pas kyang chos dbar gyi mthun rkyen gang 'grub dang bcas dben gnas dga' tshal du chos dbar la lan gnyis phebs cing / phyis su khong gi grwa tshang gi zhabs tog la dmigs nas bya ru'i khrod du dge bskul mdzad/ bsgom sde'i 'brog btsugs pa'i rgyun bzang po da lta yang yod/ yang mthu stobs kyi mnga' bdag chos rje sgrol ma ba brgyud pa chad la khad la nye ba'i dus/ bla ma 'di la yab yum gnyis char gyi tshe dpag med kyi dbang zhus pas rigs sras 'khrungs pa dang / bya ru'i khrod du 'brog pa bu tsha ma byung ba gza' mi gnyis kyi thub bstan du dge 'dun la mang ja bla ma 'di'i drung du 'bul ba yang dag phul/ rta mgrin gyi rjes gnang zhus pas bu byung ba sogs byin rlabs kyi ma rtsal phul du phyin pa yang mngon du gyur pa lags so/ /yang gser gling du bzhugs dus skabs skabs su e waṃ du phebs/ rje btsun dam pa kun dga' dbang phyug pa la gur gyi mgon po'i las tshogs rab tu mang po'i lung / dpal mgon zhal bzhi pa'i rjes gnang / de'i las tshogs kyi lung / 'jam rdor/ spyan ras gzigs/ rigs gsum spyi dbang / a ra pa tsa na lha lnga la sogs pa'i dbang / don zhags/ bcu gcig zhal la sogs pa'i rjes su gnang ba rnams zhus shing / e waṃ pa rnams la dbang / rjes gnang / bshad pa la sogs pa yang mang du mdzad do/ /lug gi lo hor zla dang po'i nang du 'bul sdud pa dpon slob nor rdzas bsam gyi mi khyab pa dang bcas e waṃ du bar chad med par phebs pa dang / chos kyi rje dkon mchog 'phel bas tsandan dmar po las grub pa'i dmar po bskor gsum bzhengs pa dang / 'bul sdud pa 'gro dus kyi phyag rtags kyi mjug tu 'dod don la dmigs pa'i bstod pa dmar po skor gsum la phul ba rnams kyang dus gsum du rten 'brel ma 'phyugs par mkhyen pa'i mngon shes mnga' ba gdon mi za'o/

/'bul sdud pa phebs gdong e waṃ du len gcig phebs/ rgyal tshab dam pa dkon mchog 'phel bas gser zho bcu gsum la sogs pa'i 'bul ba mang po dang / 'bul sdud pas dung dkar/ ja sigs/ rta/ dre'u la sogs pa'i 'bul ba mang du mdzad/ de dag dang dus mtshungs par bla ma 'di'i slob ma'i mchog gcig e waṃ du khri thog tu rgyal tshab la bskos/ gling dga' bde ba can gyi gdan sa la chos rje sangs rin pa 'khod/ gdan sa chen po'i khri thog tu theg chen chos rje'i dbon po bdag chen bsod nams rgyal mtshan pa 'khod pa rnams dus mnyam du lo thog gcig la grub/ gzhan yang mdo sngags rgya mtsho'i pha rol du son pa'i slob ma shin tu mang na yang 'dir thams cad brjod ma nus/ de nas sprel lo hor zla dgu pa la chos rje dkon mchog 'phel ba la bstan pa yongs su rdzogs pa gtad pa'i ched du slar yang e waṃ du lan gcig byon/ rgyal tshab dam pa de la dpal ldan sa skya pa'i chag med bzhi/ dpal gdong bzhi pa'i rjes gnang / las tshogs kyi lung la sogs pa chos kyi lhag ma lus pa gnang / 'bul ba yang gser zho bcu gsum gyi thog drangs bsam gyi mi khyab pa phul/ chos rje sgar pa dang / bzhi sde ba sku mched kyi thog drangs mi nyer lnga la mkha' 'gro rgya mtsho'i dbang bskur kyang mdzad/ de'i tshe zhal bzhi pa'i rjes gnang mdzad pa'i sang nyin e waṃ gi mchod rten rnams la zhabs bskor mdzad cing yod pa de'i tshe/ de'i shing sdong rnams la gzigs nas mdang nub rmi lam du sa skya nas 'ong pa yin zer ba'i shing sdong 'di tsho las ring ba la dar shing byas/ dar nag po zhe cig 'phyar bas nyi ma 'grib pa tsam byung / nged rang da lo sa skyar 'gro ba 'di la lta'am/ chos skyong gi rnam 'phrul yin pas skyon med pa srid dam/ de min dar nag po zhe cig 'dug pa de e dga' yang mi shes gsungs/ de nas lo de'i nang du mdo khams nas bu slob kyi mchog ga zi shākya blo gros pas dre'u bcu gsum/

ja sigs sum cu'i thog drangs brgya 'bul slebs pa dang / mnga' ris nas bya tshang mkhan pos gser zho sum cu so bdun gyi gtso byas pa'i 'bul ba bsam gyi mi khyab pa dang / mdo smad nas gser zho sum cu tsam dang / 'bri g.yag brgyad cu tsam gyi thog drangs 'bul ba bsam gyi mi khyab pa byung ba sogs la rten/ gdan sa chen por sprel lo hor zla bcu gcig pa'i tshes brgyad la khro phu nas sa skyar dpon slob bdun brgya tsam bteg zla ba de'i tshes bcu bzhi sa skya paṇḍi ta'i dus chen la gdan sa chen por gzhi byes kyi dge 'dun nyis stong zin tsam la gser zho brgyad cu'i gtso byas/ gos dar/ byu ru/ g.yu/ gla rtsi la sogs pa'i 'gyed mang ja bzang po dang bcas pa dang / der zla ba gnyis bzhugs ring rten gsum rnams kyi drung du mar me stobs che ba dang / bstan pa'i bya ra ba rdo rje nag po chen po'i drung du gtor bsngo tshar gsum ma ma chag pa dang / long skabs yod dus nub re la bskang gso tshar bdun ma dang / lnga ma dang / tshogs kyi 'khor lo zab pa dang bcas pa yang lan mang du mdzad/ de dag gi nub de'i gtor bsngo'i mjug tu/ thub bstan gyi gser sku chen mo bzhengs pa la bar du gcod pa mi 'byung zhing / rab gnas phun sum tshogs pa chags te/ rten de mthong ba dang / thos pa dang / yid la bsam pa tsam gyi 'gro ba'i don rgya chen po 'byung ba'i smon lam tshar re mdzad/ gzhan de'i skabs su dge 'dun gyi tshogs dbus dang / zur pa gang du'ang bstan pa dang sems can spyi la dgongs pa'i smon lam rgya chen po mdzad/ dpon chen rnam pa gnyis kyi dpon slob rnams la gsol phogs rnam pa gnyis dang / gdan sa chen po'i mi mang gi khrod nas kyang 'phral gyi zhabs tog 'bul ba rnam dag la sogs pa skal pa bzang po'i dus su sangs rgyas 'khor dang bcas pa la mchod pa tsam bsgrub/ skal ldan mang po la dbang bskur/ rjes gnang /

lung / bshad pa la sogs pas gdul bya rnams kyi re 'dod yongs su rdzogs par mdzad/ de'i tshe yang ngo mtshar ba'i mnal lam du ma byung gsungs ba dang / chos skyong 'di tsho la yang gtor bsgrub dang sngags zlos pa tsam gyi mi chog par/ tshogs 'khor dang dbyangs la dga' ba'i rmi lam byung gsungs ba dang / sngar yin na 'jam dbyangs kyi gser sku 'di dang / bla brang shar gyi rje btsun gyi sku 'di gnyis gzhon nu ma'i nyams 'ba' zhig tu 'char ba zhig yod na'ang / da lo 'di gnyis bgres nyams che ba'i rnam pa gcig ka shar gsungs/ mgon po'i sku 'di la mthong tshul sngar dang khyad mi 'dug gsungs/ de nas chos dbar 'byon khar/ nas sa bre'i khal brgyad cu gya gnyis/ ras/ snam bu sogs kyi dos chen po gnyis/ zangs che chung gnyis la sogs pa gdan sa chen po'i gtsug lag khang gi zhig bzos kyi chas la phul ba sogs kyi mdzad tshul rnam par dag pa la dpag na/ bla ma'i rten gsum dang / de dag bzhugs pa'i gtsug lag khang la sogs pa la zhig ral byung ba la thugs yul du rang gi sku lus kyi sha bcad pa las ches thu ba'i thugs chen po yod tshod du 'dug cing / de bas kyang bla ma gong ma'i gsung rab kyi grub mtha' nyams kyi dogs pa sogs brtse ba chen po'i lhag bsam bstan pa spyi khyab la bsam gyi mi khyab pa mnga' ba lags so/ /gdan sa chen por chos dbar snga ma la phebs dus sngar med pa'i chu mig gsar pa rdol ba la sa skya pa'i mi dmangs kyi 'di chos rje go bo rab 'byams pas bsgrub chu yin zer nas chu de 'thung pa dang / khrus byed pa yang byung 'dug yang sa skyar sngar res byon nas thub bstan du phebs pa'i nub gcig mnal lam du/ skyed lhas kyi brag khung yin snyam pa zhig na/ bla ma 'di grwa pa kha yar dang mnyam du bzhugs 'dug pa la/ mon pa phru gu gsum byung / bla ma 'dis grwa pa de tsho la gdong bzhi pa'i sprul pa bram ze'i gzugs can de yin pa 'dra gsungs pas/

mon pa phru gu gsum po de 'dzum zhing mgo gug gug byed par 'dug bla mas 'o na khyed ye shes kyi mgon po yin pas mngon shes thogs med du mnga' bas/ bdag tshe mjug la bsgrub pa byas na ji ltar yong dris pas/ bsgrub pa zhes pa'i tshig gcig brjod nas mgo ril ril byed pa 'dug de nub gdong bzhi pa'i bskangs gso zab pa cig byed gsungs de bzhin mdzad/ yang sa skyar sngar res phebs dus skyed lhas dpon slob kha yar gyi gtor bsgrub la byon pas/ mchod gral du gdong bzhi pa'i rten rtse gsum dang / ral gri la sogs pa bsgrengs nas gyang la bsnyel nas bzhag pa/ rtse gsum de mis reg mkhan med par bla ma 'di'i phyogs su gug pa rgya mo rong pa dbon po nam mkha' snying pos mthong zhes thos so/ /de nas gdan sa chen por bsgrub dgos rnams legs par grub nas/ sa mo bya lo hor zla dang po'i tshes brgyad la chos dbar bteg tshes dgu la sngon mo rdzong du phebs/ bcu la bo dong pas phogs phul/ bcu'i dgongs mo nas chos 'dzugs pa'i rim 'gro btsugs/ tshes bcu dgu'i bar du mdo phyogs kyi chos gsungs/ de'i ring la chos rar grwa pa rnams la zhal ta'i rigs mang du gnang ba tsho bsam na phyis ma 'ongs pa mkhyen pa'i mngon shes mnga' ba'i tshod 'ba' zhig dang / dag pa'i snang ba mang du 'char ba zhig yod tshod mchis te/ de yang zhib par brjod na/ skabs su gdan sa chen por gsang phu'i bgros gsar rnying la sogs pa'i zar zir byung tshul/ mkhyen rab dbang phyug gi grwa tshang du zar zir byung tshul/ rdzong dkar gyi grwa tshang du chags sgo byung tshul sogs brjod pa dang / gsum gros byas gcig khri thog tu 'don zer te/ de don la mi nyag gros byed mkhan gsum po de gnyis su 'gro/ mthar gnyis po de gcig tu 'gro/ gcig rjes med la 'gro gsungs/ 'di dang e waṃ gdan sa mdzad dus e waṃ du nub cig mnal lam du/

bla ma nyid bde bar gshegs pa'i ngang nas thub bstan grwa tshang ba rnams ci byed gzigs pa la byon pas/ grwa tshang ba rnams dum bu dum bur gros byed mis khengs 'dug skabs cig bka' bcu pa bsod rgyam gdan sa la bkod zer nas grwa pa rnams 'thor song / tsho gcig bsdad 'dug pa de/ dga' mo gcig ni mi yong bar 'dug der rting chen po shāka mchog pa gdan sa bskos thongs zer ba rmis gsungs/ mnal lam 'di dang gong gi zhal lta de tsho ding sang gi thub bstan gyi slob dpon rnams kyi mdzad tshul la lta bar thag chod/ yang de'i chos rar spyan bar snang la gzigs/ 'ja' sprin shin tu legs/ deng sang skyes bu dam pa cig 'khrungs sam gshegs gang ltar kyang skad cha cig yong gsungs ba dang / sngon mo rdzong gi mdun gyi thang chen de la gzigs/ khyed grwa pa tsho bltas mo blta na mang du 'dug rta so ba shin tu mang kyang zhag gcig gnyis sngon mo rdzong 'chor ba med gsungs ba sogs zhib par myang na ma 'ongs pa lung bstan par snang ngo / /tshes dgu'i nyin las dang smon gyi 'brel ba'i sbyin bdag khro mda' ba nang so lha dbang rgyal mtshan pa la ja sbyor gsum gyi bar du zhal lta mang du gnang ba la ya mtshan pa 'dra yod pa 'dra zer nang / khong rang las dngos su ma thos pas yid ches ma byas/ de nas bcu dgu'i tho rangs nas ser ma shas che ba'i snyung ba gcig gi zin/ zhal lta byung nas sku drung du gsol dpon gyis phyin pas/ sngar yong ma myong ba'i rmi lam du khyi chen po sus kyang mi thub pa lcags thag gis btags pa cig 'dug de btang na rgyal khams kun du lcags thag gis bsnyogs pa cig 'dug de ngas min pa sus kyang mi thub pa gcig byung gsungs/ khyi de ngas bka' thub pa zhig byung bas cung e dga'/ gzhan rang da res ci yong mi shes gsungs/ de nas nyi shu'i dgongs mo'i bar du zhal skom dad che/ sku stod dang dbu la snyung zug cung zad byung /

dgong mo nas skom dad che ba tsam ma gtogs snyung zug gi rigs ci yang med/ nyi shu'i tsha thon la bdag dang ga zi lha rje gnyis drung na yod pa la spyan gyis cher ba cig gzigs/ bar snang la yang gzigs/ khyed rnams da dung bsdad rgyu yin/ nga ni bde ba can du 'gro gsungs/ de nas dum cig nas chos kyi rgyal po chen po de la gcig byed rgyur 'dug na'ang / nged rang tsho yid la dran pa tsam yang ma byung 'dug gsungs/ de dang dus mtshungs par lha khang chen mo ru lha chen pa'i sras mo lo lnga drug tsam lon pa gcig na re/ lha chen nang so la chos rje go bo ba sems can ngo mi shes pa zhig la chibs nas 'u cag gi gzim khang ka gnyis ma na phebs 'dug gzigs su byon zer/ nang sos byon pas ma mthong / da 'dug gam gsungs pas/ da tshod 'dug ste da mi 'dug zer ba dang / dbu rtse rnying ma'i dkon gnyer btsun chung gcig yod pa des kyang bla ma 'di kha sing nas 'jam dbyangs kyi drung du 'byon pa ji lta ba bzhin tshes nyi shu'i dus mthong ba khong rang gnyis kyi ngag las thos so/ /de la dpag na tshes nyi shu'i nyin gang sku'i bkod pa yang bstan par gdon mi za ba legs so/ /de nas nyi shu'i nyin dang mtshan gyi bar la dge 'dun rnams la na bza'/ sku chas/ gser zho nyi shu rtsa gcig rnams sku rims chos rgyal ma 'ur 'don/ shā sa na gsung mi chag sogs dus thung ngu la dpag pa'i sku rims stobs che ba dang / lha rje bzhi tsam gyi blo bsdur ba'i gsol sman zhu ba sogs 'gyod med kyi zhabs tog bsgrub na'ang / zhing 'di'i gdul bya'i bsod nams dang / bstan pa spyi sgos kyi sku chags dang / nag phyogs kyi 'byung po gdug pa can rnams kha rgyal ba dang / zhing gzhan du 'phrin las che ba la dgongs nas nyi shu'i skya reng shar nas thugs dam rim pa chung ngu tsho sngon la mdzad/ der rjes lam dus rgyas pa thugs 'jur zhing rig pa hur phyung ste dkyil 'khor bsdu ba'i bar du mdzad/

sa skya nas rta sga sbran pa gnyis kyang byung / bsdad kyang yun ring na 'byung po'i bar chad du yang 'gro nyan 'dug gsungs/ nyer gcig gi nyi ma dros la phyi bzhag gi zhal ta sogs ci yang mi gnang ba sems dpa'i skyil krung bcas te sku'i bkod pa chos kyi dbyings su thim mo/ /de nas gsol dpon dge 'dun bzang po shes pa la dbang thob pa rang mi 'dug na'ang / bo dong er tsha ra mang ja/ byes chas kyi phyag rdzas steng nas 'gyed dang bcas pa dang / bya rgod gshong du yang de mthun/ grwa tshang ba sngon mo rdzong gzhol pa mi dmangs dang bcas pa la dgongs rdzogs sngon 'gros e dang mthun par bsgrub/ de nas thugs rje'i dbang gi sku gdung thub bstan du 'dren pa la nyer gcig gi dgongs thugs dam zab mo grol ba'i rtags shangs bug gnyis nas byang sems dkar dmar gyi rgyun babs/ de bar sku lus la gnyer ma med cing gzhon sha'i rnam pa mdangs gzi brjid phun sum tshogs par bzhugs/ thugs dam grol ba'i rtags de shar nas sngar gzhan don la thegs kha'i gzi mdangs tsam du gyur 'dug de nas nyi shu gnyis kyi nyin mtshan la gdung bzhugs pa'i shing gi sgrom bu bcos/ nyer gsum gyi nyi dros la sku gdung la dri bzang gi byugs pa dang / dar yug dang ras yug gi dril te sgrom bur bzhugs su gsol/ nyer gsum gyi sa sros nas dad ldan gyi grwa pa sum cu bskor gyi gdan drangs/ nyer bzhi'i nam lang la khad la thub bstan du phebs/ de nas nyer lnga la sku gdung bzhu bar brtsams na'ang / mkha' 'gro chos skyong gi rnam 'phrul la rten nas re zhig sku gdung bzhu mi nyan pa'i mtshan ma byung ba la rten sku gdung mchod rten gyi nang du bzhugs su gsol ba'i drung du dge 'dun bzhi yi kyai rdo rje'i bsgrub mchod rgyun ma chad pa dang / gzhan yang mchod rdzas dpag tu med pa'i mchod pa dang bcas pa nar ma chad pa phul/ de nas nyi shu lnga nas brtsams te bya lo hor zla gnyis pa'i gnam gang gi bar du gtso cher bla ma nyid kyi phyag rdzas kyi steng nas nyin re bzhin tsha gro gnyis zab ma mang ja bzang po re re dang bcas pa dang /

gzhan yang grwa bu slob sbyin bdag sogs kyi dgongs rdzogs dge 'dun brgyad brgya bskor la bsgrub/ rin chen rtse'i bod 'brog gi mi dmangs la yang nas 'gyed dang / skam zog gi 'gyed dang bcas pa dang / rta nag ri khud/ gser gling / e waṃ/ gling dga' bde ba can/ rdzong dkar dang bcas par yang tsha ra mang ja 'gyed dang bcas pa blo gzu bor gnas shing las 'bras kyi gnam thig drangs por 'debs pa'i mis ma khrel ba'i dgongs rdzogs rnam par dag pa rgya che la dpang mtho ba nye gnas dge 'dun bzang po pas bsgrub/ de nas bya lo hor zla lnga pa'i nyer drug la e waṃ nas rgyal tshab dam pa chos kyi rje dkon mchog 'phel ba grwa tshang gi 'tsho 'dzin dang / nang rten bzhengs pa'i mgon du phebs pa dang / nang rten gyi lha bzo ba dpon mo che saka ti dpal grogs mched lnga slebs pa dus mtshungs pas rten 'brel 'grig de nas rgyal tshab dam pa e waṃ chos rje pas gang dang spyi'i zhal bkod dang / ma lcogs pa'i rgyu cha rkyen 'don pa mdzad/ grwa pa mi dmangs kyi nang rten dang gtsang khang bzhengs pa'i las ka dang / rgyu cha rkyen 'don pa sogs bla ma dang las 'bras la bsam pa mdzad/ gsol dpon dge 'dun bzang po pas gang dang spyi'i 'khur gyi gzhung bzung nas bya lo hor zla drug pa'i tshes gsum nas gtsang khang bzhengs pa dang / nang rten bzhengs pa'i mgo btsugs pa la/ hor zla dgu pa'i tshes bdun tshun la nang rten zangs khal phyed dang nyis brgya/ skud gser zho dgu bcu go gnyis kyi gtso byas pa'i rgyu cha rkyen las grub pa'i ston pa'i gser sku rgyab mtho bcu gsum yod pa dang / gtsang khang ka bzhi ma'i nang gi gong ltar la sa bir zhal sprod dang / sangs rgyas sum cu so lnga/ sgo gong gi dbus su 'jam dbyangs gtso 'khor gsum pa/ ldebs ris kyi skyed la phyogs bcu'i sangs rgyas la spang skong phyag rgya pa nas bshad pa'i byang sems sdom pa dang bcas pa/

sgo'i g.yon gyi nang khugs su gur gyi mgon po/ g.yas kyi nang khugs su nor lha gnod sbyin dang bcas pa grub par byas/ de nas hor zla brgyad pa'i tshe e waṃ rgyal tshab dam pa des zhi ba'i sbyin sreg gi sgo nas sku gdung la bzhu phul ba ja sun gsum gyi ring la gdung bzhu ba me thag chod pa/ nam langs pa dus mnyam du byung / de thad du e waṃ nas mang ja/ tsha ra 'gyed la sogs pa gya noms par mdzad/ de nas gnam gang gi bar du gdung khang zhal ma phye bar bla ma mchod chog gi cho ga'i sgo nas gsol ba btab/ mchod pa bzang bar bsham/ gnam gang la gdung khang zhal phye/ phyogs su 'gyed rgyu'i 'jam dbyangs dad ldan la byin rlabs kyi rten du gdung tsha 'jam dbyangs sku rgyab la mtshan gyi yi ge 'byar ba na bza' gser dang mtshal gsol ba phyogs mtha' dag tu bkye la/ rang rang gi lag tu slebs nas ring bsrel 'khrungs pa yang shin tu mang bar 'dug gsungs/ gdung zhu ba'i dus me tog gi char dang / 'ja' sprin ngo mtshar ba rab tu mang po yang byung / gdung rus nas tsam yang ma 'khyar ba phal che ba gdung tshar btab/ gdung tsha che ba brgyad brgya btab pa la rigs lnga'i kha dog gi tshon rtsi gsol ba la dar gyi na bza' gsol ba dang / dbu thod chag grum med par byon pa'i nang du 'bru sna/ rin po che sna tshang / sman bzang drug sna tshang / byin rlabs kyi rten mang po dang bcas pas bkang / gos dar gyi na bza' mang pos dril ba dang / rten gyi stod smad bar gsum du bzhugs par 'os pa'i gzungs sna tshang gser gyi bris pa/ spar btab pa rnams dri bzang gi byugs pa/ zangs leb la gnod sbyin 'khor lo gser gyi bris pa dang bcas pa dang / gzhan yang 'bru sna tshogs/ sman sna tshogs/ rin po che sna tshogs dang bcas pa dang / bla ma nyid kyi phyag tu byung ba'i rten gsum khung btsun la byin rlabs kyi dpal 'bar bar shin tu thugs rtsis che ba rnams dang /

sa skya dga' ldan gyi 'phel gdung nas chad pa'i sras kyi ring bsrel dang / bla ma gong ma'i ring bsrel dang / dbu lo/ na bza'i dum bu/ thugs dam bdud rtsi ril bu/ rje rdo rje 'chang gi na bza'/ sku thabs gcig mus chen gyi sku chos/ sku bem skyer kha gcig bla ma nyid kyi snam sbyar la sogs pa gzungs rdzong gi chas phun sum tshogs pa rnams tshang bar bsham ste/ hor zla dgu pa'i tshes bdun gyi nyin lha bzo bas padma nas bsgrigs pa tshar rims kyi stod smad thad thad kyi gzungs rdzong bzhugs lugs gnad ma 'phyugs par rgyud sde nas gsungs pa bzhin rgyal tshab dam pa kho nas 'jug par mdzad pa'i rim pa la/ padma'i nang du gnod sbyin 'khor lo'i gtso byas pad gzungs dang / rin po che sna tshogs/ 'bru sna tshang / sman sna tshang / nas mi rgyab bcu gsum tsam dang bcas pa/ gzhan yang zhabs mgo phyag mgo sogs phyag zhabs rnams la yang rang rang gi thob tshul gyi gzungs/ 'bru sna/ sman sna la sogs pa bzhugs/ skyil krung mdzad pa'i sku smad kyi cha la gong du smos pa'i na bza' rnams dang / thob tshul gyi gzungs rnams dang / 'bru sna/ sman sna la sogs pa bzhugs/ de nas sku'i sked pa nas mgrin pa'i bar du rang rang thob tshul gyi gzungs dang / thugs kha'i dbus su dbu thod/ de'i g.yas su rdo rje 'chang gi gnang ba'i 'jam rdor gyi sku li ma zangs dkar lo tsa ba'i thugs dam yin nges/ dbu thod kyi g.yon du mus chen gyi thugs dam rdo rje rnal 'byor ma'i gser sku/ dbu thod kyi rgyab tu rdo rje 'chang gi phyag nas bzhugs pa'i sangs rgyas rdo rje 'chang gi gser sku/ dbu thod kyi mdun du rgyal sras thogs med pa'i yi dam ston pa'i gser sku/ rang rang thob tshul gyi gzungs sna tshang / 'bru sman/ bla ma nyid kyi gdung tshwa brgyad brgya po phal che ba rnams bzhugs/ dbu'i nang du bla ma nyid kyi bzhengs shing rab gnas mdzad pa'i rigs lnga rnam snang dngul/

gzhan rnams li ma yin pa rnams dang / thob tshul gyi gzungs/ bla ma gong ma/ bla ma nyid dang bcas pa'i gdung tsha/ gzhan yang byin rlabs kyi rten rab tu mang po rnams bzhugs/ gtsug tor 'og ma'i nang du bla ma nyid kyi bzhengs shing rab gnas mdzad pa'i tsandan dmar po dang / rdo gnyan las grub pa'i sa bir gnyis dang / gzungs dang / gdung tsha la sogs pa'i byin rlabs kyi rten rab tu mang po bzhugs/ gtsug tor gong mar gong du brjod pa'i ring bsrel la sogs pa dang / gzungs sogs byin rlabs kyi rten shin tu thugs rtsis che ba rnams bzhugs/ de nas rgyal tshab dam pa des tshes brgyad la rab gnas kyi sta gon rnams mdzad nas tshes dgu la dngos gzhi ste/ kyai rdo rje'i dkyil 'khor bsgrub mchod dang 'brel ba'i rab gnas phun sum tshogs pa mdzad/ de dag gi skabs su me tog gi char rgyun mi chad pa dang / dus mchod kyi skabs su 'ja' sprin ngo mtshar ba rgyun du byung ba yang kun gyi mthun snang du grub/ de nas lha bzo ba rnams la yang yon rdzong gser zho bdun cu don drug gi mgo byas/ rnga ma dkar nag gos dar/ 'phral chas/ ston mo/ ston rgyab sogs mdor na rten bzhengs pa'i cha lag phun sum tshogs pa thams cad nye gnas dge 'dun bzang pos bla ma nyid kyi sku drin 'khor med bsam nas blo gzur gnas kyi mis snyed gdags pa med pa'i mdzad pa phun sum tshogs pa mthar phyin pa lags shing / rab gnas grub pa nas bzung ste rten de'i drung du mchod pa bzang bar rgyun mi chad du bsham pa'i tshe ngo mtshar ba'i ltas dgun grang sgang la yon chab la 'khyags pa mi chags pa dang / rten gyi padma'i 'og tu rab gnas kyi me tog gtor ba'i nas la dgun yang myu gu sngo ljang sor bzhi lhag pa skyes pa rnams mngon sum du gyur pa dang / gzhan yang rten de'i zhal gyi dkyil 'khor la 'od zer phun sum tshogs pa dang / de'i drung du bsdad pa la yid rab spro ba dang /

blo sems bde ba la sogs pa yod pas/ phyogs lhung med pa'i mis da dung gzigs pas yid ches par bdog go /ces pa de rnams kyi kun mkhyen bsod nams seṅge'i rnam par thar pa dad pa rgya mtsho'i rlabs phreng rnam par g.yo ba zhes bya ba las/ a'u gzhon nu bzang pos mdzad pa'i rnam thar las 'byung tshul bshad pa'i skabs ste bzhi pa'o// //bstan pa'i bya ba rnam gsum mthar phyin nas/ /mkhas pa'i bya ba gsum la rab brtson zhing / /bslab gsum ldan pa'i chos grwa spel mdzad pa'i/ /kun mkhyen chos kyi rgyal po'i zhabs la 'dud/ /ces mchod par brjod nas// ༈ //spyi don lnga pa dga' gdung pa rin chen dpal bzang gi mdzad pa'i rnam thar dgos 'dod kun 'byung las 'byung tshul bshad pa ni/ kun mkhyen bla ma de nyid sku dngos kyi slob ma shākya'i dge slong rab 'byams pa rin chen dpal bzang gi mdzad pa'i rnam par thar pa las 'di ltar 'byung ste/ 'dir khams gsum chos kyi rgyal po/ yon tan rin po che ma lus pa'i bang mdzod/ sku blta bas chog mi shes pa'i bsod nams kyi ljon pa/ blang dor gyi gnas ma lus pa gsal bar byed pa'i ye shes kyi nyi ma/ phas kyi rgol ba ngan pa zil gyi gnon pa'i seṅge/ dgos 'dod yid bzhin du stsol bar mdzad pa'i ded dpon dam pa/ mdo sngags bstan pa'i mnga' bdag go bo rab 'byams pa bstan pa'i nyi ma zhes mtshan yongs su grags pa de nyid kyi rnam par thar pa ngo mtshar dgos 'dod kun 'byung zhes bya ba 'di la don bcu ste/ sngon bsags bsod nams las sku skye ba bzhes pa'i tshul/ /nges 'byung bsam pas bskul te bstan pa'i sgor zhugs pa'i tshul/ /zhugs nas sdom gsum gyi thugs rgyud smin par mdzad pa'i tshul/ /thos bsam bsgom pa gsum gyi grol ba brnyes pa'i tshul/ /'chad rtsod rtsom gsum gyi bstan pa spel ba'i tshul/ /mkhan btsun bzang ba gsum gyi yon tan mnga' ba'i tshul/

/bla ma yi dam mkha' 'gros rjes su bzung ba'i tshul/ /chags thogs med pas mngon shes mnga' ba'i tshul/ /rmad byung yon tan bsam las 'das pa'i tshul/ /bstan pa'i gsal byed slob ma bskrun pa'i tshul lo/ /dang po ni/ 'di ltar bcom ldan 'das ye shes rnam par snang mdzad kyi sngon gyi rgyu mthun pa'i smon lam gyi bskrun pa'i zhing gi bye brag shākya'i rgyal pos gdul bar bya ba'i gnas/ mi mjed kyi 'jig rten zhes grags pa gling chen po bzhi las/ 'jam bu'i gling zhes sgrog pa'i dbus 'gyur gyi tshal rdo rje'i gdan/ de'i byang phyogs gangs ri dpal dang ldan pa'i khrod 'dir/ bstan pa snga dar dang / phyi dar gnyis kyi/ phyi ma la yang dar tshul gnyis las/ rje 'di nyid bstan pa'i me ro mdo khams nas yar dar ba dang tshul mtshungs pa la dgongs/ mdo khams sgang gsum gyi nang nas zal mo sgang / smar khams kyi sa'i cha 'bom pa zhes bya ba'i yul du yab zha skyabs/ yum rgyal ba dman zhes bya ba'i sras su sa mo bya'i lo la ngo mtshar gyi ltas khyad par can du ma dang bcas/ dpal chen go bo bya ba'i rigs su sku 'khrungs te mtshan mi nyag dpal zhes btags/ de dang sku mched bzhi 'khrungs pa'i gcen po lha bzo ba brtson 'grus 'bum zhes bya ba bzo rig pa'i gnas la mkhas pa/ gcung po bla ma legs pa rgyal mtshan dang / gnam 'brug zhes bya ba bzhi'i nang nas/ rje 'di nyid ni byis pa'i spyod pa las 'das te/ dam pa chos kyi rigs sad pa'i rtags chos kyi khri brtsig pa/ chos bshad nyan gyi rnam 'gyur gyi tshul ston pa dang / klog kyang slob par rtsom pa tsam gyi tshegs chung ngus mkhyen pa la rten nas shes ldan rnams kyi 'di la chos pa rab gcig 'ong pa 'dug zhes mthun par sgrog pa dang / yab yum gnyis kyi kyang chos sgor bcug dgos par 'dug gsungs pa la dga' spro chen po skyes gsungs so/ /gnyis pa nges 'byung bsam pas bstan pa'i sgor zhugs pa'i tshul ni/
