dgung lo drug pa la bzang po spyod pa'i smon lam yang yang gzigs pas/ de'i tshig don me long la gzugs brnyan shar ba bzhin gsal bar dgongs pas nges par 'byung ba'i bsam pa khyad par can 'khrungs te/ dgung lo brgyad pa la mkhan chen bsod nams 'od zer dang / slob dpon kun dga' 'bum pa la rab tu byung ste mtshan bsod nams seṅge zhes bya bar gsol to/ /bslab bya rags rim kyang gsan/ der rjes go bo rab 'byams pa chen po shes rab dpal zhes grags pa'i drung du mjal bas/ khyod kyi bstan pa la phan pa rgya chen po zhig 'ong ba'i ltas khyad par can byung bas re zhig 'dir 'dug la slob gnyer gyis gsungs te/ kun mkhyen rong po'i tshig don rab gsal gyi bshad lung gnang / thugs la bzung bas shin tu dges te/ nga rang dang 'dra ba cig 'ong bar 'dug gsungs bas/ kun gyi go bo rab 'byams pa mtshan gsol lo/ /de nas bka' chen bzhi/ dbu ma rtsa 'jug la sogs pa'i gzhung rab tu mang po thugs su chud/ dbang rjes gnang sems bskyed sogs mang du gsan zhing / khyad par 'jam dbyangs a ra pa tsa na'i bsnyen pa mdzad dus mnal lam du/ ral gri gcig shub nas phyung nam mkha' la 'phyar dgos snyam pa na/ ral gri des dbus gtsang khams gsum du khyab/ tshur bsdus pa rang gi lcer song te so bar nas snyug tsam na gnyid gsad pa dang / lo rgyus go ram chen mo la zhus pas/ ltas bzang po nged la byung pa dang mthun par 'dug 'phrin las bsam gyi mi khyab pa 'byung ba'i rtags yin/ nged kyis kyang dbus gtsang du phyin/ mkhas pa'i dbang po g.yag rong sogs bla ma dam pa mang po'i drung du chos zab la rgya che ba mang du zhus/ chos sde chen po rtses thang du po ti brgya tsam gyi grwa bskor bstan pa la phan pa byas pa yin/ khyed kyang dbus gtsang du 'gro dgos gsungs nas gnang sbyin rdzong ltar mdzad/ rong ston thams cad mkhyen pa'i drung du 'bul ba mang po dang bcas 'brug lo la dpal na lend+ra'i chos grwa chen por phyags phebs/

dge 'dun tshogs pa la mang ja zhu yig dang 'bul ba brgya tshan mang po'i nang nas/ slob gnyer ba brgya'i dod la rje nyid la che bstod bsngags pa dang bcas pa phul bas/ mngon par mkhyen pas dgongs te/ spyir bstan pa rin po che/ khyad par dpal ldan sa skya pa'i bstan pa la phan pa'i bshad nyan 'bul yig nang bzhin 'brug ldir ldir 'ong ba 'dug gsungs pa'i lung bstan dang / rje btsun mi g.yo bas rjes su gnang ba mdzad dus rje nyid la nyams khyad par can du ma 'khrungs/ rong ston chen po'i zhal nas mi g.yo ba ni grwa pa brgya'i dod po bstan pa yar khur 'di la thim song gsungs pas/ sangs rgyas dngos kyi 'du shes skyes/ phyis sku drung du slob gnyer bya lugs dang / gsung chos kyi zhu gnang phul ba/ nged rang gi dge bshes byams chen rab 'byams pas/ lo 'brug lo/ gnas bod 'brug dgon par bshad nyan btsugs pa'i rten 'brel la brtag pas/ bod gangs can 'dir bshad nyan 'brug ldir ldir 'ong ba'i ltas kyang bzang / slob gnyer kyang shin tu 'phel bas der phyin par legs pa'i lung bstan bzang po gsungs so/ /gsum pa sdom pa gsum gyi thugs rgyud smin par mdzad tshul ni/ khams su dge tshul la sogs sdom pa gsum ldan du mdzad/ phyis dgung lo nyi shu rtsa bdun pa la e waṃ chos ldan du rje btsun rdo rje 'chang chen pos mkhan po/ mkhan chen kha 'phyar ba bsod nams rgyal mtshan dpal bzang pos las slob/ rje sems dpa' chen pos gsang ste ston pa'i slob dpon/ mkhas grub gung ston shes rab bzang pos grib tshod mdzad/ dge 'dun grangs tshang bas las kyi kha skong mdzad de bsnyen par rdzogs pa'i sdom pa rnam par dag pa nod nas nyes byas phra zhing phra bas kyang ma gos par bsnyen par rdzogs pa'i lo brgya lon pa'i dge slong dang tshul mtshungs par bsrung sdom mdzad pa zhig go /byang sems kyi sdom pa ni/ rje rdo rje 'chang la dbu ma sems tsam lugs gnyis/

dbang gi sngon 'gro'i sems bskyed kyi cho ga rje btsun sems dpa' chen po'i drung du dbu ma lugs kyi sems bskyed chen mo tshar gnyis dang / maṇḍal tshom bu lnga pa la brten pa'i brgyud pa gnyis ldan gyi nang gi birwa pa nas brgyud pa'i sems bskyed tshar bzhi/ dbang gi sngon 'gro'i sems bskyed tshar lnga'i sgo nas rnam par dag pa nod cing / de dag so so'i bslab bya yang zhib tu gsan/ rtsa ba byams snying rje'i nyams len tshul bzhin du mdzad pas sa la gnas pa'i sems dpa' chen po rnams dang tshul mtshungs pa zhig go /rig pa 'dzin pa'i sdom pa ni/ rje rdo rje 'chang yab sras kyi drung du smin par byed pa'i dbang bskur ba mang du zhus te/ dam tshig nyi shu sogs tshul bzhin du bsrung zhing bskyed rdzogs gnyis kyi nyams len rgyud sde so so dang mthun par mdzad pas/ gsum ldan rdo rje 'dzin pa chen por gyur pa yin no/ /de dag gi skabs su rgyud kyang smin par mdzad pa yin te/ dang po rab tu byung dus chos kyi sdom bzhi'i don la gsal snang can gyi ye shes khyad par can 'khrungs pa dang / dbang gi ye shes dbang pa'i dus su tha mal snang zhen 'gags nas mtshon byed dpe'i ye shes khyad par can thugs rgyud la 'khrungs pa'i phyir ro/ /de yang mdo sde rgyan las/ ji ltar rma dang zas la de dag gi /zag dang spyad du rung ba smin 'dod ltar/ /de bzhin rten 'dir phyogs gnyis zhi ba dang / /yongs su spyad pa nyid du smin par bstan/ /zhes gsungs pa dang mthun no/ /bzhi pa thos bsam bsgom pa gsum gyi grol ba brnyes pa'i tshul ni/ rje nyid sku tshe dpag tu med pa nas bsod nams kyi tshogs bgrangs ba las 'das pa bsags pa'i stobs kyi pha rol du phyin pa dang / rdo rje theg pa'i gzhung lugs la legs par sbyangs shing / man ngag rin po che du mas thugs rgyud bltams pa la brten nas sku tshe 'dir yang zab pa dang rgya che ba'i gzhung lugs 'ga' zhig 'bad rtsol med par thugs la gsal bar byon pa dang /

'ga' zhig dam pa'i zhal nas lan re zung re thos pa tsam gyi gzhung lugs kyi tshig don ma lus pa mkhyen pa'i mnga' bdag dam par gyur pa zhig go /de yang / tshul gnas thos dang bsam gtan pas/ /bsgom pa la ni rab tu sbyor/ /zhes gsungs pa ltar/ thog mar rab byung gi mkhan slob gnyis la dge tshul gyi bslab bya ston pa ka ri ka lnga bcu pa sogs du ma gsan zhing / go bo rab 'byams pa chen po la tshig don rab gsal gyi thog drangs mdo phyogs rab tu mang po dang dbang rjes gnang man ngag gi gnad sogs mtha' yas pa gsan gsungs/ bar du kun mkhyen rong ston chen po'i drung du tshig don rab gsal sogs zhabs drung du bzhugs ring gang gsungs gsan gsungs/ de nas lung bstan ltar 'bras yul skyid tshal chos kyi pho brang du phebs te/ yongs rdzogs bstan pa'i mnga' bdag kun mkhyen chos kyi rgyal po'i drung du/ byams pa'i chos lnga rang rang gi 'grel pa dang bcas pa tshad ma'i mdo rang 'grel 'grel bshad dang bcas pa gsan cing bskyor mgo yang mdzad gsungs/ tshad ma rnam 'grel 'grel chen brgyad dang sbyar ba'i bshad pa/ rigs gter rtsa 'grel/ gtan tshigs thig pa la sogs pa rigs pa'i gzhung lugs du ma gsan/ 'dul ba la rtsa ba'i mdo so so thar pa/ de'i 'grel pa bam po lnga bcu pa dri med bshes gnyen gyi mdzad pa/ mdo rtsa ba rgya cher 'grel pa dang bcas pa/ me tog phreng rgyud sogs 'dul ba'i gzhung lugs du ma gsan/ mngon pa la kun las btus 'grel pa rgyal sras ma dang sbyar ba/ mdzod rtsa 'grel/ 'grel bshad rgyal po sras/ gang ba spel/ gzhan yang sa'i dngos gzhi sogs sa sde lnga/ dbyig gnyen gyi pra kā ra ṇa sde brgyad sogs byams pa dang 'brel ba'i chos phal che ba gsan cing thugs su chud par mdzad do/ /dbu ma la rtsa 'jug bzhi brgya pa dang gsum/ spyod pa la 'jug pa/ rigs tshogs phyi ma bzhi/ gtam gyi tshogs la rin chen phreng ba dang /

bshes springs sogs/ shes rab kyi pha rol du phyin ma la bstod pa sogs bstod tshogs phal cher gsan/ gzhan yang 'jam bsdud smon lam gsum gyi bshad lung sogs mang du gsan cing / thos pa de dag thams cad kyang / ming rkyang tsam du ma bzhag go /zhes gsungs pa ltar/ rje nyid kyi zhal nas/ dad ldan 'ga' zhig la nged 'dir slebs dus kun mkhyen rong po la mngon mkhyen mnga' bar 'dug rab byams chos kyi rje ni shākya thub pa/ 'khor rnams kun dga' bo la sogs pa'i rnam 'phrul/ skyed mos tshal bya rgod phung po'i ri dang tshul mtshungs sam snyam gus 'dun drag po skyes te/ ja gang yod pa la mang ja 'bul ba sogs byas/ phogs rkyang pa la rten nyin mtshan 'khor yug tu slob gnyer la 'bungs pas thos byung gi shes rab kyi gzhung lugs de dag gi tshig blo la blangs/ bsam byung gi shes rab kyi don mi brjed par bzung / bsgom byung gi shes rab kyi de dag gi don tshul bzhin du yid la byas ste/ rigs grwa lung grwa sa dang / tshogs pa rgya mtsho lta bu'i dbus su chos kyi bskyel phul bas thams cad ngo mtshar te/ 'di ni don gyi rab 'byams pa rang du 'dug gzhan 'di tsam gyi blo skyed ga la 'ong zhes kun du sgrog pa dang / kun mkhyen chos kyi rgyal pos kyang bstod bkur bsngags gsum yang dang yang du mdzad de/ thugs dgyes pa chen pos rjes su bzung ba yin/ khyed rang rnams kyang bla ma la gus pa dang slob gnyer la 'bungs gsungs pa'i don la bsam na/ sangs rgyas rnams la lhag par byas/ /de la dge ba'i rtsa ba bskrun/ /dge ba'i bshes kyi mgon bcas pas/ /'di ni nyan pa'i snod yin no/ /sangs rgyas rten dang kun 'dri dang / /sbyin dang tshul khrims sogs spyod pa/ /len dang 'dzin pa la sogs pa'i/ /snod du dam pa rnams bzhed do/ /ces gsungs pa'i yon tan thams cad mnga' ba'i bdag nyid chen po yin par gdon mi za'o/

/skabs cig tu gsang sngags zab mo'i chos kyi slong tshad lta bu'i snyung gzhi drag po zhig byung ba la phan pa'i ched dang / rgyud gsum man ngag dang bcas pa la thugs gnyer gyi 'dun pa drag po dang / rje rdo rje 'chang yab sras la mi phyed pa'i dad pa chen pos thugs rgyud bskul te/ rab 'byams chos rje'i drung du e waṃ chos ldan du 'gro ba'i zhu gnang phul bas/ sngar pha rol du phyin pa'i yon tan rgya dpang che ba'i steng du gsang sngags rdo rje theg pa la mkhas pa cig byung na bstan pa spyi dgos la phan pa yongs gsungs te grol cha gnang / dbon sa mi'i dbang po nor bu bzang po la rab 'byams pa 'di pha rol du phyin pa'i yon tan bsam gyi mi khyab shes/ rdo rje theg pa'i slob gnyer la e waṃ chos ldan du song yod pa chas kha'i mthun rkyen mgo 'don bdag rkyen dgos pa'i zhu yig dang / rje rdo rje 'chang chen po'i drung du'ang go bo rab 'byams pa 'di pa slob bshad kyi yul du gyur pa'i snod ldan yin lags pa/ gsung ngag rin po che'i thog drangs dpal ldan sa skya pa'i zab chos rnams dang / gzhan yang rgyud/ 'grel pa/ rgya gzhung / dbang / rjes gnang / man ngag gi gnad sogs mgo 'don bdag rkyen du gang 'gro sku drin gyi bskyangs dgos pa'i zhu yig rten bcas kyang mdzad/ khyed kyi 'dir slob gnyer la brtson 'grus byas pa bzhin sngar gyi tshig don rnams ma brjed pa dang / gsang sngags zab mo la de bas kyang brtson 'grus che bar dgos pa'i zhal gdams mdzad/ dgung lo nyer lnga pa la e waṃ chos ldan du dbyar chos la phebs/ rten 'brel kyang shin tu 'grig kyai rdor 'grel pa lugs dang / sambu ṭi'i rdor dbyings kyi dbang gsan/ rjes kyi dus su dung bskyar te gnang bus gsungs/ rje nyid kyi lan gsum bus pas skad shin tu che ba byung ba la thugs dges/ grags pa don dang mthun pa bstan la phan pa 'ong bar 'dug gsungs/

der rjes gsung ngag rin po che tshar gnyis/ zab pa dang rgya che ba'i dbang byin rlabs/ lung rjes gnang / rgyud rgya gzhung gi bshad lung sogs mang du gsan/ rje sems dpa' chen po'i drung du gsung ngag tshar lnga/ lam bskor phyi ma zhar byung 'phros dang bcas pa/ bde mchog lū nag dril gsum gyi dbang byin rlabs/ dril bu rim lnga/ nag po rim bzhi/ nā ro mkha' spyod sogs mkha' spyod ma'i bskor/ rdzogs rim rtsa dbu ma la sogs te rnal 'byor gsang mtha'i bskor rnams ma lus pa/ gsang ba 'dus pa 'phags lugs kyi dbang / /rim pa lnga'i khrid/ rtsa rgyud rgyud phyi ma dang bcas pa/ bshad rgyud dgongs pa lung ston/ rdo rje phreng ba/ lha mo bzhis zhus/ ye shes rdo rje kun las btus pa/ rdo rje snying po rgyan gyi rgyud/ mdor byas mdo bsres sogs du ma dang / ye shes zhabs kyi bskor ma lus pa/ gshin rje gshed dmar nag 'jigs gsum gyi bskor dang / khyad par rnal 'byor dbang phyug gi gshin rje gshed dmar po lha lnga'i rgyud rgyas pa dang sbyar ba'i gzhung brgyad/ shin tu spros med kyi khrid sogs dang / kyai rdo rje'i bka' babs rnam pa bzhi/ rgyud gsum man ngag dang bcas pa ste mdor na rje rdo rje 'chang yab sras la rnal 'byor bla med kyi rgyud sde chen po rnams dang / de dag so so'i dgongs pa 'grel ba byed pa'i rnam 'grel du ma dang / so so'i dgongs pa dang mthun pa'i dkyil 'khor gyi cho ga dang / so so'i sgrub thabs dang / zab mor gyur pa'i man ngag gi gnad dang / rjes su gdams pa dang bcas pa/ rnal 'byor rgyud la sbyong rgyud dgongs 'grel lag len gyi rim pa dang bcas pa'i bshad lung / spyod rgyud la a ra pa tsa na lha lnga sogs dang / bya rgyud la tshe dpag med lha dgu sogs te rgyud sde bzhi'i bskor dang / sa skya bka' 'bum/ rje yab sras kyi bka' 'bum ste/ lung man ngag rnams bum pa gang byo'i tshul du gnang zhing legs par thugs su chud pa yin no/

/thugs kyi sras mchog dam pa rdo rje 'chang kun dga' dbang phyug pa la mgon po'i rjes su gnang ba sogs gsan zhing lung bstan pa dag kyang byung gsungs/ mkhan chen kha 'phyar ba la gur rigs bsdus/ sbyong rgyud dkyil 'khor bcu gnyis/ rta mgrin lcags ral gyi rjes gnang sogs gsan/ mkhas grub dam pa gur ston shes rab bzang po la sdom gsum rab dbye/ gsang 'dus/ bde mchog 'jigs byed sogs kyi bshad pa rgyas pa/ dkyil 'khor so so'i lag tu blangs ba'i rims pa phra zhing phra ba dogs gcod kyi tshul gyi zab don gyi gnad mang po la yang phan par byung bas bka' drin can yin gsungs/ bdag chen zha lu ba dang / chu mig pa la chos skyong bskor gyi rjes su gnang ba las tshogs dang bcas pa gsan/ gling smad pa rin po che shes rab dpal ldan pa la mkhan chen g.yag pa nas brgyud de 'ong pa rje btsun sa paṇa dang 'jam dbyangs dbyer med du bsgrub pa'i rjes su gnang ba gsan/ gzhan yang zab pa dang rgya che ba'i chos kyi gter mdzod dam par bzhugs pa so so'i gsan yig tu shes par bya'o/ /de la 'di skad ces brjod de/ gang zhig srid na mkhas pa'i mchog gyur dam pa rnams kyi gsung gi bdud rtsi legs 'thung zhing / /shes bya'i gnas rnams ma lus shes kyang nga rgyal med cing mang du thos pas mi ngom pa/ /bsam byung rigs pas tshul bzhin rnam dpyod bsgom byung rnal 'byor rgyun du bsgom pas grol ba rnyed/ /rang gzhan grub mtha' rgya mtsho'i mthar son go ram bstan pa'i bdag po kun mkhyen bla ma rgyal/ /zhes pa'i dam pa de nyid thos bsam bsgom gsum mthar phyin pas rnam grol gyi 'bras bu brnyes pa yin te/ 'bras yul du bzhugs dus snyung gzhi thu mo zhig byung ba'i tshe/ mthu stobs kyi dbang phyug chos rje'i drung du btsun pa sku rim la bzhugs pa'i mnal lam du/ rje nyid la bar chad rtsom pa'i rgyal po zhig 'dug ste/

de la khyed bla ma 'di la bar chad brtsam pa ci yin/ gang nas 'ong dris pas/ nga gu ge'i rgyal po yin/ nged gu ge'i nor rdzas stobs che ba ngor na yod/ bla ma 'di'i ma 'ongs pa na ngor pa'i bstan pa 'dzin par 'dug pas bar chad byed pa yin zer ba rmis bas/ rgyal po 'di la dmigs pa'i thugs dam mdzod gsungs ba thugs la bzhag lta ba 'khor 'das dbyer med gtso bor bsgom pa'i gnas skabs su rgyal po de'i cho 'khrul byung ba'i tshe/ bdag gzhan brje ba'i byang chub kyi sems rin po che dang lta ba rtse gcig pa mdzad pas rgyal po 'ja' yal ba ltar song ste/ bar du gcod pa dang bdud kyi tshogs thams cad las grol zhing / khyad par bde kye gnyis kyi gzhi bsnyen mdzad dus grol byed lam gyi rtog pa khyad par can 'khrungs tshul du ma zhig gsang bar gdams pas bri bar ma nus so/ /lnga pa 'chad rtsod rtsom pas bstan pa spel ba'i tshul la/ 'chad pa'i yon tan ni/ de ltar grol lam la mnga' brnyes pas gsung rab rab 'byams la mi 'jigs pa'i spobs pa thob ste/ gdul bya so so'i blo dang 'tshams par rjod byed kyi tshig rnams go bde zhing 'brel chags pa/ brjod bya don dang ldan pa/ byed las thar pa thob pa dang rjes su mthun par zab pa dang rgya che ba'i chos ston pa zhig ste/ de yang mdo 'chad na phun sum tshogs pa lnga/ rgyud 'chad pa na mtha' drug tshul bzhi sogs dang / bstan bcos 'chad pa na dgos don/ bsdus don/ tshig don/ mtshams sbyar/ brgal lan gyi gtan la phab pa lnga'i sgo nas legs par 'chad cing / de yang zhib par ni/ dgung lo sum cu so gcig pa la bla ma ye shes rgyal mtshan pa dang sku mched gnyis khams su 'byon pa'i zhu gnang kun mkhyen chos kyi rgyal po'i drung du phul bas/ khyed rang gi bla ma gong ma rnams kyi lung bstan byung tshul dang / dpon sa chos rgyal nor bu bzang pos bsgor na legs pa'i phyag dam kyang phebs/

gang sa nas gtsang phyogs la bzhugs na legs pa'i bka' lung zhib rgyas gnang / rje nyid kyi bskyar zhus 'bul ma nus/ ye shes rgyal mtshan pas nan zhus phul ba la/ 'o na khyed rang rje sems dpa' chen po'i drung du brtag pa zhus na legs gsungs pa ltar khong gi brtag pa zhur byon pas/ sems dpa' chen po'i zhal nas/ brtag pa byed mi dgos/ khams su phyin na longs spyod che ba ni 'ong / tshe ring rgyu med/ bstan pa la phan thogs kyang chung / go bo rab 'byams pa rang gtsang phyogs su bsdad na tshe yang cung zhig ring ba dang / bstan pa la phan thogs rgya chen po 'ong gsungs ba'i lung bstan dang bstun/ ye shes rgyal mtshan pas khams su byon/ rje nyid kyi 'bras yul du bzhugs/ thog mar skal ldan 'ga' zhig la zur ches pa mdzad/ der rjes kun mkhyen chos kyi rgyal pos rgyal tshab lta bur dbang bskur te/ dge ba'i bshes gnyen rab tu mang po la sdom pa gsum gyi rab tu dbye ba'i bshad pa rgya cher mdzad de/ kun mkhyen chos kyi rgyal po'i 'khor nyung rags dang bcas te rje btsun sems dpa' chen po'i drung du phyags phebs/ de'i ring rta lug sprel gsum la dam pa chos kyi char chen po phab/ bka' chen bzhi/ sdom rig gnyis/ dbu ma rtsa 'jug bzhi gsum/ byams chos phyi ma/ mngon pa mdzod sogs gzhung lugs rab 'byams kyi bshad pa rgyas pa dang / bcom ldan 'das gshin rje gshed dmar po lha lnga'i dkyil 'khor du smin par byed pa'i dbang bskur ba mdzad nas/ sngags sdom gyi bshad pa shin tu rgyas pa dang / rjes su gnang ba dang / man ngag zab mo 'ga' zhig gi sgo nas skal ldan mang po zhig smin grol la 'god par mdzad pa sogs kun mkhyen chen po bzhugs pa dang tshul mtshungs pa'i snyan pa'i grags pas sa steng ma lus par khyab pa mus su gsan pas thugs la dges pa chen po 'khrungs/ kun mkhyen chos kyi rgyal pos/ rje btsun sems dpa' chen po'i drung du/

mkhas pa go bo rab 'byams pa gdan sar bskos/ nga rang dang chos bshad nyan grwa pa'i 'dzin skyong spel gsum khyad med pa yong pa'i snyan pas khyab pa bzhin/ don la yang gnas pa blo yul du bzhag mang du thos pa nags kyi tshal dag tu/ /lang 'tsho yol ba rnams kyi gnas pa bde/ /zhes gsungs pa dang mthun par bdag rang bsgrub pa rtse gcig tu byed pa'i blo 'dun lags pa/ dben gnas dang nyams len zab mo bya tshul sogs thugs brtse bas bskyangs dgos pa'i zhu gnang phul bas/ khyed lta bu tshe 'dir bsgrub pa rang la ltos mi dgos/ mkhas grub du ma'i skye ba brgyud mar bzhes pa 'dug pas/ bshad nyan kyi rgyun mthud na gzhan don rgya chen po 'ong / gnas dben pa bsten pa bas 'bras yul du byon pa legs/ nged kyi 'dir gsung ngag rin po che cha lag zab mo bsgrub pa lung sbyin pa'i mtha' rten dang bcas pa bum pa gang byo'i tshul du phul/ dpal gsang ba 'dus pa 'di bshad pa'i gzhi che bas/ rgyud 'grel pa 'grel bshad/ rgya gzhung dbang khrid/ lung man ngag dang bcas pa rnams dang / gzhan bde mchog bskor sogs dgongs bzhed gang yod pa rnams bsgrub gsungs ba'i bka' lung phebs pa la/ gong bzhin bskyar te zhu gnang nan gyis phul kyang / go bo rab 'byams pa 'dir bde mchog gi chos kyi 'phro ma 'dra dgos pa yod pa dang / gtsang phyogs su dpal ldan sa skya pa'i bstan pa la phan pa'i bshad nyan cig tshugs su re bas/ nged kyi yi ge 'di khong pa la sprod la drung pa phebs 'phral rdzong ba'i do dam mdzad dgos gsungs ba'i bka' lung phebs pa bzhin dgongs pa dang sbyar/ phyag phebs 'phral du rje sems dpa' chen po'i bka' shog bka' lung zhib tu phebs tshul ni 'di ltar yin/ nged kyi bsam pa la ni khyed kyi 'di khar bshad nyan gyi 'phro mthud na grwa pa rnams la'ang phan thogs che zhing / nged kyi bsnyen pa dang dge sbyor la gtso bor bsgril/

sngags kyi bshad pa byas na thabs shes zung 'jug tu 'gro ba 'dug pas/ sems dpa' chen po'i drung du dgongs khrel mi 'jug pa'i zhu yig re phul na grol cha gnang bsam pa ni shar/ gang legs gsungs pa la/ rje nyid kyi sems dpa' chen po'i drung du bde mchog nag po pa'i chos rnams mi zhu kha med yod pa dang / gzhan yang zab chos 'dra zhu 'dod yod pas 'byon pa'i zhu gnang phul bas grol cha gnang / na bza'/ chibs pa/ gsol ja/ dkar yol/ gos dar sogs kyi gnang sbyin rgya chen po/ khal ma lam chas sogs gang dgos dang bcas rje nyid phyag phyi ba nyung rags dang bcas te/ bya lo zla ba dang po la mus su rje sems dpa' chen po'i drung du phebs/ thugs dges pa chen po'i sgo nas bde mchog nag po pa'i dbang bka'/ nag po rim bzhi'i khrid/ gzhan yang man ngag gi gnad du ma zhig gnang / chos don du gnyer ba'i dad ldan su byung la bshad nyan gyis gsungs pa ltar/ dbang rjes gnang / rgyud rgya gzhung gi bshad pa sogs mang du mdzad/ khyi lo la sems dpa' chen po byang ngam ring du phebs/ tshogs pa stong lhag tsam la gsung ngag rin po che gsungs pa'i phyag phyir rje nyid kyis kyang rgyud gsum gyi bshad pa dang / gzhan yang gang la gang 'os kyi chos kyi char chen po phab/ de rjes mus su phebs/ byams chen chos rje sku skyes pa sogs sku chen mang po yang mjal ba la phebs/ de dus rje nyid la khyed kyi gtsang phyogs su bshad nyan cig 'dzugs dgos/ da lta mkhas grub chen po chos rje don yod dpal ba bzhugs pa yin te/ sku nas kyang bgres/ rjes su ci yong yang mi shes pa 'dug sngar chos rje mkhyen rab dbang phyug dang / de'i gdan sar nam mkha' bsod nams chen po lta bu bzhugs kyang / de'i rjes su yang ci 'ong mi shes pa 'dug pas gtsang stod 'dir dpal ldan sa skya pa'i bstan pa la phan pa'i bshad nyan lta grub gtsang ba zhig 'dzugs dgos gsungs pa'i bka' lung yang dang yang du phebs pa las/

gang sa nas tshugs pa cig mi 'ong lags sam zhus pas/ byams chen sku skyes pa dang bgros te sang nyin rten 'brel sgrig gsungs pa'i bka' lung phebs pa'i nub mo sku skyes pa'i mnal lam du/ chos kyi khri chen po zhig brtsig gin 'dug pa la/ sus yin dris pas rje btsun grags pa'i yin zer ba rmis bas/ sang dpon slob gsum zhal 'dzoms dus sku skyes bas rmi lam rmis tshul dang / bshad nyan gyi bdag rkyen gang dgos byed pa'i zhal lta zhus pas/ rje btsun sems dpa' chen po thugs shin tu dges te rten 'brel bzang gsungs/ bshad nyan 'dzugs pa la thugs thag bcad/ phyis sku skyes pas gdan 'dren byung bas/ 'byon khar sems dpa' chen po'i zhabs spyi bor blangs smon lam mdzad pa'i tshe/ sems dpa' chen pos dbang brgyud kyi bla ma rnams dang mkha' 'gro chos skyong la bden brdar mdzad/ 'dis bstan pa spyi dang bye brag bshad nyan tshul bzhin du byed pa yod pas/ bla ma dam pa rnams kyi thugs rje dang byin rlabs ma lus pa 'jug par gyur cig chos skyong ba'i bsrung ma rnams kyis kyang 'gal rkyen bar chad bsrung zhing / mthun rkyen chos bzhin du bsgrub pa'i 'phrin las mdzod cig pa'i bka' bsgo mdzad pa'i tshe sku la 'phar g.yo sogs nyams khyad par can 'khrungs/ de'i tshe byin rlabs kyi rten/ na bza'/ bdud rtsi ril bu brgya phrag dang / stong rdo sogs gnang sbyin rgya chen po mdzad nas byams chen du phebs/ sku skye ba dang gsung gleng zhib par mdzad/ kun mkhyen chos kyi rgyal po'i drung du'ang mjal/ sngar bka' lung phebs pa bzhin gtsang stod du bshad nyan 'dzugs dgos pa'i sems dpa' chen po'i bka' lung yang yang phebs tshul sogs zhib par zhus pa na shin tu legs gsungs te/ sngar grwa pa mang nyung / mthun rkyen 'dzoms mi 'dzoms ji ltar byung kyang dka' ba spyad dgos/ nged kyis kyang bod 'brug dgon par bshad nyan btsugs tshul sogs khyed rang gi thugs la mnga'/

phugs su sems dpa' chen po thugs mkhyen mnga' zhing / sku skye bas kyang bdag rkyen legs par mdzad na bstan pa la phan pa'i 'phrin las chen po yong gsungs pa'i bka' lung bzang po yang phebs/ de'i dbyar gser kha sding du bde mchog gi bsnyen pa sogs thugs dam rtse gcig tu mdzad/ ston gtsang stod du phebs/ thog mar dga' ba tshal du sngar gyi grwa pa dad gus can 'ga' zhig dang / gsar du lhags pa thog gcig la bshad nyan btsugs/ de nas rta nag ri khud dang gser gling sogs su chos dbar mdzad/ de'i skabs nas byams chen dbyar chos la phebs pa dang / kun mkhyen chos kyi rgyal po chos sde dga' ba gdong gi khri thog tu phebs pa dang dus mtshungs/ dge 'phel rnam sras gling gi mtshams su mjal/ bshad nyan tshugs pa shin tu legs gsungs te srab chen gyi sku chos shin tu legs pa gcig yod pa gnang sbyin mdzad/ da dung rgyun bsrings dgos 'phrin las chen po 'ong gsungs/ der rjes stag lo la dga' ba gdong du mjal ba la phebs/ gsol ja mang po'i 'bul ba mdzad/ na bza' sku bem gcig gi thog drangs pa'i gnang sbyin dang / dpon slob gnyis ka la thugs dges spro chen po'i mjal kha legs pa rang byung gsungs/ de nas e waṃ chos ldan du phebs/ gsang sngags kyi chos kyi 'khor lo mang po bskor/ der rjes dpon sa chos rgyal chen po gtsang chen sku mched/ dpon drung g.yung pa dpon blon rnams kyi rin chen rtse phul/ thub bstan rnam par rgyal ba'i chos sde btab/ bshad nyan shin tu 'phel ba'i stobs kyi grwa tshogs kyang shin tu che ba'i skabs nas glang lo'i ston e waṃ chos ldan nas mi sna chos khrims dang bcas pa thub bstan du byon/ gdan sa'i 'khur bzhes dgongs pa'i zhu gnang phul bas/ de dus dgongs pa la rmi lam cig la e waṃ nas grwa pa mang po phyogs su 'gro yi 'dug pa la/ 'du khang steng nas gaṇḍi gcig brdungs pas grwa pa de rnams log byung ste/

chos gcig bshad pa rmis ba dang / rje rdo rje 'chang yab sras kyi lung bstan rnams dang / rdo rje 'chang kun dga' dbang phyug pa mnga' ris su rjes ma phebs pa'i tshe/ rta nag phu'i chu khar bskyel thung la byon pas gsung gi mtha' ma rang la/ bla ma gong ma'i lta grub dang / gnas dgon la mig rgyang dang brtson pa bsrings dgos so gsungs ste bdud rtsi ril bu khyor gang gnang ba rnams thugs la dran te dus la babs pa yin snyam du dgongs te zhal bzhes gnang / ser mchod la phyags phebs gsung chos mang du gsungs/ de nas thub bstan gyi dgun chos dang po 'dzugs pa dang bstun bshad nyan gyi 'khur slob dpon gsum dang / spyan tshab pa bzhi'i mdzad dgos pa'i bka' lung gnang / tshogs pa la yang sgrigs rnam dag sogs gang dang spyi sngar bas ma g.yos pa so so nas 'khur len dges pa'i zhal lta nan che ba gnang / e waṃ du phebs stag lo'i gsung ngag khri thog tu ma bzhugs pa gnang / yos lo hor zla dang po'i gza' tshes rten 'brel 'dzoms pa la rgyal tshab byams pa dang tshul mtshungs par/ rje gong ma rnams kyi rgyal tshab dam par dbang bskur te khri thog tu sku blta bas chog mi shes shing nyi ma 'bum gyi gzi brjid can/ gsung tshangs pa'i dbyangs dang ldan zhing / thugs mkhyen pa'i dpal gyi mngon par mtho bar bzhugs/ de'i drung du dpon sa chos kyi rgyal po gtsang chen gyi thog drangs bstan pa rin po che'i sbyin bdag rnams dang / chos sde so so'i bla ma slob dpon/ las tshan/ khams tshan/ dad ldan so so nas dga' ston gyi 'bul ba rgya chen po phul te/ tshogs pa rnams kyi rab tu gnas pa'i bkra shis kyi dbyangs dang / me tog gi char chen po phul/ dkar phyogs la mngon par dga' ba'i lha rnams kyis kyang me tog gi bskyel phul ba sogs ngo mtshar gyi ltas du ma dang bcas te/ lhar bcas 'gro ba kun gyi gtsug brgyan dam par bzhugs te/

lo bzhi'i ring la gsung ngag rin po ches thog drangs rgyud sde bzhi dang 'brel ba'i dbang byin rlabs/ lung rjes gnang man ngag sogs chos kyi 'khor lo rgya chen po bskor bar mdzad de/ rta lo sa ga zla ba'i nyer lnga'i dus chen steng du rje rdo rje 'chang yab sras kyi lung bstan/ rje nyid kyi thugs dam brtag pa'i rten 'brel bzang po dang bstun 'dul ba 'bum sde'i gzhung lugs la dbang 'byor zhing / bslab pa rin po che rnam pa gsum mig gi 'bras bu ltar gces par 'dzin pa/ dran shes bzhin bag yod pa gsum gyi dbang po'i sgo bsdams pa/ ngur smrig 'dzin pa rnams kyi gtsug na rgyal mtshan gyi tog ltar mngon par mtho ba dgra bcom pa nye ba 'khor lta bu/ byang chub sems dpa'i sde snod rgya mtsho lta bu'i pha rol tu son pa/ byang chub kyi sems gnyis thugs la 'khrungs te bdag pas gzhan gces pa'i byang chub sems kyi rba klong g.yos pas rnam pa thams cad du gzhan don du mdzad pa rlabs po che la g.yel ba mi mnga' ba byang chub sems dpa' kun tu bzang po lta bu/ rig pa 'dzin pa'i rgyud sde rgya mtsho lta bu la mnga' brnyes shing / rim gnyis zab mo'i ting nge 'dzin gyi rtogs pa brtan pas tha mal snang zhen gyi 'ching ba las grol te/ rnam par grol ba'i 'bras bu phyag rgya chen po mchog gi dngos grub brnyes pa rnal 'byor gyi dbang phyug chen po birwa pa lta bu ste/ mdor na dus gsum sangs rgyas thams cad kyi ngo bo/ srid pa gsum gyi 'dren mchog dam par gyur pa mtshungs med chos kyi rje rin po che dkon mchog 'phel ba'i mtshan can rgyal tshab dam par dbang bkur te/ na bza' gos bem dmar smug legs pa gcig gi thog drangs gnang sbyin yang dag pa yongs kyi dge ba'i bshes gnyen 'dus pa rgya mtsho la chos dang mthun pa'i dga' ston rgya chen po bka' lung ji ltar gnang ba'i lugs bzhin phyag len bzang po la thebs par mdzad de/

rje nyid kyi dge legs rgya mtsho'i shis brjod/ tshogs pa rnams kyi kyang rab tu gnas pa'i bkra shis kyi dbyangs dang me tog gi char chen po phab/ rje nyid khri thog tu phebs pa'i lugs bzhin dga' ston gyi 'bul ba rgya chen po phul/ phyi nyin bla brang nang nas kyang dga' ston gyi mang ja/ gdan non/ rje rin po che'i drung du 'bul ba/ gang la gang 'os kyi rnam gzhag dge 'dun so so la ka dan zung 'brel gyi gnang sbyin phun sum tshogs pa dang bcas te bsngo ba smon lam gyis rgyas btab/ shis brjod kyi rab tu gnas pa legs par grub rjes/ kun mkhyen chen po'i zhal nas/ da ni 'dod pa legs par grub pa yin/ khyed 'ga' zhig gi chos 'phro rnams myur du bsgrub zla ba dkar nas thub bstan du 'gro gsungs te phyags phebs chos kyi 'khor lo rgyun mi chad pa bskor ba yin no/ /rtsod pa'i sgo nas bstan pa spel tshul ni/ 'bras yul du rigs lung gi sar/ gzhan gyi ma rtog pa dang / log par rtog pa dang / the tshom gyi dra ba rnams tshar bcad pa dang / tshogs su yang chos rje rtses thang rab 'byams pas zhal phod chen po dang bcas te dam bca' bzhag pa la/ rje 'dis dngos stobs kyi shugs kyi rigs pas sun phyung ba la/ kun mkhyen chos kyi rgyal pos kyang bstod bskur bsngags gsum mdzad de rtsod pa'i 'gran zla thams cad dang bral ba yin no/ /rgyas par ni spyir sangs rgyas kyi bstan pa/ khyad par dpal ldan sa skya pa'i bstan pa dri ma med pa la ma rtog log rtog the tshom gyi dri ma 'thug pos sgrib pa rnams sun dbyung ba'i phyir du dbu ma'i lta ba shan 'byed/ stong thun chen mo/ kyai rdor/ gsang 'dus/ kun rig gsum gyi rtsod spong / sdom gsum dris lan sogs kyi gsal bar bstan pa yin no/ /rtsom pas bstan pa spel tshul la gsum ste/ bstod tshogs/ rigs gnas mchog gi tshogs/ bsngo ba smon lam gyi tshogs so/

/dang po la bla ma rin 'byung gi bstod pa/ rje rdo rje 'chang yab sras/ kun mkhyen chos kyi rgyal po/ go ram chen mo/ gung ston shes rab bzang po/ paṇa chen grags pa rdo rje/ rje btsun skarma pa/ byams chen chos rje sku skye ba/ chu 'dus mkhas btsun pa/ 'chum sde chen mkhan po/ khro phu'i byams chen/ phag mo dkar mo/ rje btsun sgrol ma/ bdag chen blo gros pa/ gur lha brgyad kyi bstod pa rnams dang / sa skya paṇḍi ta chen po'i rnam thar/ sems dpa' chen po'i rnam thar snga rting rtsa 'grel/ gsung ngag brgyud pa'i bla ma mchod chog phar tshad brgyud pa'i gsol 'debs dang mchod yal sogs mdzad/ gnyis pa la sgra rig pa rtags 'jug gi ṭīkka/ brda 'grol nges pa'i dpal ster sogs mdzad/ tshad ma rigs pa la rnam 'grel gyi ṭīka chen/ de'i sbyor ṭīka spyi don chen mo/ rigs gter gsal byed sogs mdzad/ nang don rig pa la phar phyin theg pa'i bskor/ phar phyin dka' 'grel chen mo/ de'i spyi don/ sbyor ṭīka yan lag rgyas bshad/ dge 'dun nyi shu/ snyoms 'jug rab gsal/ 'dul ba'i bslab bya/ mdo rtsa'i sa bcad/ mngon pa mdzod kyi ngo mtshar gsum ldan/ dbu ma'i stong thun chen mo/ lta ba shan 'byed/ rtsa she'i ṭīkka/ 'jug pa'i dka' 'grel/ spyi don/ rigs tshogs phyi ma rnams kyi bsdus don sogs mdzad/ rdo rje theg pa'i bskor la/ kyai rdo rje man ngag lugs kyi rnam bshad/ dbang chu'i sa chog gi gsal byed/ rje btsun bdag med ma'i dbang bskur dang byin rlabs bya tshul/ mngon par rtogs pa tshul bcu bzhi'i bshad pa/ man ngag gi gnad/ kyai rdor rtsod spong / lam 'bras chos 'byung / lus dkyil rnam bshad/ lam dus kyi dbang dang / chag gso byed tshul/ bir bsrung thun mong ma yin pa'i byin brlabs bya tshul/ rnam 'joms bir lugs kyi gsal byed/ snang ba gsum gyi skabs su nye bar mkho ba'i zin bris/ lam rgyas 'bring dang zab 'bring du bstan pa/

tshad ma'i gsal byed/ rtsa rgyud kyi tshig don la dogs gcod/ sambu ṭ-i'i bsdus don/ cho ga'i zur 'debs/ mtsho skyes kyi phra mig gur rigs bsdus kyi mngon dkyil/ lam 'bras a seng ma'i ṭīkka/ zab don bdud rtsi'i nying khu/ bde mchog chos 'byung dang rnam bshad/ lū nag gi mngon rtogs/ nag po rim bzhi'i khrid yig pha rgyud la 'jigs byed sa lugs kyi mngon dkyil/ spros med rgyun gyi rnal 'byor/ gsang 'dus 'jam rdor gyi mngon dkyil/ gtor chog mchod phreng / rnam bshad/ gsang 'dus rtsod spong sogs mdzad/ rnal 'byor rgyud la sbyongs rgyud ṭīkka/ kun rig rtsod spong dang sbyin sreg bya rgyud la dge slong ma dpal mo'i gzhung bzhi nyams su len tshul sogs mdzad/ chos skyong la mgon rkyang gi rjes gnang dang bsrung 'khor bsgom tshul sogs mdzad/ mdo sngags thun mong du zhen pa bzhi bral gyi khrid/ sdom gsum rab dbye'i ṭīkka/ spyi don/ sdom gsum kha skong / de'i sa bcad/ phyogs snga ngos 'dzin/ dris lan/ gzhan yang dris lan thor bu bcu lhag tsam mdzad pa yi go mang du dogs pas bka' 'bum dkar chag tu gsal lo/ /gsum pa lam 'bras smon lam/ bde ba can gyi smon lam sogs mdzad de/ mdor na zab pa dang rgya che ba'i rtsom pa mdzad pa de dag kyang tshig bzang po/ don bzang po mkhas pa rnams kyi yid 'phrog pa zhig ste/ thos na lha'i dbyangs ltar yid 'phrog cing / /bsam pas myang na bdud rtsi ltar tshim la/ /bsgom pas 'chi med bcud len thob 'gyur ba'i/ /dpe gsum ldan pa 'di ni khyod la sbyin/ /zhes pa dang tshul mtshungs pa'o/ /drug pa mkhas btsun bzang gsum gyi yon tan mnga' ba'i tshul ni/ de ltar mkhas pa'i bya ba gsum gyi bstan pa rin po che ches gsal bar mdzad pas mkhas pa'i grags pas sa steng ma lus pa khyab ste/ gangs can mkhas pa kun gyi gtsug gi rgyan dam par gyur to/ /de yang bsnyen par rdzogs nas lnga phrugs kyi yon tan nyer gcig la mkhas pa'i sgo nas 'dul ba 'bum phrag gi bdag po nye ba 'khor lta bu/

byang chub mchog tu sems bskyed nas/ /brtag par dge ba'i bshes gnyen ni/ /theg chen don la mkhas pa dang / /ces pa ltar mdo sde zab mo'i tshig don ma lus pa la mkhas par gyur pas/ mdo sde 'bum phrag gi bdag po kun dga' bo lta bu/ rdo rje 'dzin pa chen por gyur na zab don mtha' dag la mkhas pa'i sgo nas rgyud 'bum phrag gi bdag po phyag na rdo rje lta bu ste/ mdor na mdo rgyud man ngag gi gnad mtha' dag la mkhas pa'i sgo nas grub pa'i mtha' bzhi/ sde snod gsum/ rgyud sde bzhi'i don la thun mong ba rnams mi 'gal zhing / thun mong min pa rnams so sor 'byed pa la mkhas pa'i mkhas pa chen po rgyan drug dang mtshungs pa'o/ /btsun pa'i yon tan ni/ bslab pa rin po che la mig 'bras bzhin gces par mdzad pas nyes ltung gi dri ma phra zhing phra bas ma gos shing / dran shes bzhin bag yod pa gsum gyi dbang po'i sgo sdom pa kun spyod 'dul ba dang mthun pa'i sgo nas gtsang ba gsum gyi brgyan pa/ ngur smrig 'dzin pa rnams kyi gtsug gi nor bur gyur pa ste/ mus su rje nyid dang spre ba snya sgur bya rong pa kun dga' 'bum mnyam du bzhugs pa'i dus su chas kha shin tu dkon pa rje sems dpa' chen pos dgongs te/ sna ba gcig gi sha 'bul mi byung ba sha 'di tshang ma dge slong gsum la skyol gsungs nyi phyed yol nas gnang byung pa/ spre bos 'tshod grab dang bza' rtsis byas pa la/ rje nyid kyi nged rang gsum dge slong yin sang snga dro btsos pas chog gsungs pas/ spre bo dge slong gsum ma shi na dang tshugs byed long 'ong zer yang / sems dpa' chen pos dgongs khrel 'ong gsungs nas mtha' bkag pa sogs bcas pa phra zhing phra ba yang gzhan dbang du ma song ba bsrung ba dang / slob dpon seṅge bzang pos/ rtag tu mnyam par gzhag pa nyid kyi dran pa dang shes bzhin dang ldan pa dang / gtsang sbra kun du spyod pa nyid kyi gos la sogs pa yongs su spyod pa gtsang ba/

zhes pa'i rtags dang mthun pa ste/ btsun pa'i mchog yon shāka gnyis dang tshul mtshungs pa'o/ /bzang ba'i yon tan ni/ rje nyid kyi zhal nas nged gsang sngags kyi chos rnams zhu dus chas kha shin tu dkon pa byung yang bsod snyoms sogs lto gos kyi rtsol ba ma byas par/ chos don du gnyer ba la gtso bor byas/ 'on kyang bla ma yab sras la sangs rgyas dngos kyi 'du shes skyes/ nyi shu lnga mchod sogs zla mchod ma chag tsam dang / zab chos rnams zhu dus rab gser dngul/ tha na yang zho re re ba'i dngos po re rtsol ba chen po byas nas phul/ de'i byin rlabs dang thugs rjes da ni longs spyod ches pa tsam byung ste dga' tshor med tshe la gnod bsam pa byung gsungs ba dang / gzhan yang phan btags lan du gnod pa skyel ba sogs 'khor ba'i nyes dmigs gzigs pas gzhan don la yongs su skyo ba med pa'i sgo nas gzhan gyi phan pa chung ngu byas pa yang thugs la dran zhing drin du bzo ba dang / gzhan gyi gnod pa chen po byas pa la yang / gnod pa la ji mi snyam pa'i bzod chen po bsgom te/ gnod lan du phan pa bsgrub pa la sogs byang chub kyi sems rin chen thugs rgyud ma bltams pa'i sgo nas byang chub sems dpa' kun du bzang po dang tshul mtshungs pa'o/ /bdun pa la gnyis te/ bla ma yi dam lhas rjes su bzung ba'i tshul dang / mkha' 'gro chos skyong gi rjes su bzung ba'i tshul lo/ /dang po ni go bo rab 'byams pa chen pos rjes su bzung ste/ ma 'ongs pa na rgyab ri kha lho bstan zhig tu 'gro don rgya chen po 'byung zhes lung bstan pa ni/ 'bras yul/ thub bstan rnam rgyal/ e waṃ rnams su gzhan don 'byung ba la lta ba 'dra zhing / de dus 'jam dbyangs kyi rjes su bzung ba'i mnal ltas bzang po yang byung gsungs/ kun mkhyen rong pos rjes su bzung ste rje btsun mi g.yo ba'i byin rlabs zhugs pa sogs kyi lung bstan bzang po mdzad/

kun mkhyen chos kyi rgyal pos rjes su bzung ste/ mdo khams ma 'byon rtsis dbus gtsang du bzhugs na 'phrin las che ba'i lung bstan mdzad de/ chos kyi rgyal tshab dam par yang dbang bskur mdzad pa 'phrin las kyi sgo phye ste/ phyi nang gsang gsum gyi rten 'brel sgrig par mdzad/ rje btsun sa skya pa chen pos rjes su bzung ba'i tshul/ shing pho 'brug gi lo gsung ngag pa shin tu mang ba zhig gi rgyu dus kyi skabs su sku bsnyel te/ mnal za zi tsam gcig gi dus su sa skya pa chen po byon te/ sems can gyi don la g.yel ba ma byed gsungs ba'i snang ba byung dus/ rigs drug kun gyi bdag po rdo rje 'chang / /rgyal ba kun gyi mkhyen pa 'jam pa'i dbyangs/ /sangs rgyas kun gyi mthu stobs birwa pa/ /dbyer med bla ma khyed la bdag skyabs mchi/ /zhes pa'i bstod pa yang mdzad gsungs/ /rje btsun chen pos rjes su bzung ste/ rgyu dus kyi dbang gcig gi skabs su mnal lam dum gcig gis khyed gzhan don rgya che ba'i rten 'brel byed pa yin zer nas/ rje btsun grags pa'i bum chu yin zer ba gcig lus la bran/ khar yang blug byung ba mthar tshe dpag med kyi gzungs du song ba'i snang ba byung gsungs/ de dang mthun par mkhas pa kun blo'i mnal lam du/ bla ma 'di e waṃ gi khri thog na 'dug pa'i steng gi bar snang na rje btsun grags pa bzhugs nas 'di gzhan don rgyun ring ba'i thabs byed gsungs ba snyam pa zhig la rje btsun chen po tshe dpag med gcig tu song ba'i snang ba byung gsungs ba'ang thos so/ /sa skya paṇḍi ta chen pos rjes su bzung ste/ rong chung gi 'phrang dog pa gtsang po'i 'khor gcig la rje nyid lhung ba'i tshe/ 'jam dbyangs bla ma sa paṇa la mos gus drag po'i sgo nas chos rgyal ma tshar mang po bton pas lam 'grul pa thog cig byung ste thag pa dang / ske rags sogs mang du mthud de btang byung pa la bla ma mkhyen snyam du 'jus pas nyes med du bde bar phebs gsungs ba'i don la brtag na 'khor ba sdug bsngal gyi rgya mtsho chen po las bsgral te/

bde ba chen po'i grong khyer du 'jam dbyangs bla ma dang mjal ba dang / lam 'grul pa de rnams kyang rnam par sprul pa zhig yin nam snyam mo/ /rje rdo rje 'chang chen pos rjes su bzung ste/ ku ru kulle'i rjes gnang zhus dus/ gos chen dmar smug gyon pa'i bud med zhig gi shing tog rlon pa thu ba gang sprad nas 'di zo zhes pa dang / rnga dmar po gcig gtad de brdungs shig pa'i brda mdzad/ de brdungs pas kyang skad chen po byung / mnal sad pa dang thugs la bde nyams chen po skyes gsungs/ rje btsun sems dpa' chen po'i rjes su bzung ste/ mus gling dgar bzhugs pa'i dus zhig gi tshe gzhung bshad dmar ma gsan pa'i skabs su/ glo bur gyi snyung nad drag po zhig byung ba la sems dpa' chen po mkhyen snyam du gzim khang la dbu gtad de gzim pa'i tshe/ mnal gyi za zir cig la khang pa'i nang dri bzang gi gang / sems dpa' chen pos zhal chab mang po btab pa'i snang ba byung / de'i mod la mnal gsad de nad thams cad sprin dengs pa bzhin song gsungs/ yang ngam ring du kun rig rtsod spong brtsams dus kyi mnal lam du/ ne gseng gi thang chen po zhig na grwa pa mang pos khri chen po zhig brtsig gin 'dug pa la/ su'i khri byed pa yin dris pas sems dpa' chen po sbyong rgyud gsungs pa'i khri yin zer/ rje nyid kyi kyang rogs mdzad de khri grub pa'i steng du sems dpa' chen po phebs/ zhal phod chen po dang bcas sbyong rgyud gsungs ba nyan pas phal cher thugs la zin/ khyad par legs bshad shog bu gcig tsam thugs la zin pa mnal sad pa dang / kun rig rtsod spongs du tshig ris bris/ de'i mjug tu/ mnal lam ri rtser rtags kyi mtshan ma mthong / /zhes pa yang mdzad do/ /yang khams su mnal lam la gser gyi bris pa'i po ti mang po gzigs pas/ bcom ldan 'das ma he'i dbang po la phyag 'tshal lo/ /zer ba mang po byung pa de 'jigs byed sa lugs kyi mngon dkyil brtsams pa la 'gro don yong ba 'di la lta ba 'dra gsungs/

yang zla ba gza' zin zhig gi nub mo rje btsun 'jam dbyangs kyi bsnyen pa mdzad pa'i dus mnal lam du/ mi gcig gi dung dkar shin tu che ba gcig pang du bzhag pa rmis/ de dbang rdzas kyi dung bskyar te 'bud pa la lta ba 'dra gsungs/ bo dong er chos dbar mdzad dus/ bya rgod gshong du spyan ras gzigs rang byon la mjal du byon pas/ me tog gi char chen po babs pa sogs yi dam lhas rjes su bzung ba'i rnam par thar pa brjod kyi mi lang pa 'dug na yang / gsang bar gdams pa mdo tsam zhig bkod pa yin no/ /gnyis pa mkha' 'gro chos skyong gi rjes su bzung ba'i tshul ni/ sa skyar chos dbar snga ma la phebs dus/ kha'ub skyed lhas kyi mgon khang du gtor bsgrub mdzad pas/ gnyan los rgya gar nas gdan drangs pa'i 'od ma'i thug cig yod pa rje nyid kyi phyogs su mgo dud dud byed pa byung pa dang / thub bstan du mnal lam gcig la skyed lhas kyi brag phug yin snyam pa cig na dpon slob 'ga' bzhugs pa la/ mon pa phru gu gnyis 'dug pa/ rjes phyag phyi ba rnams la gdong bzhi pa'i sprul pa bram ze'i gzugs can yin par 'dug gsungs pas/ mon pa phru gu gnyis 'dzum 'dzum byed/ khyed ye shes kyi mgon po yin pas mngon par shes pa thogs med du mnga'/ ngas tshe mjug la bsgrub pa byas na legs sam/ bshad pa byas na dga' gsungs pas/ mon phrug gnyis kyi bsgrub pa bsgrub pa zhes brjod kyin mgo ril ril byed gsungs/ tshad ma'i spyi don brtsams dus kyi mnal lam du/ chos kyi rje dge slong blo rin pa dang / rje nyid kyi mi rtog ma'i dbyangs mdzad pas/ lung pa'i phu na mar rol mo'i sgra dang / 'od zer gyi tshogs dang / dmag gi dpung tshogs du ma zhig 'ong ba'i snang ba byung pas ci yin dris pas/ dpal mgon gdong bzhi pa'i dpung tshogs rnams yin zer/ bltas pas zhabs kyi pus mo man chad la thog gsum re tsam 'dug

zhabs las 'od zer khrom khrom 'phros nas/ khyod kyi bstan bcos kyi cha shas yongs su rdzogs pa rtsoms zhig bdag po nged rnams kyi byed pa yin zer ba dang / rta nag gser gling du nub gcig gi tshe/ bsam grub rtses bstan pa rab gsal zhes pa chos khrims la yod pa zhal ta zhur phyin pas/ khyod cung zhig yong ba sngas/ pu tra yin zer ba'i a tsa ra dung long can gcig nga'i gam du byung lab lab 'ga' zer grab yod pa yin te da yal nas song gsungs/ de dag ni chos rje nam bsod chen mo'i mnal lam du rta nag bskor na/ sa skya pa'i gur mgon gyi sgar yin zer ba rmis pas/ ma 'ongs pa na rta nag 'dir sa skya pa'i bstan pa cig 'ong bar 'dug gsungs pa dang mthun par 'dug go /gzhan yang a'u gzhon nu ba sogs drung na 'khod pa'i skal ldan 'gas kyang / skabs skabs su drung na mi med kyang zhabs rgya di ri ri mdzad pa'i zla'o re 'ong ba lan mang du byung gsungs ba sogs mdor na dpal nag po chen po lcam dral dang / zhing skyong dbang phyug gdong bzhi pa 'khor bcas/ las kyi mgon po gnod sbyin yab yum pu tra lcam sring rnams bran du bka' nyan zhing / zhi rgyas dbang drag gi 'phrin las thogs med du bsgrub pa zhig go /brgyad pa chags thogs med pa'i mngon shes mnga' ba'i tshul ni/ dgung lo gsum bzhi'i dus sngon gnas rjes su dran pa byung tshul thugs la'ang cung zhig dran zhing / yab yum gnyis gsal bar yang gsungs skad do/ /'bras yul du skal ldan gyi grwa pa 'ga' la bar du gcod pa'i rnam pa 'dra byung bas sel ba'i man ngag ji ltar gnang ba bzhin bar chad las grol rjes/ 'di 'dra ba'i rigs can rnams bsam na shes par 'dug ste/ mig mthong ba sogs kyi mthong byed nyan yod pas gzhan la gsang zhig gsungs pa dang / gnyer chen ra lod rdo rjes tshe ring thung dang / tshe mjug la ji ltar byas na sogs kyi lung bstan zhus pa na/

'jig rten gyi bya ba la snying po cher med/ gnyer las phul/ bstan pa rin po che dang dge 'dun gyi zhabs tog la brtson pa dang / dge sbyor gang 'phel mdzod tshe ring po 'ong gsungs pa ltar khong gis kyang bsgos pa bzhin bsgrub pas lung bstan dang mthun pa'i sku tshe ring ba sogs byung bas/ rje nyid la mngon mkhyen mnga' ba 'dug ces gsungs pa'ang thos so/ /dpon drung g.yung pa la'ang lung bstan snyan bskul phul tshul sogs dang / gzhan yang grwa pa snod ldan 'ga' la lung bstan pa thog tu babs pa rnams kyi don la brtag na mngon mkhyen mnga' bar nges shing / gnas lnga rig pa'i paṇa chen grags pa rdo rje dga' ba gdong du lam 'bras 'dzugs rtsis la cung zad bsnyel ba sogs rtsub 'gyur gyi rnam pa byung ba la 'then dgos pa 'dra/ nub mo mnal lam du rje nyid sku blta bas chog mi shes pa nyi ma 'bum gyi gzi brjid can gyi rnam par byon/ rnal 'byor dbang phyug gi bstan pa'i rgyun la phan tsham tshom med par gsung ngag btsugs na legs gsungs ba'i lung bstan phebs pa ltar bar chad med par grub pa dang / chos skyong gi 'phyar dar chen mo bzhengs pa'i tshe mnal lam du byon nas lung bstan mdzad pa rnams ji lta ba bzhin byung pa la brten nas mngon mkhyen mnga' bar the tshom mi gda'o/ /zhes gsungs pa dang / khyad par tshe 'jug 'di la bsgrub pa rtse gcig byas na tshe ring bar 'dug ste/ ga zi shākya blo gros sogs khams mnga' ris kyi 'bul ba 'di rnams stobs ches pas tshe longs spyod du gyur/ drug cu re gcig pa 'di la ci 'ong mi shes pa 'dug ste/ rje btsun sa skya pa yab sras kyi rjes su 'dzin nam snyam pa yod gsungs pa ltar/ phyis mdzad pa mtha' ma ston tshul/ de dus thub bstan du mi gsum gros byas pa gcig gdan sar bsko rtsis mi 'ong / so sor 'gro/ gcig la rjes mi 'ong / gnyis pa la legs po 'ong /

mthar gcig tu 'gro yang srid gsungs ba sogs drung na 'khod pa rnams las gsal bar thos pa rnams kyi don legs par bsam nas mngon mkhyen mnga' bar 'dug kyang / snod min la gsal bar mi gsungs pas kun mkhyen chen por grub ste/ rin chen phreng ba las/ gang phyir de ltar zab pa'i chos/ /snod min 'gro la mi gsungs ba/ /de yi phyir na mkhas rnams kyi/ /kun mkhyen thams cad mkhyen par thos/ /zhes gsungs pas so/ /dgu pa rmad du byung ba'i lung bstan bsam las 'das tshul ni/ sku tshe dpag tu med pa nas yi dam gyi lhas rjes su bzung zhing / mkhas pa mkhas pa zhes bya ba'i grangs su rtogs te/ chos kyi 'khor lo rgya chen po bskor bas/ zhing 'di yi mdzad pa rnams mthar phyin/ rang don chos kyi sku mngon du mdzad de/ gzhan don 'bad med lhun grub kyi tshul du rgyun mi chad pa'i phyir/ zhing gzhan 'gro don rgya che ba la dgongs te/ zhing 'dir mdzad pa mtha' ma'i tshul ston par bzhed nas/ sa pho spre'u'i hor zla dgu pa'i nang du dpal e waṃ chos ldan du phebs/ rdo rje theg pa'i bstan pa yun ring du gnas pa'i mdzad 'phrin rgya che ba'i rten 'brel la dgongs/ 'dren mchog chos kyi rje rin po che la dpal mgon gdong bzhi pa'i rjes su gnang ba bka' bsgo lung dang bcas pa dang / chag med bzhi'i byin rlabs kyang bskyar nas gnang ba yang rje nyid kyi mdzad pa'i/ dkon mchog gsum dngos bla ma nyer bsten nas/ /rmad byung yon tan kun gyi gter mnga' zhing / /gsang chen bstan pa 'phel ba'i 'phrin las can/ /'dren mchog chos kyi rje la phyag 'tshal lo/ /zhes bstod pa dang mthun par mdzad rjes thub bstan nas gdan sa chen por chos dbar bteg 'jam dbyangs bla ma sa skya paṇḍ-i ta'i dus chen la gzhi byes kyi tshogs pa nyis stong lhag tsam la chos dang mthun pa'i snum bag gi bsnyen cing bkur ba gser zho brgya'i thog drangs/

g.yu mu tig byu ru spos shel/ ja gos dar/ gla rtsi sogs sman dos/ gzhan yang zang zing gi dngos po stobs che ba'i 'gyed chen dang / che mgo so so la 'bul ba/ gnang sbyin/ mgon khang dang bla brang tha dad kyi mchod khang rnams su thug dar lcog zla ba gnyis kyi bar dkar me rgyun mi chad pa stobs che ba dang / gtsug lag khang gi zhig bzos sogs la phan pa'i dge rgyun mang du sbyar/ zab pa dang rgya che ba'i chos kyi 'khor lo yang bskor te chos dang zang zing gi gzhan phan rgya chen po mdzad/ khyad par bse mgon drung du gtor bsngo tshar bzhi lnga re ma chag pa dang / skabs skabs su dpon slob bdun brgyad res bskangs gso bstod dbyangs/ tshogs 'khor sogs mkha' 'gro mnyes pa'i cho ga rnam par dag pa mdzad pa'i 'jug tu/ rje btsun gong ma rnams kyi thugs kyi dgongs pa rdzogs pa dang / bstan pa rin po che dar zhing rgyas pa dang / thub bstan du ston pa'i gser sku chen mo gcig bzhengs pa la bar chad med cing mthun rkyen phun sum tshogs pa dang / rab gnas legs par grub pa'i bka' bsgo dang bcas pa grub pa'i sgo nas/ thub bstan gyi bshad nyan rgyun bsrings ba'i smon lam yang 'debs pa mdzad pa dang mthun par/ thub bstan du sku gdung bzhu 'bul rten bzhengs sogs grub na legs pa la dgongs te gdan sa chen po nas sa mo bya'i hor zla dang po'i tshes bdun brgyad la phebs lam du bo dong pas gsol phogs phul/ ma tha na'ang chos dbar zla gcig tsam bzhugs zhu ba nan gyi phul ba la/ da lan shin tu ring bas bsdad skabs med gsungs pa'i bka' lung thag gcod gnang kyang / drung na 'khod pa 'ga' zhig zhu ngo la sbran/ khong rnams kyis kyang grwa pa la phan pas gsol phogs bzhes na legs zer/ phyed phogs gcig blangs tshes bcu la chos tshugs/ chos gsungs pa'i skabs su rje btsun gong ma rnams kyi mdzad pa mtha' ma bstan tshul/ gnyal zhig sogs bla mas grub rtags ston rtsis la slob mas go ma chod byas tshul/

bstan pa'i 'phel 'grib byung tshul gyi lo rgyus du ma zhig gsungs gzim khang du phebs/ spyan nam mkha' la hrig hrig bzhad mo dang bcas te/ bltas mo shin tu che khyed rnams kyi mthong nge gsungs ba sogs dag pa'i gzigs snang khyad par can du ma zhig byung ba'i brda mdzad/ tshes bcu dgu'i tho rang nas snyung ba'i tshul bstan/ nyi shu'i nyin mtshan gnyis la sku rim stobs che ba bsgrub kyang / da lan nged rang gi bsam pa bzhin thub bstan du slebs na gang sa nas g.yeng ba chung zhing bsam pa rdzogs pa cig yong ba yin te/ 'ga' zhig gi gegs byas/ 'on kyang gdan sa chen po dang khad nye bas bsam pa bde/ da khyed rang rnams 'jig rten gyi bya ba la snying po med/ tshe 'di blos thong / chag med bzhi sogs dge sbyor la 'bungs gsungs ba la/ drung na 'khod pa rnams kyi 'tsho byed gdan 'dren kyang song / sku rim stobs che ba yang bsgrub kyin yod pas sku khams bde skyed che ba nas thub bstan du myur du phebs pa 'ong lags sam zhus pas/ zhal 'dzum 'dzum mdzad 'bod mi gcig byung gdan sar bskor cig 'gro dgos pa 'dra gsungs/ da nged dge sbyor la 'jog pas su yang ma btang / zar zir gyi lab lab mang po ma byed gsungs nas thugs dam rtse cig tu bzhugs pa'i ngang nas nyer gcig gi nyi ma rtse shar la thugs dam 'pho ba zab khyad can mdzad de/ zung 'jug bde ba chen po'i dbyings su rmad du byung ba'i ngo mtshar gyi ltas du ma dang bcas te gshegs pa'i tshul bstan to/ /de yang 'di ltar te/ chos sku bde ba chen po mngon du mdzad pa'i brdar 'od gsal gyi lta stangs dang / nyi ma shar 'phral gnyis dus mtshungs nam mkha' g.ya' dag pa sogs dang / gzhan don gzugs kyi skur bzhengs pa'i brdar gdan sar skor cig 'gro gsungs pa dang mthun par/ sa skya lha khang chen mo ba'i sras mo lo drug bdun tsam lon pa gcig gi rje nyid chibs pa ngo mtshar rmad du byung ba zhig la chibs te theg chen chos kyi rgyal po'i gzim khang ka gnyis mar phebs pa mthong zer ba dang /

dbu rtse rnying ma'i dkon gnyer gyi tsha'u btsun chung gcig gis kyang rje nyid rje btsun 'jam pa'i dbyangs kyi drung du byon song zer ba rnams dang / rje nyid kyi bka' lung snga phyi rten 'brel bsgrigs tshul rnams kyi don legs par brtag na/ rje btsun gong ma rnams dang / khyad par rje btsun sa skya paṇḍi ta chen pos rjes su bzung bar mngon no/ /de nas thub bstan rnam par rgyal ba'i bstan pa yun ring du gnas par bya ba dang / skal ldan rnams kyi gsol ba btab pa na dgos 'dod yid bzhin du stsol ba'i byin rlabs kyi chu rgyun 'jug par bya ba'i rten du sku gdung rin po che nyer bzhi'i tho rangs thub bstan du gdan drangs/ nyer lnga la chos kyi rje spyan tshab pas bzhu 'bul rtsis mdzad pa na yang / chos skyong bsrung ma rnams dang / dkar phyogs la mngon par dga' ba'i lha rnams kyi re zhig bzhugs na legs pa la dgongs rin po che'i char 'bebs pa la sogs kyi slong tshad che ba nas bzhu 'bul ba then/ sku gdung rin po che a ka ru dang tsandan dkar dmar ga pur kha phye sogs dri bzang gi byugs/ lha rdzas kyi na bza' sna lngas klub ste mchod pa'i bye brag du ma dang bcas za ma tog gi nang du spyan drangs/ phyi mchod rten gyi rnam pa la bla bre/ sku sbyar sogs dar gyi na bza' sna tshogs pas spras te mchod pa'i sprin phung chen po'i dbus na byin rlabs kyi gzi 'od phun sum tshogs pa lham me lhan ne lhang nger bzhugs pa'i drung du/ chos kyi rgyal tshab thugs kyi sras mchog ngur smṛg 'dzin pa rnams kyi gtsug rgyan/ bstan pa rin po che'i gsal byed dam pa gsum gyi gtso mdzad/ gzhung lugs rab 'byams smra ba'i mkhas pa sde snod 'dzin pa/ rig grol gyi yon tan gnyis dang ldan pa'i yang dag pa yongs kyi dge ba'i bshes gnyen 'dus pa rgya mtshos rang rang gi 'byor pa dang bstun/ sku gdung rin po che'i drung du kun du bzang po'i mchod pa'i sprin phung bsam las 'das pa dang /

mang ja sogs bsnyen cing bkur ba phun sum tshogs pa ('dir rtsa ba'i ma dpe las rgyab shog shog lhe chad 'dug pa'i dgongs 'jag 'tshal/)dang bar snang thams cad gang zhing / du ba 'ja' gur spungs pa'i sprin gyi rtse mor rdo rje dang / ral gri dang / rin po che la sogs pa ri mo sna tshogs kyi rnam par kun nas bkra ba'i ltas khyad par can du ma dang drung na 'khod pa 'ga' zhig la yang sngon med pa'i ro dro ba'i mchog dang ldan pa'i bdud rtsi myong ba snyam byed cing / nyams khyad par can gyi ting nge 'dzin bzang po yang byung skad do/ /de nas gdung khang zhal phye ba'i tshe rten ring bsrel mang po dang / dbu thod ril por byon pa'i nang du bdud rtsi ril bu/ rin po che sna tshang / sman bzang drug 'bru sna tshang ma/ ja sogs 'dod yon lngas gang bar byas te lha rdzas kyi na bza' dri bzang dang bcas rten gyi thugs khar bzhugs/ ring bsrel rnams dbu'i cha la bzhugs/ gdung rus rnams rin po che'i snod du spyan drangs/ phal cher la gdung tsha che ba brgyad brgya tsam btab pa la kha dog sna lnga'i tshon gyi bkra bar byas/ gos dar gyi na bza' dri bzang po dang bcas pa rnams dang / phyag na yod pa'i rten byin brlabs can rnams dang / de bzhin gshegs pa'i ring bsrel/ rje btsun gong ma'i ring bsrel/ gdung tsha sogs stobs che ba dang / gsung rab rab tu mang ba dang / gnod sbyin gyi 'khor lo sogs rgyud sde nas gsungs pa'i gzungs gzhug rnams rje btsun gong ma rnams kyi ji ltar gsungs pa dang / gang la gang 'os go rim ma nor bar lhag chad 'khrugs 'dir rtsa ba'i ma dpe las rgyab shog shog lhe chad 'dug pa'i dgongs 'jag 'tshal/ 'ja'i rnam pa la/ phyag mtshan rdo rje dang / gri gug dang / rin po che dang / padma dang / ral gri dang / 'khor lo dang / utpal dang / sna tshogs rdo rje dang / bum pa bzang po dang / dga' ba 'khyil pa'i gzugs kyi bkod pa ya mtshan pa mang po dang mchod pa'i yo byad lha'i me tog kha dog sna tshogs pa kha ba bu yug 'tshub pa ltar babs pas rdo rje me tog gi mchod pa dang /

lha rdzas kyi spos kyi ngad pa dri zhim pos phyogs kun du khyab pa rdo rje spos kyi mchod pa dang / nyin mo nyi ma'i dkyil 'khor gzhan pas bkrag mdangs bzang zhing / mtshan mo zla ba'i dkyil 'khor gsal la tsher ba'i snang bas mun pa'i go skabs bcom ste/ yang dag pa'i ye shes kyi snang ba rgyas pa'i rgyur gyur pa rdo rje snang gsal gyi mchod pa dang / char gyi rgyun babs pa rnams la ha ri tsandan dang / gur gum dang / utpa la sogs pa'i dri bzang dang ldan pas khams rab tu dwangs par byed pa'i rdo rje dri chab kyi mchod pa dang / gsol ba 'debs pa'i bsam gtan pa dad shugs can 'ga' zhig la ting nge 'dzin skye ba'i rgyur ro dro ba'i mchog dang ldan pa rdo rje zhal zas kyi mchod pa dang / lha rdzas kyi rol mo'i sgra yid du 'ong ba dad ldan rnams kyi rna bar lhung ba na mos dge bla na med pa skye ba'i rgyur gyur pa rdo rje sil snyan gyi mchod pa sogs mi las 'das pa'i lha rdzas kyi mchod pa dpag tu med 'dir rtsa ba'i ma dpe las rgyab shog shog lhe chad 'dug pa'i dgongs 'jag 'tshal/ can/ kun mkhyen chos kyi rgyal po'i rgyal tshab dam pa chos rje 'jam pa'i dbyangs kun dga' chos bzang gi mtshan can/ rje nyid kyi bstan pa ches cher gsal bar mdzad pa/ thub bstan rnam par rgyal ba dang / thub bstan yangs pa can gyi chos rje rnam gnyis la sogs pa dbus gtsang mnga' ris lho byang gsum gyi chos sde so so'i mkhan po/ grwa tshang dang dgon so so'i bla ma slob dpon mdo khams su rje nyid kyi bstan pa spel bar mdzad pa chos kyi rje kun dga' zla ba/ chos rje rin chen shākya blo gros/ skyo mda'i chos rje gdan sa pa/ sma khams bstan pa gsal bar byed pa'i bka' bcu 'dzin pa chen po tshul khrims 'od zer la sogs pa chos sde so so'i bla ma slob dpon dang / gzhan yang gzhung lugs rab 'byams smra ba'i bstan 'dzin gyi skyes bu bgrangs ba las 'das shing /

bka' bcu 'dzin pa sogs skal ldan gyi gdul bya'i tshogs dpag tu med pa zhig bsdu ba'i dngos po bzhi'i sgo nas smin cing grol bar mdzad pa yin no/ /gnyis pa ni/ thog mar dpon sa mi'i dbang po sa skyong chen po nor bu bzang po sku mched dang / khyad par chos kyi rgyal po gtsang chen sku mched kyi zhabs kyi padmo dri ma med pa la gtugs te bka' lung gus pas tshul bzhin du bsgrub shing / gzhan yang glo bo rgyal po sogs chos kyi rgyal blon bsod nams chen 'dir rtsa ba'i ma dpe las rgyab shog shog lhe chad 'dug pa'i dgongs 'jag 'tshal/ 'chad la nga mkhas zhes/ /cher rloms mang yang kun gyi 'gran bral ba'i/ /bsod nams gter chen smra ba'i seṅge mchog /kun mkhyen chos kyi rgyal po'i zhabs la 'dud/ /ces mchod par brjod nas/ ༈ /spyi don drug pa gsang phu ba don grub legs bzang gi mdzad pa'i rnam thar las 'byung tshul bshad pa ni/ dpal gsang phu ne'u thog gi mkhas pa chen po don grub legs bzang gi mdzad pa las 'di ltar 'byung ste/ yi dam kun gyi snying po kyai rdo rje/ /grub thob kun gyi dbang phyug birwa pa/ /skal ldan kun gyi 'dren pa sa skya pa/ /brgyud par bcas la gus pas phyag 'tshal lo/ /rig gnas mnga' bdag rgyal ba rdo rje 'chang / /gang gi mtshan tsam thos dang dran pas kyang / /mchog dang thun mong dngos grub mchog stsol ba'i/ /kun mkhyen bla ma dam pa'i zhabs la 'dud/ /gang de'i mdzad pa sangs rgyas 'phrin las dang / /dbyer med bdag blos ma lus brjod dka' na/ /dad pa'i blo yi dam pa khyod nyid kyi/ /rnam dkar mdzad pa mdor bsdus brjod par bya/ /khyod sngon rang don chos sku mngon gyur kyang / /gzhan don mdzad pas skal ldan smin pa'i phyir/ /rdo rje 'chang chen grags pa'i mtshan can sogs/ /sna tshogs sprul pas 'gro don mdzad la 'dud/ /slar yang rdo rje 'dzin pa 'di nyid kyi/

/mi mjed zhing gi mchog gyur 'bom gyi sar/ /snyigs dus rgyal ba gnyis pa zhang skyabs bltas/ /rgyal ba dman gyi lhums su zhugs pa'i tshe/ /ma lus bde bas khyab par mdzad la 'dud/ /sa mo bya la khyod sku bltams pa'i tshe/ /zas gtsang sras po bltams pa'i ltas bzang ltar/ /bstan la rab dga' lha yi glu gar sogs/ /ngo mtshar dpag med ston par mdzad la 'dud/ /de nas bzung ste khyod sngon goms pa'i mthus/ /byis pa'i spyod spangs dam pa'i ngang tshul can/ /klog bris la sogs sbyangs tshul bstan pa na/ /dgung brgyad pa la mthar phyin mdzad la 'dud/ /bcu phrag gcig tshe kun dga' 'bum pa la/ /yongs rdzogs dge bsnyen sdom pa nos pa nas/ /byams pa'i chos sogs bka' chen bcu bzhi yi/ /tshig don thugs su chud par mdzad la 'dud/ /bcu gnyis bzhes tshe dges pa rdo rje yis/ /dkyil 'khor chen por smin byed gsan pa dang / /lha mchog 'jam dbyangs bsgrub pa mdzad pa'i tshe/ /grub pa'i mtshan ma gzigs par mdzad la 'dud/ /dbus gtsang dag par 'byon pa dgongs pa na/ /nags khrod dben par grub chen brgyad cu yi/ /rnam thar bstod pa zhal 'don mdzad gyur pa/ /de tshe cung zad mnal ba'i mtshan lam du/ /shub bcas ral gri shin tu ring ba snang / /e ma 'di 'dra'i ral gri ngo mtshar can/ /brkyang na dbus gtsang bar du khyab par 'dug /snyam du dgongs te gyen du gzengs pa'i tshe/ /g.yas g.yon dar thag rtse la nyi zla gnyis/ /shar bas 'od kyi 'jig rten khyab gyur pa/ /khyod kyi mdo sngags bstan pas 'jig rten kun/ /khyab pa'i mtshan ma bstan par mdzad la 'dud/ /bcu dgu bzhes tshe go ram chen mo'i drung / /dbus gtsang 'byon par zhus tshe de nyid kyi/ /thub dbang shākya rgyal mtshan zhabs drung du/ /'bul zhes gnang ba thob pa mdzad la 'dud/ /de tshe de yi khyung dkar mdzo brgya dang / /yung dmar ja brgya rten bcas zhu 'phrin gnang / /go ram bsod nams seṅger mtshan gsol nas/

/rong ston zhabs drung phebs par mdzad la 'dud/ /de la zab don mang thos khyad par yang / /gtum po dkar po'i rjes su gnang ba'i tshe/ /lha mchog de nyid khyod kyi dbu gtsug la/ /dngos su thim sogs lung bstan mdzad la 'dud/ /gtsang gi rong chung bse ru brag khung gi /brag lam chad nas g.yas ru gtsang po yi/ /rba dkyil lhung kyang skyon med brag steng du/ /bla ma mkha' 'gros spyan drangs mdzad la 'dud/ /kun mkhyen gnyis pa sangs rgyas 'phel ba'i drung / /theg gsum sde snod dgongs 'grel dang bcas pa/ /lo bdun bar du gsan sbyongs tshul bstan pas/ /thos pa rgya mtsho'i mnga' bdag gyur la 'dud/ /nyer lnga bzhes tshe e waṃ chos ldan du/ /rdo rje 'chang dngos kun dga' bzang po la/ /rgyud bzhi dgongs 'grel dang bcas legs gsan te/ /gsang sngags thos pa'i mchog gyur de la 'dud/ /khyad par gsung ngag gdams pa gsan pa'i che/ /yi dam lha dang bla ma dam pa yis/ /ma 'ongs 'jam dpal rdo rje'i srol 'byed du/ /lung bstan dngos grub thob par mdzad la 'dud/ /dgung lo bcu phrag gnyis dang bdun pa'i tshe/ /thams cad mkhyen pa kun dga' bzang po dang / /sems dpa' chen po dkon mchog rgyal mtshan gyi/ /mkhan slob kha skong dang bcas dge 'dun las/ /nyes med phun tshogs bsnyen par rdzogs la 'dud/ /sems dpa' chen po dkon mchog rgyal mtshan drung / /gsung ngag lam 'bras gzhung bshad gsan pa'i tshe/ /sku yi bkod pa gnyis bstan khyod nyid kyi/ /mi mthun skyen rnams gsal bar mdzad la 'dud/ /bcu phrag gsum tshe sems dpa' chen po la/ /khams la 'gro zhes gnang ba zhus pa'i tshe/ /snyigs dus bstan pa'i bdag por khyod 'gyur bas/ /bzhugs zhes lung bstan gsal bar mdzad la 'dud/ /slar yang 'bras yul bla ma'i gnas chen du/ /thos bsam gtso bor cung zad bshad pa'i tshe/ /tsha ba cher rgyas sku khams snyung dus su/ /zab lam bsgom pas grol bar mdzad la 'dud/

/de tshe 'khor 'das dbyer med thun bzhi ru/ /bsgom pa'i mod las srid zhi mnyam pa nyid/ /thugs la 'khrungs pas gdon gyi smra bskyod sogs/ /mi mthun phyogs las rgyal bar mdzad la 'dud/ /de yi rgyun la dges pa rdo rje yi/ /dus kyi bsnyen pa zla ba drug mdzad pas/ /yi dam lha dang mkha' 'gro chos skyong gi /lung bstan dngos grub brnyes par mdzad la 'dud/ /dus der grwa mang rgya nad theb pa'i tshe/ /nyid kyi gsang chab ljags mdud tsam gyis kyang / /nad zhi gdon rnams skrag par mdzad pa yis/ /mthu stobs dbang phyug grags par gyur la 'dud/ /bstan pa'i bdag po kun mkhyen bla ma des/ /mkhas pa bstan gsal sde bdun mdo la mkhas/ /rtse thang rab 'byams mngon pa la mkhas shing / /go bo rab 'byams sdom gsum la mkhas zhes/ /mkhas mang dbus su bsngags pa mdzad la 'dud/ /de tshe mkhas pa sangs rgyas lhun grub kyi/ /sems dang sems byung rdzas gzhan khas blangs shing / /deng sang dus na nga min mkhas pa su/ /zhes sogs bla ma'ang khyad sod mdzad dus su/ /dngos stobs rigs pa sprin phung rab bsdus nas/ /thal 'gyur theg chen char ltar rab phab ste/ /pha rol log rtog thal bar brlag rjes su/ /bkas bcad nga ro 'brug ltar sgrogs la 'dud/ /de tshe khyod la kun mkhyen bla ma des/ /sgrog gleng song zhes mkhas pa'i mdun sa ru/ /rab bsngags 'dus pa kun gyi yid 'phrog pa'i/ /mtshungs med mkhas pa'i gtsug rgyan gyur la 'dud/ /kun mkhyen bla ma de nyid mus chen drung / /gsung ngag lam 'bras gsan ring 'bras yul du/ /mkhan tshab dam par bskos nas lung rig nyid/ /bshad pas bstan pa gsal bar mdzad la 'dud/ /byang phyogs ngam ring chos grwa chen po ru/ /lung rig smra ba brgya phrag lnga tsam la/ /rdo rje gur dang ngan song sbyong rgyud sogs/ /bshad pas 'khrul zad mkhas par grags la 'dud/ /bcu phrag gsum dang dgung brgyad bzhes pa'i tshe/

/bstan dang snyigs dus 'gro la rab dgongs nas/ /bshad grwa gaṅga'i chu bo lta bu'i rgyun/ /dam pa'i bka' bzhin 'dzugs par mdzad la 'dud/ /de tshe gzhan gyi grub mtha' smra ba po/ /lha dang bcas pa yid ma bder gyur nas/ /mthu gtad ngan sngags sna tshogs thebs btsal bas/ /mi rdzi phyogs las rnam rgyal khyod la 'dud/ /gang zag dam pa byams chen sku skye yi/ /khyod kyi 'phrin las gur gyi mgon po yi/ /bsgrub pa'i mtshan ma mthong ba ji lta bar/ /rnam dkar srid gsum khyab par mdzad la 'dud/ /de nas thub bstan rnam rgyal chos grwa cher/ /mdo sngags 'chad rtsod rtsom pa'i char chen las/ /gdul bya'i lo thog smin pa'i mdzad pa yi/ /kun mkhyen bsod nams seṅger grags la 'dud/ /dgung lo bcu phrag lnga dang gcig bzhes tshe/ /sa skyar rten mjal smon lam mdzad pa'i dus/ /mgon po'i rten gyi dam pa khyod nyid la/ /gus 'dud mdzad par grags par khyod la 'dud/ /de dus chos skyong 'di rnams tshogs 'khor dang / /dbyangs la dgyes pa 'dug pas zhes gsungs nas/ /tshogs mchod rgyas par phul nas rnam dkar gyi/ /'phrin las rgyas pa'i bka' bsgo mdzad la 'dud/ /bcu phrag lnga dang dgung gsum bzhes pa'i tshe/ /e waṃ gdan sar gsol btab mtshan lam du/ /rgya gar paṇa chen bzhi yi phyogs bzhi nas/ /tshig bzhi'i mngon par bstod pa khyod la 'dud/ /de nas bla ma dam pas lung bstan bzhin/ /e waṃ gdan sar lo lnga bar du ni/ /dbang lung man ngag rgyud gzhung legs bshad pas/ /gsang sngags bstan pa gsal bar mdzad la 'dud/ /de tshe rgyu dus dbang bskur cig gi skabs/ /cung zad bsnyel te yud tsam mnal ba na/ /rje btsun grags pas bum chu dbur blug nas/ /rigs kyi bu khyod brtson 'grus rtsoms zhes gsungs/ /slar yang thub bstan rnam rgyal chos grwa der/ /rim gnyis zab mo'i ngang las ma g.yos par/ /'chad rtsod rtsom pa'i bya bas dus 'da' ba'i/

/bstan pa'i rtsa lag dam pa de la 'dud/ /de ltar bshad pa'i chos grwa'i skabs dag tu/ /da lta'i lus 'di rgas shing gog 'dug pas/ /bde ba can du 'od dpag med pa'i drung / /padma'i sbubs su skye zhes gsungs la 'dud/ /ma 'ongs sku yi skye ba'ang 'byung srid de/ /yang na blo gsal gzhon nu me stag 'dra/ /cig tu skyes nas slar yang sangs rgyas kyi/ /bstan pa gsal bar mdzad zhes gsungs la 'dud/ /gzhan yang bdag gi thos pa'i dus cig na/ /da ni kho bo sa skyar smon lam tsam/ /ma gtogs bya ba lhag ma gzhan med pas/ /khyed dang gad mo bya long med ces gsungs/ /khro phu'i dga' ldan gnas su mi pham mgon/ /bstod pas mnal lam dag tu mgon po des/ /'bras bu'i rnam gzhag ma tshang tshang na ni/ /bstod pa legs zhes dges pa de la 'dud/ /sems dpa' che la mgon po lha brgyad kya/ི /rjes gnang zhus tshe bsrung ma rgya mtsho rnams/ /dam gzhag bzhin du dam pa khyod nyid kyi/ /zhi drag bka' lung gus pas len la 'dud/ /gzhan yang shangs su gal spyang mched gsum dang / /shab tu g.yu 'bar tsha gsum dam btags pas/ /khyod kyi mtshan mchog thos pas mi ma yin/ /ma lus skrag par mdzad pa de la 'dud/ /mdor na 'chad rtsod rtsom pa'i 'od zer gyi/ /thub bstan pad tshal phyogs mthar rab rgyas shing / /pha rol lta ngan ku mud zum mdzad pa'i/ /kun mkhyen bstan pa'i nyi ma de la 'dud/ /'chad pas gdul bya mchog tu gyur pa yang / /gangs can mkhas pa'i gtsug rgyan mchog rnams dang / /mi dbang sa bdag don grub rdo rje sogs/ /'jig rten che dgu'i bla mar gyur la 'dud/ /sa skya'i 'jam dbyangs gdung brgyud mched gnyis dang / /e waṃ bla ma'i rgyal tshab dkon mchog 'phel/ /gnas lnga rig pa'i paṇa chen kong po ste/ /'jam dbyangs bla ma'i bla mar gyur la 'dud/ /gsang phu'i rgyal tshab 'jam dbyangs kun dga'i mtshan/ /rgyal tshab dam pa rgyal ba 'od zer dang /

/rong ston rgyal tshab buddha'i mtshan can sogs/ /khyod kyi zhabs rdul spyi bos len la 'dud/ /btsun pa bsod rgyal kun mkhyen mus pa dang / /rdo rje 'chang dngos mgon po dbang phyug dang / /mdo khams shāka blo mnga' ris mgon seng sogs/ /grags pa mkhas pa'i bla mar gyur la 'dud/ /rtsom pa'i tshul la ngo mtshar gsum ldan dang / /'dul ba snying po mdo rtsa'i bsdus don dang / /rnam 'grol spyi ṭīka che chung gnyis gnyis te/ /nyan thos lugs kyi shing rta'i srol 'byed yin/ /phar phyin dka' 'grel spyi don che chung gnyis/ /sbyor ṭīka zur skol yongs rdzogs dbu ma yis/ /stong thun rtsa ṭīka dka' 'grel grub mtha' 'byed/ /theg chen pha rol phyin pa'i srol 'byed yin/ /sdom gsum spyi ṭīka kha skong dris lan dang / /bdud rtsi snying po sbyong rgyud ṭīkka dang / /kun rig rtsod spong zhi ba'i sbyin bsreg dang / /gur dang gsang 'dus mngon dkyil gnyis gnyis dang / /'jam rdor rnam bshad gsang 'dus rtsod spong dang / /'jigs byed mngon dkyil bde mchog chos 'byung dang / /rnam bshad lū nag mngon rtogs rigs rim bzhi yin snyam lnga'i khrid/ /sambu ṭi'i bsdus don dogs dpyod do/ /dbang chu chen mo kyai rdor rnam bshad dang / /lam 'bras chos 'byung snang gsum a seng 'grel/ /kyai rdor lus dkyil rtsod spong lam dus dbang / /bdag med mngon rtogs rab gnas cho ga'o/ /sgrub thabs mdor byas rtags 'jug ṭīkka dang / /mus srad dris lan la sogs dris lan bcu/ /smon lam bcu 'grel maṇḍal mchod chog dang / /mus chen bla ma'i rnam thar zhen bral khrid/ /gzhan yang bla ma lha dang mkha' 'gro la/ /bstan dang 'gro la brtse bas nyer dgongs nas/ /bstod tshogs bsam mi khyab pa mdzad pa yis/ /kun mkhyen ngag dbang dbang phyug de la 'dud/ /bcu phrag drug tshe dpal ldan sa skya ru/ /khams gsum 'gro bas sku gsum thob bya'i phyir/

/sgo gsum longs spyod dus gsum dge ba rnams/ /'khor gsum mi dmigs sbyin dang bsngo ba mdzad/ /de tshe gzhan don la gshegs dgongs gyur nas/ /ma 'ongs rgyal tshab paṇa chen kong po la/ /mgon po'i drung du bka' bsgo mdzad gyur pa/ /kun mkhyen dus gsum mkhyen pa de la 'dud/ /dus der sgo rum dkon gnyer la sogs kyi/ /sku rim drag po dgos zhes zhus pa'i tshe/ /da ni sku rim ji tsam byas na yang / /kho bo thub pa med ces gsungs la 'dud/ /re gcig bzhes tshe sa mo bya lo yi/ /rta zla'i tshes bcu chos dbar 'degs pa'i tshe/ /da ni bsam pa thams cad yongs rdzogs pas/ /dgon par myur du myur du 'gro zhes gsungs/ /de tshe yon bdag bo dong bsod rgyal gyi/ /sngon mo rdzong du chos dbar bzhugs dgos zer/ /nan gyi zhus pas de ka byas pas chog /de ru skabs su babs pa yin zhes gsungs/ /sngon mo rdzong du phebs tshe gzim khang gi /mthong khar rlung bu'i sgra gcig byung pa'i tshe/ /da ni shugs thon zer ba'i brdar 'dug na'ang / /'di ru bsdod pa'i khas len tshar zhes gsungs/ /de nas bzung ste tshes grangs bco brgyad bar/ /bshad pa rgya cher mdzad cing skabs dag tu/ /sngon gyi byung tshul ma 'ongs grwa tshang sogs/ /phyag mdzub gsum gyi dpe byas 'dis 'dzin gsungs/ /skabs su mdun gyi nam mkhar spyan gzigs nas/ /da ni skad cha myur du 'ong pa 'dug /nan zhus byas pa'i gdul bya 'ga' zhig la/ /zab lam bla ma'i sngon 'gro gnang ba'i tshe/ /sngon 'gro gnang nas sa paṇa gshegs pa ltar/ /dngos gzhi nga la byed long med do gsungs/ /rta so ba sogs yang yang 'ong ba 'di/ /grwa pa khyed kyi mthong gin 'dug ge gsungs/ /bcu dgu'i nyin bar slar yang 'khor tshogs la/ /chos thun bslab bya rgyas par mdzad pa'i skabs/ /khro mda' nang sos phyag dbang zhus pa'i tshe/ /legs so phyi ma mjal bar bgyid ces gsungs/ /bcu dgu'i phyi dro ser ma la rten nas/

/snyung tshul bstan pa dbu la gzer lang nas/ /bde ba can du padma'i sbug dag tu/ /zil pa khrom me brdzus te skye zhes gsungs/ /nyi shu'i snga dro sku drung mi rnams la/ /spyan gyis gzigs nas khyed rnams 'dir bsdod mod/ /kho bo bde ba can du 'gro zhes gsungs/ /de tshe sku yi bkod pa gsum bstan pa/ /gnyis ni sa skyar gdul bya dag pa yi/ /dngos su mthong zhes dad ldan kun la grags/ /gzhan yang gdul bya dag pa 'ga' zhig gi /sku yi sprul pa du ma mthong bar grags/ /nyer cig snga dro thugs dam gzhan grol nas/ /lam dus rgyas pa rdzogs rim dang bcas pa/ /bsgom nas dkyil 'khor bsdus pa'i skad cig la/ /chos kyi dbyings su bzhugs par gyur la 'dud/ /de tshe sku yi dkyil 'khor rab rgyas nas/ /yid 'phrog gzhon sha dmar ser mdangs ldan zhing / /zhal mdangs 'od zer du ma 'phro ba yi/ /blta bas mi ngom sku la phyag 'tshal lo/ /nyer gcig dgong mo thugs dam grol ba'i rtags/ /shangs bug gnyis nas byang sems dkar po'i rgyun/ /mang bar babs nas lung bstan mdzad pa bzhin/ /bde ba can du gshegs par mdzad la 'dud/ /de nas zhag grangs bzhi bcu rtsa dgu'i bar/ /nam mkhar 'ja' 'od kha dog sna lnga dang / /bstan la rab dga'i lha yi tshogs rnams kyi/ /me tog char chen 'bebs par mdzad la 'dud/ /nyer bzhi'i nyin bar sku gdung spyan drangs tshe/ /mahā kā las dbyar chab gtsang po'i steng / /rnam 'phrul gaṇḍi'i steng la spyan drangs par/ /skal ldan 'ga' yi mthong bar grags la 'dud/ /nyer lnga'i nyin bar thub bstan rnam rgyal du/ /sku gdung bzhu la 'bul bar brtsams pa na/ /ma 'ongs rten 'brel sgrig phyir mkha' 'gro yi/ /cho 'phrul sna tshogs ston par mdzad la 'dud/ /de yang dpal ldan mahā kā la'i sku/ /dngos su shar phyogs mda' gang tsam 'phags pa/ /sku gdung ril bur bzhugs par brtsams pa'i tshe/ /rang bzhin gnas su bzhugs par mdzad la 'dud/

/de nas de'i sku'i dkyil 'khor mchog /dpal ldan kyai rdo rje'i dkyil 'khor du/ /bsgrub cing phyi nang gsang bas mchod pa yi/ /zla brgyad bar du mchod par mdzad la 'dud/ /khrum zla'i nyer gcig sku gdung bzhugs phul tshe/ /nam mkhar 'ja' 'od rnam pa sna tshogs dang / /bstan la rab dga'i lha yi tshogs rnams kyi/ /me tog char chen 'bebs par mdzad la 'dud/ /nyer lnga'i nyin bar gdung khang phye ba'i tshe/ /dbu thod ril por dbus dang phyogs bzhi po/ /kha dog sna lnga rigs lnga'i rang bzhin du/ /sku yi rten du sprul par mdzad la 'dud/ /dbu thod ril po de yi ltag khung ngos/ /kha dog sna lnga'i ring bsrel bgrangs yas dang / /gzhan yang ring bsrel la sogs spur rtags mchog /gdul bya'i blo dang 'tshams par byon la 'dud/ /dbu thod yid bzhin nor bu sku yi rten/ /bstan pa'i gtso bo'i thugs khar bzhugs gsol ba/ /snyigs dus skal ldan gdul bya'i tshogs rnams la/ /dpal 'byor 'dod dgu 'byon par mdzad la 'dud/ /yi dam mkha' 'gro dngos su gzigs pa dang / /skal ldan lung bstan mkha' 'gros bskul ba sogs/ /gsang ba'i rnam thar bsam gyi mi khyab mod/ /phyogs 'dzin bskur dogs re zhig 'dir ma bris/ /zhes 'byung ngo / /kun mkhyen bsod nams seṅge'i rnam par thar pa dad pa rgya mtsho'i rlabs phreng rnam par g.yo ba zhes bya ba las/ gsang phu ba don grub legs bzang gi mdzad pa'i rnam thar las 'byung tshul rnams bshad pa'i skabs ste drug pa'o// ༈ //gzugs sku bsdu tshe brtse chen bla ma bzhin/ /skal ldan 'ga' la sku yi bkod pa'i tshogs/ /du ma bstan nas bde ba can du gshegs/ /kun mkhyen chos kyi rgyal po'i zhabs la 'dud/ /ces mchod par brjod nas/ spyi don bdun pa bya btang kun dga' mchog ldan gyi mdzad pa'i rnam thar bstod tshig byin rlabs kyi 'dod 'jo dad pa bskyed byed ces bya ba las 'byung tshul bshad pa ni/

'bring mtshams kyi btsun pa ri pa kun dga' mchog ldan gyi mdzad pa las 'di ltar 'byung ste/ khyod sngon byang chub dam pa brnyes kyang / /snyigs dus bdag sogs gdul bya'i don phyir/ /mkhas btsun bzang gsum ldan pa'i dge slong / /ngur smrig 'dzin pa'i skur bstan phyag 'tshal/ /khyod nyid mdo khams 'bom gyi sa char/ /yab nyid zhang skyabs rgyal ba dman gyi/ /lhums su 'jug tshe yum la bzang po'i/ /ltas bzang ston par mdzad la phyag 'tshal/ /sa mo bya la khyod sku bltams tshe/ /ngo mtshar ltas ston gom pa'i dbang gi /klog yig la sogs brda tsam bstan pa'i/ /mkhyen tshul ston par mdzad la phyag 'tshal/ /dgung lo lnga drug bzhes pa'i dus na/ /bzang spyod smon lam gzigs par gyur pas/ /dad dang nges 'byung snying rje 'khrungs te/ /spyan chab chu rgyun 'bebs la phyag 'tshal/ /dgu brgyad bzhes tshe kun dga' 'bum las/ /yongs rdzogs dge bsnyen sdom pa nod de/ /rnam dag khrims ldan gsung rab rgya mtsho'i/ /tshogs la thos bsam mdzad la phyag 'tshal/ /de tshe byams chos lnga sogs gzhung lugs/ /chen po bcu bzhi rong ṭīka yongs rdzogs/ /g.yag ṭīka chen mo'i mkhyen gsum yan chad/ /thugs las gsungs par mdzad la phyag 'tshal/ /de nas 'jam dbyangs bsnyen pa mdzad pas/ /yi dam lha yi rjes su bzung ba'i/ /mtshan ma mthong sogs yon tan du ma/ /brnyes par mdzad pa khyod la phyag 'tshal/ /bcu gsum bzhes tshe kyai rdo rje'i/ /dkyil 'khor chen por dbang bzhi gsan nas/ /rdo rje 'dzin pa'i mchog tu gyur te/ /dam pa du mas bstod la phyag 'tshal/ /bla ma dam pas shes rab dpal bas/ ma 'ongs 'phrin las/ /'di ltar 'byung zhes lung bstan byung nas/ /bcu dgu bzhes tshe dbus gtsang phebs te/ /mkhas grub du ma bsten la phyag 'tshal/ /na lend+rar3lt;!TCC Tibetan character 4,100 undefined in unicode!>/thub dbang rong ston chos rje nyid la/ /gtum po dkar po'i rjes gnang la sogs/

/zab don gsung rab mang du gsan te/ /ngo mtshar lung bstan thob la phyag 'tshal/ /nyer lnga bzhes tshe e waṃ dgon par/ /'jam dbyangs kun dga' bzang po'i drung du/ lo gsum gyi bar du bzhugs nas/ /rgyud sde bzhi sogs dam chos bgrangs yas/ /lan grangs du mar gsan la phyag 'tshal/ /khyad par dbang dang gdams ngag gsan tshe/ /bla ma yi dam mkha' 'gro dngos dang / /mnal lam dag tu lung bstan dngos grub/ /du ma gnang ba khyed la phyag 'tshal/ /nyer bdun bzhes tshe kun dga' bzang pos/ /mkhan po mus chen kha 'phyar sogs kyi/ /las slob gsang ston las gral mdzad nas/ /bsnyen rdzogs sdom pa nos la phyag 'tshal/ /gzhan yang dbu ma'i smon 'jug sems bskyed/ /la sogs theg chen dam chos du ma/ /gsan de rang don yal bar dor nas/ /gzhan don 'ba' zhig bsgrub la phyag 'tshal/ /sems dpa' dkon mchog rgyal mtshan drung du/ /lam 'bras gzhung bshad gsan pa'i dus na/ /sku yi bkod pa gnyis su bstan nas/ /khyod kyi mi mthun bsal la phyag 'tshal/ /rong chung sbug du brag lam zhig ste/ /mi zad g.yang 'dril g.yas ru gtsang po'i/ /rba dkyil lhung tshe sa paṇa bsgom nas/ chos rgyal ma nyer bzhi bton te/ /gsol ba 'debs par mdzad la phyag 'tshal/ /de yi mod la brag dang chu yi/ /nam yang sku la gnod pa med par/ /chu kha'i brag steng phebs par mdzad sogs/ /ngo mtshar rdzu 'phrul ston la phyag 'tshal/ /dam pa'i chos byed gang zag rnams dang / /de yi bzhugs gnas dgon pa sogs la/ /dngos sam lkog tu phyag 'tshal du ma/ /dad pa drag pos mdzad la phyag 'tshal/ /yongs 'dzin bcu phrag gcig dang brgyad la/ /dam chos rgya mtsho'i tshogs rnams gsan pas/ /mdo sngags rgya mtsho'i pha rol son te/ /mkhas mang gtsug rgyan gyur la phyag 'tshal/ /so gcig bzhes tshe khams la 'byon dgongs/ /mus chen bla mas dbus gtsang bzhugs nas/ /snyigs dus 'gro ba'i skyabs mgon mdzod sogs/

/lung bstan du ma mdzad la phyag 'tshal/ /so gsum dus na sku khams cung zad/ /ma snyoms dus na 'khor 'das dbyer med/ /thun bzhir bcad nas thugs dam rtsal 'don/ /zhag grangs kha yar mdzad la phyag 'tshal/ /de tshe gdon gyi cho 'phrul sna tshogs/ /byung nas thugs rje dpag med 'khrungs te/ /sku lus sbyin gtong dmigs pa mdzad de/ /srid zhi mnyam nyid rtogs la phyag 'tshal/ /de dus zhag grangs nyer gcig bar du/ /ting 'dzin de yi rgyun nyid bskyangs te/ /de nas yi dam dges pa rdo rje'i/ /bsnyen pa zla drug mdzad la phyag 'tshal/ /sku 'tshams ring la lha dang mkha' 'gro'i/ /lung bstan byin rlabs dngos grub gnang ba'i/ /mtshan lam byung zhing nyams rtogs du mas/ /thugs rgyud bltams par mdzad la phyag 'tshal/ /rdzong dkar grwa tshang rgya nad zhugs tshe/ /khyod kyi gsang chab ljags mdud tsam gyi/ /nad zhi gdon rnams skrag par mdzad pa'i/ /byin rlabs rdzu 'phrul bstan la phyag 'tshal/ /de tshe mnal lam dag tu rje btsun/ /mus chen byon nas khyod kyi sems can/ /du ma nyid la phan thogs byas zhes/ /legs so sbyin pa khyod la phyag 'tshal/ /gang zag dam pa byams chen sku skye'i/ /khyod nyid rje btsun grags pa'i sprul par/ /mnal lam dag tu gsal bar gzigs te/ /mkhas pa'i mdun du bstod la phyag 'tshal/ /de nas dam pa de yi khyod la/ /bshad nyan mdzad pa'i bdag rkyen gang dgos/ /byed pas chos kyi 'khor lo bskor zhes/ /gsol ba drag tu btab la phyag 'tshal/ /ngam ring gnas su bla ma'i bka' bzhin/ /lung rigs smra ba lnga brgya tsam la/ /gur dang sdom gsum la sogs bshad pas/ /'khrul zad mkhas par grags la phyag 'tshal/ /kun rig kyai rdor gsang 'dus rnams la/ /log smras bstan bcos rjes 'brangs dang bcas/ /yang dag lung dang dngos stobs rig pas/ /bcom nas ma nor lam ston phyag 'tshal/ /gser kha sding du bla ma'i bka' bzhin/ /zla gsum bar du bla ma rin 'byung /
