/nyid la thugs dam rtsal 'don mdzad pas/ /dngos grub du ma brnyes la phyag 'tshal/ /so brgyad bzhes tshe byams chen sku skyes/ /slar yang gsol btab bla ma dam pa'i/ /bka' nyid byung nas gtsang gi phyogs su/ /bya bral bshad nyan btsugs la phyag 'tshal/ /de tshe skyes chen mtshungs med dag gi /khyod kyi 'phrin las gur gyi mgon po/ /'khor bcas rnams kyi bsgrub pa gzigs nas/ /bshad nyan tshugs nges lung bstan phyag 'tshal/ /de nas lo ni nyer bzhi'i bar du/ /blo gsal grwa tshogs rgya mtsho'i dbus su/ /mdo phyogs bshad pa nyi ma re la/ /chos thun bcu tsam gsungs la phyag 'tshal/ /skal ldan gdul bya 'dus pa'i dbus su/ /gsung ngag lam 'bras nyer gnyis tsam dang / /rgyud bshad dbang lung khrid bka' la sogs/ /rgyun chad med par gsungs la phyag 'tshal/ /mdo dang sngags kyi zab don gnad rnams/ /phyin ci log bsgyur rgol ngan byung dus/ /yang dag lung dang dngos stobs rig pas/ /mi smra'i brtul zhugs bkod la phyag 'tshal/ /rtsom pa'i tshul yang mdo sngags dgongs 'grel/ /bsdebs legs don ldan yid 'phrog bstan bcos/ /'khrul med gsung rab bgrangs yas brtsams nas/ /thub bstan rgyas par mdzad la phyag 'tshal/ /dam pa khyod kyi zhabs rdul gangs can/ /che dgu'i spyi gtsug blangs te mchod cing / /rgyun par phyag phyir blo gsal grwa tshogs/ /bdun brgya brgyad brgyas bskor la phyag 'tshal/ /nga gcig bzhes tshe sa skyar phebs nas/ /der bzhugs rten dang dge 'dun rnams la/ /mchod pa bsnyen bkur rgya chen phul nas/ /smon lam grangs med mdzad la phyag 'tshal/ /de tshe kha'ur gtor bsgrub mdzad dus/ /mgon po'i rten gyi dam pa khyod la/ /gus 'dud mdzad pa dad pa can gyi/ /mngon sum mthong ba khyod la phyag 'tshal/ /nga gsum bzhes tshe lung bstan yod bzhin/ /e waṃ chos ldan lo lnga bzhugs nas/ /rgyud sde'i zab don 'khrul med 'chad pa'i/ /rnal 'byor dbang phyug khyod la phyag 'tshal/

/khro phu'i byams chen drung du lo ni/ /bcu bdun rta zla shar tshes bzhin du/ /mchod pa rgya cher phul te dpon slob/ /du mas smon lam mdzad la phyag 'tshal/ /bo dong e ru blo sbyong gsungs dang / /bya rgod gshong du bcu gcig zhal la/ /mjal du byon dus me tog char pa/ /kha ba ltar du babs la phyag 'tshal/ /e waṃ gdan sa mdzad pa'i dus su/ /rje btsun grags pa'i bum chu dbu gtsug /blug pas tshe gzungs rnam par gyur nas/ /sku lus la thim gzigs la phyag 'tshal/ /mdor na bla ma yid dam mkha' 'gros/ /dngos dang mnal lam dag tu the tshom/ /dra ba ma lus gcod par mdzad cing / /mngon shes du ma'ang gsungs la phyag 'tshal/ /nga brgyad bzhes tshe e waṃ khri thog /rgyal tshab dkon mchog 'phel ba bskos nas/ /snyigs dus 'gro ba'i skyabs mgon mdzod ces/ /bstan pa yongs rdzogs gtad la phyag 'tshal/ /de nas thub bstan rnam rgyal dgon par/ /phebs nas mtha' yas slob grwa'i tshogs la/ /rgya chen chos kyis 'khor lo bskor nas/ /gdul bya smin grol mdzad la phyag 'tshal/ /de tshe chos grwar rgas pas skyo bas/ /la mor bde ba can du phyin te/ /padmo'i dbus su gzhon nu'i lus len/ /skabs skabs dag tu gsungs la phyag 'tshal/ /drug cu bzhes pa sa sprel tha skar/ /e waṃ phebs nas rgyal tshab dam par/ /chos 'phro ma lus gnang bar mdzad sogs/ /ma 'ongs dus mkhyen khyod la phyag 'tshal/ /lo de'i smal zla'i tshes dgu'i nyin bar/ /sa skyar phebs nas der bzhugs rten la/ /mchod sprin rgya mtsho'i bgrangs yas phul nas/ /grangs med smon lam mdzad la phyag 'tshal/ /khyad par sa paṇa dus chen dus su/ /dge 'dun nyis stong skye bo'i tshogs la/ /gser sogs phyag rdzas dngos po phal cher/ /'gyed sogs sbyin gtong mdzad la phyag 'tshal/ /de tshe chos skyong 'di tsho dbyangs dang / /tshogs mchod dag la mnyes par 'dug pas/ /tshogs mchod la sogs rgya cher shoms zhes/

/gsungs nas de ltar mdzad la phyag 'tshal/ /gzhan yang lkog tu dbang bskur mdzad rjes/ /de ni dbang gi rjes ma yin gsungs/ /'bul ba'i dngos po gang byung thams cad/ /sde yi zhig gsos phul la phyag 'tshal/ /re gcig bzhes pa sa mo bya lo/ /rta zla'i tshes brgyad chos dbar bteg tshe/ /da ni bsam pa thams cad rdzogs pas/ /dgon par myur du 'byon gsungs phyag 'tshal/ /de tshe sbyin bdag grwa pa sogs kyi/ /sngon mo rdzong du phebs dgos zhus pas/ /khyed tsho cis kyang mi nyan 'dug pas/ /'dir bsdod dgos pa yin gsungs phyag 'tshal/ /de nas tshes bcu chos rim tshugs nas/ /bcu dgu'i bar du phar tshad la sogs/ /mdo phyogs gzhung lugs du ma nyid la/ /bshad pa rgya cher mdzad la phyag 'tshal/ /de tshe chos grwar sngon gyi byung tshul/ /bgros la rten nas ma 'ongs dus su/ /grwa tshang sogs su 'di ltar 'byung zhes/ /lung bstan gsal por gsungs la phyag 'tshal/ /bla ma gshegs tshul rnam thar bgros la/ /brten nas dus mchod la sogs sla phyir/ /kho bo nyi shu gcig la 'gro zhes/ /ngo mtshar du ma gsungs la phyag 'tshal/ /de dus 'ja' sprin sna tshogs dag dang / /me tog char sogs byung ba'i dus su/ /da ni skad cha myur du myur du/ /'ong bar 'dug go gsungs la phyag 'tshal/ /bar snang spyan gzigs grwa pa khyed tshos/ /mthong bar 'dug ge bltas mo blta na/ /rta so ba sogs ngo mtshar du ma/ /mang du 'dug go gsungs la phyag 'tshal/ /nan zhus phyir du lam zab bla ma/ /gsung tshe sa paṇa gzhan don gshegs bzhin/ /sngon 'gro kho bos byed mod dngos gzhi/ /byed long med do gsungs la phyag 'tshal/ /bcu dgu'i snga dro ser ma la brten/ /cung zad snyung ba'i tshul nyid bstan nas/ /dgong mo skyems dad che tsam ma gtogs/ /snyung med thugs dam mdzad la phyag 'tshal/ /nyi shu'i snga dro sku drung mi la/ /spyan gyi gzigs nas khyed rnams 'dir ni/ /bsdad rgyu yin mod kho bo bde ba/

/can du 'gro 'o gsungs la phyag 'tshal/ /nyi shu'i tsha rjes sku yi bkod pa/ /gsum du bstan pa'i gnyis ni sa skyar/ /gdul bya dag pa'i mngon sum mthong sogs/ /bsam yas rdzu 'phrul bstan la phyag 'tshal/ /nyer gcig snga dro thugs dam gzhan rnams/ /grol rjes kyai rdor lam dus rgyas pa/ /shin tu spro ba'i tshul gyi mdzad nas/ /rdzogs rim yun ring bsgom la phyag 'tshal/ /de nas bdag bskyed dkyil 'khor rim gyis/ /bsdus nas gzhan gyi bar ma chod par/ /skad cig de la sku yi bkod pa/ /chos kyi dbyings su thim la phyag 'tshal/ /de nas sku yi gzi mdangs rgyas te/ /yid 'phrog gzhon sha can du gyur nas/ /'od dang 'od zer du ma 'phro ba'i/ /blta bas mi ngom khyed la phyag 'tshal/ /nyer gcig dgong mo thugs dam grol rtags/ /shangs bug gnyis nas byang sems dkar po'i/ /rgyun nyid shin tu mang bar babs nas/ /bde ba can du gshegs la phyag 'tshal/ /nyer bzhi'i nam langs thub bstan dgon par/ /sku gdung phebs te mchod sprin rgya mtsho'i/ /dbus su zla brgyad bar du bzhugs nas/ /dad can bsod nams spel la phyag 'tshal/ /lo de nyid kyi khrum zla'i nyi shu/ /gcig la sku gdung zhugs la phul tshe/ /dbang po'i gzhu dang me tog char sogs/ /ngo mtshar du ma bstan la phyag 'tshal/ /dad ldan gdul bya'i dge tshogs spel phyir/ /dbu thod gas chag med par byon zhing / /dad ldan so so'i lag tu ring bsrel/ /du mar 'khrungs par mdzad la phyag 'tshal/ /mdor na khyod nyid bsod nams ye shes/ /mthar phyin shākya seṅge'i sprul pa/ /khyod la rtse gcig gsol ba 'debs kyis/ /da lta nyid du byin gyis rlobs shig /sgrib gnyis spangs shing tshogs gnyis rdzogs nas/ /rang gzhan don gnyis phun sum tshogs pa'i/ /kun mkhyen bsod nams seṅge khyod ltar/ /mir gyur zag med bde chen ngang ste/ /phan btags mar gyur 'gro drug sems can/ /rab 'jigs khams gsum 'khor bar gnas nas/

/bzod med sdug bsngal gsum gyi gdung la/ /kun mkhyen bla mas thugs rjes gzigs dang / /khyad par khyod lta'i mgon dang bral nas/ /mgon skyabs med pa'i blun rmongs sdig can/ /chos med kun dga' mchog ldan bdag la/ /myur 'gyogs thugs rjes gzigs shig bla ma/ /don med tshe 'di'i bya ba btang nas/ /'khor ba'i phun tshogs bsgrub blo med par/ /bdag pas gzhan gces byang sems skyes nas/ /brjod bral lta ba rtogs par stsol cig /khyad par gnyis phung blos chung spangs nas/ /gnas dang 'khor la nga bdag med par/ /dben gnas ri khrod phyogs med 'grims te/ /gang byung chog shes nor ldan stsol cig /dben pa'i gnas der dam pa khyod las/ /thob pa'i rim gnyis gdams pa la sogs/ /rang don 'phri med sems can don phyir/ /gcig tu nyams su len par stsol cig /de ltar rtse gcig bsgrub pa byed pa'i/ /'gal rkyen mi mthun bar chad mtha' dag /da lta nyid du zhi bar gyur nas/ /mthun rkyen 'bad med lhun grub stsol cig /de nas cir snang snang stong lha dang / /gang grag grag stong sngags kyi sgra dbyangs/ /gang shar sems kyi chos 'phrul bde stong / /zung 'jug 'char ba'i nyams rtogs stsol cig /rang gi brtan po zin par gyur nas/ /dam pa khyod ltar lus dang srog la/ /ltos pa med par zab mo'i dam chos/ /rgyun du 'gro la ston pa stsol cig /deng nas byang chub ma thob bar du/ /dam pa khyod kyi rjes su bzung nas/ /khyod gsungs dam chos rgyun gyi bskyangs te/ /rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas myur thob stsol cig /bstod pa 'di kun lan gcig tsam zhig /dad gus dga' spros bstod par byed la'ang / /mchog dang thun mong dngos grub stsal nas/ /dpal ldan bla mas byin gyis rlobs shig /de ltar bstod cing gsol ba'i dge bas/ /bdag dang mkha' mnyam sems can kun gyi/ /sgrib gnyis spangs shing tshogs gnyis rdzogs nas/ /myur du sangs rgyas thob par gyur cig

/ces pa de rnams kyi kun mkhyen bsod nams seṅge'i rnam par thar pa dad pa rgya mtsho'i rlabs phreng rnam par g.yo ba zhes bya ba las/ chos rje kun dga' mchog ldan gyi mdzad pa'i rnam thar las 'byung tshul bshad pa'i skabs ste bdun pa'o// //de ltar rnam pa kun mkhyen chos kyi rje'i/ /ngo mtshar rnam thar 'di brtsams dge ba yis/ /sa skya'i rje btsun dgongs don zab mo la/ /khyed ltar 'jigs med smra ba'i seṅger shog /dus ngan skye bo'i spyod pas yid dub bdag /bde gshegs bstan pa'i 'khur chen khyer ba la/ /dam can mkha' 'gro'i tshogs kyi nyer bskyangs te/ /sngar bzhin yid la re ba kun 'grub shog /mdor na bdag dang gdul byar bcas pa rnams/ /dus 'dir tshe ring nad med bstan pa rgyas/ /nam zhig tshe 'di'i snang ba nub ma thag /zhing mchog bde ba can du skye bar shog /phyi yi bla ma gang 'dul sna tshogs sku/ /nang gi bla ma rang sems gsal rig dngos/ /gsang ba'i bla ma lhan skyes ye shes che/ /gnas lugs ro gcig rtogs pa mthar phyin shog /skyes chen mchog gi ngo mtshar rnam thar 'di/ /rjes 'jug skal bzang rnams kyi legs bltos la/ /rang gzhan 'di phyi'i don rnams bsgrub 'dod pas/ /rnam thar tshul 'di'i rjes su 'jug par rigs/ /zhes kun mkhyen chos kyi rgyal po bsod nams seṅge zhes mtshan yongs su grags pa'i bstan pa'i nyi ma de nyid kyi rnam par thar pa phal che ba rnams phyogs cig tu bsdebs pa dad pa rgya mtsho'i rlabs phreng rnam par g.yo ba zhes bya ba 'di yang / 'jam mgon grub pa'i dpa' bo padma'i rnam sprul bsod nams dbang po dang byang chub sems dpa' zhi ba 'tsho'i rnam sprul rgyal sras sbas pa'i rnal 'byor sngags 'chang grags pa blo gros dang / dkyil 'khor rgya mtsho'i khyab bdag drug pa rdo rje 'chang chen po nyid gzhan ngor ngur smrig gi bla gos 'chang ba rgyal ba mus pa chen po rdo rje 'chang sangs rgyas rgyal mtshan rnams gtso bor smos pa'i yongs 'dzin dam pa chos bzhin du spyod pa du ma'i zhabs rdul spyi bos len pa/

dpal sa skya pa shākya'i dge bsnyen theg pa mchog gi rnal 'byor pa sngags 'chang ngag dbang kun dga' bsod nams grags pa rgyal mtshan dpal bzang pos/ kun mkhyen chos kyi rgyal po 'di nyid kyi gsung rab rnams la yun ring po nas 'dris par byas pas/ rdo rje 'chang gnyis pa rje btsun sa skya pa gong ma rnams kyi lta grub gtsang mar 'grel ba la mkhas pa gzhan gyi 'gran zla dang bral ba'i nges shes khyad par can brnyed nas dad pa'i spu long ches cher g.yos shing / gzhan yang kun mkhyen chos kyi rje 'di nyid kyi 'phel gdung bya btang rje'i phyag tu byung ba da lta gling dga' bde ba can gyi dgon pa na bzhugs pa la ring bsrel 'phel bzhin par/ bar skabs su rkyen 'ga' zhig gi 'grib pa la dus phyis nged rang gi gsol ba 'debs pa brtsams pa tsam gyi ring bsrel bcu gcig tsam 'phel ba sogs la rten nas/ slar yang dad pa'i dbang po rab tu rgyas te gsol ba 'debs pa'i tshigs su bcad pa zhig kyang brtsams shing / ngo mtshar ba'i rnam thar rnams kyang phyogs gcig tu bsdebs par 'dod pa'i 'dun pa snga mo nas yod kyang le lo'i dbang gis 'gyang pa la/ deng dus nye ba'i char kun mkhyen rin po che'i grub mtha'i srol 'dzin rnams kyi rgyan dam par gyur pa/ bstan pa rin po che'i 'khur gyi mi ngal zhing / mdo sngags rgya mtsho'i don la dbang 'byor pa'i bshes gnyen dam pa/ bod kyi rdo rje gdan dpal sa skya'i chos grwa chen po thub bstan lha chen gyi gdan sa bcu pa mkhan chen rin chen rgyal mtshan gyi bkas yang yang bskul ba'i rkyen byas nas/ shing mo glang gi lo gro bzhin gyi zla ba'i dkar po'i phyogs kyi tshes la dpal sa skya'i lha chen rigs 'dzin pho brang du sbyar ba'i yi ge pa ni gdan sa dan khrod pa nor bu lha sbyin gyis bgyis so/ /'di sbyar dge bas bdag cag dpon slob rnams/ /dus 'dir tshe ring nad med bsam don 'grub/

/bstan pa cher rgyas don gnyis mthar phyin nas/ /phyi ma thogs med bde ba can 'gror shog/ //sarba maṅga laṃ// // ༈ mkhan chen a pad rin po che'i dgongs bzhed ltar gu rus zhabs zhu bgyis pa'o// PAGE \* MERGEFORMAT 4 phyogs bsgrigs pa a myes zhabs/ kun mkhyen bsod nams seṅge'i rnam par thar sna tshogs/ PAGE \* MERGEFORMAT 159
